Main Menu
Personalised crash reports

A crash report is created when the game ends unexpectedly. Such a report helps Egosoft to diagnose the problem and fix it in a future update. Crash reports only include technical information for this purpose and cannot be used to identify you; unless you decide to provide contact information.\n\nFor details on the data that is included in a crash report, please visit the egosoft.com support forum.

By enabling this option, any crash reports sent to Egosoft will contain additional information helping us to get in contact with you. There's no need to enable this setting unless you've been asked to do so by the support team. If enabled, the additional information might help to trace the causes of crashes on your machine. This additional information will be used solely for the purpose of identifying and fixing the underlying cause of the crash.

page.title: Help Texts
page.t: Using smart defence from your ability menu \("$INPUT_STATE_DRONE_ABILITY_MENU$"\) launches defensive drones.
Leave a platform by returning through the Skunk's cockpit door.
Switch to your Plasma Cannon \("$INPUT_ACTION_CYCLE_NEXT_PRIMARY_WEAPON$"\). It is very effective against slow targets.
Out of missiles? Pressing "$INPUT_ACTION_CYCLE_NEXT_SECONDARY_WEAPON$" selects another type.
Dumbfire missiles like this fly forward in a straight line.
Torpedoes can be controlled and steered towards your target.
Swarm missiles like this split into multiple smaller missiles.
Auto-aiming missiles like this should be fired towards the selected target where possible.
Mine asteroids for resources using your Mining Laser.
Use Superhighways \(blue\) to travel between sectors.
Use Local Highways \(green\) to quickly travel within sectors.
Use Jump Gates to reach other systems.
Boarding capital ships requires a Marine Officer and a team of marines.
You can try to seize this ship. Target it and select 'Board' \("$INPUT_STATE_INTERACTION_MENU$"\).
Press $INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLE_FLIGHT_ASSIST$ to toggle flight assist off and on, allowing drift independent of ship orientation.
Select an object in space and press $INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLE_AUTOPILOT$ to autopilot to it.
Close the menu by pressing "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_QUIT$".
Close the menu by pressing "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_QUIT$".
Return to the previous menu with "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_BACK$".
Return to the previous menu with "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_BACK$".
You can open a comm-link with the selected ship by pressing "$INPUT_ACTION_COMM_ACTION$".
Open MAINMENU\(2-5\) to see your current missions.
Open MAINMENU\(3-2\) for details on the various weapons.
Open MAINMENU\(3-1-4\) to see the map of the current zone.
Press $INPUT_STATE_FP_JUMP$ to jump while on a platform.
Hold $INPUT_STATE_FP_CROUCH$ to crouch while on a platform.
Press "$INPUT_ACTION_QUICKSAVE$" to save your game.
You can ask for directions by targeting a ship and using the interact menu \("$INPUT_STATE_INTERACTION_MENU$"\).
You can ask for directions by targeting a ship and pressing $INPUT_ACTION_COMM_ACTION$.
Select a ship and click to open the interaction menu.
Select a ship and double-click to open the interaction menu.
You can interact with objects by double-clicking on them.
You can interact with ships by double-clicking on them.
Interact with icons on stations by double-clicking on them.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON$" to launch bombs that attach to surfaces.
You can trigger all bombs to explode simultaneously by pressing "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_SECONDARY_WEAPON$".
Attaching bombs to engines, weapon systems and shield generators is a very effective form of sabotage.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON$" to launch bombs that attach to surfaces.
You can trigger all bombs to explode simultaneously by pressing "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_SECONDARY_WEAPON$".
Approach an info point and select the drone hack option from the interact menu.
Avoid being scanned by police.
By hacking you can stop production, render weapons inoperable or make storage drop some of its cargo.
Approach an info point and choose drone scan from interact menu.
You need to be within 50m to scan.
You need to be close by to scan.
You need to be close by to hack.

Use "$INPUT_RANGE_THROTTLE$" to accelerate and "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON$" to fire.

Press "$INPUT_ACTION_STOP_REMOTE_CONTROL$" to leave the drone.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON$" to fire.
Visit a drone dealer and purchase one or more hacker drones.
Approach info points, "i" icons, to get more information on stations.
Collecting information about stations gets you discounts and commissions.
You can also find mission offers \(skull/suitcase icons\) to earn rewards.
You unlocked information on a station. Gathering information gets you discounts and commissions for trading.
Occasionally you may hit an unsecured node and collect information on multiple info points at once.
You unlocked a discount. Open the MAINMENU\(4\) to check your collected discounts.
You unlocked a commission. Open the MAINMENU\(4\) to check your collected commissions.
You found a mission offer. Click the nearby offer to get more information on the mission.
You unlocked a mission opportunity. Click on the Event Monitor for more information.
You unlocked a mission opportunity. Press "$INPUT_ACTION_EXECUTE_NOTIFICATION$" for more information and check the Event Monitor.
You unlocked a trade offer. Open the MAINMENU\(4\) for details.

Select a mission and press $INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLE_AUTOPILOT$ to auto-pilot to the mission location.
This menu shows missions made publicly available in the surrounding area.
Some missions are not published here, and you must find them near stations first.
Open the MAINMENU\(3-2\) to search for missions in the local area.
Press "$INPUT_ACTION_CYCLE_NEXT_PRIMARY_WEAPON$" to switch your weapon.
Use "RIGHT STICK" to steer and "LEFT STICK" to strafe.
Press "$INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLEMOUSESTEERING$" to enable/disable cursor steering. You will fly towards your mouse cursor.
This is your speed bar.
Use "$INPUT_RANGE_THROTTLE$" to accelerate and "$INPUT_STATE_FULLREVERSE$" to decelerate.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_ACCELERATE$" to accelerate and "$INPUT_STATE_DECELERATE$" to decelerate.
Hold "$INPUT_STATE_BOOST$" to start boosting and travel longer distances in a shorter time.
Hold "$INPUT_STATE_BOOST$" to start boosting and travel longer distances in a shorter time.
Boosting drains your shields. They will soon recharge.
The yellow guidance arrow shows you where you should fly.
Use highways to quickly travel through zones.
The objective bar shows how far away you are from your destination.
Boost towards the station.
Return to your ship and follow the guidance.
Target the marked icon and hold "$INPUT_ACTION_EXECUTE_NOTIFICATION$" to display the dock interaction. Select it and release to dock.
Double-click the marked icon and select "DOCK" to dock your ship at the station.
Open crates to find rewards.
You can leave the station by opening the MAINMENU with "$INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_MAIN_MENU$" and then selecting options 5-5.
...then selecting option 5-5 with "$INPUT_ACTION_EXECUTE_NOTIFICATION$" and the "LEFT STICK".
You can leave the station by opening the MAINMENU with "$INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_MAIN_MENU$" and then selecting \(5-5\).
These yellow icons are mission targets. Face objects to target them.
These yellow icons are mission targets. You can select them.
The yellow ring points towards the mission target, the white ring to the selected target.
This objective tells you what to do with the mission targets.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON$". Your weapon shoots towards the center of the screen.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON_AT_CURSOR$" to fire your weapon towards your mouse cursor.
When shooting for some time, the bar in the weapon panel shows you the heat build-up.
When overheated, the weapon needs to cool down before it can shoot again.
You can match speed of other ships using "$INPUT_RANGE_THROTTLE$".
You can match speed of other ships using "$INPUT_STATE_DECELERATE$" and "$INPUT_STATE_ACCELERATE$".
Once inside a slipstream, you can try to get behind even faster ships.
Leave the highway by pressing "$INPUT_STATE_FULLREVERSE$".
Leave the highway by pressing "$INPUT_ACTION_BACKSPACE$".
Try to get behind targets and stay there to be safe from enemy fire.
Evade enemy fire by using $INPUT_RANGE_STRAFE_UP_DOWN$ to strafe vertically and $INPUT_RANGE_STRAFE_LEFT_RIGHT$ to strafe horizontally.
Strafe using "$INPUT_STATE_STRAFE_UP$", "$INPUT_STATE_STRAFE_LEFT$", "$INPUT_STATE_STRAFE_DOWN$", "$INPUT_STATE_STRAFE_RIGHT$" to evade incoming fire.
The colour of the weapon panel shows you the state of your weapons. Orange means damaged, red means disabled.
Damaged weapons have reduced effectiveness.
Engineers can repair weapons for you.
Move very close to capital ships to be dragged along.
Find a suitable build location.
Stay close to friendly capital ships. Their turrets will help you.
Use correctional steering \(RIGHT STICK\) to stay inside a slipstream.
Use correctional steering \(arrow keys or mouse-steering\) to stay inside a slipstream.
Click the marked icon and select "DOCK" to dock your ship at the station.
Use $INPUT_RANGE_STEERING_PITCH$ to steer vertically and $INPUT_RANGE_STEERING_YAW$ to steer horizontally.
Steer to avoid traffic and the edges of the highways.
Colliding with or attacking ships in highways may force them to exit.
Check your freighter's status in MAINMENU\(2-2\).
Talk to people. Some can be hired, others unlock rewards.
Find a dock on your trade ship to dock at.
Call your captain with the MAINMENU\(5-2\) and tell him or her to "work here".
Target the trade ship and press "$INPUT_ACTION_EXECUTE_NOTIFICATION$" to add it to your squad.
Select the trade ship and select "Add to squad".
Ships in your squad will follow you.
You can launch missiles with "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_SECONDARY_WEAPON$".
Auto-aiming missiles fire towards the selected target.
Collect the crates which are dropped by some destroyed ships to get missiles and other valuables.
Press "$INPUT_ACTION_CYCLE_NEXT_SECONDARY_WEAPON$" to switch between missiles.
Open MAINMENU\(3-2\) for details on the various missiles.
Fly towards different dock locations on stations.
You can identify docks by the platform symbol above them.
Check the monitor to see if there is an Engineer on this dock.
Open the repair menu \(1\) to repair damage to your ship.
You can also hire an Engineer on your ship. He will handle emergency repairs.
Check the status and repair any damage to your ship.
Your ship has multiple drone slots, so it can be configured for different scenarios.
Open MAINMENU\(3-2\) for details on the various drones and their usage.
Open the ability menu by holding "$INPUT_STATE_DRONE_ABILITY_MENU$".
Launch a drone by highlighting it with "$INPUT_RANGE_MENUSCROLL_X$" and "$INPUT_RANGE_MENUSCROLL_Y$" and releasing "$INPUT_STATE_DRONE_ABILITY_MENU$".
Open the ability menu with "$INPUT_STATE_DRONE_ABILITY_MENU$".
Launch a drone by clicking it.
Launch a drone by highlighting it with "$INPUT_RANGE_MENUSCROLL_X$" and releasing "$INPUT_STATE_DRONE_ABILITY_MENU$".
You are near a trade offer. This offer has been added to your trade computer.
Scan info points to unlock trade discounts and commissions.
Trade offers for wares that the current ship can transport are selectable.
Select $WARE$ and press "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_TAB$" to set up a transaction.
Select $WARE$ and click "NEXT" to set up a transaction.
Press "LEFT/RIGHT" on the digipad to adjust quantity to 100 and press "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_TAB$" to place the order.
Use the sliders to adjust the quantity to 100, then click "OK" to place the order.
The trade ship will execute your order. This will take a while!
Try to make more profit by buying other wares, especially those on a discount.
When done, leave the menu by pressing "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_BACK$".
When done, leave the trade menu by pressing "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_BACK$".
Your trade ship has arrived in this zone. Open the MAINMENU\(2-2\), select the ship and press "Set Guidance" to set guidance to it.
Open the ability menu and launch a scanner drone.
Open the ability menu and launch a hacker drone.
Press "$INPUT_ACTION_WIDGET_TAB$" to confirm the order.
Click "OK" to confirm the order.
You can claim an unmanned ship by bringing a pilot.
Avoid notoriety changes for illegal activities by going further away from stations, where no police is watching.
Claim a ship by targeting it and using the interact menu.
Stations can be scanned in station scan mode MAINMENU\(1-1\).
Use this mode to see what parts of stations have already been scanned.
Different colours symbolise different types of station parts.
Discover more station parts to unlock discounts and commissions.
Leave the mode with MAINMENU\(1\).
Cargo can be collected using the cargo collect mode MAINMENU\(1-2\).
It can be activated when you have a transport ship in your squad.
Use "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON$" to instruct your ship to collect crates.
Small asteroids can be tagged in the {1002,1153} MAINMENU\(1-3\).
Mining ships in your squad will gather tagged asteroids.
It can be activated when a mining ship is in your squad.
Use "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON$" to tag asteroids for collection.
If you have a mining ship in your squad, you can instruct it to collect asteroids by tagging them in {1002,1153} MAINMENU\(1-3\).
You will require a mining ship for this tutorial. You can add one to your squad and trigger this tutorial again.
Your mining ship will need mining drones. The more it has, the faster it can collect resources.
You require a mining laser. You can purchase one from a mechanic.
Target a small asteroid and press $INPUT_STATE_INTERACTION_MENU$ to tag it for collection.
You can order mining ship captains to gather resources in an area.
Ships can be scanned in the ship scan mode MAINMENU\(1-4\).
Enable this mode to use the scan interaction on ships.
Use the interaction menu to scan ships.
Discover debris, left-over crates, remote installations or other valuables using the long range scan MAINMENU\(1-5\).
Hold down "$INPUT_STATE_FIRE_SECONDARY_WEAPON$" as long as possible while avoiding an overload, to increase scan range.
Fly to highlighted locations to explore your findings.
The long range scanner can be upgraded by a mechanic.
When your relationship with a faction decreases, they will increase prices, eventually stop trading with you and might even become hostile.
When your relationship with a faction increases, they will be more willing to trade with you and might even give you discounts.
Shoot enemy mass-traffic near stations to gain reputation with the faction of that station.
Purchase engine upgrades from a mechanic.
Engines involve a compromise between speed and manoeuvrability.
You can build your own ships at a shipyard by docking and talking to the ship dealer.
To make newly-built capital ships operational you need to assign a captain, a defence officer and an engineer.
To make newly-built ships operational you need to assign a pilot.
Different shipyards build different sizes of ships. Small ships can be bought, while larger ones must be ordered and built.
Here you can select which ship to order. View the encyclopedia for details on what the ship is designed to do.
Drones may be required for the ship to fulfil its purpose. This ship may already have some drones selected as default.
Ships can be expensive. If you do not wish to buy the ship, leave the menu.
The ship has been ordered. It will take time to build.
Your ship is ready. Pay attention to any upkeep missions that will help prepare your ship for service.
The status menu shows your relationship with the various factions, the items in your inventory and detailed statistics.
The property menu shows an overview of ships and stations owned by you.
This menu shows the status of the Albion Skunk.
Open tabs to see detailed information on subsystems.
The map shows a geographical overview of the galaxy.
You can change the level of detail between Galaxy, System, Sector and Zone.
Galaxy-level shows which systems are connected by gates.
System-level shows which sectors are connected by superhighways.
Sector-level shows which zones are connected by local highways.
Zone-level shows ships, some of which you can contact through comms.
You can target nearby enemies with $INPUT_ACTION_TARGET_NEXT_ENEMY$.
Target objects in front of you with $INPUT_ACTION_TARGET_NEXT_TARGET$.
Cycle your targets with $INPUT_ACTION_PREV_TARGET_ACTION$ and $INPUT_ACTION_NEXT_TARGET_ACTION$.
You can input keywords like "Shipyard" and "Jump Gate" into the search bar in the map to filter locations at every map level.
You can use $INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLE_EVENTMONITOR_DETAILS$ to enable/disable the overlay information on the event monitor and $INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLE_RADAR_MODE$ to switch the radar mode.
The graphics menu allows you to switch the radar to low quality or even turn it off entirely.
Select an object on the map and press $INPUT_ACTION_ADDON_DETAILMONITOR_T$ or double-click it to set that object as your current target.
Your ship computer database will automatically be updated with trade offers from this station.
You need to hire an architect for your Construction Vessel. Upkeep mission activated.
To collect ware containers, switch to Cargo Collect mode and tag the containers.
There are illegal items in your inventory. Either drop them or avoid being scanned by police.
Sabotaging defence control panels can give you a limited time period during which a station is weaker, or even defenceless.
Sabotaging a security control panel will increase the time available for stealing containers after hacking.
Use a Security Decryption System, which can be crafted from items in your inventory, to sabotage a control panel.
Sabotaging a repair terminal will increase the time the crew needs to rebuild that station after an attack.
Sabotaging a production terminal will cripple production for a long period of time.
Hacking into a trade terminal can give you access to illegal long-term discounts or commissions.
Use a temporary local security ID, which can be crafted from items sometimes found on platforms, to sabotage a terminal.
Use cargo collect mode to pick up stolen containers. Be aware that this will trigger station security.
Your inventory \($INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_PLAYER_INVENTORY_MENU$\) now contains objects that can be used for crafting.
You have all the parts of a craftable item.
Open your inventory \($INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_PLAYER_INVENTORY_MENU$\), select the item and click "Craft".
You can craft some items yourself. For others, you will need help.
Bring this drink to an NPC that is in a good mood.
This item can be given to someone to improve their mood.
This item can be given to someone to influence their mood.
This item can be used to bribe someone.
This item can be used to hack into a station's control panels.
This item can be used to hack into a station's terminals.
Keep an eye out for more crafting ingredients.
You have crafted a very rare item.
Important information about rare items can be found in their descriptions.
You have picked up a temporary item. If you fly away from this station, you will lose this item.
Crafted items can be given to people as gifts or used to hack certain systems.
These demonstration items will now be removed from your inventory.
In this gamestart you have a small fleet of well-protected M-sized trading ships.
These ships are not yet part of your squad, so they will not follow you.
You can assign trade jobs to these ships through the trade menu \($INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_TRADE_MENU$\), once you have found matching trade offers.
You can open a lockbox by successfully shooting all of its locks.
Be careful though; the box will be destroyed if it is damaged too much.
You have discovered a container. Once they have been dropped or released from a lockbox, they will automatically float towards your ship.
You have discovered a container. You can press $INPUT_STATE_LOOTMAGNET$ to make them float closer to your ship for collection.
This icon means you are being investigated by station security.
If it turns red, one or more security ships are very close by.
This icon means you are being targeted for attack by station security.
If it blinks, one or more security ships are in range.
In your current scenario you have a group of decently-protected small freighters.
In your current scenario you have a group of capable small freighters.
These ships are not yet part of your squad, which means they will not follow you.
You can assign trade jobs to these ships through the trade menu "$INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_TRADE_MENU$", once you have found compatible trade offers.
(smalltalk success)You were very convincing. You can impress this person even more to get substantially better offers.
Press $INPUT_STATE_FP_JUMP$ to jump and $INPUT_STATE_FP_CROUCH$ to crouch. Combining these two allows you to jump onto very high obstacles.
(only use for mouse and keyboard controls)Double-tap $INPUT_STATE_FP_MOVE_FORWARD$ to run while on a platform.
(only use for gamepad controls)Press $INPUT_ACTION_FP_RUN$ to run while on a platform.
Press $INPUT_ACTION_DOCK_ACTION$ to return to your ship immediately.
Open MAINMENU\(3-1\) to see your current missions.
Open MAINMENU\(2-5\) for details on the various weapons.
Open MAINMENU\(4-4\) to see the map of the current zone.
Open MAINMENU\(5\) to look through all the people you can talk to in the local area.
You unlocked a discount. Open the MAINMENU\(6-1\) to check your collected discounts.
You unlocked a commission. Open the MAINMENU\(6-1\) to check your collected commissions.
You unlocked a trade offer. Open the MAINMENU\(6-1\) for details.
You can leave the station by opening the MAINMENU with "$INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_MAIN_MENU$" and then selecting options 7-2.
You can leave the station by opening the MAINMENU with "$INPUT_ACTION_OPEN_MAIN_MENU$" and then selecting options 7-2.
Check your freighter's status in MAINMENU\(2-2\).
Call your captain with the MAINMENU\(7-1\) and tell him or her to "work here".
Open MAINMENU\(2-5\) for details on the various missiles.
Open the repair menu \(1\) to repair damage to your ship.
Open MAINMENU\(2-5\) for details on the various drones and their usage.
Your trade ship has arrived in this zone. Open the MAINMENU\(2-2\), select the ship and press "Set Guidance" to set guidance to it.
Stations can be scanned in station scan mode MAINMENU\(1-1\).
Leave the mode with MAINMENU\(1-1\).
Cargo can be collected using the cargo collect mode MAINMENU\(1-2\).
Small asteroids can be tagged in the {1002,1153} MAINMENU\(1-3\).
If you have a mining ship in your squad, you can instruct it to collect asteroids by tagging them in {1002,1153} MAINMENU\(1-3\).
Ships can be scanned in the ship scan mode MAINMENU\(1-4\).
Discover debris, left-over crates, remote installations or other valuables using the long range scan MAINMENU\(1-5\).
This box is where your station will be built.
Construction will start if the area is clear of ships.
You will require a Construction Vessel for this tutorial. You can add one to your squad and trigger this tutorial again.
Your Construction Vessel will benefit by having {20101,2001}(Construction URV) drones. The more it has, the faster it can build and extend stations.
(only for loading screen)Use $INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLE_HUD$ to turn the HUD on and off.
(only for loading screen)If you have the Experimental Jump Drive installed in your ship, you can jump to any Jump Gate or jump beacon you have discovered using the map.
(only for loading screen)If you have SETA, you can make time pass more quickly by pressing $INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLE_TIMEWARP$.
Select new trade wares using "{1001,6800}". You can then set up buy or sell offers for these wares.
If your manager is skilled enough, you can set up buy and sell offers at the same time.
Select "{1001,4228}" to select wares for which this station will make trade offers.
You have a weapon mod in your inventory. Visit a mechanic to get it installed.
A Flight School is available. Click the flashing event monitor to view the briefing.
You can still find this Flight School in the Tutorial menu - MAINMENU\(3-3\).
You can abort this tutorial in the Active Missions menu - MAINMENU\(2-5\).
You can abort this tutorial in the Active Missions menu - MAINMENU\(3-1\).
Hold {1019,1} to steer towards your mouse cursor.
Press "$INPUT_ACTION_TOGGLEMOUSESTEERING$" to enable/disable cursor steering. You will fly towards your mouse cursor.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_BOOST$" to toggle boosting and travel longer distances in a shorter time.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_BOOST$" to toggle boosting and travel longer distances in a shorter time.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_BOOST$" or decelerate with "$INPUT_STATE_FULLREVERSE$" to disengage boosters.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_BOOST$" or decelerate with "$INPUT_STATE_DECELERATE$" to disengage boosters.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_FULLREVERSE$" to stop boosting and decelerate.
Press "$INPUT_STATE_DECELERATE$" to stop boosting and decelerate.
Press "$INPUT_ACTION_CYCLE_NEXT_SECONDARY_WEAPON$" to switch your missile type.
When you acquire multiple missile types, you can press "$INPUT_ACTION_CYCLE_NEXT_SECONDARY_WEAPON$" to cycle through them.
Press "{1019,3}" to fire your weapon towards your mouse cursor.
Stations produce wares, which are then sold to other stations which need them as resources.
You can gather information on stations at their infopoints and trade locations.
Approaching trade locations will add trade data to your computer. Open the MAINMENU\(4\) for collected trade data.
Approaching trade locations will add trade data to your computer. Open the MAINMENU\(6-1\) for collected trade data.
You can also find traders and crew on stations. Open the MAINMENU\(3-3\) for the Comm menu.
You can also find traders and crew on stations. Open the MAINMENU\(5\) for the Comm menu.
You can dock at landing platforms to explore the inside of the station and speak face to face with people.
Stations are very important to economy and security. When you decide to build your own, be mindful of local resources and threats.
The Trade Offers menu displays those which you have collected. Press 2 to swap modes, between wares bought by stations and sales from stations.
Use the filter box to filter offers by their ware or location, such as the system name. You can also sort them by selecting the column headers.
You can assign ships to fulfil the offers, either delivering wares or buying products.
You can select which ship to perform the order at the top of the menu. Different ships can be capable of transporting different types of wares.
Ships can queue several trade orders. With additional trade computer upgrades, more orders can be queued.
{1012,3200} You can find trade offers by approaching trade offer locations.
You can select how many wares you would like to buy or sell.
The prices will change per station, based on how much they need to buy or how much they have to sell.
Finding two extremes could lead to a profitable trade run.
You can see the distance that the selected ship is from the offer. Take this into account when planning trade runs.
With trade computer upgrades, you can collect local trade offers faster.
By speaking with people on platforms, you may be able to gain a trade subscription to receive trade updates automatically from the station.
The trade order has been added to the planned trips list of your ship.
You can view or clear the planned trips in the ship's details menu.
You will require a trade ship for this tutorial. You can add one to your squad and trigger this tutorial again.
The more trade offers you collect, the higher chance you have of finding a profitable trade run for one of your ships.
You can see if you have found a profitable trade run in the trade deals menu - MAINMENU\(4-2\).
You can see if you have found a profitable trade run in the trade deals menu - MAINMENU\(6-2\).
Select a ware to trade and press "{1001,2962}"(Next) to set up the trade.
You can buy drones from drone dealers. You can find these on platforms or attempt to contact one via the comm link menu MAINMENU\(5-7-3\).
In this menu you can buy and sell drones.
You can remotely pilot ROV drones. URV drones will autonomously perform their task when launched.(see 20104,402 for ROV URV references)
Should you not wish to buy a drone at this time, leave the drone dealer.
This menu displays all of your current drones. You can launch and recall them from here.
Smart defence can be found on the left side of the menu. This will launch all defensive drones.
You can find the {1001,5610}(Recall Drones option) option on the right side of the menu.
Hacking is a risky and hostile act. You can abort this tutorial at any time.
During the hack process you must stop the bar at the highest point of the readout.
Visit a drone dealer and purchase one or more scanner drones.
Visit a drone dealer and purchase a demolition drone.
You can buy drones from drone dealers. You can find these on platforms or attempt to contact one via the comm link menu MAINMENU\(3-3\).
Your drone is on its way. Please wait for delivery.
The more damage sustained by a ship, the easier it will be for the marines to take control.
Taking out marked systems will increase the survival chance of your marines.
During operations your marines could be fatally wounded. If they make it back, they may get promoted and be more effective next time.
Your marines failed to successfully board the target. Were this not an exercise, they would have been killed.
Take on damaged, less powerful ships to train your marines for more challenging targets.
(General Tutorial)You can find a tutorial for this activity in the Tutorial menu - MAINMENU\(3-3\).
You can trigger this tutorial again at any time.
You can find the Video Tutorial menu through the Options Menu \($INPUT_ACTION_OPTIONSMENU$\).
This tutorial may have you damage neutral objects. You can abort this tutorial at any time.
A neutral object is available to assist in this demonstration.
See the "{30152,2201}(Ship Building)" tutorial for more information on acquiring capital ships.
Your ship will take time to arrive.
Target the ship and open comms \("$INPUT_ACTION_COMM_ACTION$"\) to give new orders.
Open comms through the interaction menu \("$INPUT_STATE_INTERACTION_MENU$"\) to give new orders.
This tutorial is not currently possible from this location.
(please use same translation as 1098,52 - do not turn into reference)In the full game this gate takes you to Albion.
(please use same translation as 1098,53 - do not turn into reference)In the full game this gate takes you to Maelstrom.

page.t: Location
Cash
Equipment
Property
Crew
Faction Relations
None
Always available
Requires expansion: The Teladi Outpost
Requires expansion: Home of Light
Campaign
Aboard the Albion Skunk, Ren Otani continues to forge a living in the isolated system of Albion. But as frictions between rival factions grow, Ren starts to find it hard to remain out of trouble.
Free Play

After the momentous events which reshaped Albion and beyond, you find yourself in a position to do whatever you want. Be it building a corporate empire, assembling a fleet or simply exploring, you are free to decide.
Aspiring Merchant
With a freighter at the ready you're thrown into the competitive world of trading. Amass profit to create an empire capable of toppling your rivals.
Argon Mercenary
It seems the days of the mercenary are returning as conflict again brews in the universe. Remain ahead of the curve with the latest weapon tech and always be the one to shoot first.
Empire Builder
One station is all that's needed to join the big league. Use yours to begin eroding your competition's hold on the sector while earning a hefty profit to fund your next expansion.
The Teladi Outpost
As a Jump Gate reconnects, opportunities abound for the people of Albion. Seek out new trade runs for your freighters while cautiously exploring this hazardous Teladi system.
Home of Light

Reunited with the Home of Light system, factions from across the Jump Gate network rush to form ties with the illustrious Terracorp. Will you support their monopoly or attempt to undercut their local advantage?
Verge Explorer

The road you travel is perilous, and most who came before you were forced to flee, their ships wrecked or abandoned in the unforgiving void of space. How far can you and your crew go before turning back?
Discovery \(VR Universe\)

In this version of X Rebirth you have access to the entire Home of Light expansion. The universe includes the three star systems Home of Light, Cold Star and Toride.

TRADE
- Build your own trade ships.
- Collect trade offers and discounts to get better deals.
- Land on stations and ask friends to work as trade agents to get more deals.
- Trade with wares and inventory items of your choice.

FIGHT
- Upgrade your ship's weapons, engines, shields and scanner, add drones or change its cockpit.
- Add software upgrades to your shipboard computer to make trading and fighting easier.
- Install weapon mods to create unique weapon variations.
- Use drones to sneak up on an enemy and plant explosives.
- Take part in fights and destroy your enemies using the plasma cannon and torpedoes.

BUILD
- Build stations and factories to play an even larger role in the X universe economy.
- Upgrade your stations with more shields, rocket launchers and other weapon systems for better defence.
- Continuously invest in and expand your stations with new production and storage modules.
- Increase your stations' production efficiency by hiring specialists.

THINK
- Choose between a variety of missions.
- Increase your reputation among various factions and races.
- Hire marines and board enemy capital ships.
- Hack enemy stations to disable their defence systems.
- Use the long-range scanner to find hidden secrets and explore the outskirts of space.

...and much, much more!
The complete edition of X Rebirth includes 8 unique star systems.

Additional items and features that can be found in the Complete version:
- A huge variety of ships to command and stations to own.
- Complete set of factions.
- Multiple gamestarts that offer a different look at the universe.
- Long-lasting story and campaign.
- Variety of missions and exciting mission chains.
- Great mod support.

Please visit www.egosoft.com for more information.

page.title: Quotes
page.t:
"Life is pleasant.
Death is peaceful.
It's the transition that's troublesome."

- Isaac Asimov (1920 - 1992)
"Be nice to people on your way up because you meet them on your way down." \n\n- Jimmy Durante (1893 - 1980)
"If you want to make an apple pie from scratch, you must first create the universe."\n\n- Carl Sagan (1934 - 1996)
"Knowledge speaks, but wisdom listens."\n\n- Jimi Hendrix (1942 - 1970)
"Education is a progressive discovery of our own ignorance."\n\n- Will Durant (1885 - 1981)
"Obstacles are those frightful things you see when you take your eyes off your goal."\n\n- Henry Ford (1863-1947)

"While we are postponing,
life speeds by." 

- Seneca (3BC - 65AD)

"First they ignore you,
then they laugh at you,
then they fight you,
then you win." 

- Mahatma Gandhi (1869-1948)
"It has become appallingly obvious that our technology has exceeded our humanity. " \n\n- Albert Einstein (1879-1955)
"The mistakes are all waiting to be made. " \n\n- Chessmaster Savielly Grigorievitch Tartakower (1887-1956)

"Try not.
Do, or do not.
There is no 'try'." 

- Yoda

"I may not have gone where I intended to go,
but I think I have ended up where I intended to be." 

- Douglas Adams (1952 - 2001)
"Tell me, o Muse, of that ingenious hero who travelled far and wide..." \n\n- Homer's Odyssey (800BC)
"Whatever trip we start, it is for the search of happiness. But happiness is here." \n\n- Quintus Flaccus (238 - 209)
"Nothing is constant but change." \n\n- Sakyamuni, founder of Buddhism (563 - 483)
"The only ones who fly are the ones who dare to fly." \n\n- Luis Sepulveda, Chilean writer (1949 - )
"Stars are holes in the sky from which the light of the infinite shines." \n\n- Confucius (551 - 479)

"While the other animals are prone and fix their gaze on the earth, the god gave man a face uplifted, bade him stand erect and turn his eyes to the stars." \n\n- Publius Ovidius Naso (Metamorphoses I. 84-6)

"The greatest thing
You'll ever learn
Is just to love and
Be loved in return" 

- Eden Ahbez (1908 - 1995)
"May god stand between you and harm, in all the dark places you must walk." \n\n- Ancient Egyptian Proverb
"To win one hundred victories in one hundred battles is not the highest skill. To subdue the enemy without fighting, is the highest skill." \n\n- Sun-Tsu (500BC)

"There must be something worth living for
There must be something worth trying for
Even some things worth dying for
And if one man can stand tall
There must be some hope for us all
Somewhere, somewhere in the spirit of man
" 

- "War of the Worlds musical by Jeff Wayne"
"Mother, I saw a dream in the night. There were stars in the sky for me." \n\n- The Epic of Gilgamesh (around 800 BC)

"The greatest gain from space travel consists in the extension of our knowledge. In a hundred years this newly won knowledge will pay huge and unexpected dividends." \n\n- Wernher von Braun (1912 - 1977)
"To go places and do things that have never been done before - that's what living is all about." \n\n- Michael Collins (1930 -)
"It's human nature to stretch, to go, to see, to understand. Exploration is not a choice, really; it's an imperative." \n\n- Michael Collins (1930 -)
"Don't tell me that man doesn't belong out there. Man belongs wherever he wants to go - and he'll do plenty well when he gets there." \n\n- Wernher von Braun (1912 - 1977)
"Hold fast to dreams, for if dreams die, life is a broken bird that cannot fly." \n\n- Langston Hughes (1902 - 1967)
"Minds are like parachutes - they only function when open." \n\n- Thomas Dewar (1864 - 1930)
"Shoot for the moon. Even if you miss, you'll land among the stars." \n\n- Les Brown (1912 - 2001)
"What is now proved was once only imagined." \n\n- William Blake (1757 - 1827)
"Even a fool knows you can't touch the stars, but it doesn't stop a wise man from trying." \n\n- Harry Anderson (1952 -)
"And if you gaze for long into an abyss, the abyss gazes also into you." \n\n- Friedrich Nietzsche (1844 - 1900)
"Following the light of the sun, we left the Old World." \n\n- Inscription on Columbus' caravels
"Throw your dreams into space like a kite, and you do not know what it will bring back, a new life, a new friend, a new love, a new country." \n\n- Anais Nin (1903 - 1977)
"If you can imagine it, you can achieve it. If you can dream it, you can become it." \n\n- William Arthur Ward (1921 - 1994)
"Imagination is the only weapon in the war against reality." \n\n- Jules de Gautier (1811 - 1872)
"The journey is the reward." \n\n- Taoist Saying
"It is good to have an end to journey toward, but it is the journey that matters in the end." \n\n- Ursula K. LeGuin (1929 -)
"The universe is full of magical things patiently waiting for our wits to grow sharper." \n\n- Eden Phillpotts (1862 - 1960)
"Your current safe boundaries were once unknown frontiers." \n\n- Unknown
"The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams." \n\n- Eleanor Roosevelt (1884 - 1962)
"Dreams are renewable. No matter what our age or condition, there are still untapped possibilities within us and new beauty waiting to be born." \n\n- Dale Turner
"There is a single light of science, and to brighten it anywhere is to brighten it everywhere." \n\n- Isaac Asimov (1920 - 1992)
"Reality is that part of the imagination we all agree on." \n\n- Unknown
"The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious. It is the source of all true art and science." \n\n- Albert Einstein (1879 - 1955)
"Imagination is more important than knowledge. Knowledge is limited. Imagination encircles the world." \n\n- Albert Einstein (1879 - 1955)

"When I examine myself and my methods of thought, I come to the conclusion that the gift of fantasy has meant more to me than my talent for absorbing positive knowledge." \n\n- Albert Einstein (1879 - 1955)
"As far as the laws of mathematics refer to reality, they are not certain; and as far as they are certain, they do not refer to reality." \n\n- Albert Einstein (1879 - 1955)
"Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic." \n\n- Arthur C. Clarke (1917 -)
"Time is the fire in which we burn." \n\n- Delmore Schwartz (1913 - 1966)
"I don't know what you could say about a day in which you have seen four beautiful sunsets." \n\n- John Glenn (1921 -)

"It suddenly struck me that that tiny pea, pretty and blue, was the Earth. I put up my thumb and shut one eye, and my thumb blotted out the planet Earth. I didn't feel like a giant. I felt very, very small." \n\n- Neil Armstrong (1930 - 2012)
"To confine our attention to terrestrial matters would be to limit the human spirit." \n\n- Stephen Hawking (1942 -)
"Science-fiction yesterday, fact today, obsolete tomorrow." \n\n- Otto O. Binder (1911 - 1974)
"There shall be wings! If the accomplishment be not for me, 'tis for some other. The spirit cannot die; and man, who shall know all and shall have wings..." \n\n- Leonardo da Vinci (1452 - 1519)
"Man's mind and spirit grow with the space in which they are allowed to operate." \n\n- Krafft A. Ehricke (1917 - 1984)
"The important thing is not to stop questioning." \n\n- Albert Einstein (1879 - 1955)
"You would make a ship sail against the winds and currents by lighting a bonfire under her deck...I have no time for such nonsense." \n\n- Napoleon Bonaparte (1769-1821)
"The Earth is a cradle of the mind, but we cannot live forever in a cradle." \n\n- Konstantin E. Tsiolkovsky (1857 - 1935)
"Sometimes I think we're alone in the universe, and sometimes I think we're not. In either case the idea is quite staggering." \n\n- Arthur C. Clarke (1917 -)
"Space isn't remote at all. It's only an hour's drive away, if your car could go straight upwards." \n\n- Sir Fred Hoyle (1915 - 2001)
"Space is big. Really big." \n\n- Douglas Adams (1952 - 2001)

"I measured the skies
Now the shadows I measure
Skybound was the mind
Earthbound the body rests." 

- Johannes Kepler (1571 - 1630)
"Discovery consists of seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought." \n\n- Albert Szent-Gyorgyi (1893-1986)
"Whether outwardly or inwardly, whether in space or time, the farther we penetrate the unknown, the vaster and more marvellous it becomes." \n\n- Charles A.Lindbergh (1902 - 1974)

page.title: Yisha
page.t: Hi there! Ever had a female co-pilot before? Well, you don't need to worry! I am tougher then you might imagine! Just remember one thing, keep your hands off or I will bite!
I got the pickup!
Hey! Be careful, we are taking too much damage!
Great shooting!
Well done, you must have been practising!
How many drones was that? Five?
Hey, don't be too cocky just because you destroyed a capital ship! Everyone can be lucky every now and then!
I love those Jump Gates... let's do it again!
Do you really trust that guy? I don't!
Well done Sir, you got him!
It looks like we have lost track of our target.
Smuggler? I was hoping we could have some pirates on the menu.
Good shot Captain, we got him! Let's try to find the other smuggler.
Oh yeah! Like stealing candy from a kid!
Hey pilot! Do you really think this is a good idea, taking on a Split destroyer?
You're going to need a bigger ship!
What do you want to look into?
Can I show you anything else?
Here you see the storage inventory.
All the information we could gather of their production.
These are their weapon systems. Take a look.
Enabled.
Activated.
Confirmed.
Ready to go.
Ready!
Let's do it!
I'm with you!
Not sure I agree with that.
Urgh!
('my god')Chikusho!
(laughs)
(snort/laughs)
I need a coffee...
Ugh, need to reboot...

Rebooting!

(ship successfully boarded) All your base are belong to us!
Dude, that sun is blinding!
(re-opening sector map)Hey, you looked at that already moments ago!
(asking Yisha repeatedly for way to a location)Can't you make up your mind?
(forcing Yisha to repeat)That's getting boring.
(joke follow up)C'mon! That was a good one!
Woo!
Oh yeah!
Awesome!
Beautiful!
Good one.

(surprised)Oh no...

Have you got any cards to play?

I mark, you kill!

(to ship/station)Damage report!

OK, let's have a look. What type of station do you have in mind?
That's a fine one, I think.
Exactly what we need at the moment.
Are you sure? I think there are enough of those in the galaxy.
Analysing your station again?
Do you need help deciding what to do with this station?
OK, we are getting serious here. Have you decided what you want?
You can still change your choice before you give the go.
Make your choice, I don't want to sit here all day.
I'm certain he will squander your money. You'd better get the wares yourself.
He seems trustworthy enough. Give him some money and you don't have to collect all the resources yourself.
You heard it, you can still back out of this.
Well you wouldn't be here if you didn't want to build it, right?
So you changed your mind? That was the last chance to do so, you know?
Be prepared that they will need more resources for that.
Remember you can always add upgrades but not remove them. So think twice before changing anything permanently.
OK, let's have a look. I've linked the data from the trader to Betty and your display.
You heard that? You can still back out of this.
Well you wouldn't be here if you didn't want to build it, right?
Examine their orders and keep them up to date.
Did you forget what you told them to do?
Examine their orders, maybe you can learn something here.
We can find out what they are going to do in the future.
Making sure they can defend themselves, right?
Are we planning something here?
Why do you need this info? I hope nothing illegal.
I don't think they have any special weapons here, but have a look.
Let's see what they have in stock.
Take a look. Anything you need for yourself?
Checking your assets that are controlled by this object.
You can leave that to the Manager, can't you?
The following objects are associated with them.
Let's see what I can find of their subordinates.
Space out here looks interesting.
This is dull. Don't start studying the numbers for hours again.
They are busy here, have a look.
It's your production. What do you want to know?
Maybe we can learn something from their setup?
Be quick. They are notoriously envious of their production secrets.

Currently, we don't have any on board.
Relaying the order.

Which of them should be given command of this ship?

Not to jinx it, but it seems to be going really well.
So far so good.
That was too close for comfort.
This is not going well...
Come on, we can still win this!
I don't think we can win this.
Stay alert, the hardest part is yet to come.
The hardest part should be behind us now.
Give the word and we'll pull out.
Almost there!

(Takedown in empty space)Hehe. No witnesses, no judgement.
Good shooting.(calm)

(Comment on nearly destroyed surface element)Just a little more and it'll go bang.
(Comment on nearly destroyed surface element)That one's almost finished.

What a total disaster!
That did not go as planned!
At least we got out alive.
Well, we got what we wanted...
That could have gone better.
That could not have gone better!
I'd never have pegged you as a master tactician.
(boarding, preparation)Let's make sure there are no nasty surprises first...
We should start by taking out the Jump Drive.
Now let's blow up the engines.
All right, they're sitting ducks now!
If you use the scanner drone we'll be able to make a much better attack plan.
The scanner drone should be able to get us some intel.
Let's bring a scanner drone next time, I don't like sending them in blind like this.
We should really start bringing scanner drones.
The marines will be much safer if we take out any nearby turrets first.
Let's take out the defences near the entry point.
Looks like their defences are down.
Their defences are down, looks like sabotage.
(moving forward)Let's make sure they get there in one piece.
Damnit, we have to help them!
Do something, these things are made out of cardboard!

Half of the pods have arrived.
No more pods in flight.
That's the last of them.
Alright, now for the fun part.
Let's stick around, see if we can help.
(player assist)We should try to stage a diversion.
Maybe we can lure some guards away?
Hang on, let me mark some suitable targets.
There. Just start shooting these.
We should be able to hack that with our drone.
If you use the hacker drone we can speed up the process.
Your hacker drone will be able to help - just use it and I'll direct you.
Wish we had a hacker drone right now.
You should think about getting a hacker drone, it would make this way easier.
(success)Well done! Watch it for us until we bring a replacement captain.
Great job! Keep it safe for a bit, we're bringing in a new commander.
We already have someone suitable on board - just dock and we can switch command.
Let's go hire someone to take good care of our new toy.
(fail)No!
We've lost our whole boarding squad!
Launching pods.
Ugh, nothing but garbage here.
Let's just keep looking.
Hello!
Oooh shiny!
Huh, that's weird...
(emphasis on 'that')What is that?
Should we check it out?
Don't overload it
There goes the fuse
(emphasis on 'that')You can charge it a bit more than that!
Well, that was a dud.

Let me take her down.
I'll bring her in.
I can dock us.
See you when you get back.

Maybe we can send some forces but we need most of them in Albion, keeping up pressure.
I will. Thank you Nakano.
(reserved)Huh, yeah, sure.
Just a stupid thought. These guys are Terran. I hope that we don't turn on each other once this war is over.
Heh, it's been a while since someone reminded me of the federation. Those must have been the good old days. Something to think about. Thanks Ren.
I'll let Borman know that we plan on heading back. He can tell us if it's safe.
Beryll's had a history of turning tides of war with their tech. The attack on the Earth Torus couldn't have happened without them.
They've been pumping out drones since the war started. That's no secret.
If it's enough to cause Beryll scientists to leave, it can't be good.
I bet they'll just set up an encrypted transmission. These guys can hide pretty well when they want to.
What the!? Tunnelling-scan signal. It's in our systems!
What exactly is going on?
(Surprised)That's it? Plutarch's already got thousands of drones. They may not be the smartest things in the world but they do their job.
So, the question is, why did you leave? Isn't robotic warfare your speciality?
I'll forward all of this to Borman. Once we get the all clear, we go.
Getting Borman on the comm.
(notices something strange)Err, Falk. These coordinates...
(slightly worried)OK, here we are.
Yes. Yes it was.
Alright! Let's go!
Take out those fighters!
Some of those ships are going to jump to the civilian convoy. We can hitch a ride.
The defence group's getting into position around the civilians. Not many Plutarch forces yet.
Plutarch ships jumping in!
Woah, new contacts. Unknown ship configurations. Those must be the unmanned Plutarch ships.
There's a load of them! Let's get in there!
Most ships are through the gate.
Let's keep to the rear for now. That's where Plutarch will attack.
We should move forward to the front of the group, just in case we run into Reivers.
Friendly contacts! Canteran reinforcements!
Where are our defence ships? The civilian ships are taking hits!
I doubt we'll manage to get through the gate to Albion now, unless we run an assault with our fleet.
Plutarch must be really desperate, turning to those drones. We've got them on the ropes, maybe we're going the wrong way.
Incoming transmission.
We won't be half-strength for long. The Canterans will patch us up and get into the fight themselves. And Borman knows what he's doing.
Look's like I'm not the only one with second thoughts.
Why do people keep saying that to us?
Thank you. I'll have our captains coordinate with your people. Many of the freighters are fully stocked with supplies.
Well, technically, there are several other people in the fleet ranked higher than me. We don't have much of a chain of command though.
Us too. Alright Governor, I accept. Let me know what you need me to do.
Well, that's one for the history books. Me solidifying an alliance between Argon and Terrans. We've done good.
(sigh)Enough excitement for one day.
Let's check on our stuff. Make sure things are in working order for the days ahead.

(Speech)A lot has changed in the decades past. We found ourselves isolated and alone. Perhaps everyone we once knew are doing the same, fighting for survival in this lonely universe. But now, it seems this time is ending as we have finally found people we can call friends.
We can look forward to an era of cooperation, advancement and peace. But first we must secure them against those who used our isolation to oppress our people and stagnate our culture.

Together, we can protect our peoples from these threats. Together, we can secure DeVries and retake Albion. But we must first end a dark chapter in our history so that we can look towards a brighter future.
A short time ago I, Lieutenant Yisha Tarren of the Heart of Albion under the Argon Federation, signed a treaty with Governor Nakano. We can finally declare the Terran Conflict over.
I'm glad that's over. I've never really been in the spotlight.

And now we only have one war to worry about. I was talking with Nakano about how committed Canterans will be to the fight. They'll certainly help in DeVries securing the Jump Gate. But in Albion, they want to lie back a little and leave it to us.
Right. We'll take it slow in Albion, but here, we're going to break out the big guns fast. We're gonna push this economy into overdrive! People like you are going to win us this war!
It's all part of the top secret Heart of Albion plan. I'm sorry but you've not passed the initiate exam yet.

Yeah, yeah. Just listen. We need to overwhelm Plutarch with everything we've got before their drone numbers become too much to handle. We already have a decent amount of fully-crewed ships which are just in need of repair. What we need are drones, lots of them.
It may not be the best financial investment but it will be worth it. And the more we build, the less losses we take.
Good. Thanks.
Let's get started.
We're off to a good start.
It'll be a little tough getting all the resources we need, but we'll find a way.
We need to deliver as many drones as we can to these ships.
You need to get a capital ship first. Then we deliver the drones to them.
That's right, just fill your capship with drones and we're all set.
Aww, I spoiled the surprise. The Albion Skunk is designated to accompany this ship in the battle. We scout around, they hit what we tell them to.
I'm not sure if we're ready.
Any word from Borman?

Governor. I think it's time we began to mobilise. We can send an encrypted databurst to the fleet in Albion and tell them when to attack. We have to time it just right, having our cap ships jump in as soon as we arrive from the highways. Any word on Reiver activity along the way?
We'll give our fleets some time to prepare, then we move out.
Let's make sure we're ready, then get into position.
Nakano's making a fleet-wide broadcast.
Receiving our mission specifics. Heh, we'll be right where the action is.
You'd better not stay this quiet for the whole trip.
Ok, now I'm getting a bit nervous.
Don't get too far ahead.
We're gonna fall behind.
Don't forget that we need our capship in our squad.
Everyone keep your form and continue for the station. Our ships will jump in any time.
They see us coming. We have to get in fast and strike!
Ren, look!
Borman, don't over-commit. We can fight our way to you.
Nakano's here!
We'll do what we can.
Ren, we need those drones deployed, now!
Our drones are getting torn up!
Our drones are tearing up that station!
The station's going up!
They're moving to protect the Plutarch ships!
Plutarch and Reiver ships incoming!
Borman, we have Reiver ships bearing down on us here. Can you assist?
I...he's right Sir. I don't think we can hold for long.
What about you?
Good luck Falk.
We've just lost two more ships! Damn it!
Where's Nakano's ship? Did it jump out?
(sad)We weren't ready. I thought we were ready.
Best check on the stations as we go.
(quiet, shocked)Ren. The gate.
(alarmed)Chikusho! Ren!
(panicked)Who are they, what the hell do we do?
I really don't recognise those ships. What if they're not Argon? What if they're Terran? Or something else?
(Playfully)Expanding are we?
Acknowledged. We will coordinate with the freighter in the salvage operation.
We don't have much time to waste. Let's check the situation on the other side of the gate.
Sure. We'll back you up and then secure the Jump Beacon.
We'll stay for a bit longer just to be sure.
Latest reports say that a Jump Beacon may have been destroyed. We'll have no chance of escorting the capships once they've jumped.
Let's try to keep the gate clear.
Nice to see them rebuilding their infrastructure.
Looks like they'll be able to shore up their defences with new ships soon.
They shouldn't suffer any more food shortages with these new production lines.
With the production up and running we should be able to pump out drones in no time.
We can hole up near the gate incase we need to make a fast exit.
Look at those cities. There must be millions on that planet.
Take it slow.
Omicron Lyrae?! Is she right?

Borman said there were reports that Terran forces had invaded several Argon systems, including Omicron Lyrae. Defence and shipbuilding facilities were crippled. They were requesting reinforcements from Argon Prime. Nothing was heard after that.
I wonder who won.
Ship approaching. Let's hope the Argon won.
Incoming Comms. Play it cool Ren.
Admiral. This is Lieutenant Yisha Tarren. I serve with the remaining Argon Military in Albion. That system is called DeVries. We have allies caught in conflict and they need your help!
The Plutarch Mining Corporation. They assumed power from the Argon Military soon after the gates closed. Now they are pushing into DeVries.
Colonists. They call themselves Canterans. They've taken in Albion refugees and have joined our cause. There is also a hostile faction we call the Reivers. They've sided with Plutarch.
Uh, of course, Admiral.
Should we tell them about the Canterans?
Ok. Shut up and let me do the talking.
They're from Earth. They're Terran.
Woah, let's not start throwing words like 'assault' around. These are good people. We've made our peace and they need your help. Argon and Terran civilians together, they all need your help!
At least let us go with you, we know the system, the people.
I've sent them our database and we've received the flight plan to the Jonferco station. I'm surprised that Jonferco still exists. That corporation was often hit by the Terrans during the war.
Go back and do what? We just got beat! Still, look at where we are now; Omicron Lyrae. This system has fought of the Kha'ak, Terrans. Who knows what we'll find here to use against Plutarch.
This system sure has seen a lot of action, generations of it. And the Argon never fell.
I bet they've got all of their eggheads going over our database.
How did you manage to land, speak for a few minutes and end up with bargain upgrades and a date with a CEO?
This CEO Colbern is in another sector.
Let's see what these engines can do!
Are you sure you don't want those upgrades?
Someone's in trouble.
Not too far. It seems to be near a station.
(alarmed)Those ships, Xenon!
Argon reinforcements are jumping in.
Xenon. Never thought I'd get to see one. You know the stories?
Some would say evolved. That's why Beryll's research was so dangerous. These things turned into smart killing-machines.
So, we have Xenon on one side and Plutarch on the other and we're running errands for corporations who don't want to help us.
Where first?
Looks like the freighter is waiting for us.
Let's hope they don't keep us waiting.
We've lost the ship. Looks like it sent out a distress call. Keep us alive Ren!
Are you nuts?!
We'd better lay low for a while.
Are they preparing a full invasion? What chance do we have?
I won't even bother explaining why it's a bad idea involving Plutarch. I'm not surprised they're looking out only for themselves.
The last CEO of Plutarch?
If he was assassinated, it would have been those against having a Teladi in such a prominent position in Argon space.
They're fighting their own war, you can't expect them to leave their strongholds.
(angry)You wouldn't dare! If they learn of Albion everyone there will be in danger.
You're insane.
Can you believe this? Our own people baiting the Xenon to Albion?
I'll send a data-burst but I don't know who will pick it up.
Most of the fleet is gone with Xenon swarming the whole sector. She's so out of her depth that she's not seeing straight.
Too many ships are getting past. They'll be at the gate in less than a hour.
The Xenon will tear this system apart if no-one is here to defend it.
(angry)They're all mad! Leaving the system defenceless.
I think we really need any advantage we can get. We should dock for those upgrades.
Sounds like Bayes is making progress, they shouldn't be far.
I wonder how many Xenon are on their way to Albion.
I wouldn't object to destroying any Xenon we come across.
Wow, they're moving fast.
Looks like there's a dogfight over there.
Let's keep pushing through.
Woah, what's she shouting about?
I've got their position. Let's get there in one piece.
I'll give her some credit. They've secured the area pretty quickly.
This is the last thing we needed.
Looks like she's playing it safe. How about we get ahead of them and find this Split base first?
We already know where it is. How about we take another look and see if we can find out what their plan is?
I think I'll stay on the ship while you go down and negotiate. Have fun.
So, we have a very lonely Split in the back of our ship, heading to Argon space. Why am I nervous?
Isn't it strange how Bayes was all ready to charge headlong into a Xenon sector, but stops just because of one Split ship?
But while she waits, Albion may be getting hit by Xenon.
(sarcastic)Charming.
Looks like the Navy has come to us. You'd better get back, Ren.
This is Yisha Tarren. Can't we just focus on the Xenon?
Hey, wait a minute. We didn't sign up for a lone suicide mission.
We're ready for the test.
Now that's just creepy.
A little warning next time!
What can we expect on the other side?
No argument from me.
Activating the Camouflage Device.
Xenon getting close.
Keep your distance.
Don't draw attention.
We've been spotted! We need to get out of here!
Find a quiet place for me to work on the Camouflage Device.
Let's try that again.
...play it cool Ren. Let's not make them angry.
I'm picking up the docks but they seem to be locked down. I'll mark where hack points may be.
Can we question their motives (emphasis)after we blow it up?
How about this? After we've planted the bomb and we get out of here, I'll send a communications burst. If someone answers, we've got a problem.
I've modified our drones to give out the same signal to confuse the Xenon. I don't know how long it will last.
We won't be able to dock without hacker drones.
We'll have to abort and get more hacker drones.
Almost done.
OK. I think the dock was unlocked. Bring us in.
How is it?
I'm marking what appears to be a good place for the bomb.
Get back as soon as you can. I think the Xenon are getting a little curious.
The next station is marked up.
Let's get this done, quick.
Same deal as before.
Not good. I say we've been made.
Tell that to the Xenon.
That's it, they're onto us!
How are we playing this?
It's not broken. The Xenon just aren't falling for it anymore.
Ask the Split. They're their bombs.
There's a dampening field. It may be blocking the detonation signal.
If we take out a module or two, we may be able to get past it.
Borman! It's about time.
How about taking out some of the traffic?
We should have a ship constructed.
We'll help hold them off. Just bring the cavalry.
So, we can freely go to Albion again.
I think I've paid for myself thank you very much!
Actually, how much is a co-pilot's salary?

page.title: Ren Otani
page.t: This is Otani, channel open.
Gotcha!(Triumphant)
Ha!(Dry)
Bullseye!
Loser!
Hehe(devious)
Get ready, Yisha. I'm coming back.
Yisha, I'm sending you a new crew member.
Yisha, we are going to upgrade the Skunk so get her ready.
Let me see the map.
I want a pilot on that ship!
I want an informant on that station!
Captain, wait for me to dock. I'm coming with you.
Yisha, I am sending you a new crew member.
(Entering skunk)Ready the engines, Yisha! Time to go.
(Announcing upgrades)Yisha, the Skunk is getting some shiny new upgrades. Get her ready on the double!
(Announce repairs to Yisha)Yisha, unlock the couplings. I've found an engineer to bring her up to speed!
(Announce repairs to Yisha)Good news, Yisha! An engineer is going to take a look at the Skunk. Help him out, will you?
Hello there.
Hi.
Goodbye.
See ya.
(can't converse)You seem busy.
Hold on a minute.
Wait a second.
Show me your skills, please.
Show me your wares, please.
Show me your profile, please.
Show me your licences, please.
Show me your engines, please.
Show me your shields, please.
Show me your weapons, please.
Show me your scanners, please.
I want to hire marines.
OK. I'll get some of these.
Nah.
No, I changed my mind.
OK, that's all.
Thanks. That's it.
Deal.
I'll take this.
That's it.
Give me the map.
Give me the list.
(notifications)Let's talk about this in more detail, shall we.
I'd like to discuss this matter.
Let us go over the details of this issue first.
Never mind that, do what you want.
Gotcha!
(bounty earned)Thanks!
Ka-Ching!
Easy money!
Make sure they never get their hands on our cargo!
Who do they take us for?
Get out of there as fast as you can!
Please comply with their demands.
(Discuss: Budget)About your budget...
(Retreating from interactive event)Never mind that, do what you want.
(Dicuss: Budget)Confirming budget changes.
(Threaten witness)If you know what's good for you, you'd better look the other way!(threatening)
(Threaten witness)You, erm, you'd better keep quiet! I mean, look what happened to the last guy!(Intended threat but not very threatening; a bit desperate maybe)
(Bribe witness)Look, I'm sure we can settle this peacefully.
(Relieving pilot)I wish you all the best, maybe we'll work together some other time.
(Relieving pilot)You did a fine job but everything in this world has to end, goodbye!
(Keeping pilot)Hold on a minute Pilot! There's still plenty of work to do, we'll drop by and pick you up.
(Keeping pilot)Don't be so hasty Pilot! Stay where you are and we'll come and pick you up.
For this assignment, take all ships under your command with you.
(Don't take all subordinates with)This only concerns yourself.
(Refuel usecase)You can refuel along the way, Captain.
(Refuel usecase)Fill her up as soon as possible then.
You're fired!
It didn't work out, you're un-hired.
Go find a job elsewhere!
(Screen unlocked skill profile)Thank you, give me a second to take a closer look.
(Screen locked skill profile)...and I'm supposed to believe this? I don't think so.
(filter name="agricultural")Show me your agricultural goods please.
(filter name="energy")Let me see the energy cells you have in stock.
(filter name="food")Let me have a look at your food supplies.
(filter name="fuel")Show me available fuel cells.
(filter name="gases")Let's have a look at your range of gaseous products.
(filter name="hightech")I'd like to see all the gadgetry you have.
(filter name="ice")Got some frozen water? Or maybe some ice?
(filter name="minerals")I'm interested in minerals, please show them.
(filter name="missiles")Got some quality missiles on display?
(filter name="pharmaceutical")Show me your meds if you don't mind.
(filter name="refined")Show me your best refined goods.
(filter name="shieldgenerators")A shield generator. That's what I need.
(filter name="shiptech")Show me some good shiptech.
(filter name="turrets_standard")Let me see your assortment of turrets.
(filter name="turrets_advanced")I'd like to see turrets that pack a really good punch.
(filter name="weapontech")I wish to see some tactical system components.
(filter name="water")Water please.
(Trade)OK. I'll take some of these.
(Trade)Nah.
(Trade)Never mind that.
(Trade)Well, maybe some other time.
(Trade)OK. That's it.
(Trade)Thanks. That's it.
(Trade)Deal.
(Trade)I'll take this.
(Trade)That's it.

(Ask for illegal goods)Show me the good stuff!("good" needs to be pronounced so that it becomes the prevalent word in this sentence, it is meant to distinguish between regular, boring wares and these exciting and valuable goods.)

(Ask for illegal goods)I came here looking for...specialities.("specialities" needs to be stressed, has to sound ominous, must be clear that "illegal goods" is its implicit meaning and that the speaker feels clever about substituting that with "specialities", there also needs to be a dramatic pause where the triple-period is)
(Ask for repairs)My 'Pride' needs some repairs.
(Ask for repairs)My ship was damaged, can you do something about it?
(Ask for repairs)Show me what you can do for my ship.
(Ask for particular repairs)The hull could probably use some care.
(Ask for particular repairs)I'd like the engines to live another day.
(Ask for particular repairs)A broken gun is no good, it'll need attention.
(Ask for particular repairs)I need my shields to be at their best.
(Ask for particular repairs)The Jump Drive needs some tinkering.
(Ask for particular repairs)I guess a complete overhaul should do the trick.
(Ask for particular repairs)There're some delicate systems in need of repair.
(PC: 5004)Begin and let me know if you encounter any problems.
I want you to mine something elsewhere.
(Not Spoken)Chapter 0 lines
(introduction scene, to Yisha's escape pod)Yes, I hear you.
There's a docking port on the port side.
(concerned, meeting Yisha)Hey, are you all right?
How'd you end up in that pod?
I checked. You were the only ship out there.
We can head for the nearest station but it'll take a while. This ship's not in the best shape.
If this is some elaborate plot to steal my ship, you should have waited until I finished repairs.
(introduction)Ren Otani.
You know your ships. I found it dumped not too far from here. I've been trying to restore it.
And some joker thought it would be funny to recode its ID to "Albion Skunk".
I think there's a docking port here... but I'm not sure if it's working.
Hehe... Not quite destroyed yet. I think I have an update for this encyclopedia entry.
Hmm...(clicking around)
Yeah yeah... Heard it all before...
(Not Spoken)Chapter 1 lines
You an engineer?
Can't help you there. I was out here looking for a replacement high-gain transmitter. It's probably best if we head to a station.
We'll get going after I warm up the engines a bit.
(after klaxon)Sorry about that. She does that sometimes. It's only some PMC ships exiting the highway.
Almost ready.
Yeah, they've never worked. Something to do with...(cut short)
What the hell was that for? Those were Plutarch security ships! You don't just pull off a burn like that in their faces!
She told me she was with the Heart of Albion. Sounds pretty respectable.
How did you do that?
She's been like this since I found her.
How about we get you to that station.
So, did you manage to contact anyone?
Sure. Given how well the Skunk is performing it's the least I can do.
Nothing stable. The odd job here and there. More to keep me busy than make money.
My father worked for Plutarch Mining Corporation for many years.
Seeing how stressed he became, I don't think corporate life is for me.
He's gone now but he left me enough that I can choose what I want to do.
This is Ren Otani. Yes, she's here.
I'm sorry but I have to say I'm confused. You want her to stay here?
So now what?
I have a freighter parked up not too far away. How about we head there and you explain what this is all about.
So, I assume this has something to do with the constant trouble Heart of Albion is getting into with Plutarch.
I'm starting to think Borman didn't pay me enough.
And then Plutarch came to power after the gates shutdown. You should be happy Plutarch even tolerates your group.
There she is. I can't say I've used her for trading much. Never got around to finding a crew.
No, I can't say they are. They're heading this way.
I guess they saw a ship just sitting here and thought it would be an easy steal.
Let me guess. You know just the guy.
It's a little late for that. We have company.
I don't suppose you could get the missile launcher working could you?
It's worth a shot.
(successful missile)That went better than expected.
How about we find a Defence Officer now.
This isn't a warship. We've already got guns and missiles, what else is there?
(refering to drones)It would be nice to get out of trouble from a distance.
Steady on now, I'm not a hacky-go-lucky kind of guy.
They don't have much in the way of firepower though.
The Skunk isn't exactly a small target. Against shielded targets there's only so much I can do.
Sounds like a plan.
Happy to help. A mutual friend said you needed help.
Yisha said you may have some old plasma weapons laying around.
Well, don't expect me to use them on either one of you.
Please, Captain, no need to be so formal. I'm hardly military.
I'd invite you to stay, but I fear Plutarch would put me on their most wanted list.
Are they following us?
I don't really want to start a chase.
That's quite a crowd gathering. There are some Plutarch ships approaching.
I'm taking us closer.
We're near the Jump Gate, it's open.
(comm closed abruptly)Borman?
Great, they're on us.
(Shocked)Yisha, don't!
What can you tell me about Yisha?
Thanks for the help.
Sure.
All right. Let's see what we can find.
Price isn't everything. Let's just get this done.
Let's take a look.
Not right now.
Could be worth a look.
(Yisha says something odd)What is wrong with you?
(accept help)Sure. I'd like to see someone try.
(doubt help)I doubt there's an easy fix for this thing.
I already have a combat drone.
I'm gonna take it for a test drive. Monitor the telemetry.
(Not Spoken)Chapter 2 lines
What the hell did you do that for?
This isn't what I signed on for. Why shouldn't I just turn around?
I'll put some distance between us and the gate. We'll try and talk our way out of this. Until then, try and figure out where we are.
Our gate shouldn't lead here.
Let's hope the highways point to friendly civilisation.
This is Ren Otani Captain of the Albion Skunk. Can't you just let us through? We just got here.
You make it sound like a good thing.
Get on the comm.
Just get on the comm. Tell them we're not from around here.
Doesn't look too friendly.
Can you trace it?
Keep your eyes open. He sounded friendly enough though.
This is Ren Otani. Do you need help?
We don't know what's on the other side.
Anything look familiar to you?
We're not from around here. May we dock?
Thank you for letting us dock.
I'm Ren Otani, captain of the Albion Skunk.
This is my co-pilot Yisha Tarren.
My co-pilot, Yisha Tarren, is on board.
Well, we were just out to explore, all peaceful like. We can't speak for our people but I expect we're looking for friendly relations, trade opportunities.

Maybe we can help smooth over first contact. We go back, tell our people that you're here, that you're friendly. Then we can hope to get trade lanes open, I'm sure we can supply you with whatever you need.
I think they're watching to see what we do.
You sound worried.
What the hell? She's never said that before!
What? Are you sure?
From the looks of it, neither are they.
You think we should do something?
Who are the Reivers?
Who are you people?
And the ships out there patrolling the sector. Some of them look, well, Terran.
There are some war vets back home but it's just history to most now.
She sure can, but there's still a lot of work to be done on her.
And then?
Before we can worry about getting these goods delivered, we have to find a way safely back to Albion.
That's not much of a plan.
We'll get there as soon as we can. Let us know what we need to do.
We're sorry we couldn't do more.
Look, Nakano. We'd really like to help and to travel to and from Albion freely but it may not be possible. Plutarch's locked down the gate and we're probably on their most wanted list.
So, you think we should check out the gate area?
Me neither. OK, we'll take a look.
There could be a whole fleet on the other side!
It's a little too easy. Where do you think the bulk of the Plutarch fleet is now?
There's no one here, now what?
(surprised)Captain Borman.
What are you going to do? Start a war?
I expect Yisha wants to fight, but not me. Maybe things would be better without Plutarch but, to do that, you're going to have to fight a lot of people, pilots, crewmen.
My father worked for Plutarch, as do hundreds of others. (mildly sarcastically)You're telling me trade in slaves goes on right under their noses yet they have no idea?
What exactly do you want us to do?
If you're gonna attempt this regardless, I may as well back you up.
Before we go I'll send a data-burst of all we have on DeVries, the system through the gate. The people there are hoping for a new supply line.
They're far from defenceless.
Wow, did he just snap?
You still up for helping the Canterans or do you want to help Borman fight the good fight here?
You know Yoolis?(pronounced Yo-olis)
Only by reputation.
Try peaceful.
Ren Otani, captain of the Albion Skunk.
(defensive)It wasn't me. Some pranksters changed the...(sigh) Never mind.
Thank you very much Yoolis.
We're just happy we could help.
We're sorry we couldn't do more.
Is there anything we can trade?
Thank you for answering our questions.
Other supplies?
These are some basic supplies. Are these all you need?
Thanks, but that's all we need for now.
Thanks for answering our questions.
You just called this place a war zone.
Upload the info to the computer. If it looks like we could make a difference, we will try our best.
Just put him through.

I, erm, hate to say this but, erm, well, war is around the, err, corner, as in, soon - know where I'm going?
Probably the best thing to do is to get ready for war. It's never wrong to be prepared, right?
I recommend getting ready for a rough time.
I, erm, recommend, you know, getting ready and all. War is coming and so forth.
If you own a ship, I suggest you buy the best weapons you can get your hands on and stock up on ammunition just to be sure.
If you've got a ship, make sure to fit it with the best available weapons and plenty of ammo.
If you won a, you know, a ship or so, just max out up the weaponry. Do you, erm, understand?
If I were you I'd try and hoard as many food supplies as I could. You never know, you might need them.
I suggest you grab all the food supplies you can get your hands on.
You, erm, you should take loads of food for, erm, for yourself. Like all you can carry, right?
To be safe I'd recommend staying aboard the biggest, baddest capital ship you can find. They tend to hold out the longest when things go bad.
I suggest you find a berth on some scary capital ship.
You, err, well, you can always park yourself on some, you know, big bad capital ship?
All things considered and despite how you feel about it, I - love - war. It's the best thing in the world. The excitement, the explosions, such great fun!
Hey, come on, we'll all make it through, won't we? We always do, that's how tough we are, ain't that so?
Hey, come on, you'll make it through - you're a survivor, aren't you?
