You'll make it through, erm, well, probably, err, maybe, I mean, why wouldn't you?
On the other hand, the enemy is strong this time, like, really strong, you might really not make it this time. No, actually I'm sure you'll go down this time - I won't.(cold assessment)
Instead of worrying over some possible conflict, you should cherish the life you've got instead; it might be over soon.
Cherish the life you have while you still have it.
You, erm, well, you should probably, err, you know, cherish life and such, like, when you still have one.
I think it might be safest for you to flee the area. This sector won't be the place to be.
You can always just flee the area, you know?
Well, erm, you could always, you know, like, flee and cower in fear elsewhere, right?
You wouldn't be referring to Holo-dancers, would you?
Well, those dancers sure are a sight for sore eyes, I certainly appreciate their curves!
The beauty of those constructs is undeniable.
They, erm, they sure are beautiful, those dancers, aren't they?
Their proportions sure are delicious but they're only illusions.
Holos look sweet but they aren't real.
Their, erm, their curves and all, well, it's beautiful but, well, they're just holos.
They have those holo-morganas up just to keep customers in for longer. They're like fancy furniture, only for show.
These holo-dancers, they're just for show, like posh furniture.
The furniture, erm, I mean these women, erm, holograms, whatever, they're just for show, aren't they?
I'd choose real company over some synthetic imitation any time, it's more rewarding too!
I'd prefer a real partner to any holographic one.
I'm more into real people, like, you know, with real curves and such, the real deal, not these, erm, these, err, imitations?
Well, instead of just holo-dancers I'd rather discuss the whole of VR. You seemed upset about it all, right?
Let's talk about general virtual reality instead of just holo-dancers.
I, erm, I'd rather, you know, discuss VR in general, huh, what do you say? Would you like that?
I think VR, in general, is a good thing. It has many useful applications.
I think VR is, in general, a good thing.
VR is, erm, it's good, I guess, in general at least. Right?
In space there's very little room so, you could argue, with VR we can feel like we're less confined.
In VR we can experience what we lack here in reality: spacious living-space.
We, erm, we can simulate space with it, like, erm, living quarters with, you know, more space.
Although complete virtualisation is said do be risky, it also holds tremendous potential.
Complete virtualisation can have tremendous benefits too.
Virtualising ourselves can, well, it can lead to significant improvements like, I don't know, .. something?
If we were to virtualise I guess we should arrange for some way to still interact with the outside world. Maybe have some proxy agents or so?
If we were to virtualise we'd have to arrange for a way to still interact with the outside.
If we, erm, well, if we virtualise, like, everybody, then, well, we'd have to have somebody, erm, to reach out to the outside or so.
I think VR, in many cases, is a bad thing. It's being abused a lot, lots of missed opportunities.
I think VR isn't that useful, in fact it's actually a bad thing.
VR, huh? Erm, well, yeah, I guess it's bad, can't exactly say why but I feel it's, you know, bad.
You can easily fall for the sweet illusions and forget your real life which goes down the drain as a result.
You can easily get lost or trapped in a VR environment, you lose your grip on reality.
You can, erm, you can like, erm, lose it? Your grip on reality I mean. It's easy once you, err, once you're into VR.
It is said that civilisations that virtualise often tend to stagnate and eventually perish, according to theory.
Entire civilisations have perished after completely virtualising themselves.
Virtualising, well, I bet quite a few civilisations didn't get past that. I can imagine they eventually, you know, like, perished and so on.
If we were completely virtualised we'd be blind and helpless if anything happened outside. We'd be vulnerable beyond measure!
Being completely virtualised would leave us completely vulnerable to outsiders.
If we went completely virtual, well, it'd mean that we couldn't help but be, you know, helpless against outside influences!
Oh well, in the end, isn't everything real? I'm not sure there even is such thing as 'virtual', it's virtually impossible!
Actually, I believe everything is actually real and nothing is virtual.
If something exists, doesn't that make it real? I mean, even virtual things exist in a way, right? So it's not really virtual, am I right?
Hmm...to be completely honest, I don't know a damn thing about all this, are you sure you're not overrating VR? Maybe it's all in your head?
Come to think of it, how dare you question technological advance? What century do you live in, are you some kind of ignorant troglodyte or something?(upset)
You know, since then, there've been more advancements!
The new jumpdrives are really something, right? They've made some awesome advancements in that field.
The new jumpdrives are awesome too.
Those new jumpdrives, they're really, erm, I guess they're, erm, new.
Instead of targeting the gates that shut down they now have dedicated beacons in each sector to lock on to!(amazed)
The new jump beacons are so cool, no need for gates to lock on to.
With the new beacons, errm, those jump beacons I mean, with them they, well, they needn't lock onto gates any more.
The Unfocused Jump Drive often damaged the jumping ship, with the beacons now in place we don't run that risk!
The UFJD could damage a jumping ship, beacons avoid that risk.
The beacons eliminate the, erm, the risk of, you know, frying your systems with the UFJD.
Advancements in booster technologies now allow for extended use of boosters without the need for extra fuel!
Boosters are much more efficient nowadays.
Boosters are, well, erm, they're so much more powerful or, erm, rather more efficient, I guess.
Self-sufficient boosters are now standard issue for all capital ships, that's a significant leap in mobility!
All capital ships nowadays have boosters fitted to their engines.
Capital ships, erm, they're boosting a lot nowadays, that's, err, that's kind of new.
With Jonferson's awesome new Matter/Antimatter engines, space traffic has received a good boost.
Jonfersons's M/AM Drive revolutionised space traffic.
This technological marvel, the M/AM Drive, erm, well, it's quite awesome, don't you think?
I'm still in the dark about how this in-situ antimatter aggregation for the M/AM Drive works.
I still don't know how the antimatter is made on the fly.
How, I mean, how exactly does all the Antimatter even get there? It's, erm, cool, kind of, but I don't get it.
All this mumbo-jumbo about it being technology, it's not! In reality it's magic passed down to Jonferson from a higher being! That's how it works, I know!(zealotish)
There's been an explosion in close-range traffic up to the point we see the mass-traffic nowadays. That wasn't there half a century ago I guess.
There's a lot more station-bound space-traffic today.
I don't know, I, erm, I don't remember there being this much traffic around stations when I was little.
Highways haven't been around for more than maybe thirty years, right? Also they're still being expanded.
The highway network is growing larger each year.
Highways, erm, well, they're somewhat new, been around for some time now but, yeah. They're still constructing new ones every so often, aren't they?
The most impressive highways are the super-sized ones connecting entire sectors to one another.
The Superhighways are the most impressive ones.
Superhighways are really great, erm, I mean, grand, and, erm, they're awesome. Know what I'm saying?
Hey, I'm glad you're noticing our efforts!
The road has been rough so far, but we're going to make sure we continue to pave the way.
We've been working hard to achieve this. If we all do our parts, DeVries is going to be back on track in no time.
We, erm, yeah, we've been working hard, all to make you happy...and our accounts as well. Maybe not in that particular order though.
We had to go step-by-step from importing all assets in-system in the beginning, to the self-sufficient agriculture and mining operations today.
First we had to import pretty much everything from Albion but now we're managing without it. That's great.
We had to bring our own stuff first, now we own stuff here which means we needn't bring stuff because it's kind of already here and, erm, yeah, that's it.
Going by our numbers, we expect this entire operation to start to bear fruit shortly after construction is finished
We expect the first major profits to come in soon after construction.
We, erm, we're expecting, erm, well our statistics indicate that, erm, that we can make money off this whole business like, erm, soon.
The reason I'm doing all this is money. Money rules the world and I won't let Plutarch reap what I sow ever again!(unneccessarily hard, scary, wicked)
It makes my heart swell seeing this system move into a brighter future now.
I'm happy this system is finally getting a move on.
I feel, erm, happy? Yes! I, err, guess I, erm, I do feel happy indeed!
In the future we may grow our operations even more, that's more everything for everyone!
In the future we may achieve even more!
Well, in the, erm, future, our operations, err, they will grow I guess.
Sorry to say this but, what did you actually do to further our cause? Huh? You should be out there working, but instead you're slacking in here like a parasite!
I'd like to express my utmost gratitude towards you Canterran people for enabling us even to get this far.
I want to say thanks to you Canterrans too, I couldn't have done it alone.
I, erm, I guess I should thank you guys, erm, you know, for letting us do our thing and, erm, helping and such.
With the new infrastructure in place, trade will once more flourish in DeVries!
The new infrastructure is good for the economy.
The, erm, the infrastructure, erm, the new one I mean, well, it's good for the, erm, the economy and all that.
So you've seen the broadcast?
Well, as a matter of fact I am partially to blame for releasing the material, I can tell you more if you like.
Well, as it stands I'm partly responsible for the material's release.
Ehurm. Actually I was the one broadcasting the whole thing, well, I, err, we, me and my partner, we hacked the network!
You see, there was evidence that Plutarch secretly and indiscriminately abducted people to make them slaves.
Plutarch abducted people to enslave them.
Erm, Plutarch did, err, they, erm, they abducted people. Who knows what became of them! Probably they're slaves.
There was evidence of Plutarch forcing large numbers of people to work in some sort of encampments.
Plutarch runs labour camps and forces people to work there.
The PMC runs a wide-spread slave-business, as in like, slaves, camps and forced labour and all that kind of thing.
The most incredible scenes were taken from surveillance camera footage of a mining operation. People actually died in there.
Some of the most disturbing footage showed people dying in some sort of mining complex.
Some footage, erm, I think it was taken from, erm, surveillance cameras or something, it, ehurm, it shows dead people, heaps of them.
There were a few scenes showing scientists shoving bizarre apparatus probes into screaming subjects. I've no idea what they were up to.
We had footage of some weird experimentation on living Argons too, but we didn't get to send it.
They, they did things to people, nasty things, like, I don't know, putting machinery in them and so on. Really weird stuff.
As fate has it, I do happen to know the source of all this evidence, in case you're curious.
I know the source of all this evidence.
I, erm, I happen to know where it, you know, where it all came from, the source so to say(conspicious).
Ever heard of the 'Heart of Albion'? Well, now you have. They worked hard for years to collect what was shown in the broadcast.
It was the 'Heart of Albion' who provided the evidence that we broadcast.
The, erm, the HOA, Heart of Albion is behind the evidence, I mean, they found it all out, they, erm, they didn't do any of the bad stuff.
I knew all along what Plutarch was up to of course, I just didn't think it was worth mentioning to the public until now. I didn't think it was important.
There were records and live recordings of political killings. These were obviously carried out by PMC operatives too.
The PMC had people assassinated for their political orientation.
There were records, records of political assassinations, like, documents and, erm, proof-of-kill pictures and, erm, short clips and such.
As an all-time low they also trade slaves, they sell them to the rich and powerful and they accept it as normal!
They trade slaves with powerful people, these people are equally guilty!
Some people, erm, they, err, they trade slaves with the PMC back and forth, they're, erm, they're guilty too, right?
Being afraid of the bad robots I see?
The corporations and us, we're working hard to achieve victory for the living - and we've a plan too.
We plan on defeating the Xenon.
We, erm, we're going to win, you know? Like, total victory for the living, erm, well, at least that's the plan.
An Argon fleet is currently swatting Xenon production facilities in Maelstrom. They're making good progress.
An Argon fleet in Maelstrom is destroying Xenon production facilities.
Our brothers and sisters, erm, well, the military, they're picking off Xenon facilities in Maelstrom, like, right now!
We lost our advance fleet to the Xenon on our first attempt to map Maelstrom. This time we're prepared!
We lost the advance fleet, but this time we'll win.
We won't make the same mistakes again, like, you know, having our entire advance fleet wrecked by the Xenon and such.
The worst thing you can do now is to make a fuss about it. Instead we should all remain calm and do our part.
We should all remain calm and do our part.
We, erm, we should probably, you know, sit tight and enjoy the ride...or something like that.
Hmmm...mmmmh...Oh my, we're all going to die!....eventually.(sudden but rhythmic, mind the rhyme))
Look, I'm fighting them and so should you. All you need are some fairly big guns and you're all set.
You just need some big guns to swat some of them yourself.
You, erm, you'd just need to have, you know, guns, big guns, then, only then, you can kick their metal bottoms.
I've been fighting them, I know which guns work best on them. If you want, I can help you choose.
I can help you choose the right guns.
We, erm, should probably, you know, sit tight and enjoy the ride...or something like that.
If worst comes to worst, you could always try to make your way to DeVries or even to Albion.
Retreating to DeVries or even Albion is also an option.
Well, you could of course always run with your tail between your legs, erm, well, I hear DeVries is lovely around this time of year.
You look a bit down, friend! What happened?
Look, I can tell you people were lonely here but now the Gate to Albion is open and new friends await!
With the gate to Albion open you're no longer alone out here.
You're not, you know, alone and all, I mean, I'm here, so, maybe, others will be here too. Soon maybe.
Look, we're all stranded here in a way. Granted, you Canterans probably had it much harder than us though.
Being stranded here was certainly harder than the situation for Albion.
Well, erm, we, err, we were stranded in Albion too you know? Well, uhurm, I guess being stranded here is, eh, worse, isn't it?
I find it fascinating that you folks managed to survive in this hostile environment without even a habitable planet nearby.
Even though there is no habitable planet around you survived. That's commendable.
I, erm, I find it, well, fascinating I guess. Fascinating that you survived out here with no planet and nothing.
It's really hard to believe that the horror stories I hear around here aren't just made up stories, you know.
It's hard to believe the horror stories here aren't all made up.
I'm not so sure about those horror-stories, you know. The ones that tell of all the horrible fates around here!
I hear many of your people didn't make it, friend. You have my sincerest condolences. Albion weeps with you.
I'm told many of your folks didn't make it. I'm sorry for your losses.
I'm, erm, really sorry for your losses these past thirty years, even, erm, if you're really Terrans and all.(a little embarrassed)
So, I've heard you people originally came from Earth? What were you even doing here?
I heard you people originally came from Earth, huh?
So, I'm being told you're Terrans? You sure look like Argons though. Don't Terrans have like fangs or tentacles or something?
How about you suck it up and move on already? Things will change now, Albion is just around the corner for example.
I suggest you get over it. Things will change for the better now.
I'd say you better get over it soon, like, right now! Look, things are going to change, like, for the better and so forth, get it?
I've heard rumours, nasty rumours. Rumours of deranged people eating each other.
I've heard rumours you had cannibalism going on here.
I hear you eat people? Is that true? Do you? Did you? Erm, I mean, not you personally, just, erm, oh well, whatever!
So, about these Reivers, do you know anything about them? I hear they might be Argon ex-military or something.
I hear the Reivers might be Argon ex-military.
Those Reivers, I hear they might be, erm, like, ex-military, Argon in maybe, mmmh. Can it be true?
With those Reivers also raiding your stations I find it even more stunning that you guys pulled through the way you did. Outstanding!
I'm really impressed you've managed to survive the Reiver raids for decades.
You guys are tough, right? Living through all that, plus the Reivers who are, erm, like, constantly threatening you and all.
You're just hiding the truth, aren't you? With this many people and that little food, I can picture you gnawing on somebody's leg! Well, was it like that?(interrogating)

page.title: Falk Borman
page.t: (greeting friendly)Borman here.
(greeting neutral)Comms established.
(greeting enemy)What the heck do you want?
(greeting rejected)Buzz off.
(greeting service)How can I help?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)Look after yourselves out there!
(goodbye neutral)Borman out.
(goodbye enemy)I'm through talking.
(goodbye rejected)Just shove off.
(goodbye service)Let me know if there's anything else I can do.
(ship scanned - complicit)Scanning? Sure, why not?.
(ship scanned - neutral)I assume you have good reasons for scanning me.
(ship scanned - illegal)Your scanning will get you in a heap of trouble!
(ship scanned - enemy)Hostile scans are something that I will not tolerate!
(ship scanned - confident)Nothing to see here. I suggest that you move along.
(ship scanned - possessing)Oh that! Well, everyone picks up a few bad habits. That's quite normal isn't it?
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Let us know when you are satisfied.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Feel free to waste your own time, but don't expect me to waste mine!
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Well that should earn you a bit of unwelcome attention from the authorities.
(station/capship scanned - enemy)We really don't tolerate sneaks and busy-bodies around here!
(station/capship scanned - confident)Check the cargo hasn't all piled up while you are at it please.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Now that could cause us both a lot of paperwork. How about we just forget it happened?
(directions - location not known)So sorry but I'm not from around here.
(surrender - reject)Are you on something?
(surrender - hostile)Why would I stop for garbage like you?
(surrender - complicit)Engines powering down. Don't do anything hasty!.
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Oi! Look where you're pointing that thing!
(player attacks - neutral 1)Now why would you go and do a thing like that?
(player attacks - enemy 1)You are going to wish you hadn't done that!
(light fire 1)Someone doesn't like my paint-job!
(light fire 2)It's getting a bit warm around here!
(mid fire 1)This isn't going well!
(mid fire 2)I have picked up a bogey that I cannot shake off!
(heavy fire 1)Critical systems are in the red!
(heavy fire 2)Help me right now or it will be too late!
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(shield warning 1)Shields becoming ineffective!
(shield warning 2)My shields couldn't stop a piece of popcorn just now!
(hull warning 1)Hull damage increasing!
(hull warning 2)Time to prepare for vacuum!
(Incoming Enemies)Our adversary has shown up!
(Incoming Wave)Uh oh! Even more of them to contend with.
(Last Wave)That's the end of them if we survive this wave.
(Player Needed)Hello? We're expecting a bit of support from you over here!
(Success 1)Hurrah! That was a close call but we made it!
(Success 2)Let's tidy up here and then go celebrate!
(Fail 1)OK, that was bad, really bad!
(Fail 2)Let's see if anything at all can be salvaged from this disaster!
We've got some big issues here!
Critical readings all round!
(Falk Borman lines for chapter 1)
This is Falk Borman to the Albion Skunk. I take it you have Yisha Tarren on-board.
(#sad#)I'm sorry Yisha but we can't risk it at the moment. Captain Otani, I'm transferring some credits to your account as we speak.
I hate to be so abrupt but time is short and (#sad#)bringing Yisha on-board could potentially put her and others in danger.
I'm sure Yisha can elaborate. (#nod01#)She is currently better off with you than with us.
Consider this a passenger transport job Captain Otani. A well paid one at that. We will be in contact when this all blows over.
(#cold#)Captain Otani, Lieutenant Tarren.
(#smile#)Technically neither am I, but old habits die hard.
We've just been cleared by the Plutarch Intelligence Agency. You should be clear to come back soon.
Head back to the rendezvous location. We'll meet you there. Borman out.
(#angry#)Otani, we've been intercepted. We won't be able to make it. What's your situation?
(Falk Borman lines for chapter 2)
(#smile#)It's good to see you both. We feared the worst when we heard you'd disappeared.

Well, you're back just in time. Things became chaotic just after you left. (#disapproval01#)Plutarch began to militarise the area around the Jump Gate and there were skirmishes with civilians who went too close. We decided to act.
That's right. (#laugh#)Congratulations, you're no longer top of Plutarch's most-wanted list. Heart of Albion is indeed mobilising.

(#hard#)We will do what we have to, Otani. You may not see Plutarch as we do but that's beside the point. Albion has not been a system of the Argon Federation for decades. It's about time the people get back there again.

That's something you and Yisha can help us avoid. (#disapproval01#)Everyone needs to see what Plutarch is and what they have done. I'm sending a data-burst with all our evidence of Plutarch operations: (#sad#)slave trade, forced labour camps and assassinations. This is what we're fighting against. Do you understand now?

(#nod01#)I knew your father; he was a good man and did his job well. I doubt he had any real idea as Plutarch excels in control. (#sad#)If you posed any risk to their operations you either never got to see them or you'd disappear if you did. Otani this is not hearsay or rumour, this is hard evidence and the people must be told. It is up to you whether you want to help or not.

(smiles)(#smile#)As I said, Plutarch controls all released information. We need someone to upload the evidence to the data-net broadcast system while blocking any attempts by Plutarch to take the system down.
(#nod01#)Thank you Otani. I will review the information. (#smile#)Good luck.

Otani, Tarren. The data was in the system for a few moments but the majority was purged relatively quickly. We have teams working on disseminating the remaining fragments but that will take time and we don't know if it will have the full desired effect.

Otani, Tarren. We've started mirroring the data and people should be seeing all of it on their video-streams as we speak. Plutarch has already started pulling down relay nodes to limit the impact but enough people will have already seen it.
(#punchhand01#)Well done you two! We can see the data-packets being spread all over the network. It won't be long until everyone and their Argnu sees this!

While we wait to see the outcome, let's discuss these Terran friends of yours; the Canterans? Securing supplies and transporting them through the gate will be difficult and (#shrug01#)I don't see what they can really offer us in return. Our focus should remain here in Albion.

Right now, Albion is all that matters. (#shrug01#)If Plutarch wants to flee through the gate then let them. (#hard#)Once we deal with them here they'll be effectively finished. Go ahead and make nice with these Terrans if you think they can provide us with something of value. Just don't forget who they are and who we are fighting for. Borman out.
Otani, Tarren. (#smile#)Glad to see you both still in one piece. If Plutarch knew what you were planning you'd have a whole fleet around you at any moment now.

We will need to commit almost everything to pull this off, but I think it'll be worth it. (#nod01#)We were already looking for a suitable Plutarch target to strike and this seems to be it. This ship holds Heart of Albion supporters and agents; I suppose they are considered prisoners of war now.
I'll send you the location of our primary staging area. We're hoping to draw Plutarch forces out before we make a jump to the prison ship.
(#nod01#)You do that. You won't want to miss this. Borman out.
Otani, bring your ship in to dock. We're going to jump as soon as you're on board. Get yourselves ready for combat on arrival.
All boarding crews prepare to launch. We'll clear the path!
Watch your fire on that Prison Ship! It's taking too much damage!
Our people have control of the ship. They're preparing to jump it to a safe location. Give them cover and prepare to jump yourselves.
Damn it! She's going up. Prepare to disengage!
Prepare to jump out!
Borman to the fleet. Good job out there, we certainly gave them something to think about. I require a status update from all ships within 5 minutes. We're not sitting around for long. Borman out.

Alright people, we may not have achieved our objective but we certainly delivered a message. We've lost people today so let's hit back for them! I want all ships combat-ready in 5 minutes. Borman out.
About time you got here. (#smile#)You're damn lucky to make it back.

(#warm#)Otani, we've managed to account for most of your ships' crews. (#smile#)We've also found many missing Heart of Albion supporters. Some of them will be joining us, while others will try to secure their families' safety.
(#nod01#)I'll pass on your concerns; I'm sure they'll appreciate it. (#warm#)As for your ships, you'll get them back sooner than you think.
(#sad#)Ren, I'm sorry that it went down in that way. (#angry#)We've all lost good people today.
Alright. I know you're looking to get your ships back from Plutarch. Our next operation may just help you in doing that.

(#nod01#)Yes. It's full of ships, all barely manned, while Plutarch scours databases and logs looking for intel on us. (#shrug01#)Some ships are yours, some are Heart of Albion's and some are from unfortunate bystanders.
We'll get it done. We need those ships. Get yourselves ready for more boarding operations. We can't leave it too long.

Borman to the fleet. A few moments ago, our scouting craft confirmed our intel on the Plutarch impound area. The operation's been approved. We can expect moderate resistance with the potential to disrupt our boarding operations, so protect those pods. Prepare for the jump.
(heavy combat)(#cold#)Ships bearing down, take them out!
Skunk, board your assigned ships. We'll try to give you cover.
We have Plutarch reinforcements inbound. Continue boarding operations if possible. If not, support the fleet.
We're waiting on a ship to enable their Jump Drive. Keep with it and prepare to jump out.
(#hard#)Report!
(#hard#)Find me the source!
(#angry#)Fleet, we've marked a target. Take it out. Jump when it's done.
(#smile#)Good work everyone. Start jumping to the rendezvous.
Pull out. Start jumping to the rendezvous.
(#hard#)We have to get these ships out of here now. They could also be rigged to blow on command.
(#sad#)Well Otani, now you see how hard we'll have to fight. Plutarch is not going to make it easy for us.
(#smile#)Congratulations on getting your property back Otani. You handled yourself well out there.
We'll move on. There's a lot of space to hide in. (#shrug01#)No use sitting in one place for too long.
(#sad#)We still have many people being held and Plutarch will take this time to build up their forces. We expect their drone production will go into overdrive.

(#hard#)The war can only escalate until we disable Plutarch's ship-building operations. (#thinking01#)We may need a place for refugees to escape to. If these Canterans can help, I'm willing to expend some effort in aiding them.

For now, we have to remain on the move from Plutarch forces. We don't have the luxury of building our strength in one location. That being the case, one of our Builder-ships is at your disposal. (#shrug01#)I hope you'll be able to do some good in DeVries and without interference from Plutarch.
(#warm#)Good. You two just stay out of trouble. Borman out.
Borman here. We'll keep them busy for a while but make it through fast. We won't hold them for long.
We cannot assist. (#sad#)We're avoiding superior Plutarch forces ourselves. Give us some time then contact us again. Borman out.
(slightly down)(#sad#)Ren, Yisha. I thought I should update you on the situation in Albion. We may need Canteran help sometime soon.

(#angry#)Things are getting rough for the fleet. Our supply lines are being cut and Plutarch are getting better at chasing us down each time we jump. On top of that, many civilians are being harassed by Plutarch investigations and summary arrests.
We have people on the ground trying to get the most at-risk out from there. (#nod01#)That's where you and the Canterans come in.
(#nod01#)It's safer than anywhere in Albion, at least for now. Do you think they will be accommodating?
What you've done there must account for something. (#shrug01#)What else could we offer? I'm not looking for assistance in fighting the war, just a sanctuary for our people.

(#nod01#)I like the idea but I can only send one. Discuss this with Governor Nakano. If he gives the go-ahead, take care of the mining ship. They are there to build relations and mine ore, not to dredge up the past and get into a fight.

(#smile#)A little. People affiliated with Plutarch have started to defect. Some just want out of the fighting, others are joining us. We've set up a screening program to try and weed out any planted Plutarch agents.
(#warm#)OK, let me know if and when we can send the ship. Borman out.
Borman here. If you want to come through, now's as good a time as any. We've drawn off a few Plutarch ships.
I'm sending you our coordinates. Come and meet me here.
(welcome)Otani.
(#warm#)It's good to see you in one piece. (#sad#)We heard about the massacre in DeVries. You're lucky to be alive.

(#nod01#)Hopefully their sacrifice will mean something. The situation is changing here too. We've had many Plutarch defectors come over to our cause. (#smile#)Hell, we even had a Plutarch capship join our fleet. The Plutarch attack on a lightly-armed mining convoy hasn't helped their cause whatsoever.

The real information is out there (#shrug01#)but so are rumours and speculation. Some of our supporters already think they're arming us with Terran tech to defeat Plutarch. (#smile#)We'll set the facts straight soon enough.
(#nod01#)He'll have it. Half of our forces.

(#hard#)If DeVries will become our last bastion, we'll damn well defend it. Also, if the Canterans are to become allies we'll damn well defend them too. It will stretch our forces but with Plutarch slowly losing control, it's just a matter of lasting them out.

A distraction, a big one. Plutarch has some big project happening at the Beryll Astrotech labs. We don't know if it's a new weapon or a ship under construction. All we know is that senior Beryll scientists have gone missing while others have escaped and gone into hiding.
One has agreed to meet us. I want you and Yisha to speak to her. Find out what they're doing at Beryll labs and what we can do to stop it with minimal casualties on both sides.
(#smile#)Good. When you do, prepare yourselves for the attack. If the intel's good, the attack will commence soon after. That's when our ships will begin to move to DeVries.

This is Borman. What Kaswin told you matches intel we got from another Beryll contact. (#hard#)We're set to strike. We'll attack the station first. Once the Plutarch forces jump in, the refugees will begin to move through the gate.
That's when we split forces. You take half of the ships to the gate to defend the refugee ships. I'll take the other half to keep Plutarch busy before backing you up.
I'll send coordinates. You fly there and we'll meet you there shortly.
(#nod01#)Yeah, that's right. See you there.
(#hard#)This is the Heart of Albion attack fleet. You'd do well to stand down yourselves!
We're going for the station. Try to take out some of their defences.
We need fighter cover!
Those fighters are getting too close. Take them out!
Here they are! Plutarch ships have just jumped in. Let's keep them busy!
The civilian convoy has been given orders to move out. It's time to split. You each have your duties so get to it! Good luck.

This is Borman. Plutarch forces in Albion are now focussing around the gate and they know an attack is likely. We've hit a few of their drone facilities to slow down their deployment, but the sheer amount of their ships is almost overwhelming. We can hit them, but it will have to be now.

We have Beryll scientists on our side looking for ways to disable the automated ships but we can't afford to wait until they have a working solution. We're as ready as we can be on this side. It's all on you when we go. Borman out.
We're engaging the Plutarch forces in Albion. We'll keep you up to date.
We're being overrun!
We're taking defensive positions. We'll try to push closer to the gate once we clear this wave.
(#angry#)Not now! More Plutarch ships have just arrived. We're losing people here! Can you hold them off?
(after a question was asked)Yisha?
(#sad#)Understood. (sigh)(#hard#)Give the order and have them fall back.

We've enough firepower to keep Plutarch at bay for a while but they really don't want us through that gate. (#hard#)And I'm not leaving Albion, not yet! I'll have the fleet make a jump to a secure area.
Otani, give the order and lead the way! (#hard#)More drones have shown up and we're getting ready to jump. We'll try to make contact shortly. Borman out!
Just a little longer.
Most of your crews seem very eager to be discharged and to get back to their ships.
It's an ongoing operation but (#shrug01#)at least we distracted Plutarch for a while.
Sorry, Otani. I have to go and coordinate the movements of these ships. Lay low until we contact you.
Otani, your ships are recovered and the crews are safe. I'm transferring control over to you now.
Otani, your ship is recovered and the crew is safe. I'm transferring control over to you now.
Stand by. We're getting new info.
Argon forces, this is Captain Falk Borman. Can we render assistance?
No ma'am. Plutarch have their hands full in Albion. The Xenon have interfaced with half of their tech. Plutarch is losing control, fast.
But the Xenon kept coming. We knew we had to stop them at source.
Yes ma'am.
We've got missiles incoming.
We're still not clear of Xenon yet.
Are you sure that's the last of the Xenon stations?
Admiral, we need you in Albion and DeVries. You can't afford another war on two fronts.
Ren, Yisha, you may want to return to Albion. Plutarch is on the fall but the Xenon are rapidly becoming a huge problem.
With the resources and technology outside of Maelstrom, we risk them replicating and spreading even further.
We have the Beryll scientists working on it, but a solution seems far. All we can do is destroy any we see.
Yes ma'am.
Otani, Tarren, I hope you continue to support the efforts against the Xenon in Albion. We need people like you.

page.title: Pedro Nakano
page.t: (greeting friendly)Greetings.
(greeting neutral)I hear you.
(greeting enemy)Given the circumstances, what can you want?
(greeting rejected)Nothing you have to say is of interest to me.
(greeting service)Is there something I can help with?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)Keep in touch!
(goodbye neutral)Farewell.
(goodbye enemy)Glad to see the back of you!
(goodbye rejected)Keep your goodbyes to yourself!
(goodbye service)Always at your service.
(ship scanned - complicit)Sure you can scan, but keep it brief please.
(ship scanned - neutral)Not one for proper introductions first, are you!
(ship scanned - illegal)Well that scan breaks umpteen laws round here.
(ship scanned - enemy)That looks like the opening move in a fight!
(ship scanned - confident)Scan away, there's nothing to find.
(ship scanned - possessing)That is awkward. Er, let's talk about compromise here.
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Scan if you wish.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)You know asking first never hurts.
(station/capship scanned - illegal)That, my friend, is an offence in these parts.
(station/capship scanned - enemy)Now you know just how outmatched you are for what's coming next.
(station/capship scanned - confident)Let me know when you want to say sorry for the unnecessary bother.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Right, I'll find the guilty party and make them sorry. So can we move along?
(directions - location not known)Sorry, my charts are a bit scrambled.
(surrender - reject)Repeat that joke and I'll lose my sense of humour!
(surrender - hostile)Are you really sure you want a load of grief right now?
(surrender - complicit)Yeah, no problems. Let's keep thing cool.
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Watch where your shots end up please.
(player attacks - neutral 1)That was pretty careless of you. Please think next time!
(player attacks - enemy 1)That makes me really see red!
(light fire 1)Uh oh! Duty target time again.
(light fire 2)They are getting a bit better at this shooting lark!
(mid fire 1)Now why can't they just leave me alone?
(mid fire 2)I seem to be a bullet magnet at the moment!
(heavy fire 1)This is some serious damage I'm taking!
(heavy fire 2)At this rate of incoming fire, I won't survive for long!
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(shield warning 1)Shields overloaded!
(shield warning 2)My shields are disappearing!
(hull warning 1)Hull taking sustained damage now!
(hull warning 2)This ship will be debris any moment now.
(Incoming Enemies)Ah, the enemy have just arrived!
(Incoming Wave)Sigh, we're not done yet. Here's another lot!
(Last Wave)Well if we outlive this final lot we can still save the day.
(Player Needed)Much as we hoped to cope without you, we need you here now!
(Success 1)Great! That saw them off; this time at least.
(Success 2)Take a break pilots. We have secured a victory here at least.
(Fail 1)That is what defeat feels like.
(Fail 2)Get some help here, let's salvage what we can
We are facing all sorts of failures here.
That's not good! We could be spacewalking soon.
(Pedro Nakano - Governor of the Republic of Cantera colony. In his early 50s. Patient and cautious. An eventual ally of the player.)
(Nakano Chapter 2)
This is Governor Nakano. You have been granted permission to land so please follow our directions. I will be there to meet you.
(#hard#)Unknown vessel. We have target-lock on your ship. Identify yourselves.
Defence ships have been dispatched. You are granted permission to dock but I caution you about doing anything that might be taken for a threat. I will be there to meet you. Nakano, out.
Welcome to our home. (#crossarms01#)I am Governor Pedro Nakano.
Pleased to meet you.
Thank you for aiding our freighter. Reiver space can be unforgiving if you are not prepared.
Now, I would like to know where you have come from. There is no record of your ship in our database and you sure don't act like Reivers.
That's an incredible claim. (#punchhand01#)If true, this is momentous day. It leads me to ask why you are here and the intentions of your people.
(#nod01#)Ah, so the Plutarch Mining Corporation still exists. (#thinking01#)As I recall we 'acquired' some of their components and designs in the years before the gates shut down.

Nor is the situation here that simple. I must converse with the council. (#gesticulate03#)Meanwhile I'll have Karen Stringer speak to you. She is the head of industry and can answer any of your questions about likely trade. I'm sure she'll be happy to tell you about our history, stations and ships. Just let me say that you are indeed among friends and are welcome here.

Thank you for your help with this matter. It is very rare for the Reivers to be so bold and we were caught unawares. This event was an utter tragedy. None of the crew has been located and we believe them lost along with their ship.
Your ship can only do so much in battle but maybe there is another way you can really help us.

With the possibility of the gates reopening, we can no longer be content with idling in our corner of this system. (#angry#)Our stations are in disrepair with an enemy that is unafraid to attack and pillage whenever they please. We must start to rebuild and expand our infrastructure and defences. (#nod01#)You, and Albion your system, could provide the means for us to do that.
It is up to you to decide. (#warm#)If you help us to rebuild we will be able to make our bit of space a safe haven for you and your people.
For now, I must attend to more current events. Good luck in whatever you decide to do.
This is an unexpected surprise! I don't think I can thank you enough.
There are some more things you can help us with.
We could really use a means to construct new stations.
We have been unable to maintain our infrastructure to any great degree. If you could obtain the means to repair and replace our station components, we would be most grateful!
We have seen several. They are usually way-stations for raiding Reiver parties and their stolen freighters. They are usually very well-guarded.
Again you surprise me. If this is true I will converse with the council again. It would be a welcome change of pace to perform such a raid of our own.
Of course. I'm sure you could take some of the spoils if you aid us. Please first let me prepare the way. Nothing this bold has been suggested in over two decades.
Otani, Tarren. The mission has been given the go-ahead and a task-force is being formed to raid the depot. If you wish to join them the time is right now.

This is Nakano to the Albion Skunk. There is some kind of disturbance in another sector. We already have ships on the way but it appears that Plutarch is involved. We would be grateful if you could also render assistance.
This is Nakano. What the hell happened here?
But why? We have no involvement in your conflict. What can we do now?

We appreciate all that your people have done for us and you remain welcome here. From what you have told us, that gives Plutarch enough reason to attack us. I must discuss our situation with the council. I would appreciate it if you could talk with your people and see if they can spare ships to help secure our space.

This is Governor Nakano with a sector-wide alert. Reiver raiding parties are reported approaching some of our stations. Everything we know about the Reiver threat will be made widely available. Avoid the at-risk areas until security ships have completed their patrols.

Hello again. (#smile#)I've had word that you aggressively attacked Reiver forces. While I thank you for your continued assistance, (#cold#)I must also warn you that a sensitive situation is developing. A freighter has been hijacked by Reivers and the crew's lives put at risk. Please do not engage them.

(#disapproval01#)We've never managed to negotiate with Reivers. We will simply block their movements, hit key systems, yet leave a way for their boarding crews to escape. Hopefully, they will take it.
Our rearguard attack group is protection against Reiver reinforcements while our elite unit attempts to secure the crew's safety. (#shrug01#)You are free to aid the rearguard if you wish.
(#smile#)And you stay safe.
Greetings to you both. I wanted to extend the gratitude of myself and my people for what you are doing for us.

I have not forgotten your offer of an alliance between our two peoples, but the council remains undecided on that issue. We simply do not know enough about you or your situation to offer a decision. I hope you understand.
I'll have a data-burst prepared containing our most pressing needs.
Please let me know when there is something more we can help you with.
Thank you again. Nakano out.
There are some more things you can help us with.
We could really use a means to construct new stations.

As you know, we have been unable to maintain our infrastructure properly. Having the means to repair and replace our station components would be great start in addressing this and would earn much gratitude from the council.
This is Nakano. (#warm#)Ah, Ren, Yisha! I was to call you today regarding your recent exploits in our space.

We're a little unaccustomed to stations popping up out of nowhere almost overnight. I'm glad to see you Argon haven't lost your enterprising spirit. (#smile#)It's caused some new optimism around here.

Hmm. I expect this mining ship you're speaking of is probably much larger and more capable than anything we have left. I'm inclined to accept but (#thinking02#)why not take this even further? We can send what remains of our mining fleet to accompany your ship. This can be our first official joint-operation.
I must know something first. What do you aim to accomplish here? Why is Borman now committed to improving relations between our peoples? (#lookdown01#)Is the war going badly for you?

I see. (#nod01#)As I have said, your people are welcome but we do not have the means to support a large increase in population, nor do we want to take sides in another's war. While we may support you more than Plutarch, (#hard#)we hardly want to join in the war.

I will organise a flight plan. Your ship can jump into a relatively safe area but you should scout ahead on the way to the asteroid field. Our mining ships will also have escorts which can help to secure the route.
This is Nakano. Do you read?
(#hard#)We have unknown ships moving through our sector. They may be Plutarch drones or scouts. They're heading your way.
(#hard#)We don't want to risk it bringing us into your war.
(worried)(#hard#)Not long at all. They're heading straight for you, as if they know exactly where they're going.

(#cold#)Do what you have to but, for now, get a move on. (#shrug01#)You may keep ahead out of their sensor range. I do agree that the Heart of Albion ship should pull back. I'm sending jump coordinates. These should put you in a safe area until this is over.
They're in your sector.
Response fighters are on their way. Hold on!
(concerned)(#sad#)Albion Skunk, we can't raise most of our ships. How many are with you?
(sigh)(#sad#)Understood. Ships are on their way.
(#gesticulate01#)Thank you for returning so promptly. This is a difficult time and we have some urgent questions.
(no survivors)(#sad#)None at all.
(#angry#)Did your people know that Plutarch would send scouts into our space?

(#gesticulate03#)Could they have been tracking your mining ship? They seemed to know exactly where to go. (#shrug01#)Maybe one of your people wanted us to be attacked and be dragged into your conflict.
You may well get an ally in the war. (#cold#)After this incident, any Plutarch ships in our space will be warned and then attacked if they do not withdraw.
I was hoping our new friends, Heart of Albion, would help defend our space, especially now with their refugees in our care.

(#nod01#)For the short term it would be mutually beneficial until we get our infrastructure to full strength. (#gesticulate04#)When our ship construction capabilities are fully restored we will be able to defend ourselves against anything Plutarch can throw at us.
(#gesticulate01#)We will make do. Please extend our offer to Captain Borman and give him my comms frequency should he ever need to contact me directly.
This is governor Nakano to the Heart of Albion fleet. (#smile#)On behalf of the Canteran people, welcome to DeVries.
We will begin transmitting navigation and logistics information to each of you shortly. Please follow the instructions carefully.
(#smile#)I'm glad to see you made it.
(#sad#)We have medical staff standing by.

Lieutenant Tarren. Am I right in saying that you are one of the most senior Heart of Albion officers here? (#warm#)I would like to invite you to take part in an official ceremony where we declare our alliance and the friendship between our peoples.
(#smile#)I would very much like it to be you. I am happy that you both found us first.
(#nod01#)I will, but (#hard#)first we must secure our space and get your people settled. Nakano out.

(Speech)We are here today, two peoples with a common past, to reaffirm that which we both share. Cut off from the lives we once knew, we have grown into our own peoples and, from that, comes this forging of new alliances.
I stand here proud to say that the Republic of Cantera is ready to declare its first official bond of friendship in our short history.

The Heart of Albion, of Argon descent, share our values and history. Our people were once at war but I believe that time has passed. We shall use the resources at our disposal to secure our joint influence in this new universe. Now may I present Lieutenant Yisha Tarren of the Heart of Albion.

Otani, Tarren. I have news from our scouts. Plutarch are increasing their grip of the gate. The main structure is both for defence of the gate and to refuel their ships. It looks like they soon want to push outwards from there. I think we're almost out of time.
We'll have to be. If we wait any longer no amount of drones will make a dent in them.
Yes. We intercepted this message. Patching it through.
Hardly any at all. If they see the force coming they'll just get out of the way.
Agreed. I'll coordinate with the fleet.

This is Nakano. The time has come for us to come together and push forward. Each wing has been given a task to perform in the coming battle. Our allies in Albion will also push towards the Jump Gate and will meet us for the assault on the Plutarch station.
Now take up your designated formations and prepare for departure. Smaller ships will move out first and meet up with the capital ships after they have jumped.
Fortune be with you.
Take out that capship!
Focus on the station.
Deploy the combat drones!
They have reinforcements.
(#punchhand01#)Primary objective achieved!
(#angry#)They're heading into our lines. Stop them!
This is Nakano to the rearguard. We need more ships to support the operation to secure the hijacked ship.
Otani, Tarren. You're free to follow their lead. We would greatly appreciate any help.
This is Nakano. The situation is dire. We greatly require assistance with securing the hijacked ship.
We can't allow them to jump. Take out their Jump Drive!
We will try to board the ship. Please aid the boarding crews.
Please, avoid damaging the hull.
The Reivers are attacking the ship! Stop them!
Very good. Secure the ship and prepare the crew to be evacuated.
(#smile#)Thank you both for your efforts. (#nod01#)We all owe you a debt of gratitude.
Still, I hope you will accept this token of our appreciation. We can have one of our freighters assigned to assist you in any way possible.
(#sad#)The ship is lost. Dispatch search and rescue teams.
Otani, I will have a freighter assigned to assist you. (#sad#)Please scour the area for survivors or cargo for the freighter to salvage.

Thank you for your help with this matter. It is very rare for the Reivers to be so bold and we were caught unawares. This event was a real tragedy. None of the crew have been located and we believe they were lost along with their ship.
You and your ship can only do so much in a battle but maybe there is another way you can aid us.
Otani. We've had a distress call from a Heart of Albion station. You should check it out; make sure that Plutarch isn't causing trouble there.
I will send coordinates for your mining ship.
Please, feel free to wander around.
I look forward to getting to know you better.
Good to see you, Otani.
Captain Otani, (#cold#)there is a sensitive situation developing with a freighter hijacked by Reivers. The crew's lives are at risk. Please keep your distance.
Otani, not all our ships have made it back. Some of them may have jumped to a Jump Beacon in another sector.
Let us hope this venture ends in victory this time.
We shall help secure the perimeter.

page.title: Karen Stringer
page.t: (greeting friendly)Hey there.
(greeting neutral)Comms channel open.
(greeting enemy)Yes? What do you want?
(greeting rejected)I don't want to talk to you.
(greeting service)How can I help?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)Good luck out there!
(goodbye neutral)Goodbye.
(goodbye enemy)Whatever. Don't come back.
(goodbye rejected)I don't want to talk to you ever again.
(goodbye service)Glad to have been of service.
(ship scanned - complicit)Sure, scan away.
(ship scanned - neutral)Why are you scanning me?
(ship scanned - illegal)Oi! You can't just scan my ship!
(ship scanned - enemy)Did you think you could scan me and just get away with it?
(ship scanned - confident)You won't find anything here.
(ship scanned - possessing)Err, I have a perfectly legal permit for that, somewhere.
(station/capship scanned - complicit)You're clear to scan.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)We've detected your scanning. We'd prefer if you asked first.
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Your illegal scanning activities are being reported.
(station/capship scanned - enemy)You should know that we really don't like spying!
(station/capship scanned - confident)Whatever you're after, you won't find it here.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Fine, you found something. So what are you going to do about it?
(directions - location not known)Sorry, I've no idea where that is.
(surrender - reject)Hah! That's a good one!
(surrender - hostile)I don't like threats. Now let's see if you like them!
(surrender - complicit)OK, OK! Standing down.
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Hey! Watch the friendly-fire.
(player attacks - neutral 1)What do you think you're playing at?
(player attacks - enemy 1)You're gonna pay for that!
(light fire 1)Woah, under fire!
(light fire 2)Under attack!
(mid fire 1)Could use some help here!
(mid fire 2)This guy's not going away!
(heavy fire 1)Don't know how much more I can take!
(heavy fire 2)I really need some help here!
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(shield warning 1)Shields near critical!
(shield warning 2)Shields weakening!
(hull warning 1)Hull breach!
(hull warning 2)Hull integrity threatened!
(Incoming Enemies)Here they come!
(Incoming Wave)Another wave on the way. Stay alert!
(Last Wave)This should be the last of them.
(Player Needed)Where are you? We're getting torn to shreds!
(Success 1)Alright! I didn't think we'd make it through that!
(Success 2)Everyone stand down, we made it. I guess next time they'll think twice!
(Fail 1)We got trampled on, big time.
(Fail 2)I really need an Engineer and a Medic, right now!
We've got serious problems here!
The reactor's overloading!
(#warm#)You must be Ren.
(#warm#)You must be Ren and Yisha.
Nakano sent word that you'd be arriving, (#smile#)but we didn't expect all the fireworks.

We're fine. We have damage-assessment crews on-site but we don't think anyone was in that section. (#disapproval01#)The Reivers like to steal our produce so normally they try not to damage our stations too much. (#angry#)This is the worst damage they've done for months.

(#shrug01#)We don't really know for sure. (#disapproval01#)They act like the bogey-men of DeVries; prone to shooting first and perhaps snarling threats later. Most here think them pirates who happened to be stranded here alongside us.

(#sad#)We've never been at peace, if that's what you're asking. Sometimes they pass by without firing, probably when they themselves can't afford to fight. It's been like that for decades. (#angry#)They've never seemed interested in negotiating.
We're members and descendants of a mining operation called Operation Cantera from before the gates shut down. Soon after the shutdown we collectively decided to form the Republic of Cantera.

(#facepalm01#)I see Nakano left out that crucial detail. Yes, we are Terrans from Earth. From what Nakano told me, you're most likely to be Argon. No need to worry, this was just a mining outpost and we're not packing Valhalla-class destroyers here. (#smile#)Personally, I look forward to getting to know you better. (#shrug01#)Barring the Reivers, you're the first aliens I've ever met.
I doubt it will bother anyone here, we're just colonists. Most of us have never seen an 'Argon' before. (#shrug01#)For all we know the war could have ended when the gates shut down.
That said, (#sad#)some of us did lose people on the Torus (#shrug01#)but I expect people suffered losses where you're from too.
(#nod01#)Let's hope it stays that way.

(#nod01#)For now, yes. (#gesticulate01#)We're working decades-old infrastructure which is failing. We need industrial materials for repairs as well as general supplies for the population. Recent Reiver raids have put a lot of strain on our stocks.

(#shrug01#)We have defence ships, mostly re-purposed mining ships. Our main defence is in sticking close together. We have little need to venture out of our sector but, when we do, we try to do so in strength.
(#smile#)Anyway, thanks again for your help defending the station. (#nod01#)Your ship looks like it can hold its own in a fight.
Any chance you could make use of a Terran shield generator? We've not got enough ships left to install all of them.
(#warm#)I hear you want to know what supplies we need, and I expect you've got other questions. (#shrug01#)Let's get the serious stuff out of the way first.
In general, we're in need of raw materials to aid repair of our infrastructure. We also need food to support the population. Here's a shortlist.
We'd appreciate any help. Now that's out the way, I suppose I can help answer your questions. I'll have your database updated with information on our present home system called DeVries.
(disappointed)Oh, OK.
Happy to help!
Great. Let me know if I can help with anything else.
Good to see you again.
Hey Skunk, Karen here. Our capships need more covering fire! Engineers report major damage already.
That ship of yours looks like it can hold its own in a fight.
(#nod01#)We need food to shore up our supplies.
(#gesticulate03#)We also need materials to aid our infrastructure; Refined Metals for example.

page.title: Yoolis
page.t: (greeting friendly)Hi.
(greeting neutral)Channel open.
(greeting enemy)Are you talking to me?
(greeting rejected)Be off with you!
(greeting service)What can I do?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)Fly safely.
(goodbye neutral)Until next time.
(goodbye enemy)Glad that's over!
(goodbye rejected)Don't waste my time again!
(goodbye service)I hope that helped.
(ship scanned - complicit)Check the aft cargo bay closely please, something in there rattles.
(ship scanned - neutral)Now that was uncalled for!
(ship scanned - illegal)Cease and desist! Local authorities have been notified!
(ship scanned - enemy)You fancy scanning some incoming missiles?
(ship scanned - confident)Don't mind the crew spaces, we haven't tidied up yet.
(ship scanned - possessing)Oh you mean it may be illegal in(emphasis on this) this sector?
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Let me know when you are done and we can chat if you want.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Well get on with it, time is money.
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Don't bother asking for docking permission any time soon!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)Well if you are looking for weapon details, I can demonstrate them for you!
(station/capship scanned - confident)I'm glad you don't have anything important to do, but I have.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)That is ... unfortunate. How can we persuade you just to move along?
(directions - location not known)That's a new one on me.
(surrender - reject)Right, so know any more jokes?
(surrender - hostile)Threats are useless unless backed by force. Where's your back-up?
(surrender - complicit)That seems like a good idea. Let's all stay calm about this.
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)I'll ignore that. For now!
(player attacks - neutral 1)OK, you got my attention.
(player attacks - enemy 1)Silly, silly pilot. That is going to get painful for you.
(light fire 1)I seem to have rather annoyed someone!
(light fire 2)Taking a bit of fire here!
(mid fire 1)This is turning rather serious!
(mid fire 2)I have a rather persistent attacker!
(heavy fire 1)Things are going to fall apart soon!
(heavy fire 2)I'm not sure I can control her much longer!
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(shield warning 1)Shields ineffective!
(shield warning 2)My shields are done for!
(hull warning 1)Taking internal damage now!
(hull warning 2)There goes a chunk of the hull!
(Incoming Enemies)Ah, a target-rich environment!
(Incoming Wave)Oh no! More of them inbound.
(Last Wave)Let's see this lot off and we could be done here.
(Player Needed)If you don't get here soon, we won't be here anymore!
(Success 1)Boy, did we give it to them!
(Success 2)That will give them cause to think. Well done everyone!
(Fail 1)We were slaughtered. What a mess!
(Fail 2)Now we'll have to rescue and recover what we can.
It's looking pretty bleak here!
She's going up any time now!
(Yoolis. A Teladi trader)_Documentation
(#smile#)Yisha, it is good to see you again my dear.
(#gesticulate03#)And this is?
(#nod01#)Ah yes. Previously named the Albion Pride I believe. (#thinking01#)You must be a strange one to give it a lesser name.

I heard you were on the run. (#shrug01#)I took the liberty of keeping track of your assets. Luckily Plutarch didn't find them before the Heart of Albion began their attacks. (#sad#)There are dangerous and difficult times ahead.
(#gesticulate02#)You will not have to. The people you seek are now aboard a prison ship, a converted freighter.
You must expect that a Teladi will always want something in return. (#gesticulate04#)I need information; everything you know of what is beyond the gate.
(#nod01#)You have quite a keen mind for making profits I see. (#smile#)I must remember to be careful when dealing with you in future. When you return to your ship we shall conclude our bargain.
I am unable to entertain you further at this time, my young one. Please run along.
I wish you luck and much profits in your endeavours.

page.title: Jeffry Halifax
page.t: (greeting friendly)Good to hear a friendly voice!
(greeting neutral)I can hear you.
(greeting enemy)You really expect me to listen to you?
(greeting rejected)On your way!
(greeting service)I sense you are after something?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)Off you go and keep safe!
(goodbye neutral)Maybe we'll meet again.
(goodbye enemy)Now clear the channel for someone useful.
(goodbye rejected)Don't bother coming back.
(goodbye service)I'm always happy to help out.
(ship scanned - complicit)I'll have a cup of java while you poke around in here.
(ship scanned - neutral)Is that really necessary?
(ship scanned - illegal)Well Done! You get the next free interview by the local police for that!
(ship scanned - enemy)That was one step too far that you shouldn't have made!
(ship scanned - confident)While you are looking, see if you can find the PDA that I mislaid last week.
(ship scanned - possessing)Illegal? Surely not. The guy said it was all quite legal!
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Go for it, but it might take a while.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Now that wasn't very nice of you, was it.
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Are you so stupid that you thought the authorities would not notice?
(station/capship scanned - enemy)Well as hostile acts go, that is probably the most stupid one I have seen.
(station/capship scanned - confident)I think you are going to be really embarrassed in a while.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)So you think I know about everything that goes on in this huge thing?
(directions - location not known)Unfortunately you'll have to ask a local.
(surrender - reject)That's good. Tell me another joke!
(surrender - hostile)You threaten me when flying that heap of junk?
(surrender - complicit)Well since you asked nicely, and I have no other choices, she's all yours.
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Are you sure you switched on your targeting computer today?
(player attacks - neutral 1)You'll be paying for the repairs for that!
(player attacks - enemy 1)OK, playtime is over for you!
(light fire 1)Somebody doesn't want to play nice just now!
(light fire 2)We are taking inbound fire!
(mid fire 1)This is becoming rather unpleasant!
(mid fire 2)I can't shake this guy!
(heavy fire 1)Any more and I'm outta here!
(heavy fire 2)Last chance if you want us to survive this!
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(shield warning 1)Our shields are flickering!
(shield warning 2)Nothing left of the shields now!
(hull warning 1)Ship's systems taking damage!
(hull warning 2)The hull is looking like lacework in places!
(Incoming Enemies)Nasty-looking blighters heading in.
(Incoming Wave)More of them on the way, keep them occupied!
(Last Wave)Sort this lot out and we may have stopped them.
(Player Needed)If you don't get here soon we are toast!
(Success 1)And that is how you save the universe!
(Success 2)Relax people, we have them on the run!
(Fail 1)We took heavy losses and flunked it.
(Fail 2)I'm going to need casualty evacuation and several tow-ships.
We've got a bad situation here!
I'm getting a countdown to implosion !
Just making sure you get there safely. It's not a cakewalk around here.
Alright. First I'll lead the scout team through the Superhighway and check on the other side. Skunk, you want to come with?
This is Halifax. (#hard#)We've got a small Reiver force here. Looks like they're turning to engage.
Agreed. (#hard#)We have to stick close together and not get drawn off.
(#hard#)Negative. Go for kills. They'll be back in force if you don't.
We see the same. I've cleared the rest of the ships to come through and then we can continue on to the next area.
This is it. No Reivers in sight. We'll set up a perimeter.

We had some automated warning systems but the Reivers probably scavenged them long ago. According to the latest expansion plans we must reclaim this sector soon. At that point we'll have eyes in all the right places.
(#shrug01#)Not sure if we can make it in time. (#cold#)Governor, if they get too close we will be forced to defend ourselves.
I've got contacts.
This is Canteran Space Security. Disengage your pursuit or we will take action.
No response.
(panicked)They're right on top of us!
We're getting shredded!
(response to question)Sure are, thanks to you getting us back on our feet and Plutarch distracting the Reivers for the most part.

page.title: Neyl Colbern - No pilot functionality
page.t: (#smile#)Wonderful, you're here sooner than I expected. (#gesticulate03#)I'm Neyl Colbern, CEO of Jonferco.

I don't want to keep you long, I understand you've had quite the journey from Albion. I hear that a war has broken out between different factions there. I expect the Argon Navy ordered you not to interfere.

(#shrug01#)The military are scared. There are potential enemies on both sides, but I know there may also be allies. (#sad#)I long to see Albion again and try and find old friends; this can only happen if there is peace.

So far the Argon Navy has supported your story. There are Argon and Terran citizens stranded in a DeVries sector with a Plutarch flotilla guarding the gate and threatening approaching ships. (#shrug01#)It seems to me that your people are the only ones worth dealing with.

Trade of course. We can't afford to take our eyes off the Xenon but we can't allow Plutarch to gain the advantage either. A stalemate is probably best for everyone and gives us more time. We level the playing field, bring everyone to the table and then focus on the Xenon.

Give it time. (#shrug01#)I doubt the Xenon are going anywhere soon. (#gesticulate02#)I'll make arrangements to send a goodwill freighter to the Canteran sector. It's been so long since we've had a new trade route.
(#nod01#)I wouldn't have it any other way. I'll see what I can do.

(#rolleyes02#)Trust Bayes not to tell you that our mortal enemy is already in our laps. (#hard#)A Jump Gate opened up several weeks ago leading to some strange system, very ominous and unwelcoming. Maelstrom we call it. There was evidence from scout ships that it was in fact inhabited until recently. There were functional highways, shipwrecks of familiar designs but no signs of life.

Half of our forces were sent in. The remainder waited behind in case something jumped directly back to our system using the gate. These were invasion tactics we saw during the Terran Conflict. The exploring force found stations of familiar design but, (#shrug01#)once again, no signs of life.
(#angry#)Then they woke up.

(#hard#)They focused on engines and Jump Drives first, making escape near impossible. It's a gutsy move to strand a whole Argon fleet on your own doorstep but the Xenon did the maths and knew they could win; and they certainly did.

(#sad#)We lost a lot of people that day, even some ex-Terran pilots. Those decades together made us strong but it seems to have allowed others to become even stronger. (#crossarms01#)We lost Admiral Lido, so Bayes took over command of the military. (#shrug01#)She's way out of her depth.
(#gesticulate04#)We focus on developing new technology and maintaining ships and stations. Many ships use our engines and power systems.
Since the gates shut down, and our supply lines were cut, we have had to shift focus towards more efficient designs. (#smile#)I'm quite proud of how well we've handled our isolation.
(#warm#)Jonferco was once one of the largest corporations with economic ties to several species across dozens of systems. I hope our other branches have fared as well as we have.

We will not be able to open trade to DeVries until the military feel that they've secured the area. (#shrug01#)We will use this time to prepare. (#thinking01#)There are other corporations here who will jump at the chance to open new trade routes.
(#shrug01#)There is little competition here unfortunately. Each corporation has its own area of expertise. You will likely need food aid; that is the area of the CHOW corporation. Start with them.

I expect they are already making plans to exploit the new gate connection. What we need is a united front with all of the major corporations in agreement. (#nod01#)It will be harder for the military to say no and it will make us all that bit safer when making joint trade runs.

(#gesticulate01#)Leave the other CEOs to me. What you should do is to help raise the profile of your Heart of Albion faction. Help these corporations and they will be more likely to help you. I'll send you some tips on how to get into their good books.
It goes without saying; be careful out there and the best of luck.
(#smile#)Otani, good work. (#nod01#)At least CHOW know who you are now.
Otani, this has put us in a difficult situation. CHOW are ambitious and are probably preparing to exploit the new trade opportunities without us.
(#cold#)Unfortunately the Xenon are forcing our hand. Other corporations are being pressed hard and the military is stretched too far.

(#shrug01#)You're not here to take orders from me. However, all combat-ready ships are being sent to the sector leading to Maelstrom. (#cold#)I thought we had more time but the Xenon are already massing.

Emergency talks with Plutarch are trying to bring them into the conflict, but it's not looking good. (#angry#)It seems they're happy for Omicron Lyrae to burn, followed closely by DeVries. (#rolleyes01#)The utter fools.
(#rolleyes01#)Plutarch always had trouble seeing past their own needs. (#sad#)I hoped they would have changed for the better.
What ever happened to my Teladi friend,(Falos Disanos Hunas The First) Falos Disanos Hunas I?

(sigh)(#sad#)Some days I wish I had never become involved in Albion, that system is nothing but corporate corruption and death. (#shrug01#)At least Borman is alive, but our youthful adventures are stories for another time. The Xenon are at our door and I hope you'll be there to help hold it shut.
Otani. (#angry#)The Xenon are halfway through the system, heading straight for the gate. I've sent our ships to slow them down but it won't be enough.
You need to dock at one of our stations. There are some upgrades you can install. (#shrug01#)I have a feeling you'll need them.
Once the Xenon stop coming through the gate, all combat ships that remain here will aid the counter-attack in Maelstrom.

If Bayes is successful they can stop all Xenon production. That is the only way we can win. (#sad#)Until then, our stations will have to hold off the Xenon. Now get to it, Bayes will need every ship to deal maximum damage.

page.title: Leea Kaswin
page.t: (greeting friendly)Well hello there.
(greeting neutral)Receiving.
(greeting enemy)You've got a nerve! Speak up then!
(greeting rejected)I have absolutely nothing to say to you.
(greeting service)I guess you need something?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)Fare well and keep safe!
(goodbye neutral)Bye.
(goodbye enemy)I hope that's the last time we need to talk..
(goodbye rejected)You can keep your farewells to yourself.
(goodbye service)I hope I can help you again in future.
(ship scanned - complicit)Yeah you can scan, fill your boots!
(ship scanned - neutral)We tend to frown on unasked scanning.
(ship scanned - illegal)Keep your scanner off my ship!
(ship scanned - enemy)So you think you are above the law, eh? That scan will cost you!
(ship scanned - confident)I look forward to your sincere apology when you find nothing.
(ship scanned - possessing)That is purely recreational stuff just for some close friends, you know?
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Scanning us? Go for it, if you must.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Scanning us? Couldn't you just have asked?
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Scanning us? Silly mistake! Now you are in trouble!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)Ah, how quaint! You seem to think we wouldn't notice your scan. Wrong!
(station/capship scanned - confident)How does it feel to be wasting everyone's time?
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Oops! How did that get there? Well I'm sure we can overlook this, yes?
(directions - location not known)Not the faintest idea, sorry.
(surrender - reject)Yeah right. In your dreams!
(surrender - hostile)You think you're up for this fight? Bring it on!
(surrender - complicit)Well since I have no choice you might as well get on with it.
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Watch where your pointing that my friend!
(player attacks - neutral 1)You hitting me is hardly going to help the cause!
(player attacks - enemy 1)That will prove to be the last mistake you make!
(light fire 1)Hey, that tickled a bit!
(light fire 2)Hmm. I'll need a new paint job now!
(mid fire 1)This is getting a bit serious now!
(mid fire 2)My assailant seems rather good at this!
(heavy fire 1)I'm getting in deep here, I can't keep this up!
(heavy fire 2)It's getting near ejection time if there isn't a miracle soon!
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(shield warning 1)Shields ineffective! I'm taking hull damage!
(shield warning 2)The shields cannot hold much longer!
(hull warning 1)I'm getting hull warnings!
(hull warning 2)The hull cannot take much more punishment!
(Incoming Enemies)Bogeys! They're on us!
(Incoming Wave)More of the blighters! How many more are there to come?
(Last Wave)This seems to be the final wave.
(Player Needed)Get over here now if you want us to survive!
(Success 1)Finally! Looks like we saw them all off!
(Success 2)Ease up and check systems. Looks like the heat is off.
(Fail 1)We were trounced. How do we come back from that?
(Fail 2)I have injured crew and dead ships here.
We're in terrible shape!
Our systems are critically damaged!
We can also listen when we want to.
Calm down. Disengaging the scanner. I just wanted to know who you were.
There we are. So, you're here to glean information from me?
Leea Kaswin, lead researcher at Beryll Astrotech.

(#shrug01#)The planning phase was over long ago. The Plutarch CEO put in place a contingency plan for use on any major loss of control. With the uprising and defections, Plutarch felt it was time to act.
Mass production of unmanned ships, pretty smart ones too. They use them to replace the pilots they're losing.
Some of these will be capable war machines, fighters and bombers. They can pack a hell of a punch. (#sad#)The last thing you want is a fleet of relentless robotic ships after you.
Plutarch was getting reckless. They kept trying to make these things more effective and accused us of holding back. We were; (#sad#)we didn't want to incorporate more Xenon tech.
(little chuckle)(#laugh#)We did.

Left-overs from our research during the Terran Conflict. All our drones have some Xenon tech in them but not enough to risk a resurgence of machine intelligence. (#disapproval01#)Plutarch was indeed willing to risk just that to make them more effective. (#shrug01#)We destroyed everything we could get our hands on.
We have to be sure there is no trace so we must destroy the labs. Taking out production facilities will be a secondary concern; you won't be able to stop Plutarch building more somewhere else.
(#shrug01#)I won't be taking part. (#warm#)I will be following your progress however. Kaswin out.

page.title: Jimee Tomson
page.t: Well, I have to say I didn't expect this today. (#crossarms01#)Jimee Tomson, I'm in charge of logistics and human resources here. The navy asked if we could put you in a safe and comfortable place. (#gesticulate03#)This is the best we could do on short notice.
(#rolleyes01#)Well, you've caused trouble. The Jonferco CEO himself has taken an interest in you and you don't want to keep him waiting.
(#gesticulate02#)Word is that you're from Albion. CEO Colbern had close friends there. I imagine it must have something to do with that. There may be more to it but it's not for me to know.

(#warm#)You're new here, so I'll give you some advice. (#gesticulate03#)CEO Colbern is the most powerful individual in the system. Yes, there is the navy and the Federation government, but they won't do you favours, not without a heavy price.

We've taken a look at your ship, the Albion Pride. (#smile#)Some would say it's a historical treasure, not a warship. (#gesticulate03#)How about we make some top of the line upgrades available to you, sweeten the deal.
(#nod01#)We understand. The information is being uploaded now. Be careful out there.
(#smile#)Hope you like those new upgrades.
