You should get those upgrades while they're cheap.

page.title: Drew Haswell - No pilot functionality
page.t: Captain Otani, (#smile#)I'm Drew Haswell from CHOW security. Jonferco sent word that you were coming to us for freelance work. What say we put that versatile ship of yours to good use in one of several possible areas? Of course I'd prefer that you keep CHOW facilities and ships safe.
(#shrug01#)Not as much as other companies. Understandably they don't seem very interested in food. (#disapproval01#)The Heretic Vanguards( pirate faction) cause us trouble now and again, however.

(#disapproval01#)Some call them an extremist anti-Terran group. I just call them thugs. They've made no friends here over the years and so resort to raids to sustain their operations. (#angry#)They love nothing more than to hit easy freighters heading for Terran residential areas.
(#punchhand01#)Actually that's not a bad idea; I'll send you there first. (#thinking01#)A freighter is already set to leave. Stay close to it and keep an eye out for suspicious ships.

page.title: Hanson Derby - Male
page.t: (To Yisha, familiar)So, you want me to patch up this old junker for free?
(To Yisha, familiar)You've got one, (#disapproval01#)one, favour. You're more trouble than you're worth.
(To Ren)OK guy, I'll get your ship into a decent state. That includes the weapons, so you'd best keep quiet about where you got them from.
(#thinking01#)There are some components around here I could use. Look around for them while I get set up.
Nevermind, I found them myself.
(#nod01#)Thanks. If we're doing this we'd better do it right.
You should get on board and prepare to give it a test run.
That Yisha girl. (#gesticulate02#)She's nice and all, but don't expect things to be simple with her around.
Sure but the Heart of Albion aren't the PMCs best friends are they?
I say spend a time in her world. Heart of Albion will either get you into charity work or cyber-terrorism. Never a dull day.
(#crossarms01#)I don't have all day. Give your ship a go.
Don't keep the girl waiting...or me. Get on board.
Have you not found them yet?

page.title: Debora Gimbal - Female
page.t: (#warm#)Hello Captain, I'm Lieutenant Gimbal.
Thanks for the delivery. (#gesticulate01#)We sure needed some supplies. (#cold#)When Plutarch is sniffing around it's never business as usual.
(#smile#)No need to be coy, Captain, we're free to talk here. (#nod01#)I know you have Lieutenant Tarren on-board.
(#shrug01#)Trust her to get all the fun assignments. (sarcastically)'Dig up dirt on Plutarch here'. (#laugh#)'Lay low with this unassuming young Captain and his unique ship'.
(#rolleyes02#)I know, just having a bit of fun.
So, you want weapons.
(#nod01#)Sure we do. Plutarch doesn't like the idea of the ex-military force running around like we own the place.
We're limited to half the firepower Plutarch has. It helps them sleep at night.
(dull)Right, (#disapproval01#)you're neutral. That must be fun.
(#shrug01#)The weapons are yours. (#gesticulate02#)Pontifex knows('god knows') our engineers need something to do.
(#smile#)Hope you enjoy the new guns.
(#laugh#)Don't blow up any of our stuff please.

page.title: Argon Plot Pilot - Male
page.t: Albion Skunk, stop your engines and prepare to be escorted.
They must be hiding in the nebula!
Area secured.
Admiral, something is locking onto the Jump Beacon. It's using old access codes.
Yes ma'am.
(giving an order)Slayer Squad, move!
Take out as many as you can.
Let's slay some Xenon!
We're done here. Move on!
We can move to the next zone.
We have visual on the stations.

page.title: Vice Admiral Heather Bayes - Female, No pilot functionality
page.t: This is Vice Admiral Bayes of the Federal Argon Navy. Welcome to Omicron Lyrae. (#hard#)We hope you will cooperate by answering our questions. As a precaution, you will remain under guard until we can verify who you are.
(#nod01#)Glad to hear it. (#thinking01#)You say you are from Albion, a sovereign system of the Argon Federation. The system where we found you was not Albion, so what system is it?
In conflict with whom exactly?
So who lives in that system?
Please hold.
Thank you for waiting. What else do you know about these Canterans?
(smiles)(#smile#)Good. I'm glad we don't have to beat the information out of you.

You may find this interesting. (#lookdown01#)Operation Cantera. A Terran mining operation to provide raw materials for their war effort. Its existence was uncovered just months before the gates closed.
A small mining colony with hardly any warships. They thought they were safe in their little obscure mining system. (#shrug01#)They're just lucky we didn't mount a full assault when we had the chance.
(#nod01#)We will be sending ships to assess the situation and secure the gate.

(#cold#)I'm sorry. Until we have a better assessment you will remain under guard. We hope you understand. Having the gates reopen after all these years is a momentous event and we obviously feel we have to tread carefully.

(#cold#)Despite what you may think the Terran Conflict is not over. However, I can assure you that we're not looking for a fight. There is something you can do that will benefit all concerned. Allow us to download your ship database and we can use it to chart the system and identify your people.

(#warm#)Thank you. We will send you a flight plan to a Jonferco station where you may dock. I have already informed them that you are on your way. Feel free to wander the system but, for your own safety, do not attempt to enter the gate. I will contact you as there are further developments. Bayes out.
Albion Skunk, keep away from the Xenon. Don't let them get too close as they could probe your systems.
Looks like we have a handle on the situation now.

(#disapproval01#)You have no idea how close you were to causing us major problems. (#hard#)If those machines had hacked your systems they would know everything about Albion. We'll send you our latest patches to protect your database.
You'd better get to your destination as soon as you can. We can't be sure that the sector is completely secure.
(#cold#)Albion Skunk, I'm surprised to see you here. (#disapproval01#)Your people hardly seem the type to help defend the federation.
Plutarch is hunkering down, (#angry#)Heart of Albion is 'too weak' to aid us and the Canterans are afraid to leave their scorched sector.
(#cold#)The Xenon are through that gate, ready to invade Omicron Lyrae and overrun us in days.
(#angry#)However, if they learn of the other systems, they will spread themselves thin and we can then pick them off, one by one.
(#sad#)It's only a matter of time before they find Albion, but by then it will be too late for us.
By luring the Xenon to spread their forces we can weaken them and also bring Plutarch into the conflict.
You have a choice. Aid us in attacking their infrastructure to end this war sooner, or hold back and kill any Xenon which get through the gate. (#cold#)There are no other options.
(#shrug01#)I doubt that, Otani. (#cold#)Prepare yourselves. They're on their way.
(ordering)Take out as many as you can. After the first wave, our strike-force will enter Maelstrom and head for their stations. The remainder will defend the system.
The strike-force is moving out.
Continue pushing for the stations. There is little resistance!
(shouting)I want those ships found!
I want the next beacon set up in the Xenon sector as soon as possible! Gamma wing, prepare to move out.
Split vessel, this is Admiral Bayes of the Argon Navy. We will not surrender.
We're about to launch an offensive to put them back to sleep. I suggest you move aside.
Cowards! Lock out that access code from the Jump Beacon. Everyone hold this position.
I need to know where they're based. I want reviews of all nav data.
You hardly have anything to threaten us with, Split.
How about we talk about this plan of yours?
I never thought I'd see the day a Split would sneak in and plant bombs. And how do you expect to get past the Xenon?
If this is possible, your ship may the most suitable. The Xenon may not recognise it as much of a threat compared to our ships.
Fly to this location. A Xenon scout party is on its way.

As soon as you're done, return and we'll start the assault.
Hacker drones are available on my ship.

And the stations?
It will have to do.

When close, we'll blow the stations and take out the others conventionally.
It will surely slow them down, but I doubt this is their only operation.
Alpha wing, take point.
Otani, I can't give you orders but I suggest you stick with them.
Otani, something is wrong. The bombs are not responding.
We're on the way. Take out anything you can.

Incoming missiles! Take them out!

I see Plutarch hasn't joined you.
Captain, target the stations.
Keep pushing through. Defend that Jump Beacon.
Watch the blast area!
Looks like the worst is over. This will be one long clean-up operation.
We can't be sure. We'll set up a full survey and exploration task force.
It's a big system and you only have one station.
Kol of the Split. With the gates reopening, our lives may continue becoming more interesting.
I see no need for us to complicate that with war. Your terms are accepted.
Captain Borman, let us return to Omicron Lyrae. It seems we have a lot to talk about.

page.title: Kol t-Yo - Split Male
page.t: (#cold#)Argon Captain, I am Kol t'Yo.
(#cold#)We have had many years becoming strong. You Argon will know your place.
You are here for credits? War with Xenon?
(#punchhand01#)Ha! Half Teladi, half Split. Typical Argon. We have a request on behalf of the Family Ryak.
I require transport to find a Split who lives with Argon. Our isolation must end and we require information we can trust.
(#shrug01#)We will force them to wait. Their plan will fail.
We go now.
I shall find a worthy Split to talk to. I will contact you when I am done.
We require nothing, (#shrug01#)but some items may be well received as an act of tribute.
Albion Skunk, you are instructed to land so I can disembark.
This was an interesting station. The Argon here do not cower as I had expected.
You will transport me back to Split space.
I am curious to see how you handle the Xenon in this ship.
You should collect wreckage from Xenon craft. Several 'researchers' of the low-caste seem quite interested in them.
Your service to the family is noted. I believe we may again meet in battle against the Xenon. You leave now.
This is Kol t'Yo. We have fire-power to match you!
We have plan to infiltrate Xenon sector and weaken their stations with explosives. Full assaults follow.
We are not idiots. We have survived years here! We can create a Camouflage Device to fool the Xenon.
We require a ship capable of carrying the bombs and docking at their stations.
We choose the Albion Skunk.
It remains to be completed. We require Xenon Components.
You do not have enough.
You can find the Xenon Components by destroying Xenon ships.
This will be enough.
Dock at our colony and we will install the Camouflage Device and explosives.
Do not be alarmed if we begin shooting you.
We will activate the device when you are in position.

Defend yourself!
You must dock at each station. This may require hacking.
The Split will lead the final assault.

We have bomb activation!
Argon ship approaching!
Next bomb activated!
All bombs activated!
I must correct. This Split space. We will lead such task force.
How many Split live among you? Once they learn of us, do you want peace or war?
We will allow one sector for you. And the peace we have fought for today.
Good. I'm glad we don't need to ram your ship.(laughs)

page.title: Cutscene Text - Speaker Betty
page.t: Encyclopedia -(pause) Historical ships -(pause) Pride of Albion (Pause) - This prototype built by Jonferco in 2932 was a technical masterpiece based on blueprints by engineer Bala Gi. Its great flexibility in engine performance as well as weapon, shield and hull technology would have made it the first choice for any military organization. The model however never got into mass production, due to excessive costs involved in building the main structure.

The only prototype was bought by the Argon government and played an important role in the Terran Conflict as well as the Plutarch revolution in Albion, where it was registered under the Teladi Faalos Disanos Huunas I (spoken Fa-a-los Dis-a-nos Hu-u-nas). The ship was last seen heavily damaged in a massive battle against the Plutarch Mining Corporation and was registered as lost in action.

Encyclopedia: History - Albion Revolution (pause) - Immediately following the surprising great gate shutdown of 2947, the Plutarch Mining Corporation started a revolution against the Argon government forces stationed in the Albion solar system. Unable to call in any reinforcements from their home systems, the Argon military was defeated and PMC instantiated a provisional government.

Despite the decades of being disconnected from the gate network, the PMC government has since been an enormous success and brought wealth, prosperity and security to all the people of the Albion system.
NOTE: Article locked - No updates allowed.

Encyclopedia - Map - Badlands Mining Colony: (pause) The Badlands Mining Colony is one of the oldest mining facilities in Albion. Initially a high yield but sizeable rock, it was colonised by the Plutarch Mining Corporation in the year 2942. Until Albion became isolated from the rest of the universe due to the great shutdown, it served as the unofficial capital.

Encyclopedia - Map - Mining Colony 2940 alpha (pause): Built deep inside an enormous hollowed out asteroid, this former mining colony, now nicknamed the Lonely Giant, came to fame during the Plutarch revolution against the Argon Military in Albion. Initially used as a military storage base, it became the last-stand fortification against the great Plutarch advance.

Encyclopedia entry, System: DeVries (pause) A Terran controlled solar system founded during a phase of exploration and expansion, DeVries hosted a major mining operation to support the economy during the Terran Conflict. The colonists suffered great tragedy as a result of the gate shutdown of 2947 where they were unable to build a self sustaining economy.

Thousands of people starved or were killed in the ensuing fights over dwindling supplies. The surviving colonists formed the Republic of Cantera and continue to strive for a comfortable and sustained existence while those known as the 'Reivers' continue to raid and steal.

Encyclopedia entry, Faction: Heart of Albion (Pause) UPDATE (pause) In what appears to be a resumption of the Plutarch-Argon Military conflict of 2949, Heart of Albion has declared a revolution against Plutarch rule. Both parties have amassed fleets to control key locations while neutral groups have met in an attempt to avoid a civil war. While some simply welcome a return to Argon Federation law others violently oppose Plutarch due to the often played-down claims of slave labour and assassinations.

Encyclopedia entry Technology (pause) Hacking: (pause) The act of exploiting weaknesses in computer security, hacking is deemed an illegal act in many areas. Often using Artificial General Intelligence to bypass lock-out mechanisms, hacking is potentially dangerous when handled by novices but the availability of remote drones and hacker chips has made it far more accessible.

Encyclopedia entry PMC - The Plutarch Mining Corporation URGENT UPDATE (pause) After many years of rumours surrounding Plutarch's illicit activities, proof has now been provided by the Heart of Albion. Slave trade, forced labour and assassinations of dissidents are among the crimes committed by Plutarch Mining Corporation.
Article marked for deletion.

Encyclopedia entry System...DeVries, History and Politics (pause) UPDATE (pause): After the Plutarch Mining Corporation aggressively pushed through the DeVries system and attacked a mining operation, the Republic of Cantera has mobilised its forces and turned against the aggressor. Their borders are now closed to all but a select few Albion allies.

Encyclopedia entry Xenon Technology (Pause) Initially Terraformers from Earth, these machines converted worlds for human habitation. Their Artificial General Intelligence proved dangerous, and lead to the relentless Xenon race. Continued use of AGI has caused controversies and conflicts between the Community of Planets and the Earth government. Use of Xenon technology today is considered highly dangerous and outlawed by most governments.

Encyclopedia entry: Political relations between Heart of Albion and the republic of Cantera (pause) UPDATE (Pause) To strengthen their armies against the Plutarch Mining Corporation, Cantera and Heart of Albion officially announced a new alliance.
Extract from the speech
Playback starting
End of recording
The signing of this treaty nullified the technicality that the two factions were at war through the Terran Conflict.

Encyclopedia entry: Uprising against the Plutarch Mining Corporation (pause) UPDATE (pause) Throughout the war torn Albion and DeVries systems, fleets have massed. PMC, hit by uprisings and defections of key personnel, has forced what may be a decisive encounter.
Article is being updated in realtime.

Encyclopedia entry: Uprising against the Plutarch Mining Corporation (pause) UPDATE (pause) The battle for the Albion-DeVries gate solidified Plutarch's control in both systems. With Heart of Albion and the Republic of Cantera in retreat many of their supporters have been forced into hiding.

Encyclopedia entry: System Omicron Lyrae (Pause) Despite the decades of being disconnected from their homeworld Argon Prime, thanks to the rich planets in this system, life in Omicron Lyrae developed almost normally after the gate shutdown.

The mostly Argon population were at first enthusiastically welcoming signs of the re-opening of the Jump Gates. The first gate in 2973 however connected their peaceful federation with a solar system infested by Xenon AI. Attacks soon followed.

Encyclopedia entry: System Omicron Lyrae (Pause) Despite the decades of being disconnected from the rest of the Argon Federation, thanks to the rich planets and developed infrastructure, life in Omicron Lyrae developed almost normally after the gate shutdown.

The mostly Argon population were at first enthusiastically welcoming signs of the re-opening Jump Gates. The first gate in sector Devoid Clime however connected Omicron Lyrae to a system infested by Xenon AGI. Attacks soon followed. The strict laws against AGI technology and research has potentially left the Argon Military unprepared to how the Xenon have evolved over the decades.

Encyclopedia entry System Albion, History and Politics (pause) UPDATE (pause): After the successful strike on Xenon installations in Maelstrom, the Argon Government refocused their attention towards the ongoing crisis in Albion and DeVries. Retaking Albion is considered the first step in reforming the Argon Federation.

Encyclopedia entry: System (pause) Albion (Pause) URGENT UPDATE (PAUSE) Soon after the first communication between Albion and Omicron Lyrae for decades, Xenon ships were sighted entering the DeVries system. A Level 3 AGI Hazard warning is now in place.

Encyclopedia entry: System Maelstrom (pause)- Split Colony (Pause) The relatively minor Family Ryak was once based solely on a Split carrier after falling out of favour with the Patriarchs family. During a travel to a distant Split colony the Jump Gates failed in a hazardous system now known as Maelstrom. The sightings of ravaging Xenon forced the Split to settle on one of the few large asteroids.

Encyclopedia entry: System Maelstrom - Argon Constructs (Pause) Little is known about the Argon stations in Maelstrom. Xenon technology is now integrated in almost every system and seems to aid in the production of new Xenon. Whether the Argon inhabitants died before or after the gates shutdown remains unknown.
Encyclopedia updated:(pause) Entries for Home of Light, Toride(@voice Toride pronounced To-ree-deh, with short o) and Cold Star added.

Article:(pause) These three systems survived the Dark largely through the ingenuity and vast resources of Terracorp -(pause) encyclopedia entry added. Though appreciated most by its citizens for its thriving economy, the area has also developed a keen scientific community due to the discovery of unstable warp anomalies in the far reaches of the Toride(@voice Toride pronounced to-ree-deh, with short o) system.

Article continues:(pause) Until recently Terracorp had enforced very tight security measures throughout the three systems, in order to keep citizens safe from the threats known to inhabit their outskirts. This has left large parts of the area unexplored. Because of this, many rumours have surfaced about what can be found there, and it is advised that all pilots travel carefully through the region.

(assist mission failed/timed out)We'll need to go the long way round.
The captain surrendered. The ship is ours!(cheers)
They're standing down! The station is ours!(cheers)
We're not going to ma--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)I confirm that we have control of the target. Great work!
(upgrades)Successfully upgraded. Undocking now.
Successfully downgraded. Undocking now.
Upgrades installed.
Choose a ship to upgrade.
Which upgrade do you want to change?
(*Hiring*)
You already have someone doing my job.
You already have an Engineer on board.
You already have a Marine Officer on board.
Do you want me to replace them or do you need me somewhere else?
Thank you for hiring me Sir. You will not be disappointed.
Looking forward to working with you. You won't regret hiring me.
(On board introduction)Hi there! I'm the new crew member.
(Fired in space)OK, just let me off at the next station. I'm sure I'll find a better contract.
(Fired on platform)OK, I'll leave right now. I could probably find better work around here anyway.
(Assign to object)OK, Sir. I'll move into my new quarters now.
(Assign to ship)OK, I'm in control now.
(Return to player)OK, Sir. Coming aboard.
(Leave player)Goodbye Mister Otani.
(Leave player)Farewell and good luck.
(Showing skills)Take a look, I'm more than qualified.
(Showing skills)I hope these impress you, I'm quite proud.
(Orders)Please send new target coordinates.
(Sell ship)Sold the ship as you requested. Your credits should arrive in a moment.
(Sell ship)Offloaded the old tub. The proceeds should be with you soon.
(respond to free mode)Thank you for putting your trust in me.
(respond to free mode)I appreciate freedom on the job, thank you.
(respond to restricted mode)I'll feel free to do as you tell me.(slightly sad)
(respond to restricted mode)You lead, I follow.(slightly bored)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Hey! I'm a friendly!
(player attacks - friendly 2)Hey, stop shooting at me!
(player attacks - neutral 1)What do you think you're playing at?
(player attacks - neutral 2)I'm hoping that was just a mistake.
(player attacks - enemy 1)You're so going to pay for that!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Do that again and you'll regret it!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)Another shot and you'll answer to the authorities.
(big object attacked)Hey, go play with someone your size.
(big object attacked, stress 'please')Hey! Would you please stop bugging me?
(light fire 1)Woah! Taking fire!
(light fire 2)Under attack!
(mid fire 1)I could use some help here!
(mid fire 2)This guy's not giving up!
(heavy fire 1)Don't know how much more I can take!
(heavy fire 2)I really need help!
(heavy fire 3)Request immediate assistance. I'm taking a beating here!
(station defence)Calling all our ships in the area.
(station defence)We need your immediate assistance.
(station defence)Our station is in jeopardy!
(death 1)Aaarrrgghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(death 3)Aaarrrgghhh!
(shield warning 1)Shields near critical!
(shield warning 2)Shields weakening!
(hull warning 1)Hull breached!
(hull warning 2)Losing hull integrity!
(Incoming Enemies)Here they come!
(Incoming Wave)Another wave is inbound. Stay sharp!
(Last Wave)This should be the last of them.
(Player Needed)Where are you? We're getting torn to shreds!
(Success 1)All right! I didn't think we'd get through that!
(Success 2)Everyone stand down. We made it! I guess they'll think twice next time!
(Fail 1)We got trounced, big time.
(Fail 2)I need an engineer and a medic!
(critical damage)We've got a serious problem here!
(critical damage)The reactor's overloading!
(Incoming Enemies)We've got enemies closing.
(Dangerous area)I don't like the look of this.
(Plead for life 1)Please! No more! I can't take much more of this!
(Plead for life 2)Hold your fire, I beg you!
(Plead for life 3)Please! Have mercy on me!
(Plead for life 4)Argh! My lady(his ship) is on her last legs. Please be gentle with her!
(player instructions)Follow us.
Stay close.
(followers)We'll follow you.
Lead the way.
We're ready.
Ready to go!
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)All personnel, remain calm and evacuate to safety!(urging)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)Hi, there. So, you're interested in the mission?
(General 2)Hi, pilot. You're up for the job then?
(Easy 1)You shouldn't have any problem with this.
(Easy 2)This job should be a walk in the park for you.
(Hard 1)Are you sure you're up for this job?
(Hard 2)I'm not convinced. Can you really handle this?
(Fight Easy 1)This is a perfect job for a trigger-happy guy like you.
(Fight Easy 2)You look like the kind of guy who likes blowing up stuff!
(Fight Hard 1)I like your attitude, but I think you'll be torn to shreds!
(Fight Hard 2)I hope you've got insurance. This is no cakewalk.
(Trade Easy 1)If you can shift goods, you're my guy.
(Trade Easy 2)This is a simple cargo run. Should be no problem for a guy like you.
(Trade Hard 1)I'm looking for an A-Grade freighter service here. Can you really provide that?
(Trade Hard 2)I have doubts that you can meet my delivery standards. Can you prove me wrong?
(Acceptance Query 1)So? Are you still in?
(Acceptance Query 2)Still interested?
(Accept 1)Great. I knew this job was for you.
(Accept 2)All right, that's good news.
(Reluctant 1)OK, if you think you can handle it.
(Reluctant 2)Fine. Good luck. You'll need it.
(Reject 1)Look, I'm not giving the job to someone like you.
(Reject 2)If I gave you the job, you'd just screw it up.
(Info 1)I'm transferring the job information to your computer now.
(Info 2)The job information is being transferred now.
(Success 1)Great. I knew you were the right guy for this job.
(Success 2)Nice work! I know I could count on you.
(Semi 1)OK, that'll do. It could have been better though.
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)If that's all you could do, I guess I can't complain.
(Fail 1)What was that? You've wasted my time and yours!
(Fail 2)That was the biggest screw up... ever!
(Credits 1)I'm transferring the credits to you now.
(Reward 1)Please, take this as thanks.
(Client abort)Sorry, but it looks like we don't need your services anymore.
(mission update)Change of plans. I've updated your job briefing.
(mission update 2)Your job briefing has been updated, please take a look.
(Assassination Offer 1)You know what I need. Someone needs to disappear.
(Assassination Offer 2)This individual must be stopped by any means. Understood?
(Target)They sent you after me? This should be fun!
(Target 2)You have no chance. Don't even try!
(Bribe 1)Woah, wait! Let's make a deal!
(Success)They didn't stand a chance!
(Fail)How did they get away? I thought you were up to the task.
(Fail by bribe)We know what you've done and we won't forget it. You'd better watch your back!
(Protect Station Offer 1)Listen, we need help to bolster our defences. We're expecting unwelcome company any moment now.
(Protect Station Offer 2)Hostile ships are on their way and we can't evacuate in time. Can you help our defence forces?
(Protect Ship Offer 1)We need help here! We don't have a chance!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)This is a general distress call! We're under attack and we need assistance!
(Police 1)We've received word that there are smugglers working in this area. We need an unmarked ship to get up close and scan them.
(Success 1)Good work. That should give us some leads to get to the bottom of the problem.
(Semi 1)Really, you didn't find anything? Oh well, at least you tried.
(Fail 1)You know, if we wanted someone to fly around doing nothing, we would have hired a spacefly.
(Passenger Offer 1)I'm in need of a ride. Any chance you can help?
(Passenger Offer 2)I need to leave here soon. Can you help?
(On Board)All right, I'm on board.
(Space)I don't think you have enough space for me at the moment.
(Late)Hey, you do realise I'm still back here right? What's the hold-up?
(Fail)Look, just let me off at the next station. I'll find another way.
(Assigned to platform)OK, Sir. I'm moving into my new quarters now.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)We need some cargo to be delivered somewhere. Interested?
(Return Ware Offer)We need someone to bring some wares to us. Are you interested?
(Late Sell)Our client has told us that the goods have not yet arrived. Please hurry!
(Late Return)We're still awaiting those supplies. Are you close?
(Fail Sell)Our client is not happy. This will cost you dearly!
(Fail Return)Look, just forget it. We'll get our goods another way.
(Emergency Offer)If anyone can hear this, I'm in big trouble. I need your help. Please respond!
(Emergency Offer)Calling anyone! I need help now! Please respond immediately!
(Emergency Offer)Help me! Is anyone receiving this? Please respond!
(station manager)Docking permission granted.
Welcome aboard.
We're always happy to welcome you aboard.
It is always an honour to welcome you aboard.
Thank you for dealing with an enemy of our station.
(Defence manager thanking player)Well done Albion Skunk!
(Defence manager thanking player)One less bug bugging us. You have our thanks.
Thank you for your assistance. Your payment is being transferred.
(trader introduction)Hello, pilot. Is there anything I can offer you?
(trader introduction)Greetings! Anything catch your eye?
(trader introduction)Hello... you. Looking for something in particular?
(trader introduction)Look around. I've got everything you want. What I don't have, you don't want!
(trader introduction)These are all top quality products!
(generic trader)This is what I can offer you.
(performing service)Getting right to it.
All set and done.
(Confirm sale/handoff)Here you go.
(Confirm agreement)Sure!
(giving object or info){,4110|4111}
(weapon/upgrade trader)Here are some excellent weapons that would all fit your ship.
Restocking your ammo is crucial these days.
Nobody should leave port without a full stock of ammunition nowadays.
These are all top quality products!
Mine are among the finest products in the sector.
Excellent choice.
How many do you want?
Is there anything else I can offer you?
Let's see how we can get this baby onto your ship.
Let's get to work on your ship.
Here you go. Cast your eyes upon the new, improved Albion Pride.
Your modifications are now fully operational. Enjoy your 'Pride' and joy, freshly customised!('Pride' holding some comical value, stress it!)
Fantastic job on this piece of work, if I may say so myself. Behold your new improved 'Pride' of Albion.('Pride' holding some comical value, stress it!)
(Shady trader, ayashii otoko = shady guy)(other variant could be: Looking for something 'special'?)Ah...another ayashii otoko.
Behold my 'speciality' stock!
How much will you be mitsuyu sure tsumori?(mitsuyu sure tsumori is Japanese for trying to smuggle, pronounce like mietsooyou zureh tsoomorie)
(licence trader)Another prospective licensee? Good.
These are the licenses I 'could' grant you.
Carrying this license is a privilege, don't forget that!
I hereby grant this license to you so you may be of greater use to our common agenda.
(deal confirmations)Great.
Deal.
Fine.
Confirmed.
(accepting gift from player){,4300}
Reporting in, how can we help?
Yes, what do you want us to do?
(emergency call)Help me please!
Someone, please respond!
This is an emergency. Please respond!
Request urgent assistance!
(station contacting player)Station command to unidentified vessel.
Station command to Ren Otani.
(attacking allied object)We do not tolerate unprovoked attacks in our space.
We will not tolerate your actions.
You will soon be sorry for your actions.
We will now retaliate!
I hope that was an accident.
Your actions will have consequences.
(player uncovered as enemy)You have been identified.
(station contacting law)Station command to law enforcement units.
We're under heavy attack.
Requesting assistance.
(police)Affirmative, we're sending units immediately.
Negative, unfortunately we cannot support you at the moment.
(NPC request for help rejected)What?
(NPC request for help rejected)I can't believe this!
Report related to individual, Ren Otani.
Sending file about Ren Otani.
Sending file.
On file.
Him again.
He's a known criminal.
Data received.
Her again.
She's a known criminal.
Contacting law enforcement.
(Found discount)Hey! This is a once in a lifetime opportunity.
(Found discount)Greetings! I've found a special offer just for you.
(discount offer)I can give you a good price on these things.
(discount offer)I can offer you a special price.
(discount explanation)We're experiencing a bit of overproduction.
(discount explanation)There are some technical problems with our production facility at the moment.
(discount explanation)Our factory is going through a little restructuring.
(player station manager)Reporting a problem, Sir.
(player station manager)Sir, we're having an issue here.
Our station cannot operate.
Station operation has been halted.
Transmitting report now...
Please advise...
We need more resources.
We have insufficient resources.
(can also be used for ships)Our cargo capacity is at its limit.
(can also be used for ships)Our storage bays are full.
(architect)We need a manager.
(can also be used for ships)Here are some possible options for improving our operation.
(can also be used for ships)This is what you could do to help us become more effective.
(defence officer)We're under attack, requesting assistance!
We've been engaged by hostile forces, requesting support units!
(exchange wares)Who do you want us to exchange goods with?
Which ware do you want us to transfer?
What do you want us to transfer?
How much?
How many?
Please specify an amount.
Confirmed, beginning transfer.
Aye, Sir. Transfer under way.
Do you want us to equip the target or just transfer the wares?
I'm experiencing a funding-shortage.
Unless you tell me otherwise, Sir, I'll replenish my budget from your account.
Back to business as usual, have a good day.
Please get back to me to discuss my budget as soon as you can.
Confirming budget changes.
We'll begin operations as soon as we get there.
(rejecting impossible mode order)I'm afraid that's not an option in this case.
What will our mission be there?
Where do you want us to go?
(Witness)Don't think we didn't see that!
(Witness threatened or bribed)Oh, erm, well, sure, if you say so...I didn't see anything.
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)Don't make me laugh!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)Oh, wait, (#smile#)you're that guy I've heard of, aren't you?
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)Wait a minute, you're that chap, right? You're an OK guy.
Sir, does this new assignment include all ships currently under my command or just me?
(Pilot sold his ship)Unless you have anything else for me to do I'll be looking around for another contract around here.
(new assignment)Of course, Sir. What is my new assignment?
Affirmative. I will jump to your position and join your fleet.
Sir, order confirmed! I'll get to your coordinates and henceforth serve under your command.
Sir, do you have a job for me? If you are busy I will just join your squad for the moment.
(Manager)Sir? You have a ship for me?
(Manager)The new ship will be used according to my current orders.
(NPC already assigned to job)Sir, this is my current assignment.
(Player scanned)Don't mind us, just doing our job.
(Player scanned)We'd appreciate your cooperation.
(Player scanned - aggressive)Well now, what do we have here?
(Player scanned - aggressive)What are you hiding from us?
(nothing found)You're clean, continue with your journey.
(nothing found)We've completed our scans. Thanks for your cooperation.
(nothing found - aggressive)Well, that was a waste of time. Get out of here.
(nothing found - aggressive)You're clear, but we've got our eye on you.
(contraband found - police)This is the police, we have detected contraband on board your ship.
(contraband found - police)You there, we know you're carrying. Don't make this difficult.
(drop instruction)Drop the contraband or face the consequences!
(pirate plundering)It must be my lucky day.
(pirate plundering)Well now, what do we have here?
(drop instruction)How about you drop some goodies for us and we won't have to come and get them ourselves.
(dropped)You made the right decision.
(dropped)Smart choice. Now get out of here.
(dropped part)Come now, we know you have more.
(dropped part)That's it? You can do better than that.
(Misc Canteran Pilot)
(static)This is Canteran Transport 23. Got some Reivers approaching and could do with some backup. En route to home base.
I don't know who you are but we'd appreciate an escort. Reivers are getting close. My people are on their way though, so no funny business.
We need to get safely to friendly space. Watch our back and I'll be sure to get you a warm welcome.
That's the way home up ahead. We should be safe enough on the other side.
Thanks for the help. I'll try and clear you to dock at our home station.
Otani! We're going to attempt to retrieve the life-pods but we could do with some covering fire.
(Plutarch Pilot)
This is Plutarch security. Interceptors are on their way to your position. Shut down your engines and weapon systems.
Your ship has been blacklisted. You should stand down.
(HoA Pilot)
Lieutenant, we've got the civilian fleet covered. So far so good but aren't we spread a little thin right now. Heart of Albion now has to patrol two systems with half strength fleets.
If you say so, ma'am. Thanks.
(#hard#)More ships incoming. Reivers!
(#angry#)Plutarch and the Reivers have an alliance?
Unknown vessel. We have a lock on your ship. Prepare to be escorted through the gate. This is your only warning.
Well said, (#smile#)and to the point too.
Ha! I wish I could speak as well as you!
(#smile#)I really enjoy your style of speech. Encore!
(#smile#)I'm amused by that, keep it up!
You're a smooth-talker(#laugh#), aren't you just!
(#nod01#)You seem to know what you're talking about!
You're on a roll there.
Go on, this is really entertaining!
OK, please go on.
I'm still listening.
(#thinking02#)That's an interesting point of view.
Don't let me stop you, carry on.
(#crossarms01#)You'll have to do better than that.
(#shrug01#)I'm afraid that you've lost me.
If there's a point to all this, (#rolleyes01#)then please get to it.
(#scratchhead01#)I'm having difficulty in seeing your point here.
(#angry#)You're just wasting my time. Please go away!
(#sad#)This is going nowhere. Let's just drop it.
(#disapproval01#)I'm really not in the mood for your rambling!
(#angry#)This conversation ends right here!
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)I'm glad that we had this conversation.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#nod01#)That was a refreshing little chat.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)I can offer a special trade opportunity (#gesticulate01#)here, you'll like this!
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)OK, I know someone really good who's looking for employment. Here are their details.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)I know of a very skilled professional, perhaps exactly who you need to hire.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)If we do any business now, I'll offer you a top discount.
Pff...(#disapproval01#)green lizard scum everywhere...
(#thinking01#)I wonder what lies beyond that gate now...
Yeah, very much so! You don't know, do you?
Interesting. If I recall correctly, the Argon culture came about in a similar way.
Oh, so you're really saying that I shouldn't venture out there all alone.(#nod01#) I get it.
Well, food isn't such an issue here. (#thinking01#)Maybe we could explore any trade opportunities there.(plotting, conspicuous)
I guess with the right components, one could make a fortune over there. (#lookdown01#)That's tempting.(speculative)
(#shrug01#)What's all this fuss about AI for anyway...
Really? I'm all ears, set me straight on this!
So, let's get this straight. (#scratchhead01#)AI is good news and the AGI are even better? All along I thought that AGI were the bad ones.
Really? I wasn't aware of that! Well that explains how they're all mechanical etcetera.
Is yet another armed conflict inevitable?
What's there to tell? (#shrug01#)Oh well, give me your version then.
Well, if victory is assured then I'm not so worried. Still,(#sad#) I don't like wars since there are always casualties.
Just what do you mean by 'getting ready'? How do I prepare for that?
That would be excellent advice(#rolleyes02#) - if I actually owned a ship. Oh well, maybe I should try to find one then.

(#sad#)I just knew I'd not make it this time! I'm going to die! Wait...(#punchhand01#) how about this: we trade places. You beat it and I make it? Not interested? Leave me alone then.(partly sarcastic, provocative, frightened)
Yeah, I've been thinking about doing that. I'm not sure of the best place to go though.
To think they didn't even have highways just forty years ago...
Right. There's some even more-amazing new tech, isn't there?
Well, certainly, but it also takes away freedom to roam to a degree. Still, it's a marvel of technology though!
Oh, I really wasn't aware they had to use extra fuel for that in the past. (#nod01#)That's good to know, thanks!
Well tell me about it. I guess nobody outside Jonferco knows how these babies work,(#scratchhead01#) I certainly don't.
To think that we're rebuilding now,(#punchhand01#) awesome!
Of course I am.(#rolleyes01#) It's rather hard to miss, you know!
(#nod01#)It's truly inspiring how you guys have turned this place around. (#smile#)Finally, we can look to the future with hope in our hearts!
I'm glad you're getting something out of this too. (#shrug01#)I'm still very grateful to you, even if the motivation was money.
I feel the same way too. (#smile#)At last we have something to look forward to!
Man, we've really had it tough these past years.
What happened? DeVries happened, that's what happened!
(#nod01#)You're right about that. (#crossarms01#)Compared to our fate Albion seems like a funhouse rave, that's true for sure.
Well, I can tell you, it was no cakewalk. (#sad#)We had to make sacrifices along the way, very unpleasant ones!
Oh well! They may be up to a point, but not in the way you think. Reality was even worse.
(#shrug01#)Well, if you find it hard to believe now, then imagine how hard it was actually living through them.
Yes, we came from Terra. There were many of us then, sent here in strength to mine rocks. (#sad#)Funny how these are all we have left.(bitter)
Well, while you have a point, just step into my shoes for a second. (#hard#)I can't forget what happened here, not just like that.
No, I've heard those rumours too but we had bigger more urgent problems than to worry about rumours. We had the Reivers.
We don't know either; they never talk to us, they just raid. (#disapproval01#)They're a real menace, I can tell you!

(greeting friendly)Yes? What's up?
(greeting neutral)I hear you.
(greeting enemy)Now what?
(greeting rejected)Get lost!
(greeting service)Need something?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)Take care!
(goodbye neutral)Until next time.
(goodbye enemy)Shove off, why don't you.
(goodbye rejected)Good riddance!
(goodbye service)I'm glad if I helped.
(ship scanned - complicit)I can spare some time for that.
(ship scanned - neutral)Your manners need a bit of work!
(ship scanned - illegal)Call the police! We have a spy here!
(ship scanned - enemy)OK, that got my attention! You won't like it though!
(ship scanned - confident)See anything you like?
(ship scanned - possessing)This'll not become a major problem between us, will it?
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Go ahead, I'm not going anywhere just now.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Now, couldn't you have asked first?
(station/capship scanned - illegal)You are now on the list of undesirables!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)You do know that scanning gives us a reason to open fire?
(station/capship scanned - confident)Hmm. You'll be scanning a lot of compartments for nothing!
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Ah! Right! Harrumph! Look, let's come to a little arrangement.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)(sheepishly awkward)No, err .. that's impossible. Um .. they'd never let me down like that ...
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)That's not illegal, it's an authorised load I'm carrying for my manager. No problem .. right?
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)(depressed)Why now? Why did you have to show up now?
(directions - location not known)Sorry, that's not in my current database.
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Are you totally insane?
(surrender - hostile)You just earned my undying hatred!
(surrender - complicit)All right. No need to get violent! Coming about.
(drops cargo 1)Look, take this and leave me alone!
(drops cargo 2)This has to be worth letting me go!
(bail from ship 1)Calling it a day. Let me get clear!
(bail from ship 2)I'm bailing out. Don't get trigger-happy!
(*Hired NPCs*)
(greeting formal)Calling as requested, Sir.
(greeting informal)Hello, Sir. Nice to meet you.
(hired comm greeting 2)I greet you, Sir. How may I help?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Hello, Sir. It's so nice to speak in person.
(goodbye formal)Ending comms, Sir.
(goodbye informal)Goodbye, Sir. It was good to speak with you.
Yes? What are your instructions?
I hear you. Can we help?
(join squad)Joining up with your squad.
(leave squad)Departing your squad.
(accept order 1)Yes, Sir.
(accept order 2)Got it.
(reject order 1)Sorry Sir, I can't do that just now.
(reject order 2)Unfortunately, that's impossible.
(Automatic)Automatic operations in progress, Sir.
(standby)Acknowledged. Standing by.
Affirmative.
Understood.
Negative.
(jumpdrive charging)Coordinates set and Jump Drive charging.
(jumpdrive aborted)Aborting jump!
(jumpdrive engaged)Jump Drive ready.
(jumpdrive emergency)Crash-jumping out of here ... Now!
(jumpdrive cool-down)Jump is unavailable until our Jump Drive cools.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Jump Drive engaging, Sir.
(jumpdrive success)Jump complete. All ship systems showing clear.
(engage boost to player)Boosting towards your location.
(engage boost)Boosters engaged.
(follow)We'll follow you, Sir.
(moveto)Moving into position.
(moveto dock)Moving to the dock.
(docked)Successfully docked.
Worked like a charm, Sir.
Of course, Sir, I'll stick to protocol then and continue as planned.
(arrived)We've arrived, Sir.
(arrived)We're there now, Sir.
(arrived at player)We're at your location.
(arrived at player)We've joined up with you.
Aye, Sir. Commencing guard duty.
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Sir, we're delighted to welcome you aboard.
We've lost our drones. What do you want us to do instead?
Affirmative, but expect problems ahead as we're almost out of drones.
Negative. We're out of suitable drones.
We need a drone resupply.
(request additional ships)We could make use of several more ships.
(received additional ship)Excellent! She'll come in really handy. I'm assigning her duties as we speak.
That does not fit in with our current operational mode.
Terminating current operations.
We await your new orders, Sir.
(Player loses licence)Mister Otani, any licence agreement we have with you is now over.
We'd have thought the reasons were pretty obvious.
Our ship is badly damaged. What shall we do about that?
We cannot move and need assistance in-situ!
Understood. We're off to the nearest shipyard.
Docking at the shipyard. What are your orders now?
Our Jump Drive is disabled and needs urgent repair.
Roger that. We'll jump when possible.
Shipyard reached. We await your orders.
Our engine is off-line. Until it is repaired, we're going nowhere!
We'll move when we can.
Yes Sir. Emergency jump initiated.
Emergency jump accomplished. Awaiting new orders.
Yes, let's leave this zone behind.
Relocation complete. Awaiting new instructions.
We have insufficient jump fuel to reach to our destination.
We need more jump fuel for such a jump.
Affirmative, we're setting off to the next fuel depot.
Going to refuel prior to jump.
Jump fuel exhausted, requesting fuel resupply.
We're out of jump fuel and the next fuel station is too distant. Requesting resupply.
Since we don't have the jump fuel, we'll try jumping using the generator.
We're well below the necessary fuel level but we'll try a forced-jump anyway.
We'll need to refuel to get there, Sir.
Hello Sir, Architect speaking. How may I help you?
(Asked how to get building resources)We need construction resources. In which way do you want them handled?
We have enough resources to begin now. Is that where you want this built? It's time for a final decision.
Module completed, Sir. Awaiting your next construction order.
Your station is complete, Sir. Our most hearty congratulations!
This module is the next you scheduled for construction.
These modules are available to build at this point in construction.
Are you sure this is the module you want next? Once we start, there's no pulling out.
A most excellent choice! Starting construction now.
Hello Sir, Architect speaking. With your station nearly complete, you'll soon need a Station Manager here.
Here are the stations currently available for building.
Moving to your construction site.
Hello Sir, I've some excellent spaceship models available. Would you care to look?
All right, we have enough to build. Is this definitely the one you want? After starting, there's no get-out clause.
Ship construction completed, Sir.
We're fully-committed just now, but please review our catalogue and come back later.
Hello Sir, your new ship will soon need a pilot. Do you have anyone already?
Here is the list of ships we can build for you.
Current funding will not cover the task, Sir.
(PC: You take care of it.)Affirmative, funding taken care of. Now we are in business.
Please select your chosen extensions, bearing in mind that some need to interact.
Please select your level of upgrade and confirm the work.
Please select the hull percentage to which we should conduct repairs.
This is a list of all available modules for the station.
This is an overview of my current resource status.
(architect)Any funds I do not use will be returned to you.
(Initiate Trade)You have a deal and we're on our way.
(Receive)Preparing to accept wares.
(Deliver)Preparing to deliver wares.
(Fail Space)We're unable to do that while our cargo bay is so full!
(Fail Type)Sorry, we cannot fit in that type of ware!
(Fail Space Standby)Our cargo space is full. Let us know what you want us to do.
(Fail Buy Amount)The amount we wanted is not available here now. We'll take what we can unless you have other instructions.
(Fail Sell Amount)They aren't interested in taking all our goods here. We'll sell what we can and move on unless you want something else.
(Fail Buy Ware)They don't sell what we wanted here. Moving to the next order unless otherwise tasked.
(Fail Sell Ware)They don't like our goods here. We'll continue to the next order unless you advise otherwise.
(Fail Buy Price)They're charging more than we hoped here. We'll buy anyway unless you tell us not to.
(Fail Sell Price)They're offering less than we wanted for the goods here. We'll sell them anyway unless you'd rather we didn't.
(Fail)That trade will not be possible here, please advise.
Sir, we've a considerable surge in income. Unless you tell me not to, I'll transfer the surplus amount momentarily.
The deal has been closed. Sending report.
We are in place and preparing to jump.
(fixed something)Here you are.
It looks brand new!
Told you I'd get it fixed!
(Initiate Mining)Confirmed, we will stand by to mine.
(Launch)Launching collector drones.
(Recall)Recalling collector drones.
(Automatic)Automatic operations have commenced, Sir.
(Fail Type)We cannot hold that type of ware.
Affirmative. Our drones will pick up whatever you tag.
Affirmative. Our drones will prioritise whatever you tag.
Negative. We don't have the necessary collector drones on board.
Affirmative. Our drones will start collecting.
Mining operations ended, Sir. We'll follow you unless instructed otherwise.
We are full to capacity and on our way to your location.
(Squad member)I was just told to drop my cargo, Sir.
It's a request from the police.
It's a demand from a rather hostile ship nearby.
Should I do it?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
Standing by and awaiting orders.
(scan successful)Data received - analysing for optimal point of attack.
We'll breach at the optimum spot, there.
(not scanned)That spot looks just about as good as any other.
Launching at the target.
We're being damaged!
Incoming fire!
Starting to cut the hull.
Hull breached, we're moving inside.
Assault team is ready to move.
Moving inward. Keep your sensor scans going!
Be careful, they're here somewhere.
(loud)Contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
Use that cover!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Interlock your arcs!
(lots of fighting noise)We're taking effective enemy fire!
(lots of fighting noise)Secure the position!
(lots of fighting noise)Drive on!
(lots of fighting noise)Get some fire down!
Move it!
(quiet)Multiple sensor alerts ahead.
(assist mission successful)They're pulling out! We're clear to advance.
(assist mission failed/timed out)They're really established now. We'll have to fight through and take them out ourselves.
(assist mission successful)Sentries deactivated!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We'll bull our way through!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
We're at a security console.
Starting security system hack.
(assist mission successful)Automated defences are shutting down.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Damn, they're still concentrating on us - we'll have to destroy all remaining defences!
They've activated the damn self-destruct! Attempting override!
(relieved)Self-destruct deactivated.
(assist mission failed/timed out)No good - evade and escape now! Shift it!
Confirm transfer of command. We're coming back aboard Cap'n.
We're too few to continue! Retreat!
The hull's going critical! Retreat to the pods!
We're at the pods and returning home!
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)Medic!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Man down!
Argh...(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Stand clear! Blowing the hatch!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Watch your arcs!
(lots of fighting noise)Don't let them outflank you!
Clear.
(sound of laser fire)Sentry lasers!
Deployable force field active ahead.
(assist mission successful)Force field deactivated!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We need to find another way around.
The crew have given up, the ship is ours!(cheers)
They're giving up, the station is ours!(cheers)
We've got no chance to...(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)The target is under our control. Well done everyone!
(upgrades)Successfully upgraded. Undocking now.
Downgrades completed. Undocking.
Upgrades integrated.
Choose the ship you want upgraded.
Which upgrade do you fancy?
(*Hiring*)
You already have someone employed in my capacity.
You already have an Engineer on board.
You already have a Marine Officer on board.
Do you want me to replace them or do you want me employed elsewhere?
Thank you for hiring me Sir. I promise that you will be delighted.(stress 'will')
Hiring me was the best thing you could do, Sir.
(On board introduction)I'm new here. I hope to meet the whole team soon.
(Fired in space)Right, I'm off at the next stop. I'll be quiet in the meantime.
(Fired on platform)I think I'll find another job right away before word gets round that I was fired.
(Assign to object)OK, Sir. I'll set up post where ordered.
(Assign to ship)OK, I've assumed control.
(Return to player)OK, Sir. Permission to come aboard?
(Leave player)Farewell Mr Otani.
(Leave player)Goodbye for now. I hope all goes well for you.
(Showing skills)I'm well-qualified. Take a look here.
(Showing skills)I think these are impressive, and I hope you do too.
(Orders)Target coordinate update required.
(Sell ship)Your ship has been sold. You've done well out of the deal.
(Sell ship)That ship looked really sad as she was taken away. I think the credits will be scant consolation for her loss.
(respond to free mode)Your faith in me is quite gratifying.
(respond to free mode)My freedom of action is much appreciated.
(respond to restricted mode)Well OK, I'll be sure to check everything with you first.(slightly sad)
(respond to restricted mode)I'll be sure to double-check everything I do with you first.(rather tightly)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Take care where you point that, please!
(player attacks - friendly 2)Do you care where you're shooting?
(player attacks - neutral 1)You did that because ...?
(player attacks - neutral 2)Can't you just hail a ship like any other pilot?
(player attacks - enemy 1)You're so going to wish you hadn't done that!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Keep it up and you'll end up in a penal colony!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)There's stupidity, and then there's stupidity right in front of the police!
(big object attacked)Hey, buzz off and annoy someone else!
(big object attacked)So you want to play with the big boys, eh?
(light fire 1)I've some unwanted attention here!
(light fire 2)I've a bit of a situation here!
(mid fire 1)I can't see this turning out well for me!
(mid fire 2)A persistent bastard!
(heavy fire 1)This is not good. Not good at all!
(heavy fire 2)Don't spare any time getting here, I'm almost done for!
(heavy fire 3)Help me! Just follow the debris trail to find me!
(station defence)Calling nearby defence ships.
(station defence)This station needs your immediate assistance.
(station defence)Our station is under severe threat!
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(death 3)Aaarrrgghhh!
(shield warning 1)Shields borderline!
(shield warning 2)My shields aren't helping anymore!
(hull warning 1)Taking direct hull damage - she can't last long!
(hull warning 2)A little more damage and the hull will give out!
(Incoming Enemies)Incoming bad guys!
(Incoming Wave)Just what we need! Another lot of them!
(Last Wave)See off this lot and I think we're through the worst.
(Player Needed)Get over here! I needed you an hour ago!
(Success 1)Wow! That was some fight, and we came out on top!
(Success 2)Safe those weapons. Let's have no accidents after we've won this battle!
(Fail 1)No way around it. We were thrashed!
(Fail 2)I've too much damage to think about what comes next!
We've got some big issues here!
I don't think I can stay aboard much longer!
(Incoming Enemies)We've enemies closing in!
(Dangerous area)This doesn't look too safe at all!
(Plead for life 1)Hold off please! I've had enough!
(Plead for life 2)For the sake of my daughter, let me survive this!
(Plead for life 3)Let me live and I'll report your chivalry. It may save your life one day!
(Plead for life 4)This ship is everything I own! Don't destroy her!
Follow us.
Keep close.
We'll follow you.
Lead the way.
We're ready.
Ready to go!
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)Please evacuate calmly. Do not panic and do not run.(calming)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)Great. So you're up for some gainful employment?
(General 2)Well, you could be a godsend if you can help out.
(Easy 1)This really won't cause you to break into a sweat.
(Easy 2)This is right up your street, I think.
(Hard 1)Remind me why I should believe you can do this.
(Hard 2)You really haven't convinced me that you are right for this.
(Fight Easy 1)This seems a perfect job for an adventurer such as yourself.
(Fight Easy 2)You look like someone who can win a simple scrap!
(Fight Hard 1)Being gung-ho is not a good substitute for combat-capability!
(Fight Hard 2)Remind me to avoid using your insurance company!
(Trade Easy 1)A straight-forward trade run with no complications.
(Trade Easy 2)This should be a piece of cake for anyone with the cargo capacity.
(Trade Hard 1)I'm looking for a seamless freight transfer service and I won't tolerate any excuses.
(Trade Hard 2)My clients expect the best transportation services and so do I. I have my doubts about your capability.
(Acceptance Query 1)So? Still confident?
(Acceptance Query 2)Are you still up for this?
(Accept 1)Excellent, I knew you could handle it.
(Accept 2)Brilliant, I'm happy to have you working for us.
(Reluctant 1)OK, but only if you think you can handle it.
(Reluctant 2)Hmm. Good luck. You'll be needing it, I think!
(Reject 1)Sorry, giving the job to someone like you would be a mistake.
(Reject 2)If I gave you the job, I'm sure you'd let me down.
(Info 1)I'm transferring relevant job data to your system now.
(Info 2)Everything you need to know is being transferred to you now.
(Success 1)I knew you were the right guy. Well done!
(Success 2)Nice work! I had a lot riding on you getting it done.
(Semi 1)Yeah, better than nothing, I suppose.
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)Sure, that wasn't a total failure.
(Fail 1)Well, now I have to try to recover something from this fiasco. Clear off!
(Fail 2)Well don't expect any more jobs from me after that!
(Credits 1)The agreed credits are being transferred to you now.
(Reward 1)Here's something extra too.
(Client abort)Sorry, your services are no longer necessary.
(mission update)There's been a change of circumstances. A job update is on the way.
(mission update 2)Check out the latest job update please.
(Assassination Offer 1)I need a permanent end to someone's meddling. Get my drift?
(Assassination Offer 2)I don't care how you do it, but there's someone that I never want to hear of again.
(Target)They sent that heap of junk to take me? This should be ... short!
(Target 2)You really expect me to feel threatened by you and that ship?
(Bribe 1)How about we come to a private and mutually-beneficial understanding?
(Success)They didn't have a hope in hell!
(Fail)How did they avoid you? I thought you were a real hot-shot!
(Fail by bribe)We know what you arranged with the mark. Let's see if you think it so clever later on!
(Protect Station Offer 1)With incoming hostiles, we could really use some help right about now!
(Protect Station Offer 2)We have no way to avoid serious casualties unless you can keep the incoming forces away from us.
(Protect Ship Offer 1)We're totally vulnerable here unless you can assist in our defence!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Calling on all frequencies. Ship under unprovoked attack requires urgent assistance!
(Police 1)We have good intelligence that smugglers use this area. We need a ship unknown to them to get into scanning range.
(Success 1)Good work. That evidence should let us identify their operations, origins and destinations.
(Semi 1)Really, so there was nothing going on? Oh well, if you say so.
(Fail 1)You know, we didn't offer to pay for a holiday sight-seeing tour.
(Passenger Offer 1)I really need a ride out of here pretty quickly. Can you help.
(Passenger Offer 2)Can you help me to get to somewhere fast?
(On Board)All right, I'm safely installed back here.
(Space)You haven't left any space for me to get in.
(Late)Hello I'm still here! Are we nearly there yet?
(Fail)Let me off at the nearest platform. I'll find someone more competent there.
(Assigned to platform)OK Sir. I'm moving quarters as we speak.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)We need some urgent cargo delivered elsewhere. Are you interested?
(Return Ware Offer)We need someone reliable to get some wares to us. Ready to do it?
(Late Sell)Our client has reported that the goods are still in transit. Please expedite!
(Late Return)We're still waiting for those supplies. Tell me you're nearly here!
(Fail Sell)Our client just broke off his contract. This has been a disaster for us!
(Fail Return)Look, don't even bother docking. We'll get our goods some other way.
(Emergency Offer)Help me out here! I wouldn't call if I wasn't desperate!
(Emergency Offer)All pilots! Get here, save us and earn credits!
(Emergency Offer)Hello? Is anyone there? Can anybody help me?
(station manager)Docking permission granted.
Welcome aboard.
It is our pleasure to have you aboard.
It is an honour to welcome you aboard.
Thank you for dealing with the threat to our station.
(Defence manager thanking player)Well done the 'Pride'!
(Defence manager thanking player)Thanks for sorting that out for us!
Thank you for your assistance. Your payment is being transferred.
Hello pilot. Is there anything I can offer you?
(trader introduction)Here, what I have might interest you.
(trader introduction)Sure, look around. I can tell you more about anything you see.
(trader introduction)If our rivals did have anything like these, they would be last year's versions!
(trader introduction)Full fitting and after-sales service is included!
(generic trader)This is what I have for you today.
(performing service)We'll get right on it.
We're ready.
We have a deal!
Agreed!
(giving object or info){,4111}
I've some quality weaponry that would fit your ship.
You should always stock up on ammunition whenever you can.
An empty ammo bin can be a death sentence in these parts.
These are premium-grade products!
You won't find anything better in this system.
You are a discerning customer!
How many would you like?
May I offer you something else?
Let's get this integrated into your ship's systems.
Let's get to work on improving your ship.
Here you go. The Albion Pride is the top of her line.
That work makes me proud too. We both have pride!
She looks so proud now that it brings a tear to my eye.
(Shady trader)Hey you! Looking for something a bit 'special'?(special as in illegal)
Keep it down now. I have the following 'specialities'!
How much will you be, err, smuggling?
(licence trader)A fresh customer for licences, eh?
I can supply you with the following licences.
This licence comes with responsibilities as well as advantages!
This licence is granted on the understanding that you honour its intended purposes.
Great.
Deal.
Fine.
Confirmed.
(accepting gift from player){,4300}
Reporting in, how may we help?
Yes, what would you like us to do?
Help me please!
Anyone in range, please respond!
Emergency, Mayday, please reply!
Urgent assistance needed here, please help!
Station command for unidentified vessel.
Station command for Ren Otani.
(attacking allied object)Your actions here will not be tolerated.
You will be held responsible for your actions.
You will regret those activities.
Retribution is on the way!
I hope this was all by accident.
Your actions may have dire consequences.
You have been identified and recorded.
Station command for law enforcement.
We're under heavy attack.
Requesting assistance.
We're on the case. Sending units to assist you now.
Uh, sorry! I've nothing at all to send just now.
Eh? You what?
Unbelievable!
Report related to individual Ren Otani.
Ren Otani - personal file on the way.
Sending P file.
He's on our files.
Oh, him again.
He has a criminal record.
Data received.
It's her again. She was trouble last time!
She is well-known to the authorities.
Contacting law enforcement authority.
(Found discount)We don't do this price for just anyone you know!
(Found discount)Special offer found here! Right now, right price, right up your street!
(discount offer)If I wasn't doing the best offers around, I wouldn't be here!
(discount offer)Special prices for a special friend!
(discount explanation)We made a killing in a rival's buy-out and their stock came free.
(discount explanation)Our last big-order customer had an eye for a bulk bargain - and a heart condition!
(discount explanation)Our factory went a little mad with the staff overtime.
(player station manager)We have a slight problem, Sir.
(player station manager)Sir, we have a bit of a situation.
Our station can't work just now.
Station operation is at a standstill.
Transmitting details now...
Please advise...
More resources are needed.
The resources we have are insufficient.
(can also be used for ships)Our cargo capacity is being stretched now.
(can also be used for ships)There's no more room in our storage bays.
(architect)We require a manager.
(can also be used for ships)This is what can be done to improve operations.
(can also be used for ships)This could be done to improve our effectiveness.
(defence officer)We're being attacked, help us please!
We are facing incoming hostiles! We could do with support ships here.
(exchange wares)With whom would you like us to exchange goods?
Which ware is to be transferred?
Which ware is up for transfer?
How much?
Advise the number please.
What amount did you have in mind?
Understood. Transfer in progress.
Got it. Transfer initiated.
Do you want these installed for use, or just put into cargo as wares?
I find myself short of the necessary credits, Sir.
If I may, I'll get the necessary credits from your account.
We're back in business now. Thank you.
I need to discuss my budget with you as soon as possible.
The budget changes are acknowledged.
We'll start operations on arrival.
(rejecting impossible mode order)That can't be done at the moment.
Once there, what will our mission be?
Where would you like us to go?
We are leaving for the destination specified.
We are safely at the intended destination.
Operation has now commenced.
We are taking part in joint operations.
(Witness)I saw that!
(Witness threatened or bribed)Well, I'm really not so sure exactly what I saw!
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)That's insulting!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)Ah yes, your fame precedes you.(#smile#) Glad to meet you!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)I've been following your exploits.(#smile#) It's so good to see you here!
Sir, is that task just for me or should I take the other ships that I command?
(Pilot sold his ship)I'll look around for another commission, unless you have some more work for me.
Yes Sir, what is my new command?
Affirmative. I will jump to you and join the fleet.
Joining your command at your location. Sir.
Sir, have you orders for me? If it is bad timing then I will just join your squad.
(Manager)Sir? I believe you have a ship for me?
(Manager)I'll just continue existing orders for now.
Sir, this is my currently allocated job.
(Player scanned)Just a routine authorised scan.
(Player scanned)Your cooperation in this would be appreciated.
(Player scanned - aggressive)We'll soon see what you have hidden away!
(Player scanned - aggressive)We'll find all your little secrets!
(nothing found)Nothing to report, please continue your journey.
(nothing found)Scan complete. Your cooperation was appreciated.
(nothing found - aggressive)Humph! OK, you got away with it this time. Move along!
(nothing found - aggressive)You came up clear this time. We'll get you next time!
(contraband found - police)All right. We have the authority to deal with this. I suggest that you cooperate fully.
(contraband found - police)That, Pilot, is considered contraband here. We'll deal with this shortly.
(drop instruction)Drop all contraband goods, or there will be serious consequences!
(pirate plundering)Well look here! That's just beautiful!
(pirate plundering)My, you have the same eye for the good stuff as I have!
(drop instruction)You drop some of the dodgy stuff and maybe that'll be that.
(dropped)Well, you made a smart decision there!
(dropped)Good thinking on your part. Now scram!
(dropped part)Don't get tight-fisted on us, it doesn't work like that!
(dropped part)That's almost insulting. Think again!
(Misc Argon Pilot)
This is Plutarch Security. The Jump Gate is in lockdown until full quarantine procedures can be initiated. Any ships attempting unauthorised transit will be destroyed without further warning.
(Crewman answering captain)It was their self-destruct sir. Looks like it was rigged to blow via remote.
(found an enemy ship)Enemy vessel, marking.
(can't find source)It doesn't look like it came from the immediate area.
Is your ship secure for jump?
Hold onto your lunch!
Don't take too long. We can't sit here forever.
Give them hell out there!
Succinctly put. (#nod01#)I can agree with that!
(#lookdown01#)I wish I had your gift of expression!
That's fascinating. I could listen to you for hours!
(#thinking01#)How very thought-provoking. I wish you would go on!
Heh, you're used to talking and getting your way,(#laugh#) aren't you!
(#nod01#)You seem very convincing!
Don't stop. This is good stuff!
(#nod01#)Yes, I can see why you'd say that!
Yes, I see. You have more on that, no doubt.
I still have time to carry on.
(#thinking01#)That's pretty interesting.
Don't worry. I have time to continue with this.
(#scratchhead01#)I don't quite understand that bit.
(#scratchhead01#)You're beginning to lose me there.
(#hard#)Can we get to the point of this please.
(#crossarms01#)No, I don't really see that point of view.
(#cold#)I've spent long enough on this. I need to go soon.
I can't see us agreeing here. Let's leave it be.
(#angry#)I'm sorry, I don't have time for this!
(#excuse#)On that note, this chat is over!
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)It was really good that we had this chat.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)I really enjoyed having that conversation.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)(#punchhand01#)Say, why don't I tell you of a really good trade opportunity that I know of?
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)I happen to know of someone really good who is looking for job right now.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)If you are looking to hire a skilled person, I have a lot of influence with someone open for offers.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)Do any trade with me now(#nod01#) and you'll get my best discount rate.
Why can Terrans be so easily confused?(#laugh#) See what I did there? Can-Terrans... Canterans? (#shrug01#)No? Oh, never mind.
Sure,(#shrug01#) it's just that I know nothing about them!(defensive)
(#nod01#)You may be onto something there, but I just don't know. (#disapproval01#)Argons have a hard time accepting that they are basically just colonial Terrans.(ending disrespectfully)
Sounds sweet, but luxuries aren't really my thing... Not a bad idea though. (#punchhand01#)Maybe I could use a change!(having an epiphany)
It's hard to believe that even Plutarch would be using Xenon tech.
(#nod01#)Too right! And rightfully so!
Sure, putting out a fire quickly is one thing,(#sad#) but coping with a Xenon fleet on the loose is a different kettle of fish entirely.
Point taken. That faith you mentioned - I get that.(irony)
(#nod01#)That's precisely what concerns me so much.
(#shrug01#)I can't see that we'd be any better at controlling them than Plutarch, but it may very well give us more time to react.
How can something so beautiful not be real??
Not especially. I suppose that's all VR too.
Isn't that the whole point?(#rolleyes01#) I'd have never considered them to be anything other than eye candy.
(#nod01#)Good point. Got to weigh up the risk. Fulfilling it's potential is a long shot though.
I get that. When all is said and done, we wouldn't amount to much, if we didn't.
You know what I'm talking about! (#hard#)They've got it all wrong!
Indeed. There are many ways that could happen - some may be far-fetched, (#thinking01#)but certainly not beyond the realms of possibility.
(#nod01#)Hard to imagine that not even forty years ago, there weren't even these highways.
The new technology out there now is really awesome, right?
Despite the loss of some freedom - some people like to wander off the path - it's an amazing advancement.
You live and learn! I really didn't know that extra fuel was required before. (#nod01#)Good to know. Thanks!
(#shrug01#)It's a mystery to me. I guess there's a couple of geeks at Jonferco that know, but me..?(#scratchhead01#) Not a clue.

page.title: Argon NPC Female 1 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[argon] [terran] female basic
(greeting friendly)Hi there!
(greeting neutral)Comms channel established.
(greeting enemy)What can you possibly want?(stress 'you')
(greeting rejected)I really don't feel like speaking with you.
(greeting service)How may I assist?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)May fortune favour you!
(goodbye neutral)Goodbye.
(goodbye enemy)Yeah, push off!
