(pirate plundering)That looks a fair old batch of loot you have there!
(drop instruction)You can just drop a decent share for us, or we can do this the painful way!
(dropped)That's a very wise choice!
(dropped)A good move on your part. Now clear out!
(dropped part)We both know you have far more than that.
(dropped part)You're joking, right? I'm not stupid!.
Lieutenant, Otani. This is Captain Mariya Rybak of the mining ship Amber Excavator. Nice place you have here.
A welcoming committee? You shouldn't have.
Appreciated. Lead the way.
Got it Lieutenant. Don't mention the war... Oops.
(#nod01#)Roger that Lieutenant, on our way.
(#cold#)Weapons primed. We'll fire a few warning shots to ward them off.
(#disapproval01#)Lieutenant?(wants confirmation on order)
(#nod01#)Roger that. Engaging.
We don't see any more in range. I think we got them.
This is Rybak. We're all ready for mining ops. Shall we begin?
(#nod01#)Understood.
Lieutenant, are you sure you don't need us to fight?
(#nod01#)OK. We'll be on standby. Good luck.
This is Rybak, we're coming in hot!
We can draw their fire. Just get those people out of here.
(Misc Argon Female Pilot)
Unidentified vessel, that's close enough. What do you want?
Hold position and stand by.
Albion Skunk, you've been cleared to land.
Skunk, we have your back. Just make it quick.
(Misc Female Republic of Cantera Pilot)
Welcome to the party, Skunk. (#laugh#)You'd better warm up those weapons. We'll have Reivers knocking on our door soon enough.
We're on our own for now.
We've still got the upper hand. Keep pressing!
(Misc Female Republic of Cantera Pilot)
Let's get going. Sitting still gets you killed.
This place has seen a lot of action over the years, hence the name. Kha'ak, Terran, Xenon; they come, we hold and they retreat.
We should be safe enough now. Thanks for the help Skunk. I'll let head-office know how we got on.
(#nod01#)I couldn't have said it better myself!
(#smile#)You're a natural speaker! I'm enjoying this!
(#smile#)I could listen to your voice for days!
That's very astute of you! Please go on!
(#laugh#)I bet you talk like that to all the girls!
You come across as very sincere in what you say!
(#nod01#)Yes, I can see what you are getting at!
Don't stop now, this is getting good!
Yes, I'm still with you.
(#lookdown01#)Hmm. I can understand why some would think that.
Well that is a different slant on it.
(#scratchhead01#)Don't mind me, I often fidget when talking.
That doesn't quite make sense to me.
(#shrug01#)I think we are drifting apart on this one.
(#crossarms01#)I'm still waiting to hear anything convincing.
(#disapproval01#)I just cannot agree with everything you just said.
(#sad#)I think we're wasting time talking about this.
(#cold#)I've pretty much had enough now.
(#hard#)Please go and trouble somebody else with your views!
(#angry#)I don't want to hear any more!
(smalltalk reward introduction)This chat has been rewarding for both of us. (#smile#)I wouldn't mind taking this a bit further!
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)It was great to have such a stimulating conversation.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)As as favour, I can tell you of a really good offer just now.
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)If you want, I know of a good person seeking employment. Here are some details.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)There's a very skilled professional thinking of seeking a job. I have exclusive access.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)Anything we trade from here on will be with a splendid discount.
(#disapproval01#)Eww... slimy green lizardy things are everywhere!
(#angry#)So a girl's not allowed an opinion?
Do I look the jealous type? They're still green though!
Looks aside, there's just something about them that creeps me out.
I guess speaking their language would be difficult for us. (#lookdown01#)So maybe we can forgive a few extra esses.
OK, so maybe I love a bit of gossip. Who doesn't, right? (#laugh#)Bring on 'Hug a Teladi Day'!
Are you crazy?! (#angry#)That sort of talk gets people in trouble with the law! Get outta here!
So Nopileos was Teladi? OK, I guess I can't tar all Teladi with the same brush.
It's amazing to think that forty years ago they didn't even have highways.
Right and since then ever more amazing technology has been developed.
Granted, it's splendid technology, but doesn't it just take the fun out of flying a little?
I had no idea extra fuel was needed for that in the past. Thanks for the info!
Urgh... (#scratchhead01#)my brain hurts just thinking about how they might even do that!
(#rolleyes02#)Plutarch did what?!?
Not all of it. Did you?
No kidding?! Great work! Yes, I'd definitely like to hear more!
Unbelievable! How did they manage to keep this quiet for so long?
I have no words to describe my shock at that. Are you absolutely sure? Seeing your face, I needn't have asked.
Your source is not as important as how reliable the information is.
Looks like Plutarch have found themselves another enemy. No surprises there.
(Sigh)You didn't feel it was important? (#disapproval01#)Get out of here, you oxygen thief!
(#sad#)It's been a hard few years, believe me.
What happened? (#rolleyes01#)You're kidding, right? (#facepalm01#)Take a look around and you'll see what happened.
Absolutely right but it seems to me that some of us came off much worse.
(#cold#)I'm not sure I have the words to adequately describe the horrors we endured and the sacrifices that were forced upon us.
(#sad#)Given the fact that the reality was even worse, you'd forgive people for editing the stories somewhat.
As unbelievable as it may sound now, only by living it could you fully appreciate the full horror of the situation.
Yes, a great many of us came from Terra, sent here to set up a mining colony.(#cold#) Ironic that the rocks are all we have left.(bitter)
Step into my shoes for a moment. The future may indeed be a bright one but it needs to be brighter to eliminate the darkness of our past.
No, I've heard the rumours too but we had bigger fish to fry. We had the Reivers.
No idea at all. They don't talk much. They raid a lot. (#hard#)Frankly it's hard to give a care for them when we have our own woes.

page.title: Argon NPC Female 2 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[argon] [terran] female basic
(greeting friendly)Well hello.
(greeting neutral)Receiving you.
(greeting enemy)Well this is an unpleasant surprise!
(greeting rejected)I think we have nothing to discuss!
(greeting service)I'm ready to assist in any way I can!
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)God speed!
(goodbye neutral)Goodbye for now.
(goodbye enemy)I'm glad that's all over!
(goodbye rejected)Don't bother me again!
(goodbye service)I'm pleased that I could help.
(ship scanned - complicit)Sure, just scan away. I'm only doing my nails.
(ship scanned - neutral)Remind me why you are scanning me?
(ship scanned - illegal)That's really frowned on in these parts!
(ship scanned - enemy)That seems like the prelude to a fight!
(ship scanned - confident)You'll be wasting your time, my friend.
(ship scanned - possessing)Ho Hum. I guess I've been rumbled! It's just a hobby of mine, you know!
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Yeah, we're running a sweepstake on how long you'll take!
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Aw, that not a very nice thing to do!
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Since you flaunt the scanning rules, I don't consider your motives innocent!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)You wanted to be provocative? Well you've done it!
(station/capship scanned - confident)Have I got time to have a cup of java while you get on with it?
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Hmm. I see I have a crew discipline problem then!
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)(hopeful)Look, that's just dummy illegal cargo I keep to impress the others. Just a joke, eh?
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)Well, I suppose that looks pretty bad. Yeah ... that .. err .. looks pretty bad!
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)(mildly depressed)We didn't really think anyone would mind, not this far out in the end of nowhere!
(directions - location not known)So sorry, that's one I don't know.
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)You're having a laugh, right?
(surrender - hostile)I guess you planned this all along!
(surrender - complicit)Keep your finger off the trigger. I'll obey your commands.
(drops cargo 1)Look, you play with this stuff and I'll just plod along and say nothing. Yes?
(drops cargo 2)We can all win from this. You get the goods, and I get to live and claim the insurance!
(bail from ship 1)All right, I'm getting out. This ship's like my kid sister to me. You be kind to her!
(bail from ship 2)Quit with the firing already! I am trying to get dressed for space here!
(*Hired NPCs*)
(greeting formal)I'm here to assist you, Sir.
(greeting informal)Would you like something?
(hired comm greeting 2)Hello Sir, it's great to be able to help out!
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Hello Sir. It's my pleasure to meet you at last.
(goodbye formal) We hope to see you again, Sir.
(goodbye informal)Until next time.
We remain at your service, Sir.
Don't worry! We're totally the best at what we do!
(join squad)Joining your squad.
(leave squad)Leaving your squad.
(accept order 1)Yes, Sir.
(accept order 2)Got it.
(reject order 1)Sorry Sir, I'm unable to do that.
(reject order 2)I don't have the means to do that.
(Automatic)Starting automatic operations, Sir.
(standby)Affirmative. Standing by.
Affirmative.
Understood.
Negative.
(jumpdrive charging)Co-ordinates set and Jump Drive charging.
(jumpdrive aborted)Aborting jump!
(jumpdrive engaged)Jump Drive fully charged and ready.
(jumpdrive emergency)Escape route programmed. Jumping!
(jumpdrive cooldown)We can't jump until our Jump Drive is recharged.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Jump Drive cooling.
(jumpdrive success)We have jumped and the board shows clear.
(engage boost to player)We're boosting towards the location sent us.
(engage boost)Boosters functioning.
(follow)We'll be right behind you, Sir.
(moveto)Moving to position.
(moveto dock)Moving to dock.
(docked)Successfully docked.
Now that went smoothly!
I'm glad there's no problem with what we were doing.
(arrived)We're at the spot, Sir.
(arrived)We're there now.
(arrived at player)I'm at your location.
(arrived at player)We're within visual range of you.
Understood. Turning to take up guard position.
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Sir, we're delighted to welcome you aboard.
We're out of the necessary drones. Awaiting different orders.
Affirmative, but we're very short of drones. This may take a while.
Negative. We've no suitable drones on board.
We must restock our drones first.
(request additional ships)Well some more ships here would be really good news.
(received additional ship)She's a beauty. I'll see she earns her upkeep.
That really doesn't sit well with our present tasking.
Current operations are being wound up.
We await new instructions, Sir.
(Player loses licence)You've lost our licence and all associated entitlements, Mr Otani.
The reasons should be perfectly clear to you.
Our ship is seriously damaged, any advice for me?
We're unable to move and need assistance!
Affirmative. On our way to the shipyard.
We safely at the shipyard and await instructions.
Our Jump Drive is damaged and won't work without repairs first.
Affirmative. We will jump when we have the capability.
We're docked at the shipyard. We're in good hands until you want us again.
Our engine is damaged and we must undertake repairs.
Affirmative. We'll move once we're able to.
Jump Drive charging for emergency relocation.
The emergency jump worked! Any new instructions?
Leaving the zone as ordered.
We have changed zones. Awaiting instructions.
Not enough fuel for that jump!
We need more fuel for such a long jump.
Affirmative, heading for the fuel depot.
Proceeding to refuel prior to jumping as instructed.
Jump fuel reserves are low, requesting fuel delivery.
We're out of fuel; there's not even enough to get to the next fuel station. I need a fuel resupply.
Since we don't have the fuel, we'll try to jump using the generator.
We're well below recommended jump energy but we'll try to jump the ship anyway.
We'll be needing to refuel in order to get to that destination.
Hello Sir, Architect speaking. What may I do for you?
(Asked how to get building resources)How would you like us to handle the provision of resources for construction, Sir?
Thank you, we've everything we need. You're certain this is the location you want for your station? We can't change anything once we start.
Your new module is finished, Sir. What next?
You've our heartiest congratulations on the completion of your new station, Sir.
This module is next in the construction programme, Sir.
Given your current building progress, these modules are available.
If we start work on that module, there'll be no chance for a change of mind. So are you sure, Sir?
You've made a fine choice, Sir. We'll start on it right away.
Hello Sir, your Architect speaking. Your completed station will require a Station Manager. You can hire and fetch one while we finish it off.
These are the stations we can build for you now.
Moving to the build location.
Hello Sir, what about a new spaceship? We can guarantee you get a top class ship!
We now have everything needed. Are you sure this ship is your best choice? Once we start work, we have to complete it.
Ship construction complete Sir. She looks lovely!
We're fully-booked at the moment. Please review our listings and try us again in a while.
Hello Sir, your new ship nears completion. Have you thought about finding a Pilot for her yet?
Here are the ship types we can build for you.
We really do need some more funding from you to avoid problems downstream, Sir.
(PC: You take care of it.)That's fine. Funding should not be an issue now.
These extensions are suitable. Some require others as well, but we can sort that out for you.
Your confirmation of which upgrade levels you would like would be most helpful now, Sir.
What percentage of repair of the hull did you have in mind?
Any of the modules listed here would enhance your station greatly!
Let me show you my current stocks of available resources.
(architect)Your account will be refunded with any credits I may have left over. How may I help you spend it, hmmm?
(Initiate Trade)Deal confirmed, we're on our way.
(Receive)Preparing to take on wares.
(Deliver)Preparing to off-load wares.
(Fail Space)We're rather full and cannot take all that at the moment!
(Fail Type)We can't load that type of ware.
(Fail Space Standby)Our cargo bay is too full. Awaiting further advice.
(Fail Buy Amount)They don't seem to have the necessary stocks here. We'll buy as much as we can here, unless you tell us not to.
(Fail Sell Amount)There's no market for the goods we intended to sell here. We'll sell what we can and then start the next order - unless you tell us to the contrary.
(Fail Buy Ware)They don't have what we want here. Moving on to the next order - unless you instruct otherwise.
(Fail Sell Ware)They're not in the market for what we have here. Moving on to the next order, unless you redirect us.
(Fail Buy Price)Their price is rather steep here, but we'll purchase the requested amount here unless you tell us not to.
(Fail Sell Price)It seems that we won't make the selling-price we wanted here. We'll still sell the full amount though - unless you want us to do something else.
(Fail)We cannot complete the trade you wanted. Please provide further instructions.
Sir, we've amassed quite a few extra credits. They'll be transferred to your account, unless you want us to keep them.
Deal closed. Report on the way.
We're in location and looking for trade opportunities.
(fixed something)Here, all fixed!
A new lease of life!
Well, that went well!
(Initiate Mining)Confirmed, standing by to mine.
(Launch)Launching collectors.
(Recall)Recalling collectors.
(Automatic)Automatic operation is active, Sir.
(Fail Type)We're unable to transport that type of ware.
Affirmative. Our drones will pick up everything you tag.
Affirmative. Our drones will prioritise everything you tag.
Sorry, we don't appear to have any collector drones.
We're on it! Our drones are starting to collect.
We've stopped mining now, Sir. By your leave, we will move to follow you.
(Squad member)Somebody wants me to drop my cargo, Sir.
It's the police who are demanding it.
It's a rather hostile vessel that's demanding it.
So do I do it, or not?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
Standing by and waiting for orders.
(scan successful)Data received - analysing for weak points in their defences.
We'll breach at the recommended position.
(not scanned)That spot seems as good as any, without hard evidence!
Launching for the target.
That didn't sound good!
We're taking fire!
Starting to rip the hull open.
Hull penetrated, securing entry point.
Team in assault formation.
Moving out. Report all defences detected.
Watch out for kill-zones.
(loud)Contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
Take cover and return fire!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Mark targets and take them down!
(lots of fighting noise)Too many hot-spots!
(lots of fighting noise)Regroup here!
(lots of fighting noise)Now move out!
(lots of fighting noise)Interlock your fire!
Get on with it!
(quiet)Multiple sensor contacts ahead.
(assist mission successful)They're on the run! Move up after them while we can.
(assist mission failed/timed out)They're still there and we'll have dislodge them ourselves.
(assist mission successful)Auto-sentries powering down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)They're still active. Let's do this the hard way!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
We're at a security station.
Starting system hack.
(assist mission successful)Automated sensors and defences locked out!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Damn, they're on to us - we'll have to push through the remaining active defences!
Oh no! Self-destruct activated! Attempting override!
(relieved)Self-destruct locked down.
(assist mission failed/timed out)No good - get out of here, fast!
We have command. We're on our way back, Cap'n.
We're too few now to take the objective! Retreat!
The hull's going! Implosion imminent! Get back to the pods while you can!
We're in the pods and on our way back!
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)We've lost one!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Man down!
Argh...(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Stand clear! Blowing the hatch!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Watch my back, I'll get round them!
(lots of fighting noise)Weapon jammed!
Area secured.
(sound of laser fire)Laser sentries!
Defensive force field deployed.
(assist mission successful)Force field neutralised!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We'll need to make a detour.
The crew have had enough. The ship is ours!(cheers)
They've realised it's over. The station is all ours!(cheers)
We're out of ti--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)Objective achieved. Well done everyone!
(upgrades)Upgrade successful. Undocking.
Downgrade accomplished. Undocking.
Upgrades installed.
For which ship is the upgrade intended?
Which upgrade would you like?
(*Hiring*)
You already have someone in that position.
You have an Engineer for that task.
You already have a Marine Officer under your command.
Do you want me to take an occupied position or to serve elsewhere?
Thank you for hiring me, Sir. You'll not be displeased.
I look forward to joining your team, Sir.
(On board introduction)Greetings! It looks like I'm not the only fresh face here! (laughs)
(Fired in space)OK, I'll just hang around until we dock. I'll not get in the way.
(Fired on platform)Right, I'm out of here. I'll find someone less fussy!
(Assign to object)Sir, this job and I were meant for each other!
(Assign to ship)OK, I'm in command.
(Return to player)Got that. Setting off for your location.
(Leave player)See you anon, Mister Otani.
(Leave player)I'll take my leave, Sir.
(Showing skills)I think you'll be suitably impressed by my qualifications.
(Showing skills)My credentials are quite sound, as you can see here.
(Orders)Requesting new target coordinates.
(Sell ship)That ship of yours is sold. You've made a tidy sum of credits.
(Sell ship)She looked really proud as she was sold. The credits made just don't do her justice.
(respond to free mode)It is pleasant to have an employer who trusts me to use my initiative.
(respond to free mode)I have a nose for this job and following my instincts has always paid dividends in the past.
(respond to restricted mode)Well, If you really want me to keep checking with you, then I will. You're the boss!(rather aggrieved)
(respond to restricted mode)Well that's OK. In that case, any issues we may have will not be my fault!(defensive)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Hey, next time just send chocolates instead!
(player attacks - friendly 2)Those aren't flowers that you're showering me with!
(player attacks - neutral 1)I don't know why you did that, but I wish you'd stop!
(player attacks - neutral 2)Would you like me to buy you a ship-recognition manual?
(player attacks - enemy 1)Now that will not go unpunished!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Once more and you'll find out just how lonely space can get!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)We encourage a level of free-will here. You just went too far, though!
(big object attacked)Hey, if you collide with us I'll have to clean off the smear you'll make!
(big object attacked)You know, for such a little thing, you can be quite annoying!
(light fire 1)We've a bit of incoming fire here, and it's getting annoying!
(light fire 2)We're taking fire here but nothing that we can't handle - so far!
(mid fire 1)This is getting more serious now!
(mid fire 2)I can't lose this attacker - he's scoring hits!
(heavy fire 1)This is not good. Not good at all!
(heavy fire 2)Some help is needed here before we are all killed!
(heavy fire 3)Are you cowards going leave all this mess on my plate?
(station defence)All support ships on standby, be advised that this station is engaging hostile forces.
(station defence)Please get here and clear out the attacking forces before this station starts taking damage.
(station defence)We have a problem with hostiles here. Please come and help our station.
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(death 3)Aaarrrgghhh!
(shield warning 1)Shields ineffective!
(shield warning 2)Total shield failure imminent!
(hull warning 1)I'm getting repeated hull strikes!
(hull warning 2)The hull won't hold out much longer! She's going!
(Incoming Enemies)Right on cue! Ready all weapon systems
(Incoming Wave)Don't relax now! Here's another lot!
(Last Wave)Finish this lot and we're out of the woods!
(Player Needed)I'm taking all sorts of damage! I need you here, now!
(Success 1)We really gave them hell. Let's see how fast they can run!
(Success 2)That was a pretty close call, but we pulled through and saw them off!
(Fail 1)We were savaged. Not much good came of that!
(Fail 2)They won this time, but I hope some of us can make it back and get ready for the next round!
We've got more failure warnings than working systems here!
The reactor is almost critical!
(Incoming Enemies)We plot several enemy targets heading our way.
(Dangerous area)Coming here may not have been such a good idea.
(Plead for life 1)Listen! It doesn't have to be like this!
(Plead for life 2)You're wasting time and shots! My old girl's no threat to you anymore!
(Plead for life 3)Just name what you want to leave off! Name it!
(Plead for life 4)There's no glory in blowing away a sitting duck. Go find something worth boasting about!
Follow us.
Keep close.
We'll follow you.
Lead the way.
We're ready.
Ready to go!

(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)All personnel to assigned docks and pods. Do not stop to collect personal belongings.(calming)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)Greetings. You're available for this job still?
(General 2)Hello, you look like you could do with some work. Up for the job?
(Easy 1)This one should not trouble you much.
(Easy 2)You could do this job in your sleep!
(Hard 1)I'm not so sure about you. Are you positive you can do this?
(Hard 2)You do know that over-confidence gets pilots like you killed?
(Fight Easy 1)This is perfect for an aggressive flier like you.
(Fight Easy 2)You seem like you can handle yourself!
(Fight Hard 1)I like your style, but this needs fighting skill and capability rather than empty boasts.
(Fight Hard 2)If you get this wrong, you won't live to see the reward, no matter how big it is.
(Trade Easy 1)If you can shift goods on time then we both profit.
(Trade Easy 2)This is a simple trade run. There's no need for taking unnecessary risks.
(Trade Hard 1)I'm looking for a first rate conveyor of freight. Don't waste my time if you've any doubts!
(Trade Hard 2)I've sincere doubts about your ability. It'll cost us dearly if you fail me.
(Acceptance Query 1)So? Are you still in?
(Acceptance Query 2)That's the deal. Are you up for it?
(Accept 1)Great. I knew you were just made for this.
(Accept 2)Good to hear!
(Reluctant 1)OK, but only because you assure me you can do it.
(Reluctant 2)Fine. Just don't let me down on this!
(Reject 1)Sorry, I don't trust you can do this.
(Reject 2)If I gave you the job I'd just die of worry. No deal!
(Info 1)Transferring the job details to your system now.
(Info 2)The job specifications are on your system now.
(Success 1)I knew you'd do us both proud.
(Success 2)I'm glad to see that my trust was well-placed.
(Semi 1)OK, I suppose that's better than nothing.
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)Well, you've done your best. It's a pity it wasn't good enough though.
(Fail 1)Well thanks for nothing! Which is exactly what you get!
(Fail 2)Why oh why did I believe your boastful patter? Now we're both in deep trouble!
(Credits 1)I'm transferring the arranged fees now.
(Reward 1)Please, accept this as a little bonus.
(Client abort)Sorry, change of circumstances. Your services are no longer needed.
(mission update)We've had to rearrange a few things. Your briefing has been updated.
(mission update 2)Please recheck your briefing; there are a few minor changes.
(Assassination Offer 1)I want a troublesome individual silenced, permanently. You get the drift?
(Assassination Offer 2)Payment is conditional upon the target never being seen again, anywhere!
(Target)You intend to take me on in that? I guess they found an idiot for their contract!
(Target 2)Did you give them a really cheap quote or something? I certainly hope you did!
(Bribe 1)Hang on! Let's not be hasty! There must be something I can offer that'll make you turn aside?
(Success)They can't have survived that!
(Fail)So you let them escape. Carelessness, or stupidity?
(Fail by bribe)As if we wouldn't work out what you've done! I think you'd better be very careful from now on!
(Protect Station Offer 1)With hostiles inbound, we can do with all the help we can get!
(Protect Station Offer 2)We really need you to provide cover and prevent the enemy ships from striking our station.
(Protect Ship Offer 1)We're sitting ducks here without your ship as cover!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Please help us! We're under unprovoked attack by raiders.
(Police 1)Smugglers frequent this area and an unmarked ship could get close enough to scan and single them out.
(Success 1)Well done. That information should help us to discourage any further illegal activity.
(Semi 1)Really, so there was nothing illegal going on? Well I suppose you must have tried at least.
(Fail 1)I'll bet you are consorting with smugglers yourself. Thanks for nothing!
(Passenger Offer 1)I'm in urgent need of a ride out of here. Can you help me?
(Passenger Offer 2)I really must leave here right away. Fancy making some credits by giving me a ride?
(On Board)OK, I'm nice and comfortable back here.
(Space)I do need the space to fit in you know!
(Late)Hey, I'm still here and getting really anxious. Can we move it up a gear please?
(Fail)(Sigh)Let me off at the nearest platform. I'll find a reliable ride.
(Assigned to platform)OK Sir. I'm moving into my new quarters now.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)We need a one-time sales delivery to be made. Are you up for it?
(Return Ware Offer)We need someone to collect some urgent wares for us. Are you interested?
(Late Sell)Our client reports the goods are still tied up in traffic. Get a move on!
(Late Return)Where are our urgent supplies? Are you approaching us yet?
(Fail Sell)Our client is hopping mad and is after blood! We want to offer him yours!
(Fail Return)Look, do what you like with them. We'll find someone dependable to fetch some more.
(Emergency Offer)All ships! Help us! We need you now!
(Emergency Offer)Help us out and make a fortune! Our need equals your future comfort!
(Emergency Offer)Get here fast! We don't have long!
(station manager)Docking permission granted.
You are welcome here.
We're pleased to welcome you aboard.
It's always an honour to welcome our friends.
Thank you for protecting our station.
(Defence manager thanking player)Hurrah for the Skunk! You really helped us out! Drop by again!
(Defence manager thanking player)Thanks for helping to sort out our 'little' problem.
Thank you for your assistance. Your payment is being transferred.
Hello pilot. What can we offer you?
(trader introduction)Come and browse. We cater for all tastes!
(trader introduction)You have your business head screwed on! You'll recognise value when you see it!
(trader introduction)You want it, I've got it - or can get it maybe!
(trader introduction)No-one can top these deals! Check them out!
(generic trader)These are what I have on offer.
(performing service)Let's get down to work.
We are making progress.
There, we're agreed.
Sure!
(giving object or info){,4111}
These superb weapons are most suitable for your ship.
You should always restock ammunition when you can.
Top up your ammo every stop, or you'll get caught short one day!
These are top quality goods! My mother says so too!(laughs)
If you can find better, then you can offer me a job and I'll work for free!
A wise choice.
... and the quantity?
What other offers could I make?
Our professional fitting service will adapt this for your ship.
Let's make your ship even more fearsome.
There! The Albion Pride is far better now!
Your modifications are functional. She'll make heads turn in pride now!
I'm overjoyed our modest contribution keeps the Pride at the top of her game!
(Shady trader)Pssst! Need a few things you can't find on the counters?
I have a few things here that my granny would not approve of!
Let me know how many you want and I'll have them delivered to your ship, quite... discreetly.
(licence trader)Interested in a licence, eh? You've come to the right person.
I can authorise the following licences.
Be aware that this licence means you must consider your future actions quite carefully!
A licence is granted on the understanding that you do not abuse it.
Great.
Done!
Fine.
Confirmed.
(accepting gift from player){,4300}
Reporting in, how may we be of assistance?
Yes, what would you like us to do?
Please help me!
Anyone, please reply!
Emergency, please make contact!
Requesting urgent assistance, please respond!
Station command for unidentified vessel.
Station command for Ren Otani.
(attacking allied object)Your actions here will not be tolerated.
Your actions are unacceptable.
You'll come to regret those actions.
Response forces have been despatched!
I dearly hope that was just an accident.
Your actions will provoke retaliation.
Your ship has been identified and logged.
Station command for law enforcement.
We're under sustained attack.
Requesting immediate assistance.
Affirmative, we're sending quick-response forces.
Negative, we regret we're unable to support you at the moment.
Eh, what?
You're joking!
Report related to individual Ren Otani.
Sending data concerning Ren Otani.
Sending data file.
On file.
We've heard of him!
He has criminal entries on his record.
File received.
Uh oh! Her again.
She's a wanted woman.
Contacting law enforcement.
(Found discount)This offer I found will not be around for long!
(Found discount)We just found some special offers for special customers!
(discount offer)Even I don't know how I can afford to do this!
(discount offer)This discount will not be repeated any time soon!
(discount explanation)We found some stuff we missed when taking inventory.
(discount explanation)Our forecasters forgot to take time-changes into account and left production running too long.
(discount explanation)We suspected a few suppliers of hoarding resources - and we were proved correct.
(player station manager)We have a slight obstacle here.
(player station manager)There's something here that needs your attention.
Our station has stalled.
This station's operations are at a standstill.
Transmitting details...
We need your guidance.
Please supply some more resources.
We are running out of resources. Please address this issue.
(can also be used for ships)We can't fit any more into the cargo space.
(can also be used for ships)There's no room for further stowage.
(architect)A manager is necessary.
(can also be used for ships)There are some ways here in which we can improve our capabilities.
(can also be used for ships)There are additional things we can do to improve our effectiveness.
(defence officer)We're being attacked! Please provide any assistance possible.
Calling all assigned support units, we are under attack!
(exchange wares)We understand we are to transfer wares. Who is the other party?
Which ware should be transferred?
Identify the ware for transfer.
How much?
How many would that be?
Confirm the amount please.
Confirmed, beginning transfer.
Transfer proceeding as ordered.
Do you want us to use these to equip the target, or just transfer them as wares?
We seem to be coming up short of funds, Sir.
If you like, I can take the balance needed from your personal account.
There, we're back in business now.
I urgently need to discuss my budget with you.
The budget changes are effective from now.
Operations will proceed as soon as we're established there.
(rejecting impossible mode order)That's impossible in these circumstances.
What will be our task when we get there?
What is the destination for our move?
We're off to the new location as instructed.
We're at the target location.
Our operation is in progress.
A joint operation is in progress.
(Witness)Such a blatant act! I saw everything that happened.
(Witness threatened or bribed)Ah well, now that you explain it, I guess that wasn't so bad after all!
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)Oh, do give me some credit!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#smile#)So you're the famous fellow doing all the brave deeds then! Pleased to meet you.
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#smile#)Well, we've certainly heard all about you. What a delight to meet you.
To be clear, is that an order for all ships that I command, or just for myself?
(Pilot sold his ship)I'll start looking for another job, unless you have another position in mind.
Yes Sir, what is my new command?
Affirmative. I will jump there and join your fleet.
Sir, understood! Join with you and serve in your team.
Sir, ready for new tasking? I will join up with your squad otherwise.
(Manager)Sir? You have a ship for me?
(Manager)The new ship will be tasked according to present instructions.
Sir, this is my present assignment.
(Player scanned)This is just our routine business. No need to get excited.
(Player scanned)It all goes much smoother if you just let us get on with it.
(Player scanned - aggressive)Let's see if you're as honest as you try to make out!
(Player scanned - aggressive)Maybe you've something good stashed away from prying eyes?
(nothing found)Thank you. That's all in order. Please continue.
(nothing found)We're satisfied with the scan results. Thank you for your patience.
(nothing found - aggressive)I could've sworn we'd get something this time. Oh well, there's always tomorrow!
(nothing found - aggressive)Don't think yourself clever because you got away with it this time. We're always waiting!
(contraband found - police)Our official scan shows you have contraband items. Let's have a little chat about it.
(contraband found - police)We can see what you have. Don't make this more difficult than it needs to be.
(drop instruction)Obey our instructions and drop the contraband. This doesn't need to get messy, but it will if you resist!
(pirate plundering)Wow! Look at that! A tidy little windfall!
(pirate plundering)That's a sight for hungry eyes. You have a right stash hidden away!
(drop instruction)Drop some of the spoils and then we'll see if you get to move on your way.
(dropped)Well chosen! It would have been messy otherwise - for you!
(dropped)You did right for once. Pat yourself on the back and get out of here!
(dropped part)Are you having a joke? We know exactly what you were carrying!
(dropped part)You'll have to do better than that to fly away from this!
(#smile#)That is refreshing. We think so alike!
(#smile#)If I could speak as well as you, (#punchhand01#)I'd be famous by now!
You can charm the ladies! (#laugh#)It works on me!
(#smile#)That's nice. We seem to have so much in common!
(#smile#)What a silver tongue you have!
(#nod01#)I love speaking with someone knowledgeable!
(#gesticulate01#)You should do this for a living. You're a natural.
(#gesticulate02#)The time is flying past. I'm really glad we had this chat!
Please tell me more. I want to hear what comes next.
(#nod01#)Yes, I'm following you so far.
(#thinking01#)That is a different aspect on all of this.
Yes, I need to hear the rest of it to decide.
(#scratchhead01#)That doesn't strike the right note for me.
(#disapproval01#)I don't follow. Why would you say that?
(#gesticulate02#)I'm really hoping we get to the meat of this soon!
(#crossarms01#)No, you're just confusing me now.
(#sad#)I've had about enough of that line.
(#hard#)I think you are wasting time for both of us now.
(#angry#)I really don't want to go on with this!
(#cold#)At this point, we'll part ways I think.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)This conversation has inspired me to help you.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)I liked our chat so much that I'll put in a good word for you.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)I know someone, who knows someone .. (#nod01#)You get it. I'll help you get a good deal.
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)OK, If you need to hire someone, I have a very good candidate in mind. Check out these details.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)I was approached recently by a professional looking to hire out. I can vouch for them and set it up.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)(#smile#)I really like you after our cosy chat. I'll give you a great discount on any trade we do from here on.
(#hard#)Xenon tech in Plutarch hands... (#rolleyes01#)it's a recipe for disaster!
(#cold#)Be afraid! I know the prospect gives me the heeby-jeebies.
I could try to be clever and come up with a fire metaphor, (#gesticulate01#)but the prospect of a Xenon fleet on the rampage is inflammatory enough.
Heh. Your faith, however ironic, is misplaced. Plutarch have no idea what they're toying with.
(#nod01#)Yes, I know. That's exactly what I'm so worried about.
What makes you think we could do a better job than Plutarch in controlling them? I'm not so sure.
(#shrug01#)What's with all the AI fuss?
This I'd like to hear.
Right, let me get this straight. (#thinking01#)AGI are AI that can evolve beyond their original programming. Sounds like a double-edged sword to me.
(#nod01#)OK, that's good to know. I guess that goes a long way to explain how we're in this mess.
I think something's brewing... another conflict. (#angry#)Just what we need. (sarcasm)
(#shrug01#)Conflict, war... it's all about people taking what they want by force. Unless you have another view?
Pride comes before a fall, they say. (#shrug01#)But if this victory is so certain, then I have nothing to worry about.
Ready for what? (#cold#)Oh, you want to recruit me as more cannon fodder? Dream on, friend. I pick my own fights.
Yeah, that's just the thing. (#crossarms01#)No ship, no fight. Unless you want to give me a ship?
(#angry#)I have absolutely no intention of dying in your or anyone else's war. This conversation is over.
Flee? No way. I'll just choose to be somewhere safe when the time comes.
(#punchhand01#)This reconstruction effort is outstanding!
You can't miss it. (#nod01#)The results are amazing!
The way you guys have transformed this place is totally awe-inspiring. (#smile#)It's a beacon of hope in our once-dark corner of the galaxy.
(#nod01#)The fruits of this endeavour won't just be measured in credits, I feel. (#smile#)Just look at the people now... they can smile again.
(#nod01#)Yep. It's a pretty special time. I'm glad I'm here to witness it.

(greeting friendly)Hello Pal.
(greeting neutral)We hear you.
(greeting enemy)Say what you have to say.
(greeting rejected)No time. Sorry.
(greeting service)I look forward to helping out.
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)Fly safely.
(goodbye neutral)Until next time.
(goodbye enemy)Sure, fly away!
(goodbye rejected)Let's leave it there.
(goodbye service)It was a pleasure to serve you.
(ship scanned - complicit)Fill your boots!
(ship scanned - neutral)Hey nosey, what's that for?
(ship scanned - illegal)That's not nice nor legal round here.
(ship scanned - enemy)That was rather provocative wouldn't you agree?
(ship scanned - confident)I hope I get paid for the time you are wasting!
(ship scanned - possessing)Now that is ... errr ... embarrassing!
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Give it your best shot.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Wouldn't it have been quicker just to ask?
(station/capship scanned - illegal)That was not only really stupid, but really illegal!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)Did you really mean to upset all these gun-crews?
(station/capship scanned - confident)You can spend all day doing that - and for no good reason!
(station/capship scanned - possessing)OK bloodhound, you sniffed something out. What now then?
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)(sheepishly awkward)That is .. is .. errr .. purely training materials - Yeah, that's what it is.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)That really shouldn't be there. I ordered all that stuff ejected days ago.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)(depressed)Why did you have to wait until now? That would be long gone by tomorrow. Can we like delay the scan a bit?
(directions - location not known)Sorry, no idea on that one.
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Heh, I admire your optimism!
(surrender - hostile)Do you really think you have the means to ask that?
(surrender - complicit)Yeah, go on, take it all!
(drops cargo 1)Whoa, whoa! Here's something to keep you sweet!
(drops cargo 2)Please don't kill me! I can make it worth your while with some wares.
(bail from ship 1)That's enough! I'm leaving it for you.
(bail from ship 2)I'm bailing out! Hold your fire!
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)You have my full attention, Sir.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)How may I be of service Sir?
(hired comm greeting 2)I hear you. What will it be?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Hello Sir. How may I help you?
(hired comm goodbye 1)Until next time.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)I hope to see you again Sir.
Yes? How can we be of service?
What can we help you with?
(join squad)Joining your squad.
(leave squad)Leaving your squad.
(accept order 1)Yes Sir.
(accept order 2)Got it.
(reject order 1)Sorry Sir, I cannot really manage that.
(reject order 2)That's impossible I'm afraid.
(Automatic)We're beginning automatic operations Sir.
(standby)Affirmative. Standing by.
Affirmative.
Understood.
Negative.
(jumpdrive charging)Coordinates set. Charging Jump Drive.
(jumpdrive aborted)Aborting jump!
(jumpdrive engaged)Jump Drive charged.
(jumpdrive emergency)Getting out of Dodge! Jumping!
(jumpdrive cool-down)We can't jump until our Jump Drive is ready.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Jump Drive on cool-down.
(jumpdrive success)Successfully jumped and all ship systems are showing clear.
(engage boost to player)Boost engaged and en-route for new location.
(engage boost)Boosters set to maximum.
(follow)We will follow along after you Sir.
(moveto)Confirmed. Moving to new coordinates.
(moveto dock)We're on our way to the dock.
(docked)Successfully docked.
(task completed)Task done, sir.
(confirm no change)Confirmed, proceeding as originally planned.
(arrived)We've arrived, Sir.
(arrived)We're here.
(arrived at player)We're pulling alongside now, Sir.
(arrived at player)We're back with you.
Taking up recommended guard position.
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Sir, we're delighted to welcome you aboard.
(lost drones for current task)We're out of those drones. Awaiting new orders.
(task start but low on drones)OK, but be aware that we're low on drones.
(no drones to start task)Negative. No suitable drones are available.
(restock request to player)We need more drones and must do a replenishment.
(request additional ships)We could surely use another ship or two.
(received additional ship)Thank you. I'll set her to work straight away.
It wouldn't fit in with our current operations.
We'll stop all current operations in that case, Sir.
Awaiting new instructions.
(Player loses licence)You are hereby stripped of our licence, Mr Otani.
You should be well aware of the reasons for our action.
Our ship is badly damaged. What should we do now?
(movement status)We cannot move. We need assistance here!
Affirmative. We're off to the next shipyard.
We have docked at the shipyard and await your orders.
Our Jump Drive is damaged. We'll need repairs before it can be used again.
Affirmative. We will jump when we can.
We have docked at the shipyard. Your instructions are awaited.
Our engine is damaged and we cannot move. We need repairs here.
Affirmative. We will move when we regain the capability.
Affirmative. Charging Jump Drive for emergency relocation.
Emergency jump successful. Awaiting new instructions.
Affirmative. We're leaving this zone now.
We have relocated successfully. Awaiting your new orders.
We have too little fuel to jump to the intended destination.
We need more fuel to jump there.
OK, on our way to the next fuel depot.
We're headed out to refuel before the jump.
Jump fuel reserves depleted, we need a fuel transporter to rendezvous with us.
We're out of range of the next fuel station. We need resupply.
Our fuel reserves are too low so we will attempt a generator-powered jump.
Without having enough jump energy we'll try forcing a jump anyway.
We'll need to stop for fuel somewhere in order to get to our destination.
(Hired Architect)Hello Sir, Architect here. What services can I provide you?
(Asked how to get building resources)We have two options for getting the necessary resources for construction. Which will it be, Sir?
All right, that is sufficient for now. Are you positive you want us to build the station here? Your go-ahead is final and binding.
Module construction complete Sir. Do you have any new construction orders?
Station construction complete Sir. Congratulations.
This module is the next one listed for construction Sir.
I'll show you which modules are currently available to build given the design and progress.
Are you quite sure that you want us to build this module? The start-up order cannot be reversed.
An excellent choice. We will start building straight away.
Hello Sir, your Architect speaking. The station we are building requires a Station Manager. You will need to hire one and bring them here.
These are the available stations that can be built for you.
(builder ship moving)Moving to new construction location.
(Ship builder)Hello Sir, would you be interested in a new spaceship? We supply the most modern models.
All right, we have sufficient. Are you really sure that you want that ship built? Once we start that's it.
Ship construction complete Sir.
We are rather busy just now but check out our catalogue at your leisure and please return later.
Hello Sir, your ship under construction will require a pilot when completed. Do you have anyone suitable already?
Here are all the ships we can currently build for you.
We don't have the necessary level of funding yet, Sir.
(PC: You take care of it.)Funding is now sorted. Let's get back to building now.
These are the extensions available. Be aware that some interact with each other.
Please confirm the upgrade levels and place the order.
Please confirm the hull percentage you want to see repaired.
Here are all currently available modules for this station.
This overview shows my current resource levels.
(architect)Don't worry, anything left over at the end will be transferred back to your account.
(Initiate Trade)You have a deal, we're en-route.
(Receive)Preparing to receive wares.
(Deliver)Preparing to deliver wares.
(Fail Space)We cannot do that while our cargo bay is full.
(Fail Type)We're unable to transport such a type of ware.
(Fail Space Standby)All cargo space is taken. We await further instructions.
(Fail Buy Amount)Unfortunately the requested amount is now unavailable here. By your leave we will buy as much as we can.
(Fail Sell Amount)Our buyer here no longer wants that volume of goods. We will sell as many items as he wants and then move on to another order unless you intervene.
(Fail Buy Ware)We've arrived as intended but the specified good is not available. We're moving on to the next order unless you wish to redirect us .
(Fail Sell Ware)We've safely arrived but, unfortunately, the goods specified are not bought here. With your assent, we're moving on to the next order.
(Fail Buy Price)The price now exceeds our intended threshold. Regardless, we'll purchase the requested amount, if you allow it.
(Fail Sell Price)Our specified goods will not fetch the expected price here. We'll sell them anyway unless we're told otherwise.
(Fail)We cannot do that operation, please give us further instructions.
Sir, we have generated considerable surplus profit that I'll transfer to your account unless you tell me to keep some.
Deal completed and the report is on its way.
In location and setting up for trade.
(fixed something).. and all fixed.
(fixed something)Back up to full spec!
(fixed something)I told you you'd be pleased.
(Initiate Mining)Accepted, standing by to commence mining.
(Launch)Launching collectors.
(Recall)Recalling collectors.
(Automatic)We're beginning automatic operations Sir.
(Fail Type)We're unable to take that type of ware on board.
Affirmative. Our drones will collect everything you tag.
Affirmative. Our drones will prioritize everything you tag.
Sorry. We have no collector drones.
Affirmative. Our drones will initiate collection duties.
We've stopped mining now Sir. We will move to follow you if you've nothing else for us.
We are returning to you with a full load of cargo.
(Squad member)Sir, I've been told to eject my cargo!
The orders come from the police.
It's a hostile ship doing the demanding.
What should I do?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
Standing by and awaiting new orders.
(scan successful)Data received - analysing for best point of attack.
We'll breach right there.
(not scanned)I guess that spot looks as good as any other.
(boarding pod launching)Launching pod at target.
(boarding pod hit)Pod suffering damage!
(marines under fire)Incoming fire!
(pod attached)Hull breach under way.
(marine entering ship)Hull breached, securing hull entry.
My team is ready to move out.
Moving! Sweep your arcs.
(marine on alert)Watch out!
(loud)Contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
Spread out!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Check, check, check!
(lots of fighting noise)Marines going down!
(lots of fighting noise)Steady! Stand fast here!
(lots of fighting noise)Go! Move, move!
(lots of fighting noise)Cover my back!
(combat)Get up and get going!
(quiet)Multiple unknown traces ahead.
(assist mission successful)They're scattering! Follow up but not too close!
(assist mission failed/timed out)They're really dug in. We'll have to smash our way through.
(assist mission successful)Sentries out of action!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We'll have to take them out ourselves!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)We're at a security node.
(marine hacking)Hacking into security.
(assist mission successful)Automated defences are disabled.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Damn, too slow - we'll have to chance the active defences!
Oh no! Self-destruct activated! Attempting remote abort command!
(relieved)Self-destruct aborted.
(assist mission failed/timed out)We failed! Get out of here quick!
(boarding successful)We have control.
We're too few to carry on! Fall back!
The hull has had it! Get back to the pods before it goes!
We're in the pods and homeward-bound!
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)I'm hit!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Marine down!
Argh...(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Stand clear! Blowing the hatch!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Cover me, I'm moving up!
(lots of fighting noise)Reloading!
(checking for enemies)Clear ahead.
(sound of laser fire)Remote lasers!
Force field obstacle ahead.
