(assist mission failed/timed out)We need to get around that thing by another route.
The crew have given up, ship control is ours!(cheers)
They've realised it's lost, the station is now ours!(cheers)
It doesn't look good --(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)We control the target. Well done!
(upgrades)Upgrades successful. Undocking.
Downgrades complete. Now undocking.
Upgrades all installed.
Choose which ship to upgrade.
Which upgrade do you want changed?
(*Hiring*)
Someone is doing my job already.
You have an Engineer on board already.
You have a Marine Officer on board already.
Am I to replace them or am I needed someplace else?
Sir, you will greatly appreciate my appointment.
I very much look forward to working with you. You won't regret it.
(On board introduction)Hi, I'm the latest crew member.
(Fired in space)Just drop me at the next station stopover. I'll find another contract, don't you worry.
(Fired on platform)OK, I'll just leave right away. There's probably better work available here anyway.
(Assign to object)OK, Sir. I'll move over to my new duty station now.
(Assign to ship)OK, I'm in control.
(Return to player)OK, Sir. Coming on board.
(Leave player)Bye, Mister Otani.
(Leave player)So long and take care.
(Showing skills)I'm very well qualified, as I can show you.
(Showing skills)My qualifications are most certainly appropriate. Take a look here.
(Orders)Please send new target coordinates.
(Sell ship)I've sold the ship as requested. Your credits will be with you shortly.
(Sell ship)I've found the old dear a new master. He sends his appreciation in the form of a stack of credits.(Colloquial)
(respond to free mode)You'll soon see the benefit of giving me latitude in decision-making.
(respond to free mode)Such freedom of choice will make my work much more efficient.
(respond to restricted mode)Well I can follow orders to the letter - if you really want that!(slightly offended)
(respond to restricted mode)Yes, I get it. You make all the decisions, and I deal with the come-backs!(wounded pride)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Hey! Try watching where you point that thing!
(player attacks - friendly 2)Hey, these shields aren't paid for yet!
(player attacks - neutral 1)Are you going to let me in the joke?
(player attacks - neutral 2)Please tell me that you pushed the wrong button!
(player attacks - enemy 1)That was not the most sensible thing you've done today!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Any more of that and the police will return the favour to you!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)Keep that up and you'll be explaining it to a Police vessel!
(big object attacked)Hey little guy, aren't we a bit out of your league?
(big object attacked)Are you experiencing a display malfunction? Have you noticed our size?
(light fire 1)Hah, that woke us up.
(light fire 2)I don't like their idea of saying hello!
(mid fire 1)This isn't fun anymore!
(mid fire 2)Why can't this guy leave me alone?
(heavy fire 1)This is all ending in tears really soon! - Mine!
(heavy fire 2)Get over here! I'm nearly done for!
(heavy fire 3)Requesting immediate assistance. I'm falling apart here!
(station defence)All local ships, please report for defensive action.
(station defence)Assistance needed at our location.
(station defence)Follow coordinates to this location. Prepare for defensive action!
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(death 3)Aaarrrgghhh!
(shield warning 1)Shields critically weakened!
(shield warning 2)Shields in the red!
(hull warning 1)Hull breach!
(hull warning 2)Hull integrity borderline!
(Incoming Enemies)They are nearly on us!
(Incoming Wave)Another wave incoming! Don't lose focus now!
(Last Wave)This could be the final wave.
(Player Needed)Where are you? We're getting shot to pieces here!
(Success 1)Wow! That was a close one! Glad to come out of that!
(Success 2)OK, we made it. They came off far worse than we did!
(Fail 1)We lost that one, and took some high losses doing it.
(Fail 2)I need emergency crews here before we lose everything!
(critical damage)We've got some big issues here!
(critical damage)The reactor's gone unstable!
(Incoming Enemies)We have closing enemies.
(Dangerous area)This reminds me a lot of a different area I've been in. That didn't go too well!
(Plead for life 1)Look, I've a family. No more, please!
(Plead for life 2)Hold your fire, I didn't sign up for a suicide mission!
(Plead for life 3)Let me go and I'll retire. I'm too old for this anyway!
(Plead for life 4)This bucket can't take any more. Life support is all that's left!
(player instructions)Follow us.
Keep close.
(followers)We'll follow you.
Lead the way.
We're ready.
Ready to go!
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)Evacuate! Evacuate! Obey all directions issued.(urging)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)Hi there. So, you're up for this mission?
(General 2)Hi pilot. You're game for a laugh then?
(Easy 1)You shouldn't need a lot of effort for this one.
(Easy 2)This you can do in your sleep!
(Hard 1)Are you positive you really want this job?
(Hard 2)You haven't really convinced me you are right for this.
(Fight Easy 1)This is perfect for a pilot who likes a walk-over.
(Fight Easy 2)The odds couldn't be more stacked in your favour!
(Fight Hard 1)While I see your enthusiasm, this could be more than you can chew!
(Fight Hard 2)I hope you are single, I'd hate to be responsible for a grieving widow!
(Trade Easy 1)If you can shift goods on time then this is right up your street.
(Trade Easy 2)This is a basic cargo run. Even you should handle it easily.
(Trade Hard 1)I'm looking for innovative transport solutions here - are you up to it?
(Trade Hard 2)I maintain the highest trading and business standards with my customers. Can you meet my expectations?
(Acceptance Query 1)Are you in or out?
(Acceptance Query 2)The job's still awaiting your answer.
(Accept 1)Great. I knew you could take this on.
(Accept 2)All right, that's really good news.
(Reluctant 1)OK, but only if you think you really can handle it.
(Reluctant 2)OK. Good luck .. and I think you'll need it.
(Reject 1)Look, no offence, but you're really not good enough for this.
(Reject 2)If I gave you this, you'd screw up the job and my business.
(Info 1)Transfer of job information to your system is in progress.
(Info 2)The job information is in your system now.
(Success 1)I knew you seemed right for this job.
(Success 2)Well done! You did indeed strike me as reliable.
(Semi 1)OK, that will have to do. Maybe do it better next time - if there is one!
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)If that's all you could manage. Not a total loss I guess.
(Fail 1)What am I supposed to do now? You've ruined me!
(Fail 2)So you came back empty-handed. I have to ask, why bother?
(Credits 1)I'm transferring your credits now.
(Reward 1)Take this as a little extra thanks.
(Client abort)Sorry, but it seems you've been made superfluous to our needs.
(mission update)Things have moved on. I've updated the job briefing on your system.
(mission update 2)Your job requirements have changed, please take a new look.
(Assassination Offer 1)I need to remove someone and I don't want to worry about them coming back.
(Assassination Offer 2)Someone needs a permanent one-way holiday. Understood?
(Target)You were sent to take me out? Really? How bizarre!
(Target 2)You really have no chance at all. I expect you'll try anyway!
(Bribe 1)Err, hold on! Can we talk financial alternatives first?
(Success)They had no hope of surviving!
(Fail)Escaped? How? I thought you were Mr Perfect?
(Fail by bribe)We have a good idea how it really went down. Watch your blind-spot Pilot!
(Protect Station Offer 1)We need capable Pilots to help defend our station against incoming enemies. We don't have much time before they arrive and need all the local help we can get.
(Protect Station Offer 2)Our defence forces will be badly-stretched against an incoming force headed our way and arriving soon. Can you please assist and save the population on our station?
(Protect Ship Offer 1)Any ship responding, we're under attack! Please help!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Our ship is being overwhelmed by hostiles! Please help us out and we will see you are well-rewarded!
(Police 1)We're looking to use a ship unknown to the area to scan potential smugglers known to operate near here. Help us with this and we'll see your work is rewarded.
(Success 1)A good result. That should give us the clues we need to track them to their sources.
(Semi 1)So you didn't find anything! I guess it was the smugglers' day off!
(Fail 1)Did you check that you had a working scanner? Our patrols intercepted at least one smuggler ship that you let through unchallenged!
(Passenger Offer 1)I'm in need of a fast transport, and pretty much straight away.
(Passenger Offer 2)I have to get somewhere fast, fancy a lucrative hire job?
(On Board)OK, I'm tucked up on board.
(Space)Hmmm, I don't see how I can fit on board at the moment.
(Late)I know you enjoy having me on board but I do have to get somewhere soon, OK?
(Fail)That's it. (sigh)I missed the appointment. Let me off now.
(Assigned to platform)OK Sir. I'll take up my new duty station now.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)We need some cargo delivered. Are you ready to help?
(Return Ware Offer)We need someone to bring us some urgent wares. Do you want to know more?
(Late Sell)Our client is really fretting about his goods. Don't let me down!
(Late Return)We're still looking out for those supplies. Shift up a gear please!
(Fail Sell)Our client is hopping mad. I am way in debt over this!
(Fail Return)Never mind. We just lost our credibility and business around here.
(Emergency Offer)Any ship in jump range, I'm in serious trouble and need urgent help. Answer, please!
(Emergency Offer) Top priority! Get here fast! Is anyone there?
(Emergency Offer)Hello? Please pick up on this. I'm in such deep trouble. Please assist!
(station manager)Docking permission granted.
Welcome aboard.
We're delighted to have you aboard.
It is a pleasure to welcome you aboard.
Thank you for dealing with those enemies attacking our station.
(Defence manager thanking player)Skunk, you're the best!
(Defence manager thanking player)Thank you 'Pride'. You'll always be welcome here.
Thank you for your timely assistance. Payment is being authorised.
(trader introduction)Hello Pilot. What can I offer you?
(trader introduction)Greetings! See anything you like?
(trader introduction)Hello... you. Looking for something special?
(trader introduction)Look around. If I don't stock it, you don't need it!
(trader introduction)These are state-of-the art products!
(generic trader)This is what is up for offer.
(performing service)I'll get right on it.
That's good enough for me to get started.
(Confirm sale/handoff)There you are.
(Confirm agreement)Absolutely!
(giving object or info){,4111}
(weapon/upgrade trader)These deadly weapons will certainly enhance your ship's capabilities.
Nobody sensible goes anywhere without full ammo stocks nowadays!
Only a fool passes up the chance to restock used ammo.
These are all top quality products!
My products put other traders to shame!
An excellent choice Sir.
How many will you take?
Is there something else I can help with?
Let's adapt this for your ship.
Let's get started on installing this into your ship.
Here you go. Enjoy your upgraded Pride of Albion.
Your modifications are fully functional. Take 'Pride' in your improved ship.('Pride' holding some comical value, stress it!)
That is just wonderful, if I may say without boasting. Your much improved 'Pride' of Albion is ready.('Pride' holding some comical value, stress it!)
(Shady trader)Buddy! Looking for a way to make big money fast?
This stuff can get you in trouble, but the profit is worth the risk! Take a look.
How much will your ship take, without it being too obvious?
(licence trader)I thought I could see some interest in licences. You look the type.
I have these licences available - for the right client.
Taking this licence implies changing your behaviour pattern. You need to be aware of that.
Don't forget, the licence is issued in the best interests of the community as a whole, not just for your own ends.
(deal confirmations)Great.
Done.
Agreed.
Accepted.
(accepting gift from player){,4300|4302|4310}
We're here, how can we help?
Yes, how can we help?
(emergency call)Help, please!
Someone please reply!
All frequencies, emergency, please respond!
Please! We need urgent assistance!
(station contacting player)Station command for unidentified vessel.
Station command for Ren Otani.
(attacking allied object)We do not tolerate unprovoked attacks in our space.
We'll not tolerate your actions.
You'll be very sorry for your actions.
We are retaliating!
I really hope this was just an accident.
Your actions could result in serious consequences.
(player uncovered as enemy)You've been discovered.
(station contacting law)Station command for law enforcement authorities.
We're under massive attack.
Requesting timely assistance.
(police)Affirmative, units are on the way.
Negative, unfortunately we don't have any uncommitted resources.
(NPC request for help rejected)What? Don't you care?
(NPC request for help rejected)I don't believe it!
Report related to individual Ren Otani.
Sending file about Ren Otani.
Sending file.
On file.
Oh, him once more.
That's a known criminal.
Data received.
Her again.
The police are well aware of her activities.
Contacting law enforcement.
(Found discount)Now this is a once-in-a-lifetime deal.
(Found discount)Hey! I've found a bargain just for you.
(discount offer)I can give you a really good price on these things.
(discount offer)I can offer you a very special price.
(discount explanation)We had a cancelled order due to a client mishap.
(discount explanation)There were some transport issues that left us with stocks on hand.
(discount explanation)Our factory is modernising and we need to clear the shelves.
(player station manager)We have a bit of difficulty here.
(player station manager)Sir, we have an issue needing your attention.
Our station cannot continue operation.
Station operation is at a stop.
Forwarding details ...
We need your advice ...
We need additional resources.
We have run out of resources.
(can also be used for ships)Maximum cargo capacity has been reached.
(can also be used for ships)There's no more room in cargo.
(architect)Now we need a manager.
(can also be used for ships)Should you want to improve efficiency, here are some options available to you.
(can also be used for ships)These options can be beneficial in terms of our effectiveness.
(defence officer)Please assist, we're under attack!
Defence alert! We have hostile intruders in our proximity. Please support local defences.
(exchange wares)With whom shall we conduct the transfer?
Please advise the ware for transfer.
Which ware is for transfer?
How much?
Transfer of how many?
Confirm the amount please.
Roger that. Transfer under way.
Of course. The transfer is going ahead now.
Are these destined for cargo, or to be installed in the target for use?
I don't have sufficient funds for this.
I can replenish my funding from your account, but only if you wish me to.
There we go, funding is no longer an issue. Let's move on.
I need to discuss my budget with you at your earliest opportunity, Sir.
My budget revisions are now in force.
Let's get there and set up the operation.
(rejecting impossible mode order)That can't be done right now. Sorry about that.
Once we arrive, what is our task?
Where was it that you wanted us to go?
Setting off for the specified location.
We have arrived at the target location.
The operation has commenced.
We're conducting a joint operation.
(Witness)I saw that as plain as day! No mistake!
(Witness threatened or bribed)Suddenly my memory has gone all blank. I was never good at remembering details anyway.
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)Oh please! Do I look that weak?
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#smile#)I know you. You're the heroic chap in the vids! What an honour!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#smile#)Of course I know you. Who doesn't admire you around here?
Sir, do your orders include the ships under my command, or do you just want me to deal with it personally?
(Pilot sold his ship)Will you be finding another post for me, or shall I just get out of your hair now?
(new assignment)Naturally Sir, what is my new assignment?
Confirmed. I will jump and join your fleet.
Sir, order confirmed! I'll get to your coordinates and henceforth serve under your command.
Sir, any new tasks for me? If not, I will join your squad in the meantime.
(Manager)Sir? You've a ship ready for me?
(Manager)The new ship will be used according to my given orders.
(NPC already assigned to job)Sir, this is my current assignment.
(Player scanned)This is what we do in the line of duty. Understand?
(Player scanned)We pose no problem for you - unless you have something to hide!
(Player scanned - aggressive)Let's see what you've tucked away from the authorities, eh?
(Player scanned - aggressive)You might fool some dumb official now and again, but you won't fool us!
(nothing found)Thank you. That's quite satisfactory. Off you go then.
(nothing found)See, that wasn't so bad was it? We'll let you get on your way.
(nothing found - aggressive)Hmm. You're either clean or smarter than we thought. Maybe too smart for your own good!
(nothing found - aggressive)You've won this round. We'll see you again for a rematch some time!
(contraband found - police)Pilot, we know what you're carrying and you know it's illegal here.
(contraband found - police)Well this isn't going so well for you. We'll deal with your contraband now.
(drop instruction)Drop all illegal goods, or we stop playing nice!
(pirate plundering)Oh, will you look at that! It's my birthday!
(pirate plundering)That looks good! Well, for me at least! There's a fortune to be made here!
(drop instruction)Just drop some of that booty our way and you might get out of this in one piece!
(dropped)You used your brain. Now move away.
(dropped)I guess that'll do. Get moving before I change my mind.
(dropped part)I won't fall for that one. That's a pathetic amount!
(dropped part)Are you trying to wind me up? You're succeeding if you are!
(CapshipPilot)Give us some cover while we get in position.
You'll then need to check the Jump Beacon in the next sector.
So far so good. We should have a clear jump to the Canteran sector now.
(#smile#)What a refreshingly frank and accurate assessment!
(#sad#)If only I could express myself as well as you can.
That is wonderful. (#smile#)I am so impressed by that!
(#gesticulate02#)I can't wait to hear you say more about that!
That's pretty slick. I wish I had your powers of persuasion!
(#punchhand01#)At last! (#smile#)Someone who doesn't spout rubbish and propaganda!
(#smile#)Keep going. That's just enthralling!
(#smile#)I haven't had this much intellectual conversation in years!
(#nod01#)Yes, I'd be happy for you to continue.
(#crossarms01#)Well, I suppose I can spare some more time.
(#nod01#)I can see some merit in what you say.
(#nod01#)That is a novel approach. Please expand on it.
(#crossarms01#)I think we are not quite on the same wavelength.
(#scratchhead01#)I'm struggling to follow your logic now.
(#gesticulate01#)Will we be finished here any time soon?
(#excuse#)That just doesn't sit right with me.
(#angry#)I think you may be making fun of me!
(#disapproval01#)Let's stop before somebody gets annoyed.
(#shrug01#)Let's just agree to differ, eh?
(#cold#)That's quite enough for now I think.
(smalltalk reward introduction)I think we're two of a kind, you know. (#smile#)I think we should help each other out.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)I enjoyed our chat so much that I'm feeling generous now.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)(#punchhand01#)I know! There's a really good offer at a station that I could let you in on.
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)I have details of a willing worker who would be right up your street as a hireling. Look here.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)There's a professional I know who's looking for a new position. Check them out here.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)(#smile#)We're such good pals that I feel like offering you a special rate if we do any trade.
(#disapproval01#)Green scalies wherever you go!
(#crossarms01#)You can't deny I'm entitled to my own view.
All right, all right! (#rolleyes01#)Teladi aren't all greedy, but they're still green!
Well, OK, you shouldn't judge a book by its cover, (#crossarms01#)but the cover tells me to be very suspicious.
Oh. They're not mocking us then? (#nod01#)Maybe their tongues are too long for our words.
(#gesticulate02#)I'll concede that I'm no expert on Saurians but there's no smoke without fire, if we're talking about their rep.
(#excuse#)Woah, there! Maybe I was getting a tad carried away but there's no reason to go loco!
(#shrug01#)Maybe I was wrong about our Teladi friends then, if he's anything to go by.(embarrassed)
(#cold#)Plutarch scares me anyway... using Xenon tech, now there's another level of fear.
Absolutely, aren't you?
Indeed, but fires can be extinguished. (#hard#)Xenon ships on the rampage - that's another danger entirely.
I couldn't agree more. (#crossarms01#)Plutarch always has our interests at heart.(bitter irony)
(#nod01#)Exactly. That's exactly what's going to keep me up at night.
(#gesticulate01#)What makes you think we'd be able to control them any better than PMC? It might buy us some time though.
(#sad#)They are insane if they think researching Xenon tech is a good idea!
Beryll? (#disapproval01#)They should rename themselves 'Peril' for all the hurt they will bring upon us.
You're going back some time there, I suspect. I saw nothing to suggest any criminal activity.
No doubt they have PMC breathing down their necks, wanting results. (#gesticulate03#)I hope they don't make mistakes because of that.
It's amazing to think that these highways weren't even here forty years ago!
(#nod01#)There certainly have been.
Well, it's a miracle of technology! (#shrug01#)The freedom you lose is replaced with convenience.
That's interesting to know. (#thinking01#)Boosters used extra fuel... cool! Thanks!
(#shrug01#)I couldn't even pretend to understand how that stuff works. It's amazing! Someone at Jonferco is sitting on that secret.
(#sad#)Xenon ships are here! The end is nigh!
Yes. (#hard#)You too should be afraid, be very afraid.
The Argon fleet won't let them get away with much. (#cold#)It's worrying that Xenon are right here in Omicron Lyrae!
(#sad#)We certainly took a beating in Maelstrom. I guess it's a lesson learned though, even if we took heavy losses.
(#smile#)That's very kind of you. (#rolleyes02#)Would you like to help me pick a ship too, as I don't have one of those either.

page.title: Argon NPC Male 4 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[argon] [terran] male basic(cheerful)
(greeting friendly)Hello mate.
(greeting neutral)I hear you my friend.
(greeting enemy)I didn't expect to hear from you!
(greeting rejected)Sorry, it's far too nice to chat.
(greeting service)I really hope I can help out.
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)So long buddy!
(goodbye neutral)Bye for now.
(goodbye enemy)Well that was ... different!
(goodbye rejected)Another time maybe.
(goodbye service)Brilliant! Glad to have helped.
(ship scanned - complicit)Go for it, old buddy
(ship scanned - neutral)Heh, are you peeking?
(ship scanned - illegal)That's not going to make you many friends!
(ship scanned - enemy)Hey, are you trying to ruin my good mood?
(ship scanned - confident)Ha, ha! You'll be looking a long time to catch me out
(ship scanned - possessing)Oh don't mind about that. Everyone has a bit of naughty stashed away.
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Go ahead. We're all yours chum.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Hey, you're interfering with my games channel!
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Why get all suspicious or take risks? We're open enough on here!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)If I wasn't so trusting, I'd call that quite suspicious.
(station/capship scanned - confident)Take your time, I'm watching a good 3D channel.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)No problem, we'll just confiscate whatever shouldn't be there. Want some??
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)(jovial)Yeah, there's a really funny story to that being there. Got a while?
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)Well you see we have a few really good supplies officers and they somehow tend to attract the really good stuff.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)(mildly depressed)Oh well, that was almost a clean getaway - not that this thing can run fast anyway.
(directions - location not known)I'd love to help but that one's beyond me.
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Hey, I love a good joke too!
(surrender - hostile)Some would get bitchy now, but I just roll with the punches!
(surrender - complicit)Not a problem, do your thing .. but leave me some creature-comforts for the ride home.
(drops cargo 1)OK, have fun with these goodies.
(drops cargo 2)Hey, let me give you some good stuff and we'll all enjoy tomorrow.
(bail from ship 1)I'm out of here now. Look after the old girl!
(bail from ship 2)No need to shoot, I'm opening the doors!
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)Delighted to speak with you Sir.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)What do you desire Sir?
(hired comm greeting 2)Hello Sir, I am so pleased to be in your service!
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Hello, Sir. What a grand day for business!
(hired comm goodbye 1)It was a pleasure to talk.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)Goodbye until next time Sir.
Reporting in. How can we be of service?
We are at your disposal, just ask.
You are in the best of hands. How can we help?
(join squad)Delighted to be joining your squad, Sir.
(leave squad)Leaving your squad. Sir it was an honour.
(accept order 1)Absolutely, Sir.
(accept order 2)Of course.
(reject order 1)Sorry Sir, I regret that I cannot do that.
(reject order 2)That's not currently possible.
(Automatic)Sir, automatic operations are go.
(standby)Affirmative. Standing by and ready for anything.
Affirmative.
Understood.
Negative.
(jumpdrive charging)Coordinates loaded. Jump Drive coming on line.
(jumpdrive aborted)Aborting jump!
(jumpdrive engaged)Jump Drive fully ready.
(jumpdrive emergency)On our way, see you later. Jumping!
(jumpdrive cool-down)The Jump Drive is not quite ready yet. Any time now.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Jump Drive building up.
(jumpdrive success)Jump successful, Sir. Ship systems all show green.
(engage boost to player)Boosting to your location. We'll be there soon!
(engage boost)Full boost applied.
(follow)I will stick to you like glue Sir.
(moveto)A pleasure. Moving to specified coordinates now.
(moveto dock)Moving to dock. We'll send you a vid of the cold beers in the bar
(docked)Successfully docked, home and dry.
(task completed)It is done just as you wanted, Sir.
(confirm no change)Absolutely, Sir, continuing as planned.
(arrived)We're here, Sir, and looking good.
(arrived)We're in place and ready for anything.
(arrived at player)We're here to join up with you.
(arrived at player)We've caught up with you. Good to see you.
Roger that, Sir. We'll guard our area, don't you worry!
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Sir, it's fantastic to have you aboard.
(lost drones for current task)Ouch! We seem to be out of drones. We may need a new task.
(task start but low on drones)Of course. We're really low on drones but, as always, we'll do our best for you.
(no drones to start task)I'm really sorry. Without the right drones we cannot do that.
(restock request to player)We need some more drones. Is there any chance of a resupply?
(request additional ships)Sir, for this job we could certainly use another ship or so.
(received additional ship)That's excellent! We'll get her working right away.
I'm sorry, Sir. That wouldn't fit in with our current operations.
We'll stop our current operations.
Ready for retasking, Sir.
(Player loses licence)You've let us down, Mr Otani. Your licence with us is revoked!
You'll know the reason if you think about it.
We seem a bit damaged just now? Any ideas on how we can get repairs?
(movement status)We're stuck here I'm afraid. We'll need some local assistance.
Roger that. We are shipyard-bound.
We're at the shipyard now. Any new orders for us or should we go and have a drink?
Our Jump Drive is disabled which rather cramps our options.
Naturally. We will jump as soon as it comes back on line. There's plenty to do meanwhile.
The shipyard gave us a great welcome. Any new orders for when we're repaired?
Our engine is off-line and needs some tender love and care.
Got it. Moving when possible. Try not to miss us too badly!
We're attempting an emergency jump. This could be interesting!
Yay! Emergency jump worked! Awaiting new orders - thankfully!
We're leaving this zone with mixed emotions.
We'll await new orders in our new location - it is much more scenic here!
We seem a bit short of fuel if you want us to jump there. Just a little problem!
We need a tad more fuel for that particular jump, any advice?
At your command, heading set for the nearest fuel depot. I hope they have the good stuff.
I'm refuelling before trying that jump.
We seem to be out of jump fuel. Are there any fuel transporters around?
The next fuel station is beyond our current fuel range. We would welcome any fuel transfer or resupply.
We'll try a generator-powered jump, but I'll have to be holding my lucky charm when we do.
We're going for a forced jump despite the fuel situation. Wish me luck everyone.
We'll set off for the destination, but we'll need to refuel at some point to be able to get there.
(Hired Architect)Hello Sir, your Architect at your service. How may I help?
(Asked how to get building resources)How would you like us to handle the delivery of resources for the construction?
We're fully topped up with resources thank you. This is the spot you chose for the station? Any last rethink on that? Once we start that'll be it.
Module construction completed Sir, and fine it is too. Any new construction orders for me?
Station construction complete Sir. Congratulations on a beautiful station.
This is your next module listed for construction Sir.
I'll show you all the modules available for construction in the current state.
Are you about this module being next? Once you give the go-ahead, we are committed.
A brilliant choice. You have an eye for this, I see. We will start building straight away.
Hello Sir, your Architect speaking. Your new station will need a Station Manager on completion. You'll want to hire the best and have them delivered here.
These stations can be built for you Sir. They are beautiful constructions if you don't mind me saying so.
(builder ship moving)Moving to your designated construction site.
(Ship builder)Hello Sir, may I interest you in having a spaceship built? We have a very competitive and modern catalogue.
Excellent! We have all the resources we need to build now. Are you sure that you want us to build this particular model? Once we start you cannot change your mind.
Ship construction complete Sir. What a beauty she is!
We have a backlog of construction just now Sir. We'll deal with that with our usual efficiency though. Meanwhile, please browse our catalogues and call back in a day or so.
Hello Sir, your ship under construction is nearly ready. She will need a skilled pilot who reflects your high personal standards. Do you have anyone available?
We can build any of these excellent ship types for you.
It pains me to mention it, but we are rather short of credits, Sir.
(PC: You take care of it.)That's all fine now. I'll get on with the necessary arrangements.
The extensions listed here are now available. While placing your order, be aware that some require others to work.
We await your advice on which upgrade levels to set. Your order and confirmation would be welcome, Sir.
To which hull percentage would you have us do the repairs?

I'm so grateful that you have been able to help, (#excuse#)even if it's about the money. At the end of the day, look at the difference it's all made!
(#nod01#)I feel the same, exactly the same. (#punchhand01#)It's a great thing that's happening here.
(#rolleyes02#)Plutarch! Wow! I had no idea!
Just bits and pieces. (#scratchhead01#)What's it all about?
You? Well done, I guess. You definitely need to tell me more!
(#hard#)It beggars belief that they could cover this up for so long. It speaks volumes about the lack of free media!(unsettled)
That's shocking! Are you sure? (#cold#)You saw it... I suppose you are.(resignation at end)
(#nod01#)The source isn't important now, as long as the evidence is authentic.
(#disapproval01#)I'm betting Plutarch had to have done something really bad to upset them.
(#facepalm01#)Not important?(outrage) You're kidding me, right? (#angry#)People like you with no backbone disgust me!(disgusted)

page.title: Argon NPC Male 5 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[argon] [terran] male basic(cheerful)
(greeting friendly)Hey, my friend.
(greeting neutral)Hearing you loud and clear, pal.
(greeting enemy)I'll listen.
(greeting rejected)Not today thanks.
(greeting service)I'm really looking forward to this!
(greeting neutral - no comm){,1}
(goodbye friendly)You take care and look me up again.
(goodbye neutral)Be good, mind!
(goodbye enemy)I'll be watching!
(goodbye rejected)Enough already!
(goodbye service)It was really great helping out.
(ship scanned - complicit)Do you think you can check for leaks as well?
(ship scanned - neutral)Hey, does this mean we're best buddies now?
(ship scanned - illegal)You'll get into trouble you naughty Pilot!
(ship scanned - enemy)I hope this isn't the lead up to anything painful!
(ship scanned - confident)I'll go hide on the ship and you see if you can find me!
(ship scanned - possessing)OK, you got me there. There's enough to go round you know!
(station/capship scanned - complicit)OK, but can you do it from the port side? That's my better profile!
(station/capship scanned - neutral)We see you are a bit of a nosey parker!
(station/capship scanned - illegal)If that scan was a joke, it was a pretty silly action around here.
(station/capship scanned - enemy)See the defences? They see you too!
(station/capship scanned - confident)Go ahead but excuse the mess; we haven't tidied up yet.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Well we could debate this all day, or you could name a price for your silence maybe!
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)Damn! I was sure they said it was only illegal in the other systems...
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)Are you sure? I cannot believe that the crew would allow something like that to be smuggled aboard.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)Hmm, well maybe we could put it down to a scanner glitch? Yes?
(directions - location not known)My memory, it's awful these days. Sorry.
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Ha ha. I just laughed so much that I armed the defence systems by mistake!
(surrender - hostile)I don't suppose I could ask you to surrender to me instead?
(surrender - complicit)No problem. Let's get this done all nice and safely.
(drops cargo 1)Look here is a sweetener for you to let me go.
(drops cargo 2)I think a bit of dropped cargo could convince you to hold fire? Yes?
(bail from ship 1)Ok, enough! I'm going swimming!
(bail from ship 2)Ejecting now! Look after the old girl!
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)Good to speak to you Sir.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)Lovely to meet you Sir.
(hired comm greeting 2)Hello Sir. How may I help?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Hello Sir. You look even more distinguished in person!
(hired comm goodbye 1)Until next time.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)It was my pleasure Sir.
Signing off for now Sir.
I am at your Service.
(join squad)I'm now in your squad.
(leave squad)I'm leaving your squad. I'll miss them!
(accept order 1)Of course Sir.
(accept order 2)Be certain of it.
(reject order 1)Sorry Sir, that's beyond even my capabilities.
(reject order 2)That's not currently feasible.
(Automatic)Automatic operations have commenced Sir.
(standby)Naturally. I'll await your commands.
Affirmative.
Understood.
Negative.
(jumpdrive charging)Charging Jump Drive for new destination.
(jumpdrive aborted)Jump aborted!
(jumpdrive engaged)Counting down to jump.
(jumpdrive emergency)We are out of here! Jumping now!
(jumpdrive cool-down)The Jump Drive is still on cool-down.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Jump Drive charging.
(jumpdrive success)Jump achieved and all systems are in the green.
(engage boost to player)Boosting to meet up with you, Sir.
(engage boost)Boosters operating at full efficiency.
(follow)We will stick close to you Sir.
(moveto)We're on our way to the coordinates.
(moveto dock)Moving to dock.
(docked)Successfully docked.
(task completed)Task accomplished Sir.
(confirm no change)Got that. Proceeding as planned.
(arrived)We're in position, Sir.
(arrived)At location as ordered.
(arrived at player)It's great to be back with you, Sir.
(arrived at player)We're at your location now, Sir.
OK, taking up guard position now.
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Sir, it's an honour to welcome you aboard.
(lost drones for current task)Err .. we don't have any drones for that task.
(task start but low on drones)We're short of those drones, but we'll use what few we have for as long as we can.
(no drones to start task)Much as I'd like to do it myself, we need some more drones to do that.
(restock request to player)We need to restock our drones. We can't do much without the little chaps.
(request additional ships)Some more ships would be handy in this job, Sir.
(received additional ship)That's great! She'll be put to work straight away.
That's incompatible with our current operations, Sir.
We'll wind up our current operations now.
We're ready for new instructions, Sir.
(Player loses licence)Our licence agreement was just cancelled, Mr Otani.
I'm sure you'll know the reasons why.
Our ship is badly damaged but holding up for now. We'll need new orders.
(movement status)We can't move, even if I get out and push. We need assistance right here!
Affirmative. We're on our way to the next shipyard. I'm looking forward to a decent shower!
We're docked at the shipyard. Awaiting new orders - but the food here is great!
Our Jump Drive is damaged. We're not jumping anywhere else without it.
We'll jump as soon as we can. I don't intend to hang around here anymore than I have to.
We've docked at the shipyard. Awaiting new orders while we get cleaned up.
Our engine is damaged - we could only move by towing the old girl with an escape capsule.
We'll move as soon as we can - at least the scenery is spectacular here!
We'll do an emergency jump. See you on the other side - hopefully!
Hurrah! Emergency jump successful - it's nice here. Awaiting new orders.
Departing this zone now.
We're safely in the new location and awaiting orders.
We don't have enough fuel to jump that far.
We need some extra fuel for that length of jump.
Heading for the nearest fuel depot. We'll get the galley restocked too!
We'll refuel and then do the ordered jump. A logical sequence really!
A fuel tanker would be handy just now, we're out of jump juice!
We're running dry on fuel and the refuel station is too far away. We need some resupply here.
Attempting generator-powered jump since we don't have the fuel we need. Wish us luck!
We're below the required energy stocks but we'll force a jump anyway. This should be interesting!
Absolutely, Sir. We'll have to refuel before we can get there though.
(Hired Architect)Hello Sir, Architect speaking. I've lots of suggestions for you.
(Asked how to get building resources)How would you like us to handle the provision of construction resources?
All right, that is sufficient for now. Please confirm you want that station here since the construction runs on automatic once started.
Your fine new module is complete Sir. What would you like next?
Your station is ready Sir. It's magnificent!
This is the next module on the build schedule Sir.
Current progress dictates what modules may now be added. I'll show you what is available now.
Are you sure this is the module you want? It's too late to change your mind once we start.
What a grand plan! Construction will start immediately.
Hello Sir, your Architect here. Your station in progress will need a Station Manager. Now would be a good time to find one and deliver them here.
The stations available for construction are listed here. They're most impressive.
(builder ship moving)Moving to the new construction site now.
(Ship builder)Hello Sir, you've a good eye for spaceships. What can we interest you in?
We've all we need to proceed. Are you positive this ship is the one you want? Once we get going, the cost is payable in full.
Ship construction complete Sir. She is breath-taking!
Our construction list is currently full but if you check out our listings and call back later, then I am sure that we can satisfy your needs.
Hello Sir. Concerning your fine ship in progress; she'll be needing a skilled pilot. Do you have anyone available or in mind?
Here are ships we specialise in. Take your pick.
We don't have enough funding, Sir.
(PC: You take care of it.)Check. Our funding is fine now, so let's get on with it.
These are the extensions we provide. Some interact with each other and so you must bear that in mind.
I would grateful if you'd set and confirm the upgrade levels.
Set the repair percentage you want us to attain.
Here are the station modules that we can add for you.
I can show you my resource status in this display.
(architect)Don't worry, any credits not needed will be returned to you in full.
(Initiate Trade)That's a fine deal, we're on our way to meet you.
(Receive)Preparing for receipt of wares.
(Deliver)Delivery of wares imminent.
(Fail Space)I'm sorry, our cargo bay is full and we can't fit in even a Teladi contortionist!
(Fail Type)We'd need a different ship to transport that type of ware. I guess you won't buy me a bigger ship?
(Fail Space Standby)Well we've been lucky and are already chock full! What shall we do instead?
(Fail Buy Amount)We can't get all that we wanted here. Tell you what, I'll buy what I can unless you've another plan
(Fail Sell Amount)It seems we have more than they want now. Want me to sell off what I can, or should I do something else?
(Fail Buy Ware)Well we're here, but they don't seem to have what we wanted. I'll press on to the next adventure, unless you've some orders for me.
(Fail Sell Ware)Yes, I know they must be insane, but they don't seem to want what we have to sell. Want me to go on with then next trade or have you something else in mind?
(Fail Buy Price)They're charging a silly price here for what we wanted. I'll buy at that outrageous price if you want.
(Fail Sell Price)I'll need some advice here. They won't pay our asking price. Shall I sell the load for peanuts anyway or what?
(Fail)That deal isn't going to happen here with the market as it is. What now?
I seem to have a stack of lovely credits we have made for you. Shall I transfer the surplus to your account?
That deal is all sewn up now. I'll send you a report of the details.
We've arrived, so let's get trading!
(fixed something)There, I told you I was a wizard with these things.
(fixed something)Just like new at a fraction of the replacement price!
(fixed something)See? It is all in knowing where and how hard to give it a bang!
(Initiate Mining)Ready to mine. Just give the word.
(Launch)Collectors on the way. Wish them good luck!
(Recall)Collectors being recalled. Let's see what they bring home.
(Automatic)Automatic operations are running.
(Fail Type)That would challenge our ship. She needs a different cargo bay for that.
Affirmative. Our drones will happily pick up whatever you tag for them.
Affirmative. Our clever little drones can prioritize anything you tag.
That's a no-go. We don't have the drones for that job.
Of course. Our busy little drones will collect that up in no time.
We have finished mining and will tag along with you - unless you've another task for us.
We're full to the brim and returning to meet up with you.
(Squad member)Hmm. I've just been hailed and told to drop my cargo!
The markings suggest that it's a police ship.
The ship is not acting at all friendly towards me.
Should I just comply?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
Waiting on standby for your next set of orders Sir.
(scan successful)Analysing the data for the best point of attack.
We'll drop down here and make that hull look like paper.
(not scanned)Well in my best guess we might as well drop right there.
(boarding pod launching)Pod on the way.
(boarding pod hit)Hey, their fire is a bit too accurate for my taste!
(marines under fire)We're certainly earning marine-pay here!
(pod attached)Starting to peel the hull open.
(marine entering ship)Hull breached, let's take a look around inside!
Team formed up and ready to exploit.
We're moving up. Fingers on triggers.
(marine on alert)I've got movement here - lots of it!
(loud)Contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
Scatter!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Light them up!
(lots of fighting noise)We're taking losses here!
(lots of fighting noise)All-round defence!
(lots of fighting noise)Get up and move forward!
(lots of fighting noise)Covering fire! Hit them hard!
(combat)Keep going!
(quiet)Hostiles ahead.
(assist mission successful)Look at them run! Get up and follow!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We're not seeing a withdrawal. We'll have to fight through.
(assist mission successful)Sentries knocked out!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Never mind, we'll deal with them the hard way!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)We're at a security outpost.
(marine hacking)Starting system hack.
(assist mission successful)Automated defences neutralised.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Well, that's a bummer. We'll take out the defences ourselves.
Uh oh! That sounds like the self-destruct alarm! Get it hacked, now!
(relieved)Self-destruct sequence aborted.
(assist mission failed/timed out)It's not working! Get out of here, pronto!
(boarding successful)We have control.
Our losses are too heavy to continue. Fall back!
This hull won't make it! Head for the pods!
We're in the pods and on our way back.
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)I need a medic!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Damn, that's a fine marine gone!
Argh...(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Get that hatch open! Fire in the hole!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Marking priority targets!
(lots of fighting noise)Get some fire on that corner!
(checking for enemies)Clear to move!
(sound of laser fire)Laser turrets!
Force field blocking the corridor.
(assist mission successful)Force field disengaged!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Now we need to find another route past it.
They've given up, the ship is taken!(cheers)
They've no stomach for more, the station has surrendered!(cheers)
I don't think we're going to ma--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)The target is well and truly ours. What a team!
(upgrades)Upgrades installed and we're moving out.
Downgrades completed. Moving now.
Upgrades installed.
Choose the ship for the upgrade.
Which upgrade do you require changed?
(*Hiring*)
Did you know that you have someone doing my job already?
You do have an Engineer on board at the moment.
You have a Marine Officer on board already.
Do you want me to replace them or will you find me another job?
You'll never look back after hiring me Sir.
My appointment will start a great partnership, Sir.
(On board introduction)I'm your new crew member. Where do I start?
(Fired in space)I'll leave at the next station stop-over. I'll be all right there.
(Fired on platform)I'll leave immediately. Finding a new job won't be such a chore here.
(Assign to object)OK, Sir. I'll assume my new job immediately.
(Assign to ship)Right. I'm in post now, Sir.
(Return to player)OK, Sir. I'll be with you shortly.
(Leave player)Wish me luck, Sir.
(Leave player)Cheerio, try not to miss me!
(Showing skills)They don't come much more qualified than I am. Look here.
(Showing skills)These should impress you, I worked hard enough for them!
(Orders)Please let me have the new coordinates.
(Sell ship)That ship I sold has made you a tidy stack of credits.
(Sell ship)Sold as promised. I'll miss that dear old tub though.(Colloquial)
(respond to free mode)It's great that you trust me to do a good job on my own.
(respond to free mode)I'll show that your trust in me is well-founded.
(respond to restricted mode)I can play the good and loyal messenger. No worries there!
(respond to restricted mode)OK. If you ever want me to use my own initiative, then just let me know.(hinting that this would be a good idea)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Waiting for an apology and a good explanation!
(player attacks - friendly 2)Am I supposed to fire back as a big joke too?
(player attacks - neutral 1)Do you feel like sharing what that was all about? Any time would be good!
(player attacks - neutral 2)Press the wrong button there? I hope so for your sake!
(player attacks - enemy 1)Aww .. and we've only just met. Such a shame!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Now that was pretty silly. Any more and you'll be seeing lights - red and blue ones!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)I get it, you wanted attention. Well here come the police to give you some!
(big object attacked)(laughs)Look, we're being attacked by a spacefly!(laughs loudly)
(big object attacked)(sigh)I'm trying to watch a good vid here. Will you go away?
(light fire 1)Well that was ... unimpressive!
(light fire 2)That would make some pilots angry! Me, I'm just puzzled!
(mid fire 1)I think this is a bit more serious!
(mid fire 2)I've a real dog-fight here!
(heavy fire 1)I'm losing bits off my ship, and I think they matter!
(heavy fire 2)I would appreciate a bit of help before I end up walking home!
(heavy fire 3)This could be my final transmission! I want my Mummy now!
(station defence)Come in all assigned ships. This station is being attacked.
(station defence)We could do with some local deterrence here. Please report in.
(station defence)Our station has a problem. Attackers need seeing off.
(death 1)Aaagghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(death 3)Aaarrrgghhh!
(shield warning 1)Shields paper-thin!
(shield warning 2)Shields marginal!
(hull warning 1)Hull damage mounting!
(hull warning 2)The hull is almost shot out!
(Incoming Enemies)Well there's a sight, but not a good one!
(Incoming Wave)More coming! Don't give up yet!
(Last Wave)Get through these and we could be home and dry!
(Player Needed)Hello? Aren't you supposed to be over here helping me?
(Success 1)They're done for. Good work everyone! There were a few close-calls there!
(Success 2)Phew! That made them think again. Let's see what the cost has been.
(Fail 1)Short version - we lost badly.
(Fail 2)We came second by a long way!
(critical damage)I'm in very poor shape here!
(critical damage)Power is unstable and I can't hold her for long!
(Incoming Enemies)Enemy targets on closing vectors!
(Dangerous area)This looks ... ominous. I don't like it here!
(Plead for life 1)Can't you tell when a ship is out of the fight?
(Plead for life 2)Spare me and I'll become a Goner preacher!
(Plead for life 3)Listen my death is worthless to you, but my ship is worth a lot!
(Plead for life 4)This ship has given her all. Don't let her die as a cloud of glowing scrap!
(player instructions)Follow our lead.
Stick close, real close.
(followers)We'll be your shadow.
Lead on MacDuff.
Ready when you are.
Ready and waiting!
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)Evacuation ordered. Follow your training and obey all orders.(calming)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)So, are you still up for this little adventure I've planned for you?
(General 2)You'll like this! Are you ready to set off?
(Easy 1)You can probably do this one on autopilot!
(Easy 2)The main hazard here might be boredom!
(Hard 1)I'm not sure you can do this. I hope you can prove me wrong!
(Hard 2)I've a lot riding on this and I don't like taking chances on greenhorns!
(Fight Easy 1)This will be a doddle for gun-happy pilots like you.
(Fight Easy 2)Yeah, I think you could be classed as overkill for this job!
(Fight Hard 1)I see you are keen, but the keen ones usually end up dead!
(Fight Hard 2)Not afraid eh? That sounds a bit like empty bravado to me!
(Trade Easy 1)A simple job moving stuff. Even you couldn't mess this one up!
(Trade Easy 2)You'll like this cargo-run. No hassle and no danger!
(Trade Hard 1)I need a freight delivery made in the face of adversity. Are you good enough?
(Trade Hard 2)You seem sure of yourself, but I'm not so sure!
(Acceptance Query 1)Had second thoughts?
(Acceptance Query 2)Still looking to make a name for yourself?
(Accept 1)OK, this could profit us both.
(Accept 2)Fair enough, we'll give it a go.
(Reluctant 1)Well, against my better judgement, go on then!
(Reluctant 2)I really, really hope I'm not making a big mistake!
(Reject 1)No sorry, I think it would end in grief for both of us.
(Reject 2)I think I'll wait for someone who seems more suitable for this.
(Info 1)Your computer should have the information now.
(Info 2)Check out the job details on your computer.
(Success 1)Well done! That makes us both really happy - and richer.
(Success 2)Good stuff! I felt you would bring me some good luck for a change.
(Semi 1)Was that it? Oh well, it's not a complete loss.
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)I won't get rich on so-so jobs. I hope the next pilot is better.
(Fail 1)Why did you bother checking in? You've ruined me!
(Fail 2)What? You expect a pat on the back for that screw-up?
(Credits 1)Your lovely pile of credits is on its way.
(Reward 1)Here is a little extra by way of thanks for a good job.
(Client abort)I'm afraid the client has pulled out. No job, sorry.
(mission update)Your briefing has been changed to meet new circumstances.
(mission update 2)Check out your briefing, there have been some updates.
(Assassination Offer 1)I want someone removed - forever, and ideally painfully.
(Assassination Offer 2)I want you to help someone to meet up with their parents again - their dead parents!
(Target)You were sent to remove me in that crate? This is a joke right?!
(Target 2)Don't spend your blood-money yet, you'll have to get me first!
(Bribe 1)There could be something in it for you - if we both leave here alive!
(Success)No-one could survive that!
(Fail)You lost them? Did they suddenly engage a cloaking device or something?
(Fail by bribe)You took their money over ours? That'll prove very costly for you!
(Protect Station Offer 1)Hi, our defence forces could do with a hand just now. We have hostiles incoming and nowhere to send our civilians.
(Protect Station Offer 2)Thin out the raiders due here any time now. We'll pay you for each kill you do.
(Protect Ship Offer 1)We're out-gunned here. Anyone, please help!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Distress call! Help us survive continuing attacks by raiders. We can pay well.
(Police 1)Smugglers operate in this area and we need an unfamiliar ship to get close enough to scan them. We pay well for information about such operations.
(Success 1)That looks like excellent data and should lead to several arrests of ring-leaders.
(Semi 1)So there was nothing suspicious? Oh well. Perhaps they got wind of you.
(Fail 1)Well, since they have been boasting how they got their shipments through, I think you must've been asleep!
(Passenger Offer 1)I need a lift pretty much now. Can you help me out?
(Passenger Offer 2)I have to get to a destination rather quickly. Are you up to earning some credits?
(On Board)I'm snug and cosy back here.
(Space)Yeah, funny! How am I supposed to fit in here with no room?
(Late)Hello! I'm getting really bored back here. Any chance of getting there soon?
(Fail)I'll just hop out at the next stop and try to piece my business back together. Thanks for nothing!
(Assigned to platform)Starting on new assignment now Sir. Thank you for your faith in me.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)We need a good operator to deliver some freight for us. Is that up your street?
(Return Ware Offer)We need a consignment of wares brought here. Does that appeal to you, my friend?
(Late Sell)Much as we want you to enjoy the scenery, we do have a deadline to meet!
(Late Return)The wait here is killing us. Any chance you could hurry it up?
(Fail Sell)Our reputation for prompt delivery just took a dive! Don't show your face around here again!
(Fail Return)Do what you want now. We'll find a reliable delivery service instead!
(Emergency Offer)I need assistance here! Please come back if you can help!
(Emergency Offer)I can make it well worthwhile for anyone receiving this who can help me out with a problem!
(Emergency Offer)Get here fast! Big problem! Big need! Big reward!
(station manager)Docking permission granted.
Welcome aboard.
Good to see you aboard.
It is nice to have you visit us.
Saving our station from those raiders was rather heroic.
(Defence manager thanking player)That's one we owe you, Skunk!
(Defence manager thanking player)Thanks 'Pride'. You got us out of a mess there.
Your assistance was really appreciated. Here are your credits.
(trader introduction)Pilot, I've some great deals to offer!
(trader introduction)Hi, like what you see here?
(trader introduction)Great to see you. We try to cater for all needs here.
(trader introduction)Don't go anywhere else, we offer the best deals around.
(trader introduction)There's nothing shoddy nor sub-standard in my stock!
(generic trader)This is what I have available for you.
(performing service)Let's get started.
Nothing to hold us back now.
(Confirm sale/handoff)A pleasure to do business.
(Confirm agreement)Accepted!
(giving object or info){,4111}
(weapon/upgrade trader)We can customise any of these weapons to fit in your ship.
Ammo resupply should be up there with life-support maintenance in my opinion.
Anyone leaving port without full ammunition bins is taking a big risk.
We only stock the finest goods here!
My rivals know that we beat them on quality and price.
A fine choice, if I may say so.
May I ask the quantity you want?
Would you like to see anything else?
We'll get this fitted to your ship.
We'll take this over to your ship and get it in place.
Pride of Albion, that's a great name for her after that work.
We take pride in our modification work. She'll wear her name well after this.
We've done a job that befits a lady with the name 'Pride of Albion'.
(Shady trader)I sense you don't mind taking a bit of a risk, if the money's right!
I can do you a special deal on some very 'special' stuff!(special as in illegal)
Let me know how much you can take without arousing too much suspicion.
(licence trader)Ahah! Someone in the market for a licence, I believe.
I can determine if you're suitable to be granted one of these licences.
We remind customers that each licence imposes a degree of responsibility upon the owner.
This licence permits you to further the interests of the issuing faction.
(deal confirmations)Excellent!
Bargain struck!
Agreed.
You have a deal!
(accepting gift from player){,4300}
Hello, what seems to be the problem?
You can count on us, whatever the need.
(emergency call)Emergency! Help needed!
Calling all ships, please respond!
Is anyone out there? I need your help!
Please open contact! I am in trouble here!
(station contacting player)Station command for unidentified ship.
Station command for Ren Otani.
(attacking allied object)We do not tolerate unprovoked attacks in our space.
Your actions will not be tolerated here.
You will regret doing that!
We'll take you to task for that!
Tell me that was not intended!
That leads to a place where you don't want to go!
(player uncovered as enemy)Your cover has been blown!
(station contacting law)Station command for local authorities.
We're sustaining heavy fire here.
Please provide assistance.
(police)Be assured, we're sending forces now.
We're already heavily engaged and don't have any forces to spare just now.
(NPC request for help rejected)You cannot be serious!
(NPC request for help rejected)I just don't believe it!
Report related to individual Ren Otani.
Sending file about Ren Otani.
Sending file.
On file.
Don't we know him?
Ah, that criminal!
Data received.
Not her again!
Ah yes. We know of her.
Contacting law enforcement.
(Found discount)Hey! This is far too good to miss!
(Found discount)Hi, this place can do you a really good deal!
(discount offer)I've some leeway on price. Want a good discount?
(discount offer)This offer is hurting me!
(discount explanation)We seem to have a healthy surplus of stock just now.
(discount explanation)We had some time-wasters bidding for stock.
(discount explanation)Our resource-buyer got a bit carried away.
(player station manager)Sir, there's a delicate situation here.
(player station manager)We have a dilemma that needs straightening out.
Our station is prevented from working.
Station operation is at a halt.
The details are on the way...
We need your advice ...
Our resources don't meet the demand.
Our resources can't meet the level of demand.
(can also be used for ships)We're completely full.
(can also be used for ships)All storage has been used up.
(architect)We could do with a manager here.
(can also be used for ships)You can improve our operational capability with these options.
(can also be used for ships)If you want to make us more effective, then you have these options.
(defence officer)We're suffering attacks and need support at this location!
We need support forces here to deter ships that have engaged us!
(exchange wares)We can transfer goods to whomever you indicate.
Which ware would that be?
What is the intended ware?
How much?
What number?
Specify the amount please.
That's all in order. Commencing transfer.
Transfer details acknowledged. Initiating.
Are these items just for cargo, or to be mounted in the target itself?
I've too few credits to proceed, I'm afraid.
I can obtain the necessary credits from your account, unless you have other instructions.
That has resolved the funding problem. We can proceed.
I need to discuss my budget with you in the very near future, Sir.
The budget changes are in force.
Once we're in location, we'll start the operation.
(rejecting impossible mode order)That can't be done at the moment. Sorry!
What will be the mission after we arrive?
Please identify our destination.
Destination confirmed. We're on our way.
We're at that location now. Please supply any further mission details.
Our operation has commenced.
Beginning of joint operation confirmed.
(Witness)Oh yes! I saw that happen in every nasty detail!
(Witness threatened or bribed)I, err, suppose I could have, err, been mistaken. Yes?
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)Oh, get real!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)Gosh! (#smile#)I never thought I'd get to meet a real local hero like you!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#smile#)You're the guy in all the newscasts. Well I never! What a great day for me!
I can do this on my own, no problem! Unless you like me to take my other ships as back-up! What's it to be?
(Pilot sold his ship)I can go looking for job here. Unless you want me to stay on in another position, that is.
(new assignment)Naturally Sir, where would you like to employ me?
On my way to your location now. I'm looking forward to joining your fleet.
Got that Sir! Moving now to join your command.
I'm available for new tasking Sir. I will join your Squad until you decide.
(Manager)Sir? You've a ship assignment for me?
(Manager)I'll continue to comply with previous orders for now.
(NPC already assigned to job)Sir, this is what I am doing now.
(Player scanned)We do this hundreds of times every day. No need to get concerned over an official scan.
(Player scanned)Keep it calm and businesslike and our scan will be done in no time.
(Player scanned - aggressive)Well, let's see what the shifty-looking pilot doesn't want us to find!
(Player scanned - aggressive)We like seeing nervous pilots, but not so nervous that they make us nervous!
(nothing found)There, all done. You can leave with our thanks for your time.
(nothing found)We're finished thanks. Nothing to report means no paperwork. A win all round!
(nothing found - aggressive)I hate smug pilots. Get moving before I wipe that smirk off your face!
(nothing found - aggressive)You're a disappointment. I was sure we were on to something.
(contraband found - police)This is the police. You're in breach of the local contraband regulations.
(contraband found - police)Well, it seems we have an over-ambitious pilot. Just follow our orders and deal with this properly.
(drop instruction)Eject all contraband and we'll resolve this without any violence!
(pirate plundering)We've hit pay-dirt! Look at that!
(pirate plundering)See, I said he looked shifty and nervous!
(drop instruction)We can do this the hard and painful way, or you can drop some of the stuff.
(dropped)Well done. At least you got that bit right.
(dropped)That was the right thing to do. Now you can move along.
(dropped part)Come now, you had more than that aboard.
(dropped part)You didn't think we'd fall for that did you?
(Misc Canteran Pilot)
(static)This is Canteran Transport 23. Got some Reivers getting close and could do with some backup. En route to home base.
I don't know who you are but we'd appreciate an escort. There are Reivers getting close. My people are on their way though, so no funny business.
We need to get to friendly space safely. Watch our back and I'll be sure to get you a warm welcome.
That's the way home up ahead. We should be safe enough on the other side.
Thanks for the help. I'll try and clear you to dock at our home station.
Otani! We're going to attempt to retrieve the life-pods but we could do with some covering fire.
(Plutarch Pilot)
This is Plutarch security. Interceptors are on their way to your position. Shut down your engines and weapon systems.
Your ship has been blacklisted. You should stand down.
(HoA Pilot)
Lieutenant. We've got the civilian fleet covered. So far so good but aren't we spread a little thin right now. Heart of Albion now has to patrol two systems with half strength fleets.
If you say so ma'am. Thanks ma'am.
Additional ships incoming. Reivers!
Plutarch and the Reivers have an alliance?
Unknown vessel. We have a lock on your ship. Prepare to be escorted through the gate. This is your only warning.
(#smile#)Now that strikes a deep chord with me!
(#sad#)If only I were as adept with words as you are!
(#nod01#)We see so much eye-to-eye! It's uncanny!
(#nod01#)That's great news. We are so much of the same opinions!
(#smile#)You know how to get your way don't you! (#laugh#)Quite the orator!
(#scratchhead01#)Wherever did you get such good information?
(#smile#)Keep it up! I have never been so impressed.
We could keep this up all night. (#smile#)I like a good chat!
(#gesticulate01#)Continue please. I'm still paying attention.
(#gesticulate02#)I get it. That's an unusual viewpoint though.
(#shrug01#)Well it takes all sorts to have a good discussion.
(#shrug01#)You need differing views to have a good debate.
(#disapproval01#)That's beginning to sound rather superficial to me.
(#rolleyes01#)I have little idea what you are going on about.
(#rolleyes02#)If you could hurry up please. I have other business.
(#crossarms01#)I don't think we're quite on the same chapter or page.
(#angry#)I think you're nothing but a time-waster!
(#angry#)I can see that you don't respect another's opinions.
(#sad#)I think you made a mistake in talking to me!
All right. (#disapproval01#)We've finished this talk now!
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)This conversation has been the highlight of my day! I like you!
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)You've earned my respect during our chat.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)I know, I can tell you about a special offer on a station nearby. You'll find this interesting!
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)Here are the details of someone looking for a job. I can personally vouch for them.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)If you're looking to hire a skilled professional, then I know just the person for you.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)Anything we trade from now on gets my personal discount. (#smile#)It's only available for special friends.
Canterans. (#shrug01#)Is it just me or do they sound Terran?
(#excuse#)Why wouldn't I? We just don't know enough about them.(defensive)
(#excuse#)I'm not so sure. The Argon and Terran peoples didn't get on. Maybe it's the same with the Canterans.
Luxuries aren't something I've dabbled in, but (#punchhand01#)hey, now you mention it, (#smile#)it's a great idea!(having an epiphany)
(#cold#)I dread to think what Plutarch will do with Xenon tech.
(#cold#)The prospect is truly terrifying. You too should be afraid.
Even if you can fight fire with fire, (#hard#)a Xenon fleet on the rampage is a frickin' big fire.
(#laugh#)Haha, OK, I see what you're saying. (#sad#)I'm right there with you.(bitter irony)
(#nod01#)That's precisely what has me worried.
(#hard#)That's a dangerous path. Not least because we don't know if we'd be any better than PMC at harnessing Xenon tech.
(#scratchhead01#)AI this, AGI that... what's all the fuss?
(#gesticulate01#)Give it to me straight. It's about time I knew what it's all about.
OK, (#thinking01#)so let me get this straight AGI really aren't the bad guys or am I missing something?
(#nod01#)That certainly explains a lot. I didn't know that it happened like that.

page.title: Argon NPC Male 6 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[argon] [terran] male basic(grumpy)
(greeting friendly)Yes?
(greeting neutral)What now?
(greeting enemy)Get on with it!
(greeting rejected)Shove off!
(greeting service)I suppose you need my help?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)Bye.
(goodbye neutral)Out!
(goodbye enemy)Don't come back!
(goodbye rejected)Get lost!
(goodbye service)Yeah bye, got to earn a living somehow!
(ship scanned - compliant)Get on with it!
(ship scanned - neutral)So, you think I care?
(ship scanned - illegal)Oh look, another wannabe pirate!
(ship scanned - enemy)Are you looking to make me mad?
(ship scanned - confident)Waste my time, why don't you!
(ship scanned - possessing)You want to make something of it?
(station/capship scanned - compliant)We haven't got all day you know!
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Great, another busybody!
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Go tell your excuses to the marines!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)That's it, now I'm getting angry!
(station/capship scanned - confident)Great, don't take our word for it then!
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Oh for pity's sake! Who cares about a stash like that?
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)(annoyed)Have you any idea how long it took to get that stuff?
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)Typical, I'll bet you demand a share now!
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)(depressed)That's all I need! More paperwork and hassle!
(directions - location not known)How in the hell should I know!
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)In your dreams!
(surrender - hostile)I'd normally tell you to stick it where the suns don't shine!
(surrender - compliant)Go on, just take everything!(depressed)
(drops cargo 1)Look, just take this and go!
(drops cargo 2)This is all you're getting!
(bail from ship 1)Take it! I never liked it anyway.
(bail from ship 2)All right! All right! I'm getting out!
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)I hear you.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)What do you want?
(hired comm greeting 2)Yeah?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Looking for me?
(hired comm goodbye 1)Sure. Bye.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)That it?
Yes? What do want this time?
So what is so urgent?
(join squad)I'm here!
(leave squad)I'm off!
(accept order 1)Yeah.
(accept order 2)If I have to!
(reject order 1)That would be a 'no'.
(reject order 2)Pull the other one!
(Automatic)Automatic engaged - let's get some rest.
(standby)Yeah I'll wait. Nothin' better to do!
Yes.
Acknowledged.
No.
(jumpdrive charging)We'll jump when we jump!
(jumpdrive aborted)(Sigh) Aborting! Make your mind up!
(jumpdrive engaged)That'll be the Jump Drive you can hear!(dry, sarcastic)
(jumpdrive emergency)I'm jumping out of here pronto!
(jumpdrive cool-down)I'll jump when it's ready. OK?
(jumpdrive cool-down)Engaging Jump Drive.
(jumpdrive success)Jump successful and all systems working, for now.
(engage boost to player)Boosting to your location.
(engage boost)Boosters engaged and making a hell of a row!
(follow)We're right behind you. Don't forget that!
(moveto)Yeah, we're moving, we're moving!
(moveto dock)Heading back to dock at last.
(docked)We're docked, how about some time off?
(task completed)It's done. I said it would be!
(confirm no change)Yeah, no change here. What did you expect?
(arrived)We're there.
(arrived)We've arrived.
(arrived at player)We've met up with you.
(arrived at player)We're in your area.
OK, OK. More bloody guard duty!
(greeting to player on boarding own station)So you're back onboard then.
(lost drones for current task)Guess what? No drones. Now what?
(task start but low on drones)Well our last remaining drones will do what they can.
(no drones to start task)No drones here genius, go figure!
(restock request to player)More drones would be a good start, don't you think?
(request additional ships)Yes, we would certainly make good use of more ships if you provided them.(speaking patiently as if explaining to an idiot)
(received additional ship)At last! I'll set her to work.
No, that is not going to work!(patiently as if to an idiot)
Stopping current operations, which were going so well ...(followed by incoherent grumblings)
Yes, we're wasting time now waiting for new instructions.
(Player loses licence)Mister Otani, we're relieved to release you from our licence agreement.
If you don't already know then I can't be bothered to remind you!
Our ship is trashed! Get us out of this mess!
(movement status)We can't move, so the ball's in your court!
Limping off to the shipyard. See you, suckers!
We're here at shipyard. What a dismal heap of scrap it is.
Our Jump Drive is broken. Guess what? It needs repairing.
We'll jump when it works again. Sheesh!
We're at the shipyard and twiddling our thumbs!
Our engine is useless until some grease-monkey fixes it.
Being short of a tow, we'll move when the engine works again!
Emergency jump initiated. Let's see where we end up this time!
Emergency jump worked. Are we just to sit here doing nothing?
We're getting away from here.
Well we're not where we were any more, are we? So what now?
We won't get there with the fuel we've got.
Our fuel isn't enough to get there in one go.
Off to the depot to get fuel Someone should've thought of that earlier!
Fly slow, get fuel, jump. How can I stand the excitement?
We're out of fuel. Send a tanker, and tell them to bring some beers too!
Not enough fuel even to get to the fuel station. Great planning there!
No fuel to jump. Trying to jump using generator only, but we know how well that usually turns out!
I hate forced jumps, the generator grinds and showers sparks!
Yes, yes. I'll go there just as soon as I have enough fuel to do so!
(Hired Architect)Yes, I'm an Architect. I build things!
(Asked how to get building resources)We need resources for construction. Now, how do you propose to let us handle that?(patiently)
Finally! We've enough to start. Let's do this if you're sure. No money back after this point.
That module's done. Shall we wait here all day, or do you want another?
After more than enough delays, here is your station.
Well, you chose the schedule. This is the next module due.
I only show the modules that will actually fit at the time. You get it?
This module? No doubts? You say go, and we get on with it.
Here's your choice. You choose it, we build it.
Architect again. Your station is nearly ready. You will soon require a Station Manager to run it.
You choose a station from the list and we make it happen.
(builder ship moving)Nothing happens until I get there you know!
(Ship builder)Do you want a new spaceship? I can fit you in now, if you want one.
This is the ship? Once we start, your money has gone.
Ship complete. It will cost you to leave it where it is.
Can't you see we're busy? Come back later when I've got more time.
Your ship will need a pilot. Get one here for when she completes or we charge you docking fees.
We build these ships, take them or leave them.
You haven't given us enough credits, yet. Duh!
(PC: You take care of it.)Finally! We now have the credits to be able to get on.
We do extensions. Some need others so they come in sets. Don't quibble!
Tell us what upgrade levels you want. We aren't mind-readers!
I get it, you want repairs. To what percentage level?
These modules will fit now. If you don't see it, then don't ask for it!
I can show you what resources I hold. Getting worried?
(architect)You'll get back the credits that I don't use. Did you think I was going to keep them?
(Initiate Trade)Done! We're on the way so don't waste our time!
(Receive)Ready to take on wares. Can we push this along?
(Deliver)Ready to finally get these wares off my ship and move out.
(Fail Space)I'd like to see you fit that into our full cargo bay!
(Fail Type)Nice one! We can't carry that type of ware 'cause they don't fit!
(Fail Space Standby)We'll just float here while you get your cargo space sums in order!
(Fail Buy Amount)They don't have enough! Say now, or I'll take what they have.
(Fail Sell Amount)They don't want it all. I'll dump what I can on them unless you've a bright idea first.
(Fail Buy Ware)Great! They don't sell that here! I'll try the next order if you can't come up with something!
(Fail Sell Ware)Good info. They don't want that stuff here! Moving on to the next trade - unless you have something else.
(Fail Buy Price)They've hiked up the price here. I'll buy it anyway if you don't stop me.
(Fail Sell Price)The selling price is awful here. I'll sell anyway unless you've a better plan.
(Fail)That trade is not going to work here. Come up with something else.
By some strange miracle, I've too many credits now. I'll transfer the surplus to you unless told otherwise.
Deal made. I'll tell you about it sometime.
We're there and starting to look for trade ... if there is any.
(fixed something)Well, say thanks!
(fixed something)It'll work, I said as much!
(fixed something)Well don't just gawp! Get it back into service!
(Initiate Mining)You tell us and we start mining.
(Launch)Launching collectors, off they go.
(Recall)Recalling collectors, we can't afford to waste them.
(Automatic)Commencing automatic operations, so we'll take a break!
(Fail Type)We don't fit that type of ware. Duh!
Our drones will pick up everything you tag - within reason.
Our drones will prioritise everything you tag. So do it right!
Our current lack of collector drones might be a problem, do ya think?
Our drones are collecting. I hope we aren't wasting them!
Mining terminated. We'll tag along while you work out what to do next.
Yes, I can't get any more in, so I'm on my way back.
(Squad member)Oh nice! I've just been told to drop my cargo.
It's the police.
It's just some random pilot who fancies his chances.
