Well? Do I do it or not?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
Getting bored waiting here!
(scan successful)Data received - analysing for best survival options.
We'll do it right there.
(not scanned)Due to your lack of foresight, just pick any spot.
(boarding pod launching)Here we go.
(boarding pod hit)Oh that helps! Damage already!
(marines under fire)Someone woke the defences!
(pod attached)Sawing hull, this one's a bitch!
(marine entering ship)Hull penetrated. Let's see what's waiting on the other side!
Team inserted and fanning out.
Keep looking around.
(marine on alert)Heads up!
(loud)Contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
Go to ground!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Get those bastards!
(lots of fighting noise)We're taking hits here!
(lots of fighting noise)Hold them for now!
(lots of fighting noise)Now! Turn the tables!
(lots of fighting noise)Pour it on!
(combat)Get up damn you!
(quiet)It seems far too quiet!
(assist mission successful)Don't let them get away. They're running!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Damn! There's a fully-manned defence here.
(assist mission successful)Sentries failing!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We'll do it the hard way!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)We're at an interface.
(marine hacking)Hacking the system.
(assist mission successful)Automated defences set to passive.
(assist mission failed/timed out)No joy - we'll have to overcome all these defences!
That's the self-destruct armed! Get it locked down!
(relieved)Self-destruct locked down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)No good - get off this ship, abort!
(boarding successful)We have command, let's count the cost.
We're no longer an effective force. Let's get out of here!
The hull can't take any more. Get to the pods before it vents!
We're in the pods and on our way back.
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)Damn that hurts!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Where'd that marine go?
Argh...(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Get a limpet on that hatch!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Neutralise that position!
(lots of fighting noise)Check the grills and ducts!
(checking for enemies)All clear.
(sound of laser fire)Turret Lasers!
Mobile force field ahead.
(assist mission successful)Force field taken out!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We need another way past the field.
The bridge is ours. The ship's under our control!(cheers)
They're giving up! The station's ours!(cheers)
That doesn't sound goo--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)Target under control! That was nasty while it lasted!
(upgrades)Upgrades fitted. I expect you want me back.
Downgrade complete. It's typical that I get that job! (stress 'I')
Upgrades installed and operational.
Which ship gets the upgrade?
Which upgrade do you want?
(*Hiring*)
You have someone doing my job. What now?
You have an Engineer on board. So?
You have a Marine Officer on board. Do we fight for the job?
Am I a replacement for them or did you put me in the wrong place?
You got me, warts and all!
I can do my part of this, I just hope you lot can!
(On board introduction)I just joined. The first to say 'make the coffee' gets a thumping!
(Fired in space)OK, I'll leave at the next station and find a worthwhile job.
(Fired on platform)I'm glad to be leaving too. I'll get a decent appointment instead!
(Assign to object)I'll move in now. I've a few things to sort out anyway.
(Assign to ship)I'm onboard. What a tub!
(Return to player)I'll be glad to get back.
(Leave player)Goodbye, Otani.
(Leave player)I'm off!
(Showing skills)Yes, of course I'm fully qualified. Otherwise we'd both be wasting our time.
(Showing skills)Of course I'm qualified, look at these. They're not just a note from my Mum you know!
(Orders)Some new target coordinates would be good.
(Sell ship)I sold that old heap of a ship, and got more than she was probably worth.
(Sell ship)I've gotten rid of that ship for you. The new owner seemed pleased enough, but was tight-fisted about paying much.
(respond to free mode)Well, that latitude was unexpected. It's quite gratifying though.
(respond to free mode)Sure, I like the freedom to decide things; it's how I work best.
(respond to restricted mode)Sure, you tell me when to nod!(annoyed)
(respond to restricted mode)Just don't expect me to carry the can for any decisions you make!(petulant)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Oh for ... Wake up!
(player attacks - friendly 2)I'll teach you some manners!
(player attacks - neutral 1)Are you off your rocker?
(player attacks - neutral 2)Was that necessary?
(player attacks - enemy 1)You've really made me see red!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)If you try that again we'll have your head served on a platter!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)We have a really tiny brig waiting for guy's who do that!
(big object attacked)Oh, just go away and annoy someone who cares!
(big object attacked)Oi, go and find an Argnu dung heap to buzz around!
(light fire 1)Yeah, I noticed!
(light fire 2)Someone heading for trouble here!
(mid fire 1)I don't suppose anyone cares that I'm taking fire here?
(mid fire 2)Someone rid me of this unwelcome stalker!
(heavy fire 1)Someone get here and prepare to pick me up!
(heavy fire 2)I'll be in the suit you'll see anytime now!
(heavy fire 3)Who said light-shows were pretty. This one hurts!
(station defence)Calling our so-called 'support'. Where the hell are you when we need you?
(station defence)Get here fast and do your jobs.
(station defence)In case you hadn't noticed, the home station that you're employed to defend is under attack!
(death 1)Aaarrrgghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(death 3)Aaarrrgghhh!
(shield warning 1)Shields pathetic!
(shield warning 2)Shields useless!
(hull warning 1)Hull taking a beating!
(hull warning 2)Hull giving way!
(Incoming Enemies)Right on cue, an ugly bunch!
(Incoming Wave).. and there's more!
(Last Wave)Do these ones and we'll get a rest, I think.
(Player Needed)Don't hurry! You'll hear my suit bounce off your hull when you finally get here!
(Success 1)Well that went against the odds! How did we survive that?
(Success 2)Well if they are beaten, that means we won. Why do I feel so sick then?
(Fail 1).. and that is called an 'epic fail'!
(Fail 2)Someone bring a tin-opener and get me out of this mangled heap!
(critical damage)I'm operating by memory alone here, nothing's working!
(critical damage)I don't have long before the power-core blows!
(Incoming Enemies)Enemies incoming, as if we didn't have enough problems already!
(Dangerous area)I said we shouldn't go here. Did anyone listen? No!
(Plead for life 1)OK, you win! I'll be your lapdog or whatever!
(Plead for life 2)I'm getting out of here! Go chase someone who wants to fight!
(Plead for life 3)You need me alive. I know stuff you need!
(Plead for life 4)Look, you can have what I've got with me! Everything!
(player instructions)Follow me, don't deviate!
Keep where you can see me.
(followers)We're on your tail.
Lead on. I hope you know where you're going!
We've been ready for ages now!
Ready for whatever gets thrown at us!
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)Get to your evacuation stations! I want to get out of here too!(urging)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)Look, are you in or out?
(General 2)How many times do I need to ask?
(Easy 1)Even you shouldn't mess this up!
(Easy 2)Like them easy, eh? I thought as much!(disdainful)
(Hard 1)I think you're bluffing me!
(Hard 2)If I had any choice, you wouldn't be it!
(Fight Easy 1)Yeah, go play pew-pew and impress the locals.
(Fight Easy 2)If you use a missile for this, you've probably spent your reward!
(Fight Hard 1)You do a good line in patter, but deeds are what count here!
(Fight Hard 2)If I were a betting man, I'd bet on the other guy!
(Trade Easy 1)If you can work out how to open your cargo bay, you'll do OK this time.
(Trade Easy 2)Even a numpty like you can do this without looking silly.
(Trade Hard 1)I need a top-line haulier for this. Have you seen one recently?
(Trade Hard 2)See that sign? It says 'No Time-Wasters'.
(Acceptance Query 1)So?
(Acceptance Query 2).. and your intention is?
(Accept 1)Well, at least I don't have to go looking again!
(Accept 2)So what are you still doing here?
(Reluctant 1)So get on with it then! As if I had a choice!
(Reluctant 2)I feel like I'm about to make a really stupid mistake!
(Reject 1)Nah. I'd be cutting my own throat!
(Reject 2)No way! I'd rather lose this contract than lose everything else as well!
(Info 1)Your computer has everything you need to know, so don't ask me for any more.
(Info 2)The ship has the details. It looks smarter than you anyway.
(Success 1)Well that's a turn-up for the books. You actually did it!
(Success 2)I can use the money, but I really don't need the stress you gave me!
(Semi 1)Just as I expected. Mediocre!
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)Since I expected nothing more, I guess I have to be happy now.
(Fail 1)Well, that was true to form! I guess we're both looking for jobs now!
(Fail 2)Thanks for that total mess up. How come you came back?
(Credits 1)Much as it hurts, here's your credits.
(Reward 1)I hate giving a bonus. Here, take it before I change my mind!
(Client abort)That's a relief! The job's off, so I don't have to worry now.
(mission update)There's been a change in the plan. Try to be more flexible!
(mission update 2)Check your system for a job update. You can do that, right?
(Assassination Offer 1)I need a hatchet job! No, you don't have to use an axe!
(Assassination Offer 2)I want a hologram of this mark dying! Clear?
(Target)How droll! They sent a puppy after an attack-dog.
(Target 2)You are out-classed and out-gunned! Unfortunately, you are also stupid!
(Bribe 1)Whatever you are being paid, I'll top it - if you don't top me!
(Success)Did you use a bit of overkill?!
(Fail)Why am I unsurprised? You lost the mark and they escaped. Gosh!
(Fail by bribe)You no doubt took a bribe! Unless I see evidence of a kill, I'll assume the mark is alive.
(Protect Station Offer 1)You help us and I'll see you get the credit for any kills. Only kill the ones attacking the station mind!
(Protect Station Offer 2)Our station defences usually cope. Unfortunately they're all in deep maintenance!
(Protect Ship Offer 1)Get over here! We'll pay well for raider kills - if we survive!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Raiders providing excellent bounty opportunities! See me to my destination to receive a big bonus.
(Police 1)We know smugglers are due through here. Get amongst the traffic and scan them. Report any contraband.
(Success 1)Adequate. You'll get your money and we'll get endless paperwork for their trials!
(Semi 1)So, nothing! Did you scan asteroids by mistake? Oh well, we'll cover your fuel.
(Fail 1)We know they were there. Were you sight-seeing or did someone pay you to look away?
(Passenger Offer 1)I need a ship for a journey and you need a job. Simple enough?
(Passenger Offer 2)I need to get somewhere. My money says you are going there too. Correct?
(On Board)I'm onboard. Don't you ever clean up back here?
(Space)Are you thinking of towing a life-pod? There's no room in there!
(Late)Had you hoped I'd died of boredom by now? When do we get there?
(Fail)What a disaster! Just let me off at the next stop.
(Assigned to platform)I'll move in just as soon as someone clears out the rubbish!
(Sell Ware Offer 1)Get this freight to the destination and sold on time, and you get a cut.
(Return Ware Offer)Bring some stuff to us and we'll give you a reward.
(Late Sell)You do know there was a deadline for this sale?
(Late Return)If you don't get here soon with our goods, you'll be sorry!
(Fail Sell)The buyer has severed our contract. You really need to steer clear of us!
(Fail Return)Too late! Don't bother now; we'd only be saddled with the goods ourselves. So get lost!
(Emergency Offer)Get your ears on! We need help, right here, right now!
(Emergency Offer)If you can hear this then listen closely. I need your help.
(Emergency Offer)I know you can hear this! I'm talking to you! Get on over here and help out!
(station manager)Docking permitted.
I know you, don't I?
Mind you don't upset the locals.
We really don't want any trouble.
I'm glad you saw those raiders off. You survived too. I suppose you want payment now.
(Defence manager thanking player)Yeah, thanks Skunk. You helped out.
(Defence manager thanking player)OK, you did good Otani. Now we'll clear up the mess.
Payment for the raiders you killed was authorised - when we saw that you'd survived!
(trader introduction)Don't walk past! I have everything you need here.
(trader introduction)Do you have the credits for any of my things?
(trader introduction)I hope you're not another time-waster!
(trader introduction)I've the best stuff around. Anyone who says different is a liar!
(trader introduction)I sell better stuff than the rip-off merchants on the other stations!
(generic trader)What you see is what I've got.
(performing service)Yes, I'll be on it when you stop interfering.
I'm ready. Are you done?
(Confirm sale/handoff)Done. Well someone has been!
(Confirm agreement)Yes, I already agreed that.
(giving object or info){,1012}
(weapon/upgrade trader)I can squeeze these weapon-types onto your ship - somehow.
Ever hear that 'click, click' when you run out of ammo? Not many survive hearing that!
Only a skinflint saves on their ammo stocks - and skinflints don't survive long here!
I'll challenge anyone to best my quality and price!
Sure I'm expensive, I only sell the best!
A good choice, at last!
How many? Or should I try to guess?
Anything else I can show you? It's not like I have a family to go home to or anything!
Let's see how we can bend your ship around this masterpiece.
Let's get started on installation in your ship. Get the cutting torches!
There, all installed. Now that didn't hurt your 'Pride' a bit!
Take pride in your new improvements, or should that be improvements in your 'Pride'!
Your pride-and-joy has come through quite undamaged by the new fittings.
(Shady trader)Hey, you looking for something unusual, or are you just time-wasting?
I do 'special' cargo for special pilots who take a few risks. You get my drift?(special as in illegal)
Take as much as you want, but then it's your problem. I never met you before, got it?
(licence trader)Another upright citizen after a licence to benefit society? Hmm. Maybe, or maybe not.
These are the licences I trade in.
This licence is not a 'get out of gaol' card, nor does it make you into a real policeman!
I wonder what infamy I'm instigating by granting you this licence?
(deal confirmations)At last!
Good.
Eventually!
If you say so!
(accepting gift from player){,4300|4301|4302|4310}
I'm here. Now what?
I can wait, or I can go!
(emergency call)Get over here!
Get the wax out of your ears!
Mayday - that means 'Help me'!
Help by yesterday would be good!
(station contacting player)Station command to rather scruffy vessel.
Station command to Ren Otani.
(attacking allied object)Your actions here will not be tolerated.
Don't do that again!
You had to go and stir up trouble, didn't you?
That was unfortunate! Prepare for retaliation!
At least make it 'look' accidental!
Will we ignore that? Nope!
(player uncovered as enemy)Your true colours are exposed!
(station contacting law)Station command calling law enforcement.
Be advised, we are under sustained attack.
Some help would be good!
(police)Sure, we can assist. Stand by.
Join the queue buddy! We'll get round to it when we can.
(NPC request for help rejected)Did I just hear that?
(NPC request for help rejected)I don't believe it!
Report related to individual, Ren Otani.
Sending records about Ren Otani.
Records transmitted.
We have him on file.
Now him we know!
He's been on both sides of the law.
Data received.
Not her again!
We have that 'young lady' on our records.
Contacting law enforcement.
(Found discount)Take advantage of this discount here or it'd be a chance missed.
(Found discount)The special offer here is time-limited - it's valid until the trader gets bored!
(discount offer)If I offer anyone a deal then I expect them to listen!
(discount offer)Everyone gets a discount price here, some can't believe the prices!
(discount explanation)Someone got it wrong and over-ordered. They don't work here now.
(discount explanation)Our stock-buyer got the decimal in the wrong place.
(discount explanation)We had a muddled period while the boss and the accountant had a fling.
(player station manager)We have a problem. I suggest you need to address it.
(player station manager)We need you to sort out something that you've overlooked.
The station has stopped; it's useless now.
All station progress has stalled. What a waste of time!
Yeah, yeah! Sending the report now ...
Yes, we do need your attention and advice.
We've run out of resources. No resources, no work.
Resource stocks have run out. We're stuck without them.
(can also be used for ships)The cargo space is full up. Nothing else can fit in.
(can also be used for ships)Storage space is all used up and there's no room for anything else.
(architect)Now we need a manager.
(can also be used for ships)We can improve our operations if we do something like these.
(can also be used for ships)These things can help us become more effective.
(defence officer)We're taking damage here. Where are all the support ships?
Support units, where are you? Come and do your job!
(exchange wares)So, we've a transfer to do. Will you tell us the target, or do I pick one?
Which ware?
Transfer which ware exactly?
How much?
How many?
What number?
Eventually we got there! Starting transfer.
Right, transferring now. Too late to change your mind!
Is that consignment for cargo or to be installed for use?
I'm out of funding.
I'll use your account to make it up, unless you have another scheme in mind.
We can get going again now.
I need you to review my budget arrangements, don't waste any time getting back to me.
Budget revised.
When we get there, I'll start thinking about the operation!(stress 'When')
(rejecting impossible mode order)No, no, no, and again, no!
Do you intend to tell us what our job there will be?
A destination would be useful.
We're off to the destination given. I hope it's the right one!
Well now we're there.
Operation in progress.
Joint operation in progress.
(Witness)I can identify you for that crime! I know what I saw!
(Witness threatened or bribed)OK, OK! You're the boss now. I'll use your version of events instead.
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)You have no clue what pulls my strings!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)Sure I've heard of you. You're a big-shot just now. (#gesticulate01#)I guess it doesn't hurt to be seen with you.
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)Yeah, I know what you did. (#gesticulate01#)You being seen with me could be good for business.
So, do I do this single-handed, or do I take the other ships I've got as well?
(Pilot sold his ship)If you're not offering me another job, then I'll go and find something useful to do.
(new assignment)So after settling me in here, you want me there?
If you want to keep an eye on me, then I'll come and join you!
Why didn't you just say 'Come here' and save time for both of us?
Either give me a job, or I'll pack up everything and come and haunt you!
(Manager)You said something about a ship for me?
(Manager)So I take over and carry on as before? OK, I can do that.
(NPC already assigned to job)You've forgotten what I do? Here's a reminder.
(Player scanned)Look, we do this all day and we've heard all the jokes and moans you could ever dream up!
(Player scanned)Just let it happen. I don't like doing this any more than you like having it done to you.
(Player scanned - aggressive)I really hope we find something sweet, or I tend to get twitchy!
(Player scanned - aggressive)Every comedian we meet thinks they know how to fool our scans!
(nothing found)Your ship's clean. Move on now.
(nothing found)That's all done. Nothing to report. Let's go find another target.
(nothing found - aggressive)Gah! I hate time-wasters. Go annoy someone else!
(nothing found - aggressive)Hmm, so not this time then. I'll be watching next time!
(contraband found - police)This is the police, you know what we found so don't try to deny it!
(contraband found - police)I hate paperwork and you just created a load for me. You'd better behave from now on.
(drop instruction)Just dump the illegal stuff or I'll get even more annoyed!
(pirate plundering)Well, it's not really that much but it'll do for today.
(pirate plundering)Well, that's unimpressive, yes it's illegal, but still unimpressive.
(drop instruction)Drop some of that stuff and then we'll decide what to do about you.
(dropped)That's a really good choice, given the alternative outcome!
(dropped)Smart. Get yourself out of here before we get bored.
(dropped part)If you think that little lot will please us, then you're dead wrong!(stress 'dead')
(dropped part)Are you trying to funny? Be warned, I've got no sense of humour.
(#scratchhead01#)How did you know I wanted to hear that?
If I had your voice-control, I'd be a holo-actor!
(#rolleyes01#)Have you considered public-speaking as a profession?
(#nod01#)That is just so similar to my own thoughts. We might be related!
(#nod01#)You have a good line in patter! It's almost convincing.
(#punchhand01#)At last! Someone both clever and innocent!
(#nod01#)You're on the right track there, maybe. Carry on.
(#gesticulate04#)Keep this up and we'll end up drinking partners!
I'd like you to continue, (#shrug01#)perhaps with a bit more brevity though.
(#crossarms01#)I'm waiting for your final conclusions on this.
(#thinking01#)That's interesting, but not as I understood it.
(#rolleyes02#)Well it's nice to hear the other side of a debate - sometimes.
(#cold#)I'm afraid that just doesn't cut it with me.
(#cold#)I really don't see, nor care, how you came to that view.
(#excuse#)I'd really like us to get this over with soon.
(#disapproval01#)We don't seem to have much common ground here.
(#angry#)I think you're just trying to wind me up!
(#disapproval01#)If that was joke, it wasn't at all funny!
(#hard#)I really don't need to hear any more of this rubbish!
(#angry#)Let's call it quits before it gets physical!
(smalltalk reward introduction)We got on rather well. (#smile#)That's quite unusual for me!
(smalltalk reward introduction)I don't normally enjoy chatting with customers. (#smile#)You are an exception.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)As a favour, I can share knowledge of a station doing a really sweet deal just now.
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)I know a person who needs a job. Their credentials are good but their advertising is hopeless.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)I have a top professional on my books who is after an employment contract. Interested?
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)Stretch to some trade now and I'll make it really worth your while.
(#disapproval01#)Gimme a break! Those scaly green scumbags are everywhere!
(#angry#)Who rattled your cage? I'm entitled to my own view.
(#disapproval01#)A minority might not be obsessed with money but they're still green and ugly!
It's not just about the looks. (#crossarms01#)Those freaks are shady to the core!
(#shrug01#)They're lizards. Their speech impediment is caused by having those long tongues in the way.
(#excuse#)I may not know them very well but I don't really need to. Let people talk.(indifferent)
(#angry#)Now you're just being stupid. Get outta here!
OK, (#shrug01#)but one noble lizard doesn't make them all that way... you'll have to do better than that.
(#hard#)Utter insanity! (#rolleyes01#)What would possess them to research Xenon tech?
(#facepalm01#)Researching Xenon tech will cause nothing but problems for them. I'm glad I'm out of it now.
(#nod01#)Used to be, yeah. I wouldn't call this newest enterprise criminal, but it's certainly not for the good of the public either.
I suspected as much. (#shrug01#)No prizes for guessing who their main customer is.
(#gesticulate04#)War? What is it good for? Absolutely nothing, I'd say.
(#disapproval01#)I suppose you're going to tell me anyway, so go right ahead.
(#sad#)Let's just hope it's not a pyrrhic victory, eh?
Speak for yourself. (#crossarms01#)I'm going to get ready to be somewhere else, if I can help it.
That would be handy, (#rolleyes02#)if I actually owned a ship and had the slightest inclination to get involved.
Yeah, please don't include me in your death plans... (#cold#)I plan to die of old age! Now get out of my sight!
(#nod01#)Yeah, that sounds like a plan. Better to be far away from such unpleasantness.
(#disapproval01#)Gimme a break! Why are we teased with this stuff all the time!?
(#gesticulate01#)Yeah, but not just them - the whole VR thing.
(#shrug01#)All this virtual decoration just makes you desperate for something real.
Potential, maybe. (#shrug01#)But there are far greater risks to humanity in my view.
Proxies? (#disapproval01#)Is our universe so bad that'd we have someone else live our lives while we pretend to have another?
(#nod01#)That's precisely my point. (#gesticulate03#)This tech has been abused since the get-go and there's no way back for it.
(#gesticulate02#)It doesn't take a wormhole scientist to realise how easily that could happen. People need to stay anchored in reality and maintain perspective.
(#disapproval01#)Plutarch really plumbed new depths!
(#shrug01#)Just snippets, yeah. What did you get?
You're kidding me? (#nod01#)Good going. Tell me more.
(#disapproval01#)It goes to show how arrogant they are, that they think they could conceal this for so long.
That's pretty grizzly stuff there. (#scratchhead01#)Are you 100 percent sure? Need I ask?
As long as the evidence is authentic, (#nod01#)I suppose it doesn't really matter who the source is.
(#punchhand01#)Mark up one for the little guy. It's about time someone brought PMC down a notch or two.
(#angry#)Not important?(outrage) You fool. Get out of here!(disgusted)
(#cold#)Prepare for the end! The Xenon are here!
Not without good reason! (#excuse#)Have you seen what the bad robots do to good people?
Let them keep swatting. (#gesticulate03#)Just as long as they keep the Xenon away from here!
(#shrug01#)Sometimes it's one step forward, two steps back, I guess. We won't give up.
(#crossarms01#)Weapons are no good to me, if I don't have a ship!
(#sad#)You can't imagine the troubles we've lived through in recent years.
Where have you been hiding? (#angry#)Take a look around then dare ask me again.
(#nod01#)You're not wrong there. Albion seems to have had a party in comparison.
(#nod01#)It was no picnic, that much is certain. (#sad#)A lot of very, very unpleasant things happened and many more sacrifices made.
(#shrug01#)If I told you the reality was much worse, you'd understand why people are liberal in their recollection of events.
Believe the stories or don't. (#crossarms01#)All I know for sure is that they are based on very real events. We can't escape that past.
A large number of us were sent from Terra to mine rocks. (#hard#)Not much to show for years of toil but these rocks.(bitter)
Just put yourself in my place for a second. (#cold#)It's not easy to put the past behind you while the scars are still healing.
(#facepalm01#)Rumours are rumours, Reivers are real. Do you understand?
Remind me next time they raid to stop one and ask him about that. (#rolleyes02#)I'm sure he won't mind.(intense sarcasm)

page.title: Argon NPC Female 3 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[argon] [terran] female basic(cheerful)
(greeting friendly)Hiya.
(greeting neutral)I'm all yours, buddy.
(greeting enemy)I'll give you two minutes, and no more!
(greeting rejected)Sorry, no time to chat!
(greeting service)I am so excited to be helping!
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)You all have a nice day!
(goodbye neutral)Good luck.
(goodbye enemy)I'll be keeping an eye out!
(goodbye rejected)I've heard enough!
(goodbye service)I'm so glad I could help.
(ship scanned - complicit)Do you think my bum looks big?
(ship scanned - neutral)Hey, are you checking out my bottom?
(ship scanned - illegal)Naughty, naughty!
(ship scanned - enemy)Hey, a girl's got to have some secrets!
(ship scanned - confident)I'll just wait here for you to say 'Sorry'.
(ship scanned - possessing)Look, that's just a side-deal. Want me to cut you in?
(station/capship scanned - complicit)Do you think this uniform suits me?
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Hey, it's a peeping-tom!
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Let's hear the excuse - scanner malfunction maybe?
(station/capship scanned - enemy)While you're at it, check out my targeting!
(station/capship scanned - confident)Feel free. Just don't tell anyone about the state of the house-keeping!
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Well you've got life-experience. Never bent the law yourself?
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)No matter how hard I search them, they always find a way to smuggle stuff on board!
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)I thought the loading crew looked a bit shifty - and too well-paid!
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)Look ... err .. we ... um ... Oh, damn!
(directions - location not known)It's .. it's .. No, sorry, it's gone.
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Funny! What's the next joke. 'Open the hatches'?
(surrender - hostile)Normally, I'd drop you a few warheads! Guided of course!
(surrender - complicit)OK. Let's do this calmly and carefully and no-one gets hurt!
(drops cargo 1)Check out the loot I dropped. I'll let you get on!
(drops cargo 2)Here's something for you. You pick that up and let me go on.
(bail from ship 1)I'm on my way out! Watch out when using the port thruster, it's temperamental!
(bail from ship 2)Ejecting! My ship deserves better than you, but we've no choice!
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)How nice to speak with you, Sir.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)At last we meet, Sir.
(hired comm greeting 2)Hello Sir. Can I help you?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Hello Sir. My, you're a fine one!
(hired comm goodbye 1)See you later.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)So long for now, Sir.
It was good to talk.
I'm delighted we spoke.
(join squad)In your squad now, Sir. Looking forward to this!
(leave squad)Leaving squad. I wish them well!
(accept order 1)Be sure of it, Sir.
(accept order 2)That's a given!
(reject order 1)Sorry Sir, that's a bit beyond me!
(reject order 2)I can't do it that way, Sir.
(Automatic)Automatic operations are a go!
(standby)Naturally. I'll wait here for further instructions.
Affirmative.
Understood.
Negative.
(jumpdrive charging)Jumping any time now.
(jumpdrive aborted)Jump cancelled!
(jumpdrive engaged)Jump imminent.
(jumpdrive emergency)Emergency jump engaged!
(jumpdrive cool-down)We have to wait for the Jump Drive to recharge.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Jump Drive cycling.
(jumpdrive success)We've jumped and all systems are in the green.
(engage boost to player)We're boosting to meet up with you.
(engage boost)Boosters online.
(follow)On your six, Sir.
(moveto)Moving to location.
(moveto dock)Moving to dock.
(docked)Successfully docked.
(task completed)Task finished, Sir.
(confirm no change)We'll continue as planned.
(arrived)We're here now, Sir.
(arrived)We've arrived safe and sound.
(arrived at player)We're glad to be back with you.
(arrived at player)It's great to be back in your company.
Got that, Sir. We'll guard our area.
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Sir, we're ecstatic to have you aboard.
(lost drones for current task)I would, but I'm fresh out of drones for that.
(task start but low on drones)Be advised that we have few drones left so this may take a while.
(no drones to start task)I'd love to, but we don't have the drones to do that.
(restock request to player)We're out of drones. I need some more of those little fellows!
(request additional ships)We could certainly use some more ships.
(received additional ship)Outstanding! We'll make the best use of her here.
That doesn't gel with our current role, Sir.
OK, we'll end the current operations here.
We're looking forward to our new task.
(Player loses licence)Mister Otani, you have lost the right to hold our licence.
You'll fully understand our reasons, of course.
We took some severe damage there. We need instructions, but we'll get through this!
(movement status)We're stuck here without power! Please send someone to help
We're heading for the nearest shipyard. I can't wait to visit a proper girl's rest-room!
Docked at the shipyard. They can have the ship for repairs, and we can have a decent meal!
Our Jump Drive was knocked about. We need assistance to get it going or replace it.
We'll jump as soon as we can. I don't like sitting here much either!
We've docked at the shipyard and await your orders. Nice to have a shower in privacy!
Our engine is dead and we aren't going anywhere soon. Got any good vids?
We'll catch up when the engine is repaired. Meanwhile, those vids were rubbish!
We're doing an emergency jump. We'll be sure to let you know if or when we arrive!
Yes! Emergency jump successful - it's so peaceful. What next, boss.
.. and we're away.
We've relocated and await our next orders with interest.
Sorry. Our fuel can't stretch to a jump that far, no matter how hard we try.
Extra fuel is needed for that length of jump.
Heading to the nearest fuel depot. Any shopping lists from the rest of you?
We'll refuel and then jump to where you want us. Not many other options really!
A fuel tanker would be a really pretty sight just now; we've no fuel for jumps otherwise!
We can't even get to the fuel station with what we have. We need resupply or a tug!
We'll attempt a jump on generator power alone. I hope this works and we don't end up in Limbo!
If we crank up the generator we can try to force a jump using that. We'll see how far we get. Wish us luck!
We'll need to top up with fuel before making that kind of journey.
(Hired Architect)Hello Sir, Architect speaking. I've many great ideas for you.
(Asked how to get building resources)We need to get some construction resources in place first. How do you wish me to deal with that?
Check that this is the right spot for your station. When you confirm, Sir, we'll start the work and there'll be no going-back.
That module is ready. Which one do you want next?
You should be proud of your newly-completed station!
According to your schedule, this module should be next, Sir.
The modules you can add are determined by current build progress. This is what you may add.
This module, positive? Last chance to change your mind!
That's impressive! Construction will now commence.
Hello Sir, Architect speaking. Now would be a good time to find a Station Manager for your new station and bring them to the site.
We have a fine catalogue of station models. Here are the ones we can build for you.
(builder ship moving)Moving to the building site to start work.
(Ship builder)Hello Sir, I'd bet you could use another spaceship. Why not review what we have?
We have sufficient materials for your ship now. Please confirm you want this model and we'll get busy. No refunds after that!
Your ship is finished, Sir. What a fine vessel!
I'm awfully sorry, but we're fully booked. There should be some slots available soon though. Please come back later and we'll see.
Hello Sir, Concerning your fine ship in progress; she will be needing a skilled pilot. Do you have anyone available or in mind?

(#shrug01#)Well I definitely wouldn't consider myself in that way... it must have been way before my time there.
As I thought. (#crossarms01#)It wouldn't take a big leap of logic to deduce who their primary customer is.
(#rolleyes01#)So are we going to be embroiled in another conflict?
(#disapproval01#)Other than that people will be killed and their homes destroyed? Go on, this should be funny...
(#shrug01#)If that's the case, then I've nothing to worry about, right? (#rolleyes01#)Oh, apart from all those dead people.
Oh, I didn't realise this was a recruitment interview. You want me, personally, to get ready? (#laugh#)That's funny!(chuckles)
(#excuse#)There's the thing. No ship, see. Sorry about that.
(#angry#)If you think that I'm going to go getting myself killed in your war, think again. We're done here!
Nice that you're thinking of the safety of a lady. (#rolleyes01#)Don't forget to run away yourself, if you get scared! (cheeky)
(#scratchhead01#)It boggles the mind to think that these highways weren't here forty years ago.
(#nod01#)I know, right. It's like a phoenix rising from the flames. (#punchhand01#)The pace of development is astounding.
(#smile#)Yeah, beacons are a great idea. (#laugh#)I just hope someone's ship doesn't break down before it can clear the area of the beacon!
(#thinking01#)Oh, I really wasn't aware they had to use extra fuel for that in the past. That's good to know, thanks!
Well, the aggregation process actually begins in the charging chamber... (#laugh#)bwahaha! (hearty laugh) Who am I kidding? I don't have a clue!

page.title: Argon NPC Female 4 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[argon] [terran] female basic(grumpy)
(greeting friendly)Now what?
(greeting neutral)I don't have all day!
(greeting enemy)Spit it out!
(greeting rejected)Go boil your head!
(greeting service)Let me guess, you want something!
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)Signing off.
(goodbye neutral)Nice chat - Not!
(goodbye enemy)Let's hope that's the end of it!
(goodbye rejected)Hope you rot!
(goodbye service)Crawl back when you need something else!
(ship scanned - compliant)Hurry up! I do have a life to lead.
(ship scanned - neutral)If I minded, would it make any difference?
(ship scanned - illegal)Just great! A law-breaking busy-body!
(ship scanned - enemy)Are we going somewhere unpleasant with all this?
(ship scanned - confident)While you waste your time, I'll catch up on paperwork!
(ship scanned - possessing)Oh just go away. Like I care what you found!
(station/capship scanned - compliant)Just keep your scanner off the sanitation cubicle!
(station/capship scanned - neutral)One day, that long nose of yours will get bitten off!
(station/capship scanned - illegal)I love it when the cops roast the nosey guys!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)Yeah well that does it! Now you're in for it!
(station/capship scanned - confident)I guess you've got power to waste then!
(station/capship scanned - possessing)You really expect me to worry about what the crew bring on?
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)(annoyed)I paid a fortune for that, I'm not spacing it for anyone!
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)All right, name your price for playing dumb!
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)The licence is at the destination; the client said so when we made the deal!
(directions - location not known)What am I, a mobile map-store?
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Oh yeah? You and whose fleet?!
(surrender - hostile)If I had any choice in this, you'd be toast now!
(surrender - compliant)Go on, get on with the looting!
(drops cargo 1)Take this instead. Don't you worry that I'll have to make good for it!
(drops cargo 2)Take this and be satisfied!
(bail from ship 1)I'm going, I'm going. Give it a rest now!
(bail from ship 2)I've had enough! Take the old argnu!
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)You call the shots, right?
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)Right, what do I have to do?
(hired comm greeting 2)You're my boss, right?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)You asked for me?
(hired comm goodbye 1)On it.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)Are we done?
Something for me?
I guess this can't wait?
(join squad)Don't panic, boys. I'm here now.
(leave squad)Don't miss me too much!
(accept order 1)Fair enough.
(accept order 2)I suppose so.
(reject order 1)That isn't going to happen.
(reject order 2)Amusing! So what's the real job?
(Automatic)Yes, I've pushed the button marked 'Automatic'.
(standby)You're the one paying for me to hang around!
Yes.
Acknowledged.
No.
(jumpdrive charging)We'll jump when this thing decides it can!
(jumpdrive aborted) Jump cancelled! (then muttering)Jump, don't jump!
(jumpdrive engaged)jumping, hopefully!
(jumpdrive emergency)Emergency jump engaged and counting!
(jumpdrive cool-down)I'll jump when the system lets me. OK?
(jumpdrive cool-down)Jump Drive still cooling.
(jumpdrive success)We've jumped and, somehow, everything still works.
(engage boost to player)Now boosting to you.
(engage boost)Boosters, err, boosting.
(follow)We'll follow you. Don't brake too hard without warning!
(moveto)Moving off, at last!
(moveto dock)Moving to the dock. I hope they're expecting us!
(docked)We're docked now and hoping for some time off.
(task completed)I said it would get done!
(confirm no change)No change here. I'd tell you if there was!
(arrived)We're here.
(arrived)We're here at last.
(arrived at player)We're behind you.
(arrived at player)We're alongside.
Sure. On guard duty, again!(muttering follows)
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Sir is now aboard.
(lost drones for current task)Well, we could go out in suits I suppose. There are no drones here!
(task start but low on drones)We'll use the few drones we have, but this will be slow and boring!
(no drones to start task)Sure, just find us the drones and we'll be all over it.
(restock request to player)At the risk of being obvious, some more drones would be handy.
(request additional ships)I keep asking for more ships for this job.
(received additional ship)At last, she's something at least.
That contradicts your previous orders to us.
(Sigh)Stopping what we're doing.
Yes? ... and the new orders are ..?
(Player loses licence)Mister, you lose your licence and any goodwill we ever had.
Don't play the innocent with me!
Our ship looks like a scrapheap, we're going need a lot of help here!
(movement status)We can't move, so something will have to come to us!
We'll get to the shipyard. Probably by next year at this speed!
The shipyard is pleased to see us. We've four assessors here, all tutting and frowning!
We'll need a lot of repairs before we can jump again.
Yes, we'll jump as soon as it works again.
We're stuck at the shipyard with nothing to do but enjoy the hammering and smell of burning!
Our engine is broken and we're a bit challenged in the movement department!
Yeah, that's logical! We'll move when we have the means to move again!
Here we go. Emergency jump engaged. This will be ... dramatic!
Well we jumped and we are ... somewhere else. I'll get back to you on that
We're leaving. Don't get tearful over it!
Well, we're out of the Zone. Would you like to expand on our orders now?
We won't get there on the fuel we have now.
That's far too far given our fuel reserves.
Off to get fuel. Better late than never, I suppose.
We'll go and buy more fuel and then complete the jump. See you all whenever!
We running dry on fuel! Now would be a good time to magic up a fuel tanker.
Through masterful planning, we don't even have enough fuel to get to the fuel station!
As we're out of fuel, we'll try a jump on generator alone. This is not a good idea!
We'll try to force a jump using ship power. I hope the other systems can take the strain!
Well, to get that far we'll need to stop off to get fuel. OK?
(Hired Architect)I can design and build you stuff, seeing as I'm the Architect!
(Asked how to get building resources)You know you'll need resources for building, right? I expect you'll want me to do all the running around after them?
We can start now with what we have. Make sure this is what you want as there's no chance to change your mind later.
If you've finished admiring your new module, would you like us to start another one?
Against all odds, your new station is now complete.
This it the next module you scheduled.
If I don't list a module here, you either can't have it or it won't fit yet.
This module next. Are you sure? Last chance to reconsider!
You pick one, we build it, you live with it!
Architect here. Now your station's nearly ready, you need to get moving on finding a Station Manager for it.
Tick the box and we get started on your station. Simple enough?
(builder ship moving)It helps if you let me get there to do the building!
(Ship builder)Yes, I build spaceships. The sign over my head is a dead give-away. Want one?
That's the ship you want? Be certain, we don't stop for rethinks!
Your ship is complete and is blocking up my production area.
Sure, I'll drop all my other customers and see to you. In your dreams! Come back when we have the spare capacity.
You'll be needing a pilot for your new ship soon. I've a brother looking for work, not that he's any good mind!
We build these types of ships. If you want different types you go somewhere else.
You haven't given me enough funding for that.
(PC: You take care of it.)Finally, we have enough funding committed to proceed.
Some of our extensions need others to work. You can't use one of them without the other. Get it?!
Ok, you want an upgrade. Shall I guess the level you want?
Of course we can repair it. You tell us the percentage you can afford!
We only offer you the modules that will fit. I we don't offer it, you can't fit it!
Trust me! I'm looking after your resources for you! See here for details.
(architect)What I don't spend will eventually get back to you. I expect a decent tip though!
(Initiate Trade)We're on our way. Make sure you come good on your side of the deal!
(Receive)Ready to take on wares.
(Deliver)Ready to out-load wares.
(Fail Space)We're already full! Where do expect me to stow that lot?
(Fail Type)I'd take it if I could, but the ship won't take that type of ware, dummy!
(Fail Space Standby)Take your time, I'm going nowhere while you work out the space needed!
(Fail Buy Amount)The amount for sale here doesn't match the order. I'll take all of it unless you stop me.
(Fail Sell Amount)They don't want everything. Tell me if this is a bad idea, but I'm going to sell what I can.
(Fail Buy Ware)Someone got it wrong! They don't sell what we need here, and I'm moving on unless you stop me.
(Fail Sell Ware)This isn't going well. They don't want any here! I'll get moving unless you've other ideas.
(Fail Buy Price)They are ripping us off here. I'll have to pay over the odds for anything I buy here. What now?
(Fail Sell Price)The cheap-skates here only offer a fraction of the price we want, Shall I sell anyway, or what?
(Fail)We can't do that trade, not now or here anyway. Where to now?
Do you want the extra cash I'm holding from our trades so far? I've no idea how we made so much!
Deal struck here. I fill you in shortly.
We've arrived and are looking for trade.
(fixed something)Of course it works now!
(fixed something)True to my word, as good as new ... well almost!
(fixed something)I didn't fix it just for you to admire it you know!
(Initiate Mining)Well start mining when you give the word.
(Launch)Collectors on the way. Don't forget they're out there!
(Recall)Recalling collectors. At least we get something back!
(Automatic)Automatic operations running. I guess we just became redundant here!
(Fail Type)We can't take that type of ware on board, silly!
The drones will collect what you tag, so be careful where you point and click!
Our drones will prioritise everything you tag. Don't tag a drone; it looks amusing but wastes time!
Since we have no collector drones, that shouldn't keep us busy for long!
Collection in progress. Let's hope our drones all come home afterwards.
Mining operations have ended. We'll just follow along now, if that's OK with you.
We're full up and returning to you.
(Squad member)I've just been hailed and told to drop my cargo!
It was a police interceptor.
It was some Pilot who is not playing at all nice.
So do I do it, or not?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
I wondered when we would get the go.
(scan successful)That data will help us pick the best spot to land and cut.
The data shows that to be the best place to go for.
(not scanned)We may as well pick any place you fancy, without any scanner data.
(boarding pod launching)We're on the way.
(boarding pod hit)We're taking some damage here!
(marines under fire)Who stirred up this hornets' nest?
(pod attached)We're grinding metal. This hull's a tough one!
(marine entering ship)We're through the hull. Let's see what surprises they've got for us!
Team onboard and securing the area.
Sensors on scan-and-track!
(marine on alert)Targets located ahead!
(loud)Contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
Break them up!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Let them have it!
(lots of fighting noise)They're kicking back! We're getting hurt!
(lots of fighting noise)Easy! Let them into the kill-zones!
(lots of fighting noise)Now blow them away!
(lots of fighting noise)Keep up your fire!
(combat)Don't stop now!
(quiet)I don't like it. It must be a trap!
(assist mission successful)They're demoralised! Follow them as they run.
(assist mission failed/timed out)That didn't help. They're still here in strength!
(assist mission successful)Sentry-bots deactivating!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We're stuck with them! Blast those bots away!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)We're at command console.
(marine hacking)Hacking into security.
(assist mission successful)Automated defences deactivated. Phew!
(assist mission failed/timed out)That failed! We'll have to take out the defences as well!
Now the self-destruct too? Lock it down or we fry!
(relieved)Self-destruct locked down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Abort - we can't stop the count-down! Get to the pods!
(boarding successful)We're in control and mopping up. I can't see there being any more problems.
We not enough to take her now. Pull back to the pods!
The hull's giving out. Get to the pods before we get spaced!
We're back in the pods and setting back for home.
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)My suit's failing!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Damn, another marine down!
Argh...(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Open that hatch with a cutting charge!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Get rid of that sniper!
(lots of fighting noise)Clear that corridor!
(checking for enemies)No movement here.
(sound of laser fire)Auto-weapon turrets!
Force field deployed ahead.
(assist mission successful)Force field disengaged!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We need a different way to get around the force field.
We've taken all the key stations in the ship. She's ours!(cheers)
They've thrown down their weapons. The station is ours now!(cheers)
We won't live through this --(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)We have control of the objective! We made it through!
(upgrades)We're on our way all suitably upgraded, as ordered.
We have been downgraded and are returning to next task! Just don't expect us to be happy about it!
Our upgrades all seem to be functional.
Tell me which ship to upgrade.
What upgrade do you want?
(*Hiring*)
You already have someone in my post. So?
You have an Engineer. What should I do?
You have a Marine Officer on board. Do we pick straws or something?
I suppose I could replace them. Is that wise when there may be other posts that need me?
For good or ill, I'm what you've got now!
There's no doubt of my competence, what about the rest of you?
(On board introduction)I've just reported here. I don't do coffee, dirty jobs or errands!
(Fired in space)OK, At the next station, I'll move on and look for something sensible to do.
(Fired on platform)I'll leave right now and go a find a decent employer!
(Assign to object)I'll get settled in there. I'll soon lick them into shape!
(Assign to ship)I'm here. You wouldn't believe how much she needs my help!
(Return to player)Returning. I wish someone would make their minds up!
(Leave player)Goodbye, Otani.
(Leave player)Goodbye.
(Showing skills)Of course I'm qualified or I wouldn't still be here.
(Showing skills)Well my credentials seem to impress others, even if they don't impress you!
(Orders)An update of target coordinates would be really handy!
(Sell ship)I sold that tub for a bit over what she was worth. I found a really stupid buyer.
(Sell ship)The buyer for your ship knew his stuff. I got what I could. It's tough if it doesn't seem like much!
(respond to free mode)Well, I didn't expect that. You boss types normally like to dabble too much!
(respond to free mode)How unusual! I expected you to want to micro-manage everything, even though I can do a better job of it!
(respond to restricted mode)Sure, you micro-manage everything and I'll agree with you - in public!(mildly sarcastic)
(respond to restricted mode)Yeah whatever. You call the shots and I'll run messages.(resignation)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Are you dreaming or something?
(player attacks - friendly 2)Round here, firing on a friend is considered bad manners!
(player attacks - neutral 1)Look, can we talk about your issues?
(player attacks - neutral 2)Why did you do that? What have I done to you?
(player attacks - enemy 1)I'm so totally going to swat you!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Our police officers have a phrase for that: 'Come quietly or we shoot!'
(Player attacks - police warning 2)If you want trouble, our police ships will oblige you!
(big object attacked)If you want to play, go and fetch your big brothers!
(big object attacked)Look if you just want to call attention to yourself, paint your ship pink or something!
(light fire 1)Someone knocking?
(light fire 2)I felt that!
(mid fire 1)Are the rest of you just going to watch while I get hit?
(mid fire 2)Someone rid me of this pesky assailant!
(heavy fire 1)I'll be needing a lift any time now!
(heavy fire 2)My dear old ship is falling apart under me!
(heavy fire 3)There's no way I can afford the repair bill anymore!
(station defence)Hey, defence ships. Come and earn your pay!
(station defence)The station needs you pilots to get moving and get over here.
(station defence)We have a problem with some attackers here. At least they knew how to get here!(stress 'they')
(death 1)Aaarrrgghhh!
(death 2)Nooooo!
(death 3)Aaarrrgghhh!
(shield warning 1)Shields non-existent!
(shield warning 2)Shields ineffective!
(hull warning 1)Hear that? That's hull stress!
(hull warning 2)The remaining hull won't take much of this!
(Incoming Enemies)Here they are! Let's play for keeps!
(Incoming Wave).. and another lot!
(Last Wave)Take out this last wave and we could be home and dry!
(Player Needed)You were meant to be keeping them off me!
(Success 1)Well we won this one! Can we afford the price of victory though?
(Success 2)I think we beat them off. Suddenly I don't feel too well!
(Fail 1)What a complete shambles! How do we pick up the pieces now?
(Fail 2)I guess that means we're all alone and on the run now!
(critical damage)My ship's not responding to commands. Get me out of here!
(critical damage)I've a panel full of red warning lights and not much else here!
(Incoming Enemies)Hostiles closing fast.
(Dangerous area)If I had a choice, I wouldn't be anywhere near this place!
(Plead for life 1)OK, you say 'Jump' and I ask 'How high'!
(Plead for life 2)I've given in. Stop shooting damn you!
(Plead for life 3)Listen, I know a secret cache of loot that I can share - if I'm alive!
(Plead for life 4)I'll pay or do anything. Just let me live!
(player instructions)Stay right behind me!
Make it close.
(followers)We're looking after your six.
We'll follow you, perhaps just out of curiosity!
Can we move off now?
We're ready, but what about you?
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)Get to the lifeboats and pods. Do not take any luggage.(neutral)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)Are you in, or do I have to read your mind?
(General 2)Are we doing this or not?
(Easy 1)I think even you can't make a mess of this one!
(Easy 2)A bit risk-averse are we? That's quite OK with me.
(Hard 1)This would be an unfortunate occasion to be bluffing!
(Hard 2)OK, so was that a sensible decision or just a chat-up line?
(Fight Easy 1)Yeah, the biggest risk from this job is if you collide with the target.
(Fight Easy 2)Don't waste too much fuel on this job as you might not cover the costs.
(Fight Hard 1)If you're as good as you say, why aren't you employing me?
(Fight Hard 2)Be careful the target doesn't claim a bounty on you instead!
(Trade Easy 1)Pick up freight, move, drop freight. Easy.
(Trade Easy 2)When you get there with the freight, don't look too embarrassed at taking the money!
(Trade Hard 1)I need the best traders for this job. So why are you here?
(Trade Hard 2)My mother said I always had a soft-spot for incompetents and underdogs!
(Acceptance Query 1).. and your answer is?
(Acceptance Query 2)Was that a 'Yes'?
(Accept 1)It's yours. Don't make me seem silly!
(Accept 2)Shouldn't you be off on a job for me?
(Reluctant 1)(Sigh)I just know I'm making a big mistake but ... OK, get on with it.
(Reluctant 2)I knew today would stress me out. I'll have to risk that you can do it.
(Reject 1)I don't think so. I'd need my head examined if I gave you the job!
(Reject 2)This is too important to waste it on a wannabe like you!
(Info 1)Everything you need is on your system, so don't hang around here!
(Info 2)Your computer has all the details of the job. It doesn't ask stupid questions either!
(Success 1)Well, I had written that one off. I was wrong, thankfully!
(Success 2)You did it, but I've aged years in the process!
(Semi 1)You've done exactly as well as I expected. Not that well!
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)I can't grumble too much, I've not lost anything at least.
(Fail 1)If you find another job. make sure it's with a rival of mine!
(Fail 2)Why come back? Did you want to rub in the failure some more?
(Credits 1)Here's your share of the reward.
(Reward 1)This bonus is for a job well done. I've no idea how you managed it.
(Client abort)The client has cancelled and we can all go home now.
(mission update)There's a light flashing on your system, It means the job details have been updated.
(mission update 2)Read the update on your briefing. That's right, you need to change your plans.
(Assassination Offer 1)I want a liquidation done. No, not a business account, a person!
(Assassination Offer 2)I want to see and hear this person do an abrupt exit ... from life!
(Target)Remarkable! This idiot thinks he has a chance against me!
(Target 2)I'll give you one chance to back down. After that its curtains for you or me!
(Bribe 1)I can outbid whatever you're being paid - I've connections that guarantee the money and who might not like losing me either!
(Success)That was pretty final!
(Fail)Don't tell me, your navigation crashed and you couldn't find their location!
(Fail by bribe)I don't think you're telling the truth. I'll bet you think the mark will pay you for letting him go. You idiot!
(Protect Station Offer 1)Kill off the raiders attacking my station, and I'll pay you a bundle - if I'm still around!
(Protect Station Offer 2)We're a bit light on defences just now. Help defend the station from incoming raiders and we'll pay well!
(Protect Ship Offer 1)Watch our backs! If we get through and you kill any attackers, we'll make it worth your while.
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Beat off the raiders attacking my ship and we'll reward you handsomely for each kill.
(Police 1)Take your unmarked ship and scan all traffic for contraband. We know there are smugglers around here and we'll pay for information.
(Success 1)Well that seems a lot of contraband, more than we thought. We'll have our work cut out. Here's your payment.
(Semi 1)It seems you found their siesta-time. Oh well, here's some cash for expenses.
(Fail 1)Turn a blind eye did you, or were you hoping we'd pay you for just sleeping on the job?
(Passenger Offer 1)I have cash and need transport by ship, you have a ship and have expenses to meet. That seems destiny, yes?
(Passenger Offer 2)I need to get somewhere really badly, so badly that I'll pay a stupid fee to do it. Interested?
(On Board)I'm settled in back here. I wish you'd change the decor though!
(Space)I'll get in there just as soon as you throw some rubbish out to make room!
(Late)You won't get anything for keeping me as a ship's pet! Get a shift on!
(Fail)(Sigh) What a wash-out. Let me off and try to salvage something out of this mess.
(Assigned to platform)I'll move over to my new duty station. It had better not look like a rubbish dump!
(Sell Ware Offer 1)We pay well if you get the freight delivered and sold on time.
(Return Ware Offer)The right stuff brought here in time earns premium prices!
(Late Sell)The time limit was a deadline and not a mild suggestion, you know!
(Late Return)You're running out of time. Get here with those goods pretty soon, or else!
(Fail Sell)The buyer has imposed penalty charges. Don't show your face here again!
(Fail Return)You blew it. Keep the stuff, sell it or eject it. We couldn't care less now!
(Emergency Offer)We could do with some assistance now! There're credits here for those who help!
(Emergency Offer)Listen carefully, I will say this only once ...
(Emergency Offer)Don't just sit there listening. Get over here and help out!
(station manager)Docking approved.
Glad you could visit us. Keep out of trouble!
Good to see you, but mind your manners here.
We encourage sensible pilots coming to see us.
Here's your credits. I don't know if the station would have made it without your help.
(Defence manager thanking player)Yeah, you helped out I suppose!
(Defence manager thanking player)We would have made it through on our own eventually. Perhaps not as quickly.
Here's your money. With all the cheering going on in the station, I doubt you'll need to spend much here!
(trader introduction)Stop and chat. I'll make it worth your visit if you shop here.
(trader introduction)I buy and sell the best goods, if you have the means.
(trader introduction)Are you sure you can afford the quality stuff I deal in?
(trader introduction)See how ill my competitors look when they glance over here?
(trader introduction)I don't deal in anything I wouldn't use myself!
(generic trader)I have this stuff for offer.
(performing service)I'll be on it as soon as you stop chattering!
It's done..
(Confirm sale/handoff)That's a wrap!
(Confirm agreement)I think we've reached a deal.
(giving object or info){,1012}
(weapon/upgrade trader)We'll get that fitted to your ship, don't worry. Pass me that hammer.
Running out of ammo is never a joke!
Stock up on ammo here. This could be your last chance - literally!
If you can afford stuff like this, then we don't have to worry about small change, do we?
I put quality above all else. Not like some!
That's a sound decision, coming from you!
How many?
Are we done looking at stuff here?
We'll get that installed in your ship. Just give us a while. It's best not to watch though!
Right let's start installing this lot. Shouldn't take long, and they usually clean up after themselves.
That's all done. The installations really enhance the old Pride!
There, the Pride's looking good now. We didn't even scorch the paintwork!
Well, your 'Pride' is looking great now. Those new extensions could be life-savers someday!
(Shady trader)Oi! If you're not up for a bit of risk in avoiding the 'authorities' then move along!
I do a few lines that timid pilots won't touch! The money's good if you're brave enough.
How much do you want, and no more questions after that, eh?
(licence trader)I sell the licences. If you want one, you see me.
I can grant these licences - if I believe the customer's genuine.
The licence implies a bond of good behaviour from you. You won't keep the licence for long if you don't bear that in mind!
This licence comes with strings attached. Mind they don't end up strangling you!
(deal confirmations)That's agreed.
Signed and sealed.
We got there at last!
We can all agree to that.
(accepting gift from player){,4300|4310}
I'm waiting.
Do you still want me here?
(emergency call)Get here now!
Over here!
Make all speed getting here!
Don't stop for anything!
(station contacting player)Station command to odd-looking ship.
Station command to Ren Otani.
(attacking allied object)We do not tolerate unprovoked attacks in our space.
That was a very, very bad idea!
We don't like indiscriminate violence here!
You really know how to upset people, don't you!
You didn't even make the effort to look sorry for doing it!
That can't be overlooked. Prepare for the consequences!
(player uncovered as enemy)Your true intentions have been revealed!
(station contacting law)Station command calling police controller.
We're under significant attack!
Are you helping or not?
(police)We hear you. Police assets will be with you shortly.
Maybe later. We're kind of busy at the moment.
(NPC request for help rejected)What the hell?
(NPC request for help rejected)That's a joke, no?
Report related to individual, Ren Otani.
Report for Ren Otani on the way.
You should have the report now.
Yes, we know about him.
He's known to the police
He often skates around the law.
Report received.
We know her!
That is one criminal lady.
Contacting police controller.
(Found discount)This discount will not last long.
(Found discount)This is the best place to get a discount!
(discount offer)You get a special discount here because we like you!
(discount offer)Not everyone gets a discount here, so take it up quickly!
(discount explanation)We sometimes get ships delayed and several deliver the same goods at the same time.
(discount explanation)We sub-contracted to an ordering firm. They messed up and don't work for us now.
(discount explanation)We had a competition between production lines. One got a bit carried away.
(player station manager)We have another problem.
(player station manager)We need you to sort something out.
The station is completely stalled.
Station operation has all but ceased.
Here are the details ...
Send some useful advice ...
If we don't get more resources then we stop.
Our resources are running out, again.
(can also be used for ships)We're full up.
(can also be used for ships)We've no more storage space.
(architect)A manager is necessary.
(can also be used for ships)If you want to improve efficiency then consider these.
(can also be used for ships)Our effectiveness could be better. See these.
(defence officer)We're facing stiff opposition and could do with assistance.
We have enemies pushing against us and need urgent support!
(exchange wares)So who gets involved in the transfer?
Which ware gets transferred?
What ware does the transfer cover?
How much?
Amount??
Number?
Transfer operation running.
Transfer under way.
Do you want these transferred as wares into cargo, or to have them installed into the target?
I'm short of credits for this job.
I'll use your account to make the up the shortfall, unless you have a better idea.
Right, that's the credits sorted.
We have to talk about my budget. Get in contact soon.
Budget changes noted.
When I get there, then I'll worry about getting the operation started.(stress 'When' and 'then')
(rejecting impossible mode order)I'd have to be a magician to do that!
Assuming I get there, what am I supposed to do?
So, you have a destination for me?
Leaving for destination.
We're here.
Operation in progress.
We're starting joint operations.
(Witness)I have no doubt at all about what I saw.
(Witness threatened or bribed)Right! So maybe my eyes do play tricks on me sometimes!
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)Oh, give it a rest!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)OK, I've heard of you. (#shrug01#)I guess you rate special treatment!(sounds surprised at herself)
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)Yeah, I know about you. I'll have to treat you a bit special. (#gesticulate01#)I don't normally do that, so look appreciative!
I know I'm good at this, so was that order just for me, or am I also supposed to take the ships under my command as well?
(Pilot sold his ship)I'll look after myself now then shall I? You didn't say if there was another job for me. Was that intentional?
(new assignment)A new job? I just got this one!
I'll come and live in your pocket, if you want!
I'll come and join you. I hope there'll be welcoming party!
I'll be joining you if you don't give me another job soon!
(Manager)I heard you'd a ship for me?
(Manager)Take over but don't change anything for now. That makes sense, I think.
(NPC already assigned to job)I have this job already. You gave me it!
(Player scanned)Look, if you let us get on with it then it's all over in a flash.
(Player scanned)Try not to make a fuss, the other ships usually just cooperate.
(Player scanned - aggressive)You'll do as we say and just sit there while we scan!
(Player scanned - aggressive)I hope you have some little secrets for us to expose!
(nothing found)You're in the clear. On your way.
(nothing found)That's all in order. Move along.
(nothing found - aggressive)I don't know how, but you got away with it. Get your tail out of here.
(nothing found - aggressive)I'm sure I've missed something! Still, I've got bigger fish to catch!
(contraband found - police)Look, we can see your contraband on our police scanner. No funny business now!
(contraband found - police)OK, keep well clear of any weapon controls. We can see that you're carrying contraband!
(drop instruction)Eject the contraband and we'll take it from there!
(pirate plundering)Well, we'll be making a killing here! Ooops, bad choice of words there!(wicked laugh)
(pirate plundering)Well bless my soul, if I had one! We've struck it rich!
(drop instruction)Why not give yourself a chance to survive and drop some of that lovely loot?
(dropped)Good thinking! That wasn't so hard was it?
(dropped)See, that wasn't so hard! We'll deal with the stuff you dropped.
(dropped part)You didn't expect us to be happy with that part-load did you?
(dropped part)Get real! We aren't doing this just for fun you know!
(#gesticulate02#)Yes, yes. That's all good stuff, but time is money.
(#gesticulate03#)Your views are interesting but your optimism can be grating!
(#gesticulate04#)Your style is OK, but you need to lose that constant smile!
Of course I'm still interested. (#rolleyes01#)I'm still here aren't I?!
You have a smooth style fair enough, (#shrug01#)but it won't work on me!
(#nod01#)I can't fault your knowledge of the subject.
(#gesticulate01#)Carry on, carry on.
Listen, (#crossarms01#)I said I understand you. It doesn't get better than that!
(#gesticulate01#)Yes, yes. Move along.
(#shrug01#)Don't mind if I listen while I do something else do you?
That's a passable viewpoint if you ignore a few things.
(#crossarms01#)Don't mind me, I always yawn at this time of day.
(#disapproval01#)I am that close to telling you to push off!
(#gesticulate01#)If that was meant to be a telling point, it wasn't!
(#cold#)I'll give you ten seconds to say something relevant.
I would ask you to repeat that, (#shrug01#)but I can't be bothered.
(#angry#)Just go away!
(#angry#)Get out of my face!
(#facepalm01#)Please, for pity's sake shut up!
(#hard#)Goodbye. Don't bother me again.
(smalltalk reward introduction)Well, I suppose we got on pretty well together, (#shrug01#)all things considered.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#nod01#)That was not too unpleasant a way to spend time together.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)It's normally against my nature, but there's a good station discount that I can put you on to.
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)There's someone I know who's after a job. They're OK, or I wouldn't bother mentioning them.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)My cousin's a really top notch professional who's looking to hire out. Want me to put in a good word?
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)(#rolleyes01#)I can't believe I'm doing this but, if you want to trade any further, I'll do a top discount.
(#angry#)Damn it! Those Teladi scumbag lizards make my blood boil!
(#disapproval01#)You have a problem with that, stranger?
(#hard#)They are greedy, driven purely by profit. (#gesticulate01#)Am I jealous of that? Hell, no.
Sure, they're green and ugly, but it's not about the looks. (#shrug01#)There's just something, er, wrong about them.
(#crossarms01#)Oh, yeah. The hissing. Annoys the hell out of me. I'm glad they've spared me the torture of learning their noises.
(#shrug01#)I've been happy enough until now keeping my distance from those annoying lizards. (#nod01#)I think I'll stick to my guns, thanks.
(#cold#)I may be no lizard-lover but that kinda talk's gonna get you some unwelcome attention. I suggest you leave.
That's nice for him. (#rolleyes01#)I'm sure he's a real folk hero.(showing ignorance of Teladi gender status)
(#excuse#)I wouldn't be surprised if that gate led to trouble of some kind.
Yeah, sure. (#crossarms01#)If only to avoid the trouble that lurks behind it.
(#crossarms01#)Earth, you say? Welcome to the lost earthlings club, Cantera.(deadpan, unimpressed)
(#nod01#)Good. Thanks. (#rolleyes02#)You've given me a very good reason to avoid the place!
(#thinking01#)Maybe we could sell them some of our food for a tidy profit.(plotting, conspicuous)
Hmmm, tempting. (#punchhand01#)With a supply of the right components, there's a fortune to be made there.(speculative)
(#scratchhead01#)What's the big hoo-haa about AI anyway?
Well, I'm not going anywhere for a while, (#shrug01#)so why not.
Right. (#scratchhead01#)So AI is good and AGI are as bad as they need to be? I think I have it right.
Hmm, that's interesting. (#nod01#)I didn't know that. It explains quite a lot.
(#gesticulate01#)It's unreal. How do they get away with this?
(#nod01#)Of course. It's the whole of this VR thing too.
(#disapproval01#)That's exactly what they are... decorations. Offensive ones at that.
Judging by the way it's currently used, I'd say (#shrug01#)it's potential is still a way off from being fulfilled.
(#excuse#)That would make it even easier for us to detach ourselves from reality. We would just lose ourselves in VR.
(#nod01#)Exactly my point! Bad people use good things for bad purposes. VR is no different.
(#excuse#)Yeah. I can totally see how that could happen if we don't remain grounded in our own reality.
(#facepalm01#)The Xenon are nearly on top of us!
(#crossarms01#)And you're not? You should be!
(#nod01#)You can rely on the Argon fleet to give them a good pasting, (#cold#)I just hope there's enough of it left to defend us here!
I hope you're right. (#sad#)They took some pretty heavy losses in Maelstrom and they can't afford to lose many more like that.
(#gesticulate04#)That's very nice of you, but my lack of ship will be a problem.
Is the suffering nearly over?
DeVries happened. (#rolleyes01#)Have you just come out of cryo-sleep or something?
(#nod01#)You're dead right about that. Albion had it very easy compared to us here.
(#cold#)Words can't begin to describe the horrors we endured. The suffering... it's... still too raw.
(#cold#)Since the reality was even worse, you might forgive survivors for wanting to hide some of the more painful detail.
(#rolleyes01#)Believing the stories is hard for you? Trust me, it was hard to believe it was actually happening at the time.
(#gesticulate01#)A large number of us left Terra to set up a mining colony here. (#sad#)As you can see, we don't have much to show for our efforts except rocks.
(#facepalm01#)You can't seriously expect any survivor to just 'suck it up' as you say... (#sad#)It will take a long time to forget what happened here.
I couldn't tell you whether the rumours are true or not as (#shrug01#)we had had bigger problems to grapple with: the Reivers.
(#shrug01#)No idea. They come, they raid, they disappear. (#hard#)Smalltalk isn't something they're known for. Suffering and death - that's what they're known for!

page.title: Split NPC 1 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[split] male basic
(greeting friendly)Split greets friend.
(greeting neutral)Split listens to you.
(greeting enemy)What do you want of Split?
(greeting rejected)Split reject your greeting, go away!
(greeting service)Split able to help.
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)Split hope to see again.
(goodbye neutral)Split leaving now.
(goodbye enemy)You go away and leave Split alone!
(goodbye rejected)Split ignore your farewell.
(goodbye service)Family feel happy to help.
(ship scanned - compliant)Scan permitted, when you ready.
(ship scanned - neutral)What is scan for?
(ship scanned - illegal)You stop scanning now.
(ship scanned - enemy)You must stop scan now or face Split anger!
(ship scanned - confident)Split has nothing to hide.
(ship scanned - possessing)Do not blame pilot. Family decide what ship carry.
(station/capship scanned - compliant)You allowed to scan.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Split wonders why you not ask first?
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Illegal scan angers Split authorities.
(station/capship scanned - enemy)Family not tolerate such scan. You go away fast.
(station/capship scanned - confident)You waste time on scan here.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Split think you make mistake and misread scanner.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)Split think contraband rules here very silly.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)You risk upsetting Family if this reported.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)Split say, you should look away. Let ship go on.
(directions - location not known)We not know of such location.
(directions - refusing to help){,13}
(surrender - reject)You make joke? Split not understand.
(surrender - hostile)Split dishonours Family to save own life!
(surrender - compliant)Split give up. Not fight anymore.
(drops cargo 1)Here is freight. You leave Split alone now.
(drops cargo 2)Split respect Family honour, we try to save ship!
(bail from ship 1)Split gives up all honour. Take ship and go!
(bail from ship 2)Ship now yours! Family forgive our failure in combat.
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)Split greets you.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)Split glad to meet you.
(hired comm greeting 2)Split enquire, how can we help?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Split can be of service?
(hired comm goodbye 1)Split bids goodbye.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)We go now. We say farewell.
What can Split do for you?
What you want Split to do?
(join squad)We join your squad.
(leave squad)We leave your squad.
(accept order 1)Split understands orders.
(accept order 2)We accept orders.
(reject order 1)We cannot accept orders.
(reject order 2)Split cannot do this.
(Automatic)We start Automatic operations.
(standby)We wait until more orders.
We agree.
Split understand.
We not agree.
(jumpdrive charging)We will jump where you say.
(jumpdrive aborted)We stop jump now!
(jumpdrive engaged)We jump soon when drive show ready.
(jumpdrive emergency)Split do emergency jump!
(jumpdrive cool-down)We jump soon. Drive not ready yet.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Drive will soon be ready.
(jumpdrive success)We have jumped. All systems still work.
(engage boost to player)We are boosting now. Soon be back with you.
(engage boost)We have boosters online.
(follow)We follow you now.
(moveto)Split go to destination now.
(moveto dock)We leave for dock.
(docked)We arrive at dock.
(task completed)Task is done now.
(confirm no change)Split go on as ordered before.
(arrived)Split has arrived.
(arrived)We at the place ordered.
(arrived at player)We are with you.
(arrived at player)Now we are here too.
Split begin guard duty.
