(greeting to player on boarding own station)Split welcomes leader aboard.
(lost drones for current task)No drones held. You must change orders.
(task start but low on drones)Not many drones left. You may see problems soon.
(no drones to start task)No drones held. Split cannot do task.
(restock request to player)Need more drones. You get more for Split.
(request additional ships)More ships would help us. You send more.
(received additional ship)Ship has arrived. We make it start work now.
Your order does not fit operation.
We stop old operation now.
You supply new orders.
(Player loses licence)Pilot Otani, you lose our licence now.
You already know reason for loss.
Ship badly damaged. What you want Split to do?
(movement status)We cannot move. Split need help here.
We go to shipyard.
We arrive in shipyard. You need to give new orders.
Jump Drive not working. We need repair here.
Split orders jump when Jump Drive repaired.
We soon dock at shipyard. What orders for Split after that?
Engine is damaged and does not work. Repair must come to Split.
We will move when engine is working.
Split getting ready to jump.
We have jumped away safely. What new orders for Split?
We are leaving zone.
We have left zone. Split waiting for orders.
Split will jump when fuel is available.
Split needs fuel to make a jump.
We will go to fuel station.
We fetch fuel and Split jump as ordered.
We have no fuel. You must send fuel here to ship.
We have no fuel and fuel station too far away. We need orders.
We have no fuel. Split will try jump using generator.
Split has no jump energy. We will use generator to try to jump.
We cannot jump far. Split ship needs more fuel.
(Hired Architect)We are Architect. What do you need building?
(Asked how to get building resources)Building needs resources. How you want Split to find them?
We hold enough resources now. You want to build station here? Split cannot change later!
Module now ready. What do we build next?
Station now ready. Split congratulate on this.
We will build this module next.
Split show modules you can build. Design progress limits choice.
You want this module? You cannot change mind later.
Split approve your choice. We will start building now.
We are Architect. You need a Station Manager. You hire one and bring here.
We show your available choice of stations. We can build one of those here.
(builder ship moving)We will go to building site.
(Ship builder)Split offer to build you a ship. All models are good ships.
We hold everything we need now. You want this ship? When we start, the ship must finish.
Your ship is ready now.
We are busy now. You look at catalogue and come back later.
We will soon finish ship. Ship will need pilot brought here.
We can make ships from this list.
You must give Split more credits for this.
(PC: You take care of it.)We now have all credits. We will start to build now.
We make extensions from this list. Extensions sometimes need others to work.
You choose upgrade level. Split start work when you give order.
You choose hull percentage. We repair hull to that level.
We build modules from this list.
Split hold resource stocks as shown here.
(architect)We return unused credits at the end.
(Initiate Trade)Split agree to trade. We are coming.
(Receive)We ready to receive wares.
(Deliver)We ready to deliver wares.
(Fail Space)Cargo bay is full. We cannot take more.
(Fail Type)We cannot take that. Ware is wrong type for ship.
(Fail Space Standby)Cargo space is full. You tell Split what to do.
(Fail Buy Amount)They do not sell all we want here. We will buy what we can, if you agree.
(Fail Sell Amount)They do not buy all we want here. We will sell what we can, if you agree.
(Fail Buy Ware)We are there. They do not sell the wares we want. We will go to next order, if you agree.
(Fail Sell Ware)We are there. They do not buy our wares. We will go to next order, if you agree.
(Fail Buy Price)They ask too much for the wares. We will buy anyway, unless you disagree.
(Fail Sell Price)They pay too little for our wares. We will sell anyway, unless you disagree.
(Fail)We cannot do that trade. You must give new orders.
Split make many credits from trade. We will send you surplus, unless you say to keep it.
Split make deal. We will send report.
We are there. We will start trade.
(fixed something)We made it work.
(fixed something)We made it look like new.
(fixed something)We did the repair.
(Initiate Mining)We are ready. We will start mining now.
(Launch)Collectors away.
(Recall)Collectors coming back.
(Automatic)We will start Automatic operation.
(Fail Type)We cannot take that. The ware type is wrong.
You tag things and drones pick them up.
You tag things and drones prioritise them.
We have no collector drones. That will not work.
Drones collecting now.
We have stopped mining. You send further orders, or we will follow you.
We are full now. We will come back and join you.
(Squad member)A ship told us to drop our cargo.
Ship belongs to police.
Ship acts very hostile.
Split ask, do we comply?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
We wait for order.
(scan successful)We can see the data. We will pick best spot to attack.
We will go here where weak.
(not scanned)We choose any spot. We not know which spot is the best.
(boarding pod launching)We leave for the target.
(boarding pod hit)Pod taking hits!
(marines under fire)Enemies shoot at us!
(pod attached)We will cut the hull now.
(marine entering ship)We are through hull. We will enter the ship.
We are getting ready. We will move soon.
We are moving now. We will seek the enemy.
(marine on alert)We can see the enemy now.
(loud)We have contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
You use cover!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Enemy afraid of Split firepower!
(lots of fighting noise)We lose a marine!
(lots of fighting noise)Make this position safe!
(lots of fighting noise)You all move forward!
(lots of fighting noise)Make the enemy fear Split!
(combat)Do not stop now!
(quiet)We can hear the enemy.
(assist mission successful)Enemies running away. We will follow.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Enemies still here. We will attack their position.
(assist mission successful)Sentries dead now.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Sentries still shooting!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)We are at control console.
(marine hacking)We are starting hack.
(assist mission successful)We see the auto-defences are falling quiet.
(assist mission failed/timed out)We see the auto-defences are still shooting!
We hear the self-destruct! Split must quickly override!
(relieved)Self-destruct stopped!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Split override failed! We must run now. Run fast!
(boarding successful)We win control. We have victory.
We not enough marines to win now! We must go back.
Hull will fail soon! We must run back to pods!
We are in the pods. We are coming home!
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)We are taking damage!
(sound of combat/laser fire)We lost a marine!
Yeurgh...(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
We are throwing stun!(pause followed by load bang/explosion)
We are throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
You take cover! Hatch being blown!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)You shoot as cover. We can reload.
(lots of fighting noise)We all move forward!
(checking for enemies)We see place is clear.
(sound of laser fire)We find a sentry!
We find a force field.
(assist mission successful)Force field is going down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We seek longer way round.
Captain has surrendered. We take the ship!(cheers)
Crew have given up. We take the station!(cheers)
We have no time to--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)We have taken the target. We did well!
(upgrades)We are undocking now. We have the upgrades.
We are undocking now. We have the downgrade.
We confirm upgrades installed.
You choose the ship and we do the upgrade.
You choose the upgrade.
(*Hiring*)
You already have one in Split job.
You have an Engineer.
You have a Marine Officer.
We replace one you select? You say if Split needed elsewhere.
You hired Split. This will make you happy soon!
Split is very good. You will see.
(On board introduction)Split says hello to all crew members.
(Fired in space)We will leave at next station. We will seek new contract there and earn back Family honour.
(Fired on platform)We will go now. We will seek new job to regain Family honour.
(Assign to object)Split moving there for duty.
(Assign to ship)Split on board assigned ship now.
(Return to player)Split returning to Otani.
(Leave player)Split leave Otani.
(Leave player)We going now. Wish Split good luck.
(Showing skills)Split is very qualified. We show here, if you not believing.
(Showing skills)Split is very proud. We hold many papers to show you.
(Orders)Split ask, where do we go next?
(Sell ship)We sell your old ship. We gain much credits for Otani account.
(Sell ship)We get much credits for selling ship. You soon get transfer.
(respond to free mode)You show trust of Split. We show much gratitude.
(respond to free mode)We soon show Otani. Decision to trust Split is very good.
(respond to restricted mode)Split follow precise orders. Split obey and do as told.(neutral)
(respond to restricted mode)Split always follow Otani order. We think this waste of Split talent.(rather miffed)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Split ask, what are you trying to do?
(player attacks - friendly 2)Split demand that you stop shooting!
(player attacks - neutral 1)Family asks, why do you do this thing?
(player attacks - neutral 2)Family hope that was a mistake!
(player attacks - enemy 1)Split now see you pay for attack!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Split say, you stop shooting right now!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)Family will take action if you go on.
(big object attacked)Split wonder if pilot needs new forward sensor?
(big object attacked)Split ask pilot, when your ship grow up and be big too?
(light fire 1)Pilot attack us with tiny weapon!
(light fire 2)Split say attack of small importance.
(mid fire 1)We ask for help now. Pilot not go away!
(mid fire 2)We seek Family come quick and drive away enemy!
(heavy fire 1)Family must help soon or Split die!
(heavy fire 2)We not last long now! We need help!
(heavy fire 3)Our ship soon fail. We need help quick!
(station defence)Station needs help. You come and defend soon.
(station defence)We need ships come here now. Station under attack!
(station defence)Family help soon or station take bad damage!
(death 1)Yeurghhhh!
(death 2)We join Family ancestors!
(death 3)Family, honour our memory!
(shield warning 1)Shield stop soon!
(shield warning 2)Shield not work now!
(hull warning 1)Hull take damage!
(hull warning 2)Hull not hold long!
(Incoming Enemies)Enemy come here now!
(Incoming Wave)Split have more to do. More enemy almost here.
(Last Wave)We soon see end. Last enemy here now.
(Player Needed)Split seeks Otani help now! We in trouble.
(Success 1)Family has much honour now. We win victory!
(Success 2)Enemy gone now! We bring great victory for Family.
(Fail 1)We lose in big defeat. Family see shame!
(Fail 2)Split ashamed! We allow enemy to take victory.
(critical damage)Split ship not last long now!
(critical damage)Reactor come apart soon!
(Incoming Enemies)Enemy come here now.
(Dangerous area)Family protection not strong here! This is not good place!
(Plead for life 1)For Family sake! We say, leave Split alone!
(Plead for life 2)Split always prepared to die well, but ask ship not destroyed!
(Plead for life 3)Split not want to die! We beg pilot spare our life.
(Plead for life 4)No more shoot our ship! Split say, we want to live!
(player instructions)Follow us.
Keep close to Split.
(followers)Split follow you now.
We follow you now.
Split ready now.
We all ready.
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)All obey orders of officials. All get off if you not panic.(neutral)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)We show you mission. Pilot still interested?
(General 2)We offer mission. Pilot say if take or not.
(Easy 1)We offer easy mission. Pilot have no difficulty.
(Easy 2)Mission not hard for pilot. You will not fail.
(Hard 1)We much worry pilot fail mission. We risk much in giving.
(Hard 2)You not dishonour Family. You make all right choice or you fail.
(Fight Easy 1)You like easy fight. This mission suit pilot.
(Fight Easy 2)You find no big fear. Mission easy this time.
(Fight Hard 1)You have hard mission. You make sure not fail or you die!
(Fight Hard 2)You right fearing mission. You risk life for credits.
(Trade Easy 1)Split say, you move freight with no problems.
(Trade Easy 2)Freight mission is easy. You make credits very quick.
(Trade Hard 1)Freight mission is hard. Pilot must be good or fail and lose honour!
(Trade Hard 2)Mission is for good pilot. Freight move not easy or quick.
(Acceptance Query 1)You interested still?
(Acceptance Query 2)You still do mission?
(Accept 1)Split agree.
(Accept 2)We now happy.
(Reluctant 1)Split not very sure.
(Reluctant 2)Split say, you must take care.
(Reject 1)Split say, you not good enough.
(Reject 2)We think you fail. You not get mission.
(Info 1)Data transfer to ship computer now.
(Info 2)Ship computer soon get data.
(Success 1)We say, you give Family much honour. You do very well!
(Success 2)Family salute you. You help Split by mission success.
(Semi 1)Family expected more. Still, we relieved you not fail instead.
(Semi 2)Split wonder why you not do better. Maybe you not have luck?
(Fail 1)You fail mission. You go away fast!
(Fail 2)You dishonour Family and Split. You stay away now!
(Credits 1)We give you much credits now.
(Reward 1)You do so well. We give extra reward.
(Client abort)Our client not want you now. Mission is gone.
(mission update)Mission details change. You look on ship computer.
(mission update 2)Client change mission details. Ship computer have changes now.
(Assassination Offer 1)You must eliminate target. Family much want target dead.
(Assassination Offer 2)Split seek end of dishonourable person. This person must not survive.
(Target)You threaten Split? We think you make silly joke!
(Target 2)You not worry Split! You come close, then you lose life!
(Bribe 1)Split offer pilot much credits! We want to keep life and ship.
(Success)Family pleased by pilot. This good success.
(Fail)Split not understand your failure. You go away now.
(Fail by bribe)We aware you take credits from target! You fear wrath of Family now!
(Protect Station Offer 1)Enemies come to station soon. You come and help us!
(Protect Station Offer 2)We pay good credits if you help defend station. Enemies coming soon.
(Protect Ship Offer 1)Enemies threaten Split ship! You help and get much credits.
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Ship in great danger! You kill enemies and Family very grateful.
(Police 1)Family need unknown ship to scan traffic. Find hidden smugglers then Split pay well.
(Success 1)Family very pleased you find smugglers. We now track back to sources.
(Semi 1)Family sorry you find nothing. We think maybe better next time. We pay expenses.
(Fail 1)Family think you not try hard enough. You get no reward from Split.
(Passenger Offer 1)We need quick ride to destination. Pilot help Split move in time?
(Passenger Offer 2)We ask, if you fly Split to destination quick?
(On Board)Split on Otani ship now.
(Space)Split find no room to go on board.
(Late)Split ask, why you so slow? We must get to destination quick!
(Fail)You go too slow. We find faster ship at next station.
(Assigned to platform)Split move to new job now.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)Family want urgent delivery of freight. Pilot able to do job?
(Return Ware Offer)We want freight delivered here fast. You fetch freight for Split?
(Late Sell)Family ask why freight not there. Split say, get there very soon.
(Late Return)We still wait for freight. We ask pilot, when you arrive here?
(Fail Sell)Family lose contract and honour! You fail to deliver on time!
(Fail Return)You stay away. Split find freight elsewhere. We not trust you now!
(Emergency Offer)Split need help now! You come and help!
(Emergency Offer)We call all pilots. Split need your help!
(Emergency Offer)Family needs help of pilot. You come quick!
(station manager)Split let pilot dock now.
Split greets pilot here.
We glad to have aboard.
Split feels honour to have aboard.
Split thanks pilot for help to station.
(Defence manager thanking player)We thank Skunk for help.
(Defence manager thanking player)We thank Otani for assistance.
We thank pilot for help to us. We pay credits for aid.
(trader introduction)Split greets pilot. We make you good offers.
(trader introduction)We greet pilot. You want to see our offers?
(trader introduction)Split ask, what such fine pilot want to see?
(trader introduction)Split have all best offers. You look and we do deals!
(trader introduction)We think pilot can afford many offers here.
(generic trader)We offer deals on these.
(performing service)We make good progress.
We are ready.
(Confirm sale/handoff)We all agree.
(Confirm agreement)Split confirm deal!
(giving object or info){,4110}
(weapon/upgrade trader)We make weapon fit on Otani ship.
We fill your ammunition locker.
Pilot be very wise to take all ammunition can carry!
Split sell only finest items!
We offer best deals here.
Pilot chose very well.
We ask, what amount you want?
Split ask, what else can we offer pilot?
We see how this fit in Otani ship.
We start work now.
We make 'Pride' much better ship.
Modification working well now. We say to Otani, enjoy improved 'Pride'.
Split do really good job. 'Pride' now better than ever.
(Shady trader)Flurrbb! You after 'special' type freight? You can keep secret from police?(special as in illegal)
Split have many 'special' wares! We show you list but you not tell Family we here.
We ask, how many you take? We send to Otani ship in unmarked crate.
(licence trader)Split offers pilot types of licence.
We do many licences. Here is list.
We tell pilot, licence come with some restrictions!
Licence is yours, but you must read and agree conditions.
(deal confirmations)Split agree to deal.
Split say, we have deal.
We now agree.
Split confirms this.
(accepting gift from player){,4302}
We get here. Now Split say, what you want of us?
We now ask, what you seek of Split?
(emergency call)Split request urgent help!
Split seek assistance quick!
We say, get here quick fast!
We ask, who come to help Split?
(station contacting player)Station hailing unknown ship.
Station calling Otani.
(attacking allied object)Family will not tolerate such action in our space.
Split do not allow actions like this.
We say, you will regret your action very soon.
Family ready to retaliate!
Family confused and ask if that was accident!
We say, your action will not go unpunished!
(player uncovered as enemy)Split say, attempt at disguise not working now.
(station contacting law)Split contacting police ships.
We are under attack!
We ask for help.
(police)We are sending Family warships to you now.
We have no free ships. We cannot help you now.
(NPC request for help rejected)Split not understand this!
(NPC request for help rejected)We cannot believe help not come!
We are sending report on Otani.
Sending report on Otani now.
Details being sent now.
Split authorities know of Otani.
This pilot is known to police.
We know Otani is a criminal.
We are receiving data.
We know of Tarren female.
Female is known criminal.
We are calling police.
(Found discount)We discover good discount. You hurry to come here.
(Found discount)We find very good offer. You must accept quick.
(discount offer)Split make good offer to pilot.
(discount offer)We offer special price to you.
(discount explanation)Our factory works hardest in sector. Factory makes many products quick.
(discount explanation)We buy many items very cheap from bankrupt firm. We have much stock now.
(discount explanation)We change to new supplier. He makes resources cheaper than before.
(player station manager)Split has found new problem.
(player station manager)We see another problem. You must help us fix.
Station not working now.
Station come to stop.
We send details in report.
Split seek your advice.
We need more resources.
Our resource have run out.
(can also be used for ships)Cargo bay is full right up.
(can also be used for ships)Storage space has no room now.
(architect)We need manager here now.
(can also be used for ships)Split say, options on this list help operation run better.
(can also be used for ships)You pick option to make our operation better.
(defence officer)We are fighting off enemies. You must bring help!
Enemy are attacking us here. You must send support!
(exchange wares)We start transfer soon. Who else involved in transfer?
You tell Split ware.
You show us ware.
You say how much.
You tell us how many.
You give amount.
Split have all details. We do transfer now.
We are ready. Transfer starts now.
You tell Split if we install in target, or put into cargo.
Split short of credits. You must give us more.
We can take credits from Otani account, if you agree.
Split have enough credits now. We start work soon.
We need Otani to discuss budget. You make contact soon.
Split sees budget changes.
Split arrive there soon. We begin operation straight away.
(rejecting impossible mode order)Split say, not possible.
We ask, what is our mission when we arrive?
We ask, where do we go now?
(Witness)Split see everything that happens!
(Witness threatened or bribed)We not trouble Family with upset. Split see nothing wrong now.
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)Split outraged by dishonourable proposal!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#warm#)We already hear of Otani. We approve of his actions.
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#smile#)We see the deeds of Otani. We see honour in this pilot.
We ask if just take our own ship, or take all ships Split commands?
(Pilot sold his ship)You offer us new job, or we look for new work on station.
(new assignment)Split ask, what is our new job?
Split come to Otani location. We join fleet there.
Split now join fleet in Otani location.
You send us new task now. Otherwise we join up with you.
(Manager)You assign us new ship?
(Manager)You give us new ship and we carry on current order.
(NPC already assigned to job)Split show here what we do for you already.
(Player scanned)Split authority checks your ship for contraband. You stay calm.
(Player scanned)Family ask we scan for illegal freight. We be finished soon.
(Player scanned - aggressive)We not like look of your ship! We scan for surprises!
(Player scanned - aggressive)Split find anything you hide! You not fool us!
(nothing found)Split find nothing illegal. You move on now.
(nothing found)Scan all done now. You all clear and may continue.
(nothing found - aggressive)We find nothing this time. We not trust you next time though!
(nothing found - aggressive)We go away this time. You wise to fear our return!
(contraband found - police)Family find contraband on your ship. Now you obey Split orders.
(contraband found - police)Family know what you carry hidden. You not make trouble for Split.
(drop instruction)We say, you drop contraband quick. You not want trouble from Family!
(pirate plundering)We happy Split! We find much you give us, we think!
(pirate plundering)We find much loot here. You make Split pilot very happy!
(drop instruction)You drop some freight for Split. We let you go, maybe!
(dropped)You smart pilot!
(dropped)You make good choice, this time!
(dropped part)Split already know you have much more!
(dropped part)We get very annoyed if you try trick Split again!
(#smile#)Split really like what you say.
(#warm#)Split think you very good talker!
(#nod01#)Split want to hear much more.
(#laugh#)We very much amused by talk.
(#nod01#)We think you understand Split view.
(#nod01#)You understand what Split mean.
(#warm#)You talk some more. Split keep listening.
(#smile#)We spend more time having nice talk.
We listen to you for now.
We still listen a bit more.
(#nod01#)Split think we understand your view.
Split still try to follow.
(#gesticulate01#)We losing what you mean.
(#gesticulate02#)You lose Split understanding now.
(#gesticulate03#)Split still wait for point to your talking.
(#scratchhead01#)We not understand what you mean.
(#hard#)You leave Split alone now!
(#disapproval01#)We stop talk, we had enough!
(#shrug01#)Split tired of talking now!
(#angry#)Split annoyed now, we speak no more!
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)Split very pleased with Otani pilot. We have very good chat.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#warm#)We much enjoy chat. (#nod01#)Split get to like Otani.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)Split help pilot. We know station giving big discount. We show you station detail.
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)We know very good worker who asking for job now. We know this person and show details here.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)We show details of professional that Split once use. We help you hire, if you want.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)We should trade now. (#smile#)We are friends now, so we offer pilot friend much discount now.
(#shrug01#)Split do not understand trouble about AI.
Tell Split. (#nod01#)Split interested.
Split say that AI good, AGI bad. (#disapproval01#)Split do not trust machine that thinks for itself.
This was not known to Split! (#nod01#)Split now better understand nature of Xenon.
Do Split hear words of war?
(#thinking01#)Split require more information.
(#punchhand01#)Split approve of rapid, decisive victory!
Split always prepared.
(#rolleyes01#)Split require ship first.
Split ready for battle (#scratchhead01#)but say you die first!
(#crossarms01#)Split do not understand 'flee'... Explain!
(#disapproval01#)Ugly Humans not real.
Yes. (#shrug01#)Split think photons wasted on Humans.
(#shrug01#)Decoration for Human, not Split.
Split believe virtual reality only for battle simulation!
(#sad#)Illogical Humans. (#shrug01#)Humans waste own life in VR.
Split say VR dangerous. (#disapproval01#)Bad people use it badly.
(#shrug01#)Such scenario obvious to Split. Lazy people cause this.
(#punchhand01#)Battle calls! Xenon challenge Split!
(#nod01#)Fear steels the blood!
(#gesticulate04#)Argon fleet impress Split with victory in Maelstrom. Next battle looms close.
(#sad#)Split hope losses in Maelstrom not repeated.
Split grateful for offer (#shrug01#)but lack ship.

page.title: Split NPC 2 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[split] male basic(grumpy)
(greeting friendly)Split greets you.
(greeting neutral)Split ask, why you disturb us?
(greeting enemy)Split wonder at true motives!
(greeting rejected)Split not talk to you, go away!
(greeting service)Split help but you must wait turn.
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)Split go now.
(goodbye neutral)Split have better things to do.
(goodbye enemy)You leave Split alone and not come back!
(goodbye rejected)Split unimpressed by your farewell.
(goodbye service)You tell pilots, Split help very good.
(ship scanned - compliant)You do scan, we cannot stop anyway.
(ship scanned - neutral)Split demand you stop scan.
(ship scanned - illegal)Split say, you stop scan now or we call police.
(ship scanned - enemy)You scan more, you face Split weapons!
(ship scanned - confident)Split glad you waste time.
(ship scanned - possessing)Split pilot not responsible for ship cargo. You speak to Family.
(station/capship scanned - compliant)We let you scan, if you must.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Split annoyed you not ask first.
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Illegal scan tempts retaliation by Family!
(station/capship scanned - enemy)Now you annoy Family. Soon you pay!
(station/capship scanned - confident)You waste time, Split not care.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Split say, you learn to read scanner properly.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)We ignore these rules. Silly rules not apply to Split.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)You must not dishonour Family. You go embarrass non-Split.
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)You must not pick on Split. Go find contraband elsewhere.
(directions - location not known)We not know, it not our business.
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Your threat is silly. Split think you mad.
(surrender - hostile)Split have no choice. Family will understand!
(surrender - compliant)We surrender. Next time Split take revenge.
(drops cargo 1)Here is freight. You not trouble Split again!
(drops cargo 2)Split try to save ship! You not understand needs of Family!
(bail from ship 1)Split say, take ship; next time we take yours!
(bail from ship 2)Ship now yours! Family make us stronger next time.
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)Split greets.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)Split now meet you.
(hired comm greeting 2)Split ask, what you want?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)Split is here to meet you.
(hired comm goodbye 1)Split says, goodbye.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)We go now.
What you want of Split?
What you want from Split?
(join squad)We join Otani squad.
(leave squad)We leave Otani squad.
(accept order 1)Split do as told.
(accept order 2)We understand orders.
(reject order 1)We cannot accept this order. Order silly!
(reject order 2)Split cannot do this. You think again!
(Automatic)We start Automatic operations now.
(standby)We do nothing until get orders.
We agree.
Split understand.
We not agree.
(jumpdrive charging)We will jump where you say. You get location right.
(jumpdrive aborted)We stop jump now! Split say, make up mind!
(jumpdrive engaged)We jump when drive show ready, not before.
(jumpdrive emergency)Split do emergency jump now!
(jumpdrive cool-down)We jump soon. Drive not ready yet. You wait.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Drive soon be ready. We wait, soon jump.
(jumpdrive success)We have jumped. Ship systems show good. Split is surprised.
(engage boost to player)We boost now. We back with you quick.
(engage boost)Boosters work now.
(follow)We follow you now. You remember we there!
(moveto)Split go to destination now. You not change mind later!
(moveto dock)We leave for dock. We not know when arrive.
(docked)We arrive at dock. Now Split have rest.
(task completed)Task is done now. Split expect more work come soon!
(confirm no change)Split go on as before. We ask, why you remind us?
(arrived)Split there now.
(arrived)We at place ordered. We not late.
(arrived at player)We are with Otani.
(arrived at player)Now we with you too.
Split begin guard duty. Always Split get guard duty!(inaudible muttering follows)
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Split sees leader come aboard.
(lost drones for current task)No drones held. You must change orders. Why you not realise?
(task start but low on drones)Few drones left now. We have problem when run out.
(no drones to start task)No drones held. Split cannot do task. You send silly order!
(restock request to player)Need more drones. You get more for Split, or we waste time.
(request additional ships)We not enough ships to work fast. You send more to help.
(received additional ship)Ship arrived now, take long enough! We start it to work now.
Operation not suitable for this order.
We stop old operation. We doing nothing now.
You supply new orders or we waste time.
(Player loses licence)Pilot Otani, you lose our licence now. Family not forgive you soon!
You know reasons you lose licence. Split not care you upset.
What you want Split to do with badly-damaged ship? We not have many choices.
(movement status)We cannot move. Split needs help this location.
We go to shipyard.
We arrive in shipyard. You give new orders or Split have holiday.
Jump Drive not working. We need repair here or not be jumping.
Split orders jump when Jump Drive repaired. Split say, we must wait for that.
We soon dock at shipyard. What orders for Split after that?
Engine is damaged and does not work. Repair must come here to Split.
We will move when engine works. Split thought that obvious!
Split ship getting ready to jump.
We have jumped away. What new orders for us?
We leave zone now.
We have left zone. Split waiting for orders.
We will jump only when fuel is available.
Split needs fuel before can make a jump.
We will go to fuel station. Split ask why we not go earlier?
We fetch fuel first, then Split jump as ordered.
We have no fuel. You send fuel here to ship, or we stay here.
We have no fuel and fuel station too far away. We need orders now. Why this let happen?
We have no fuel. We will try jump using generator. Split not think will end well!
Split has no jump energy. We will use generator to try to jump. We take big risk.
We cannot jump far. Split ship needs more fuel, or we get left behind.
(Hired Architect)We are Architect. What you want building?
(Asked how to get building resources)Building needs resources. You want Split to do all work to find?
We hold enough resources now. You want to build station here? Split cannot change later even you demand!
Module now ready. What module we build next?
Station now ready. Split think, not bad job!
We will build this module next.
Split show modules you can build. Design progress limits choice, so no ask for others.
You want this module? You cannot change mind later. You are warned!
Split approve. We start building, at last.
We are Architect. You need a Station Manager. You hire one and bring here quick.
We show you choice of stations. We can build one from list here. No other one.
(builder ship moving)We go to building site now. You not bother with talk.
(Ship builder)Split offer to build you a ship. All models are good ships, you choose.
We hold everything we need now. You want this ship? When we start, the ship must finish and you must pay.
Your ship is ready now. You look and say thank you!
You see we very busy now. You look at catalogue. You come back when we not busy.
We will soon finish ship. Ship need pilot brought here now.
We can make ship on this list. No other one.
You must give Split more credits for this. You waste time if not give now.
(PC: You take care of it.)We now have enough credits. We will build now.
We make extensions from this list. Extensions sometimes need others to work. You heed this!
You choose upgrade level. Split start work when you give proper order.
You choose hull percentage. We repair hull to that level, and no more.
We build modules from this list. We build no others.
Split hold resource stocks as shown here. We not charge you for storage, yet.
(architect)We return unused credits to you at the end. You leave tip for Split workers?
(Initiate Trade)Split agree to trade. We are coming.
(Receive)We ready to receive wares.
(Deliver)We ready to deliver wares.
(Fail Space)Cargo bay is full. We cannot take more. Split think that obvious.
(Fail Type)We cannot take that. Ware is wrong type for ship. You give Split wrong ship!
(Fail Space Standby)Cargo space is full. You tell Split what to do. We must make room!
(Fail Buy Amount)They do not sell all we want here. We will buy what we can, or go on. Decide quick.
(Fail Sell Amount)They do not buy all we want here. We will sell what we can, if you make decision.
(Fail Buy Ware)We are there. They do not sell the wares we want. We will go to next order, if you agree. We go soon.
(Fail Sell Ware)We are there. They do not buy our wares. We will go to next order, if you agree. We must decide quick.
(Fail Buy Price)They ask too much for the wares. We will buy anyway, unless you disagree.
(Fail Sell Price)They pay too little for our wares. We will sell anyway, unless you disagree.
(Fail)We cannot do that trade. You must give better orders.
Split make many credits from trade. We will send you surplus, unless you say to keep it. Split expect you want!
Split make deal. We send report now.
We are there. We start to trade.
(fixed something)We make it work properly.
(fixed something)We make it work like new.
(fixed something)We do repair and it work.
(Initiate Mining)We are ready. We start mining now.
(Launch)Collectors heading out.
(Recall)Collectors coming back.
(Automatic)We will start Automatic operation.
(Fail Type)We cannot take that. The ware type is wrong. You get ship wrong again!
You tag things and drones pick them up.
You tag things and drones prioritise them.
We have no collector drones. That will not work. You give different order.
Drones collecting now.
We have stopped mining. You send further orders quick, or we go to follow you.
We are full now. We will come back and join you.
(Squad member)A ship demands we drop our cargo!
Ship belongs to police.
Ship acts very hostile towards us.
Split ask, do we comply?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
We wait for orders now.
(scan successful)We have the data. We will pick best place to assault.
We will go where enemy is weak.
(not scanned)We do not know which spot is best. We pick nearest spot.
(boarding pod launching)We leave for the target.
(boarding pod hit)Pod taking damage!
(marines under fire)Enemies shoot at Split!
(pod attached)We will drill through hull now.
(marine entering ship)We are through hull. We enter soon.
We ready inside now. We move out soon.
We moving. We will engage enemy on sight.
(marine on alert)We can hear enemy movement!
(loud)We have contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
You take cover!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Enemy fear Split weapons!
(lots of fighting noise)We have a marine down!
(lots of fighting noise)Secure this place!
(lots of fighting noise)You make haste forwards!
(lots of fighting noise)Make enemy run from Split!
(combat)You not stop firing!
(quiet)We detect enemy nearby.
(assist mission successful)Enemies afraid of Split. They run and leave area.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Enemies not move out. We must go through them.
(assist mission successful)Sentries all down now.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Sentries shoot still!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)We are at security panel.
(marine hacking)We start security hack.
(assist mission successful)Auto-defences fall silent.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Auto-defences still shoot at Split!
Self-destruct alarm! We need override quick!
(relieved)Self-destruct stop now!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Override not work! Run fast back to pods!
(boarding successful)We in control now. Split have victory.
Marines too few now. We will fail! We must return.
Hull soon failing! Make haste to pods!
We are in pods. We return home now!
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)We take damage!
(sound of combat/laser fire)We lose marine!
Yeurgh...(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
We throw stun now!(pause followed by load bang/explosion)
We throw smoke now!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Blow up the hatch! Marines take cover!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)You keep shooting fast. We reload weapons here.
(lots of fighting noise)We chase enemy now!
(checking for enemies)This place seems clear.
(sound of laser fire)We find active sentry!
We find a new force field.
(assist mission successful)Force field taken down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We must find long way round.
Captain gives up. We hold the ship!(cheers)
Crew now surrender everywhere. We control the station!(cheers)
We run out of ti--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)We take the target. We win victory here!
(upgrades)We undock now. We have all upgrades ordered.
We undock now. We have the downgrade.
We check all upgrades installed.
You choose ship for upgrade. We not make guess.
You choose upgrade. We start work then.
(*Hiring*)
You already have one doing job you ask of Split.
You have an Engineer.
You have a Marine Officer.
We to replace one you select? Otherwise you say where Split needed.
You hired good Split. We soon remove doubts.
Split very good at job. You see soon enough.
(On board introduction)We greet new crew. We get on if you not annoy us.
(Fired in space)We leave quick at next station. We seek better contract with respect for honour.
(Fired on platform)We go straight away. We seek new job that is worthy of Split.
(Assign to object)Split moving to new place of duty.
(Assign to ship)Split on board ship as ordered.
(Return to player)Split now return to Otani.

(greeting friendly)Greetings friend of Teladi. You seek deal?

(goodbye enemy)I feel so cheapened by talking to you.

(goodbye service)I shall await your return.
(ship scanned - compliant)You may scan and see my goods. You seek to trade, yes?

(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)Oh dear! Teladi was sold unopened unmarked crate at bargain price. I did not get around to opening it yet.(evasive)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)Oh, sad day! Perhaps my profits for this trip will see big loss!(despairing)

An excellent choice, Sir. I will start construction straight away.

Here are the stations that I can construct for you.

(lots of fighting noise)Shoot out those sensors!
(combat)Stay together!
(quiet)Shh! Enemies look for us.
(assist mission successful)Enemy is unsettled. Some are leaving.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Enemy positions not leaving. We must assault them.
(assist mission successful)Sentries closing down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Sentries still active. Shoot and destroy them!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)I am by a security station.
(marine hacking)Starting system hack.
(assist mission successful)Auto-sentries shutting down.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Auto-sentries still operational! We must storm past them.
Self-destruct sequence started! Attempting override!
(relieved)Self-destruct sequence shutting down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)No good - escape back to the pods!
(boarding successful)I confirm successful transfer of command!
I have had too many casualties! We cannot succeed! Set off for the pods.
The hull will soon fail! Run to the pods!
We are safely in the pods and setting course for home!
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)Teladi hit!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Casualty!
Arrssst..(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by load bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Stand clear! Blowing the hatch!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Stay low and reload!
(lots of fighting noise)Shoot at that sniper!
(checking for enemies)This place seems clear.
(sound of laser fire)Laser sentries!
Force field set up ahead.
(assist mission successful)The force field is shutting down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)I will seek a secondary route.
The captain surrendered. The ship is ours!(cheers)
They are standing down! The station is ours!(cheers)
I see no chance--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)I see we have control of the target. Such a success!
(upgrades)Successfully upgraded. Undocking soon.
Successfully downgraded. Undocking soon.
Upgrades installed.
Choose a ship to upgrade.
Which upgrade do you want installed?
(*Hiring*)
You already have someone doing such a job.
You already have an Engineer on board.
You already have a Marine Officer on board.
Do you want me to replace them or do you need me somewhere else?
Thank you for hiring me, Sir. You will not be disappointed.
I anticipate good times working with you. You will not be sorry for hiring this Teladi.
(On board introduction)Hello crew members. You see I am new here. I am sure we can do good business together.
(Fired in space)Yes, just set me down at the next station. I will be sure to find a better situation next time.
(Fired on platform)Yes, I will leave now and seek better business here.
(Assign to object)Yes, Sir. I will move to my new quarters.
(Assign to ship)Yes, I will take control of that ship now.
(Return to player)Yes, Sir. I will be at your side very soon.
(Leave player)Goodbye Mister Otani.
(Leave player)So long and good profits.
(Showing skills)You can see here, Teladi is the most qualified around. I make more profits that way.
(Showing skills)I sense these credentials will impress you. I am so proud of them.
(Orders)Please send new target coordinates.
(Sell ship)I sold the ship as you requested. Your credits should arrive soon.
(Sell ship)I sold the ship for many credits. I closed a very sweet deal!
(respond to free mode)I appreciate you putting your trust in me. You will not be disappointed.
(respond to free mode)I appreciate such freedom on the job. Thank you, Sir.
(respond to restricted mode)I will follow your lead at all times. Although why do you not trust Teladi to know this business?(puzzled)
(respond to restricted mode)You send orders on all big decisions, I send them on.(very bored)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)Stop! Teladi is a friend!
(player attacks - friendly 2)Silly pilot! Stop shooting at me!
(player attacks - neutral 1)What do you think you are doing? You risk loss of profits!
(player attacks - neutral 2)Teladi is hoping that was a stupid mistake.
(player attacks - enemy 1)So, you take big risks and now someone must pay the price!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Do that again and you will soon be very sorry!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)Another shot and you will answer to the authorities.
(big object attacked)Silly pilot does not see the size of the target!
(big object attacked)Stupid pilot wastes ammunition. Better to sell it instead!
(light fire 1)Stop! Someone loses profits soon!
(light fire 2)Someone is shooting at Teladi!
(mid fire 1)I could use some assistance here!
(mid fire 2)This pilot is not letting up!
(heavy fire 1)My ship cannot take more shots!
(heavy fire 2)Assistance is needed straight away!
(heavy fire 3)Requesting assistance soon. Ship is almost too damaged to survive!
(station defence)Sending urgent recall signal to all our ships in the area.
(station defence)This station needs your immediate assistance.
(station defence)Our station is in severe jeopardy!
(death 1)Aarrrssst!
(death 2)Hissssh!
(death 3)Profits and life all lost!
(shield warning 1)Shields soon fail!
(shield warning 2)Shields so weak now!
(hull warning 1)Hull losing pressure!
(hull warning 2)Hull soon breaks!
(Incoming Enemies)Here come the enemies!
(Incoming Wave)More enemies coming now. Stay focussed!
(Last Wave)This should see the last of them.
(Player Needed)Where are you? Teladi needs you here fast!
(Success 1)Success! I did not think I would survive this!
(Success 2)All stand down. We succeeded! Enemies sent packing!
(Fail 1)We lost, and at huge loss to ships.
(Fail 2)I am lost and seriously hurt!
(critical damage)I have a serious ship problem here!
(critical damage)My ship reactor is almost at overload!
(Incoming Enemies)I see enemies closing.
(Dangerous area)I said there would be no profit coming here. I see great potential for loss too!
(Plead for life 1)Please! No more, I beg! I submit!
(Plead for life 2)No more shooting, I beg you. Please!
(Plead for life 3)Please! Show mercy on Teladi!
(Plead for life 4)My ship is soon space-dust. Stop shooting, I beg you!
(player instructions)Follow us.
Stay close.
(followers)I will stick close to you.
Show us the way.
I am ready to start.
Ready to set out!
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)All personnel, stay calm. Walk swiftly to safety stations!(urging)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)Hello pilot. So, you are still interested in the mission?
(General 2)Hello, Sir. You seek to take the job then?
(Easy 1)You should not have any problems with this task.
(Easy 2)This job should be a simple slither in the sand for you.
(Hard 1)Are you sure you are suitable for this job?
(Hard 2)Teladi is not convinced. Can you avoid loss of profits?
(Fight Easy 1)This seems suitable for a shooter like you.
(Fight Easy 2)You seem the type who likes to destroy stuff!
(Fight Hard 1)I like your optimism, but I see much risk to profits here!
(Fight Hard 2)I hope you have Teladi insurance. Soon your family collects on it, maybe!
(Trade Easy 1)If you can shift standard goods, you are suitable.
(Trade Easy 2)This is a simple stores run. It should be no issue for a pilot such as you.
(Trade Hard 1)I seek a top freighter service. Can you provide that without loss of face?
(Trade Hard 2)I have doubts that you can meet my standards. Can you show this Teladi is wrong?
(Acceptance Query 1)So? Are you still in?
(Acceptance Query 2)Still interested?
(Accept 1)Superb! I sensed this job was for you.
(Accept 2)Accepted, that is good news.
(Reluctant 1)Teladi is concerned. I must trust you can succeed.
(Reluctant 2)So! You must ask for support from good spirits. You will need some.
(Reject 1)Sorry, I cannot send someone like you.
(Reject 2)You might take this job and fail, then you will lose us many credits.
(Info 1)I am transferring the job details to your system now.
(Info 2)The tasks details are being sent now.
(Success 1)Splendid. I knew you would succeed.
(Success 2)Excellent! Teladi knew pilot would surprise him.
(Semi 1)Some credits will be given. Though no losses, yet there are few profits.
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)Teladi hoped you would make him many credits. Still, it is good it is not a total loss.
(Fail 1)Was that supposed to be your best? You wasted my time and yours!
(Fail 2)That was a serious loss of face and credits!
(Credits 1)I am transferring the credits to you now.
(Reward 1)Please, take this as extra thanks.
(Client abort)Sorry, but it seems that I don't need your services anymore.
(mission update)Change of plans. See your new job briefing.
(mission update 2)Your job details have changed. Please look at your system now.
(Assassination Offer 1)I suggest a target. Someone goes and makes the target disappear for sure. Many credits change hands. Simple!
(Assassination Offer 2)This person must be stopped, by any means. Understand pilot?
(Target)They sent you after me in hope of profits? This should be fun!
(Target 2)You have no hope of success. You should not be silly!
(Bribe 1)Teladi asks if we can make a deal? No-one else needs to know of this.
(Success)They stood no chance!
(Fail)How did the target escape? You said you were skilled at this!
(Fail by bribe)I suspect you make credits in side deal. You seek to out-deal Teladi?
(Protect Station Offer 1)Listen, we need help to bolster our defences. We expect serious opposition soon.
(Protect Station Offer 2)Hostile ships will soon be here. We cannot evacuate in time. Can you assist our defence ships?
(Protect Ship Offer 1)I need assistance! I seek help quickly!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)I am in distress! I am being assaulted and look for assistance!
(Police 1)I know that smugglers have used this area many times. I need an unmarked ship to get close and scan for such ships.
(Success 1)Excellent. We can follow the leads and find the sources of the smuggling. That will save loss of credits.
(Semi 1)You found no smugglers? That is sad, but not a total loss since they remain unaware of our surveillance.
(Fail 1)So, you sat there doing nothing and still want us to pay you credits? You are insane!
(Passenger Offer 1)I must make a deal somewhere else very soon. Can your ship transport Teladi that fast?
(Passenger Offer 2)I must leave here as soon as possible. Can you assist Teladi?
(On Board)All set, Teladi is safely aboard.
(Space)You have insufficient space for me. You must find me a seat.
(Late)So, you expect Teladi forgets the time? I must be there very soon. Speed up!
(Fail)You were too slow and Teladi has lost credits now. You must drop me at the nearest station!
(Assigned to platform)Yes, Sir. I will go to my assigned quarters.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)I need some goods delivered swiftly. Interested in earning credits?
(Return Ware Offer)I need someone to bring some wares to us. Are you interested in making profits?
(Late Sell)Our client has told me that the goods are still not in-situ. Please speed up delivery!
(Late Return)I still await those supplies. Are you close? I feel profits seeping away!
(Fail Sell)Our client is most unhappy. This will cost us both dearly!
(Fail Return)Forget my business contract. I will seek the goods somewhere else.
(Emergency Offer)If someone hears this, I have a bad situation here. I need help. Please respond!
(Emergency Offer)Sending a wide-band appeal! I need assistance! Please respond soon!
(Emergency Offer)Help me! Is anyone receiving this? Please respond!
(station manager)Docking permission granted.
Welcome aboard, Sir.
You are most sincerely welcomed aboard, Sir.
Sir, it is my pleasure to welcome you aboard.
Thank you for sorting out that enemy of our station.
(Defence manager thanking player)Splendidly done, Albion Skunk!
(Defence manager thanking player)One less enemy troubles us. You deserve my thanks.
Thank you for your assistance. Your credits are being transferred.
(trader introduction)Hello, pilot. Is there something I can assist you with?
(trader introduction)Greetings! Something take your fancy? I have many good deals.
(trader introduction)Hello, Sir. Looking for something at a special price?
(trader introduction)See my listings. Something not shown here is probably unnecessary!
(trader introduction)These are all supreme products!
(generic trader)This is what I can make you good deals for.
(performing service)I will soon make progress.
All set and done.
(Confirm sale/handoff)This is signed and sealed.
(Confirm agreement)I am satisfied.
(giving object or info){,1018}
(weapon/upgrade trader)Here are some splendid systems that will safely fit your ship.
Restocking your ammo is crucial these days. I can give excellent deals.
Someone who leaves port without full stocks of ammunition is most stupid.
These are all superb products!
Mine are amongst the finest products in the sector.
Splendid choices.
So, how many do you seek?
Is there something else I can make you offers for?
Let me see how we can get this to suit your ship.
Let me start work on your ship.
See here. See the new, superior Albion Pride.
Your modifications are most satisfactory. Your new 'Pride' will support more testing missions now.
Fantastic job on this, although I say so myself. See your new improved 'Pride' of Albion.
(Shady trader)Pssst. You seek something of a 'special' nature? We supply only the most 'special' of goods here.('special' meaning illegal)
See my 'specialities' in stock! You be sure you keep all this silent outside of this station!
How many items can you shift while under the noses of the authorities?
(licence trader)I can sell you licenses. Come closer.
These are the licenses I supply, but not to just anyone.
Some pilots forget that a licence carries responsibilities!
I supply you with this licence so that you can assist this faction in its aims and desires.
(deal confirmations)Accepted.
Teladi strikes a deal.
Satisfactory.
Most certainly.
(accepting gift from player){,4300|4302}
Teladi is here to assist.
Yes, what do you seek of me?
(emergency call)Help me please!
Someone, please respond!
Assistance needed here. Please respond!
Requesting utmost speed of assistance!
(station contacting player)Station command to strange vessel.
Station command to Mister Otani.
(attacking object ally)Attacks such as yours will be strongly resisted. No profits come of such actions.
I will not stand for your actions.
You will soon be sorry for your actions.
We will now seek recompense!
I hope that was an accident.
Your actions will have consequences.
(player uncovered as enemy)Your pretence has been discovered.
(station contacting law)Station command to supporting law enforcement units.
I am assailed!
Requesting assistance.
(police)Yes, we're sending units at once.
Sorry, we cannot support you just now. We have no spare ships.
(NPC request for help rejected)What outweighs the loss of profits here?
(NPC request for help rejected)Teladi faces ruinous losses!
Report concerning, Mister Ren Otani.
Sending details of Mister Otani.
Sending details straight away.
He is on our system.
He turns up again.
He is a well-known suspect.
Details received.
It is her once more.
She is a known suspect.
Contacting law enforcement officers.
(Found discount)This is a Teladi sensation. A once in a lifetime chance for profits.
(Found discount)Greetings! I have discovered a special offer just for you.
(discount offer)I offer you a splendid price on these items.
(discount offer)I offer you a special price. A Teladi seldom offers such as this!
(discount explanation)Two Teladi sisters in the firm make big deals at same time, for the same wares.
(discount explanation)Teladi station recently offers bonus payments to workers. Production soars.
(discount explanation)Some supplies were taken as salvage from rivals of Teladi who had an 'accident' in space. They are not recovering well in business!
(player station manager)Reporting a situation, Sir.
(player station manager)Sir, I am having an issue here.
My station has stopped progress.
Station operation has been stopped.
Sending details now...
Please advise...
I seek more resources.
I have insufficient resources for use.
(can also be used for ships)The cargo space is stuffed full of stores. Teladi is normally most joyful at this.
(can also be used for ships)Our storage bays are ever so full. Teladi thinks this is usually a good situation to be in!
(architect)We seek a manager.
(can also be used for ships)Here are some possible options for improving our operations.
(can also be used for ships)This is what you could do to assist us become more self-sufficient.
(defence officer)We are being assaulted, requesting assistance!
We have been assailed by hostile forces, requesting support units!
(exchange wares)Who do you want us to exchange these goods with?
Which ware do you seek to transfer?
What do you want us to transfer?
Please say how much.
Please show how many, Sir.
Please specify an amount.
Yes, starting transfer.
Yes, Sir. Transfer under way.
Do you want me to equip the target with these, or just store them away as cargo wares?
I am short of credits.
Unless you say otherwise, Sir, I will restock my budget from your funds.
Back to business and profits as usual, have a nice business day.
Please seek me out to discuss my budget as soon as you can.
Confirming said budget changes.
I will begin operations as soon as I get there.
(rejecting impossible mode order)I am sorry. That is not possible in this case.
What will my mission be there?
What is my destination?
(Witness)Do not assume that I missed seeing that!
(Witness threatened or bribed)Ah! If you say so...I am sure I did not see anything suspicious.
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)Do not make silly jokes!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#smile#)Teladi respect you. (#nod01#)You have prevented much loss recently!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)(#warm#)I have seen newscasts about your exploits. (#rolleyes01#)You will be a challenge to trade with, I think.
Sir, is this new assignment just for me, or should I take all my assigned ships?
(Pilot sold his ship)I hope you will assign me a new post, seeing as you have sold my ship!
(new assignment)At once, Sir. What is my new assignment?
Yes, I will jump to your coordinates and support your fleet.
Sir, I have your instructions. I will move to your coordinates and serve under your command.
Sir, do you have an assignment for me? If you are busy I will just join your squad for now.
(Manager)Sir? You have a ship for me?
(Manager)The new ship will be used as per my assigned orders.
(NPC already assigned to job)Sir, this is my current assignment.
(Player scanned)Pay no attention to us, Teladi ships routinely scan others for illegal items.
(Player scanned)I ask pilot to assist us by cooperating with scan.
(Player scanned - aggressive)Teladi pilot thinks you seek to avoid tariffs and fees!
(Player scanned - aggressive)Teladi pilot searches for what you seek to hide from me!
(nothing found)You seem clean. Press on with your journey and make good profits.
(nothing found)Scans all finished. Thanks for your assistance.
(nothing found - aggressive)You have wasted my precious time. Leave here fast!
(nothing found - aggressive)So, you are clear this time. I will see you again soon, I sense.
(contraband found - police)This is Teladi police, I see contraband on board your ship.
(contraband found - police)Teladi authorities know you carry illegal items. Now you must submit to my orders.
(drop instruction)Drop the illegal goods or face the consequences!
(pirate plundering)Today I will make much profit!
(pirate plundering)Such expensive illegal items. This is what I wanted to see!
(drop instruction)You must eject some wares for me and, perhaps, I will not have to turn nasty!
(dropped)You make a sound decision.
(dropped)Smart choice. Now set off out of here.
(dropped part)I see you want to play tricks.
(dropped part)That is an insult to a Teladi. You offer too few profits.
(#smile#)Well said, you speak with style and confidence.
(#sad#)I so wish I could speak as well as you!
(#warm#)I am most amused by your style of speech. Please say something else!
(#smile#)Teladi enjoys company of such a speaker. This is superb!
(#smile#)You are a smooth-talker, are you not!
(#nod01#)You seem to know what you are speaking about!
You are convincing. (#smile#)Teladi likes what you say.
(#nod01#)Press on, this is quite amusing!
Please continue, for now.
I am still listening, so far at least.
This subject is of some passing interest to me.
Do not stop at that, say something more interesting.
(#gesticulate01#)You will have to do better, I have other business soon.
(#gesticulate03#)You are losing me soon.
(#gesticulate04#)Please come straight to the point of this.
(#gesticulate02#)I cannot see your purpose in your choice of subject.
(#cold#)You are just wasting my time. Please stop now!
(#excuse#)This will see no profits. Let us stop now.
(#hard#)I see no point in continuing. You just smell of loss!
(#hard#)This conversation ends here. (#shrug01#)I have other customers.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)I am so pleased we had this conversation. I like you now.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#warm#)That was a refreshing discussion. (#thinking01#)Let me see what I can work out for you.
(offering service){,5}
(smalltalk station discount reward)I can offer a special trade deal at this station, (#smile#)you will appreciate this!
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)OK, I know someone really smart who is looking for a task with profits. This is their details.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)I know of a very skilled professional, perhaps exactly who you seek to hire for reasonable credits.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)If we make more deals now, I will offer you my best special discount.
(#rolleyes01#)Why are they being so mean to us?
Ah. An Argon. (#disapproval01#)You here to look down on me too?(the ARE is left out on purpose)
I'm sorry, it's just so hard to tell you people apart. (#shrug01#)You all look the same to me.
You speak the truth, friend. My sincerest apologies, (#nod01#)of course we should certainly avoid such escalation.
Well, maybe you guys should read the mood... but then again you have no scales. Maybe I should be more polite instead.(hissing)
(#scratchhead01#)What's all this fuss about AI anyway?
(#nod01#)You have my undivided attention!
Let me see. So you're saying that AGI is AI that can evolve. (#thinking01#)Sounds risky to me.
That's interesting. I see now how they may have got to this stage of their development.
Teladi hate war (#shrug01#)but I sense a looming conflict.
Go on, share your wisdom.
Quicker victory means fewer casualties means more survivors (#punchhand01#)means more customers means more profit!
(#rolleyes02#)I shall be preparing to be somewhere other than the combat zone!
I'm sure I could find a good deal on those and maybe a ship too, since I don't own one currently.
I'm not sure I'm ready to die... for you or anyone. (#disapproval01#)I think you should go now. Enough of your silliness!
(#nod01#)That's a very good idea. I will try to find the safest direction.
Just forty years ago there were not even highways here...
Thanks to Teladi ingenuity and enterprise (#nod01#)there have been many advancements, indeed.
It's a miracle of technology! (#smile#)Anything which speeds up trade transactions is fine by me.
(#thinking01#)I was not aware that such extra fuel was required in the past. Thank you for the information.
(#nod01#)This is an impressive innovation and worthy of Teladi investment.

page.title: Teladi NPC 2 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[teladi] female basic(cheerful)
(greeting friendly)Greetings friend. What a splendid day for trading!
(greeting neutral)Hello, you seek a partner in business?
(greeting enemy)You make me fear for my profits.
(greeting rejected)I have no deals for the likes of you!
(greeting service)Super to see you! You should certainly browse my services.
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)May all your deals bear splendid profits.
(goodbye neutral)I hope I will see further trade with you soon.
(goodbye enemy)Your unwanted presence has soured my day.
(goodbye rejected)My profits will come without your assistance.
(goodbye service)I look forward to your swift return for further services.
(ship scanned - compliant)Your scan will show what I have to trade? Do you want to speak of prices?
(ship scanned - neutral)You may find much of interest. I can suggest some trades if you want.
(ship scanned - illegal)You risk troubles with the authorities. You should ask me for trade-lists instead!
(ship scanned - enemy)Your scan angers me! I have no business suitable for you.
(ship scanned - confident)You will see that my business is all suitably licensed.
(ship scanned - possessing)I fear you have exposed a weakness of mine. I cannot resist a bargain when offered!
(station/capship scanned - compliant)You wish to discuss business while you scan?
(station/capship scanned - neutral)I see you scanning! Do you wish to trade or is this just curiosity?
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Your scanning is illegal. You must consider the costs if you are caught by the authorities.
(station/capship scanned - enemy)So, you wish to spy on Teladi, eh? Your motives are no doubt most suspect!
(station/capship scanned - confident)You waste time scanning us when you could be making profits. This seems silly to Teladi.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)Oh no! My sisters were supposed to ship that out at the last station!(annoyed)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)That was discovered floating and handed in for safe-keeping until disposed of properly. Teladi are upright citizens, yes?(devious)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)So that is what it was! I asked myself why the loaders went to great pains to distract us at the dock!(innocently)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)So you found it! I was sure it was safe to transport and store this time. Where is Teladi pilot to recover this sad loss?(despairing)
(directions - location not known)So sorry, I do not know where to suggest.
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Teladi pilot thinks you are being silly!
(surrender - hostile)Teladi pilot surrenders. The loss of this ship will ruin my business!
(surrender - compliant)Teladi pilot chooses life over profit. This was a most difficult decision!
(drops cargo 1)I sue for peace! I will spare you some goods.
(drops cargo 2)To save my ship I will leave you some stores!
(bail from ship 1)I leave my ship to you. Take my profits but spare my life.
(bail from ship 2)You have my ship. You must let Teladi eject safely.
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)Hello, Sir. I look forward to serving with you.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)At last, I meet you in person.
(hired comm greeting 2)I greet Mister Otani. Such a pleasure!
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)It is good that we meet at last, Sir.
(hired comm goodbye 1)Goodbye, Sir. It was a pleasure.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)See you again soon, Sir.
So, what would you like to discuss?
What shall we speak about?
(join squad)Joining your squad, Sir.
(leave squad)Leaving your squad, Sir.
(accept order 1)Yes, Sir!
(accept order 2)Understood!
(reject order 1)Sorry, Sir, that is not possible .
(reject order 2)That does not make sense.
(Automatic)Commencing Automatic operations as instructed, Sir.
(standby)Standing by. I hope to hear from you soon, Sir
Yes.
Understood.
Sorry, not this time.
(jumpdrive charging)Coordinates selected. Jump Drive sequencing.
(jumpdrive aborted)Aborting jump sequence.
(jumpdrive engaged)Jump Drive sequence almost complete.
(jumpdrive emergency)I am starting a rapid escape. Jumping now!
(jumpdrive cool-down)Unable to jump. The Jump Drive is still sequencing.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Starting Jump Drive sequence.
(jumpdrive success)Jump successful, Sir. It seems that all systems still show clear.
(engage boost to player)Now boosting to assigned location.
(engage boost)Boosters selected.
(follow)I will stay behind you, Sir.
(moveto)Yes, just setting off now.
(moveto dock)Setting out for safe docking.
(docked)Docking is successful.
(task completed)Successfully completed, Sir.
(confirm no change)As you say, Sir. I will persist with current orders.
(arrived)I am situated as ordered, Sir.
(arrived)I have reached there safe and sound.
(arrived at player)I am pulling alongside, Sir.
(arrived at player)I can see you now, Sir.
Yes, Sir. Taking up defensive stance.
(greeting to player on boarding own station)Sir, I'm ecstatic to see you aboard.
(lost drones for current task)Those drones are missing. You must issue other orders.
(task start but low on drones)Yes, I am short of suitable drones so expect issues later.
(no drones to start task)Sorry, Sir. I have no such drones on board.
(restock request to player)I must have a resupply of drones.
