(#facepalm01#)This conversation must stop. I must attend to other business.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)I must express my sincere admiration of you.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#smile#)Our discussion has sealed our companionship.
(offering service){,4400}
(smalltalk station discount reward)I will tell you of a station where those with introductions may gain significant discounts.
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)These are the details of someone who seeks employment. They have my express recommendation.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)Here is a professional who you could hire. Their skills and commonsense are most impressive.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)Let us do some trade now. (#smile#)I will apply my most special discount for these negotiations.
(#disapproval01#)Argons. Always acting all high and mighty.
(#angry#)Oh look, another one looking down their nose at me! What do you want?
You bet I have. (#angry#)Some of these punks don't know their place, I can tell you!
(#sad#)You're right about that, Argon. I rarely feel welcome around here, it's so sad.
(#warm#)I'm very pleased to hear that, Argon. (#nod01#)I wish there were more around like you.
(#shrug01#)I don't understand why everyone is getting so wound up about AI.
(#nod01#)I'd be very interested to hear what you have to say on the matter!
As I understand it, AGI is AI that has developed the ability to evolve.
(#nod01#)That would explain a lot about their development as a 'race'.
(#sad#)Is there yet another war on the way?
I don't like war (#shrug01#)but maybe you can share your wisdom.
(#sad#)The shorter the better to avoid unnecessary suffering.
(#excuse#)I'm afraid I'll be getting ready to run in the opposite direction. (#shrug01#)We Teladi are a peaceful people.
Hmm. I don't have a ship, unfortunately. (#shrug01#)If I did, I'd be flying far away from here.
(#facepalm01#)I don't think that's a good idea... dying. That would definitely hurt my profits. (#crossarms01#)You can take such ideas away with you!
(#crossarms01#)Yes. Great idea. Goodbye!
So beautiful, (#shrug01#)yet so unreal.
For Humans (#shrug01#)but these holo-dancers lack proper shape and colour.
(#disapproval01#)If you consider such ugly images decoration.
(#sad#)Teladi advice to fulfil VR's long-term potential has gone ignored. Shame really. Now there's lots of risk.
(#nod01#)Well that may give more work to Teladi, so good news!
Exactly. (#rolleyes01#)Nothing good will come of this in the long run.
Yeah, I could see something like that happening in a number of ways. (#rolleyes02#)Extreme but not impossible ways.
(#smile#)They didn't even have highways forty years ago... amazing.
(#nod01#)Inspiring increase in technological development.
(#smile#)Such a technology will have a very positive effect on trade. (#punchhand01#)That's very good for me!
(#thinking01#)I was not aware of this fact. Very interesting.
(#smile#)Such magical technologies will pave the way to new profit opportunities.
(#disapproval01#)This PMC did what?!
Not all of it. Do you have more?
(#nod01#)This is incredible. Please tell.
(#sad#)They have kept this under wraps for too long.
(#sad#)This is a very unsettling development. I hope those guilty are brought to justice.
(#nod01#)The source only needs to be reliable and the evidence authentic.
(#laugh#)I sense a disturbance in Plutarch's profit margins.
(#gesticulate01#)This couldn't be more important! You shouldn't keep such things a secret. (#punchhand01#)Go now and tell everyone!

page.title: Teladi NPC 3 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[teladi] female basic(grumpy)
(greeting friendly)Yes, what do you want of Teladi?
(greeting neutral)Be quick, this is not a good day for Teladi!
(greeting enemy)Why do you cast your shadow over my day?
(greeting rejected)I have no time for this!
(greeting service)You seek my services, or not?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)Maybe we speak of business again.
(goodbye neutral)Speak again when business is better.
(goodbye enemy)Go and sell your sisters into slavery!
(goodbye rejected)Speak no more.
(goodbye service)Come back if you need. Some work must pay the bills here.
(ship scanned - compliant)Scan and see that I have nothing of worth. Such poor trade so far!
(ship scanned - neutral)Scan if you insist, but I want recompense for my time.
(ship scanned - illegal)You shall see the error of your ways when I tell the authorities! Or perhaps we discuss a deal for silence?
(ship scanned - enemy)You cast a shadow of fear through your sordid interest!
(ship scanned - confident)I have nothing held in secret. See for yourself
(ship scanned - possessing)I just need to get those to the next station where I can secure the licences ...
(station/capship scanned - compliant)Scan if you must. You waste our time.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Why do you stick your nose into my business?
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Your illegal scanning angers me. Stop before I call the authorities and seek compensation.
(station/capship scanned - enemy)What is the purpose of your scan? This leads perhaps to something more aggressive?
(station/capship scanned - confident)Just ask what we possess and we will all save wasted business time.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)So? It is not as if you can do something about it!(belligerent)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)See here! That cannot be ours. No sane Teladi would hold such stores in open view!(in denial)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)That is the downside of trading for mixed lots. Sometimes there are things you would prefer not to see. You understand?(persuasive)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)Another setback! What else can go amiss on this tour of business?(despondent)
(directions - location not known)Why do you ask me?
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Get lost!
(surrender - hostile)So, you force my surrender. What choices do you leave?
(surrender - compliant)I submit! So now my business goes under!
(drops cargo 1)For profit's sake, accept these and shove off!
(drops cargo 2)Stop shooting and fight amongst yourselves for my leavings!
(bail from ship 1)I submit and leave ship! There is no profit in loss of life.
(bail from ship 2)I surrender my ship! I have already lost everything else.
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)Yes? I see you.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)So, you are the boss!
(hired comm greeting 2)What is your business with me?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)I assume you have instructions for me?
(hired comm goodbye 1)Comms closed.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)I will go now.
What is your business?
I see you. What do you seek?
(join squad)Joining squad.
(leave squad)Leaving squad.
(accept order 1)Yes.
(accept order 2)That is indeed possible.
(reject order 1)No.
(reject order 2)Not possible.
(Automatic)Automatic operations are running.
(standby)Standing by.
Yes.
Understood.
No.
(jumpdrive charging)Charging drive for jump.
(jumpdrive aborted)Aborting jump.
(jumpdrive engaged)Drive almost charged.
(jumpdrive emergency)I am escaping by jumping!
(jumpdrive cool-down)The Jump Drive must settle first.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Starting jump sequence.
(jumpdrive success)Jump successful. Systems clear, as far as I can see.
(engage boost to player)Boosting to you.
(engage boost)Boosters engaged.
(follow)I will be in support.
(moveto)Setting off.
(moveto dock)Setting out for dock.
(docked)Docking successful.
(task completed)It is done.
(confirm no change)Staying on same orders.
(arrived)I am there.
(arrived)I have arrived.
(arrived at player)I am beside you.
(arrived at player)I see you.
Starting guard duty.
(greeting to player on boarding own station)So, you come aboard.
(lost drones for current task)My drones are all lost. Send new orders.
(task start but low on drones)We are short of drones. Expect issues soon.
(no drones to start task)I have no drones suitable.
(restock request to player)Restock my drones.
(request additional ships)I need more ships for this.
(received additional ship)I will set her to work.
That contradicts our present operation.
Stopping operations.
Send new orders.
(Player loses licence)Mister Otani, your licence with us is cancelled.
You know the reasons.
My ship condition is serious. What next?
(movement status)I am stationary and need assistance!
Setting off to nearest shipyard.
I am at the shipyard. Awaiting orders.
My Jump Drive is down and needs repair first.
I will jump when possible.
I am docked at the shipyard. Send a new set of orders.
My engine is useless. See to it first.
I will move when possible.
Starting emergency jump.
Emergency jump successful. Send new orders.
I am leaving this zone.
I am safely out of the zone. Send instructions.
I have insufficient fuel to jump so far.
I need more fuel to jump as far.
Heading to fuel station.
I must refuel before the jump.
Fuel supplies depleted. Resupply needed here.
Insufficient jump energy. Fuel stations are out of range. I need assistance.
Insufficient jump fuel. Setting up a jump using generator only.
I am short of jump energy. I will see if I force a jump.
Bring sufficient fuel supplies to see me through the jump.
(Hired Architect)Architect speaking. What services do you want?
(Asked how to get building resources)I need resources for all constructions. How should I arrange this?
I have everything I need. Be sure you want the station here. Once I start, that is it.
Module complete. Standing by for next construction task.
Station complete. It is satisfactory.
This module is next for construction.
These modules are available for construction. They are determined by the design progress.
Be sure you want this module. Once I start, there is no reversal.
Satisfactory. We will start straight away.
Architect speaking. Your station will need a Station Manager. Hire one and send them here.
I can construct these stations.
(builder ship moving)Moving to site.
(Ship builder)Want a new spaceship? See here for details.
That is sufficient. Sure you want this ship? Once I start you must pay. No refunds!
Ship complete.
Surely you can see I am busy! See my boards and come back later.
Your ship will need a pilot. Make sure someone suitable is here very soon, or else I must start to charge docking fees!
This is my ship list.
You did not supply enough credits.
(PC: You take care of it.)That is enough credits to press on with.
These extensions are suitable. Some will need others too.
Adjust the upgrade levels and issue the order to start.
Select the hull repair percentage for us to work to.
This lists the available modules for the station.
This lists my resource status.
(architect)I will transfer surplus credits back to you after construction is over. I assume you will leave a tip for the staff?
(Initiate Trade)Trade deals set up. I am on my way there.
(Receive)Set to receive wares.
(Deliver)Set to deliver wares.
(Fail Space)Cargo space is too full for this.
(Fail Type)That type of ware does not fit this ship.
(Fail Space Standby)My cargo space is full. Standing by for other orders.
(Fail Buy Amount)Another mistake! The necessary amount is not for sale here. I will buy what I can and push on, unless told otherwise.
(Fail Sell Amount)For profit's sake! Nobody wants the full amount of goods here. I will sell what I can and set off - if you say so.
(Fail Buy Ware) The specified good is not sold here and we have wasted time. Moving to the next order, unless instructed otherwise.
(Fail Sell Ware)The specified good is not bought here. How could we get this so wrong? I will swap to the next order, unless you say otherwise.
(Fail Buy Price)The current price exceeds my limit. Say now or I will purchase the said amount. Such a deal makes a Teladi most sad.
(Fail Sell Price)I cannot sell our goods for the expected price here. Say soon or I will sell the specified amount anyway. A Teladi trader would be sickened by such a loss!
(Fail)The requested trade is impossible here. Send new orders.
I have surplus credits from trade. I will send you the surplus unless you order something else. At least something must have gone well.
Deal agreed. Sending details now.
Destination reached, setting up trade.
(fixed something)Seems fixed.
(fixed something)Seems serviceable.
(fixed something)Seems OK now.
(Initiate Mining)Standing by to start mining operations.
(Launch)Sending collectors.
(Recall)Recalling collectors.
(Automatic)Starting Automatic operations.
(Fail Type)That sort of ware does not fit my ship.
The drones will pick up things you tag.
The drones will prioritise things you tag.
I have no collector drones.
My drones will start collecting.
I have ceased mining. I will follow you unless you send other orders.
My ship is full now. Setting off for your position.
(Squad member)Some officious person has told me to drop my cargo!
It was a police ship.
It was a seemingly hostile ship.
Should I comply or not?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
Awaiting order to start.
(scan successful)Scan received - assessing suitable sites for assault.
I select this spot.
(not scanned)This spot seems as good as any other.
(boarding pod launching)Pods away.
(boarding pod hit)Seeing defensive fire!
(marines under fire)Marines under fire!
(pod attached)Hull reached and drilling started.
(marine entering ship)Hull penetrated. Securing access.
Team shaking out.
Setting off. Stay sharp!
(marine on alert)Enemies massing ahead.
(loud)Contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
Shoot them down!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Do not waste a shot!
(lots of fighting noise)Callsign injured!
(lots of fighting noise)Shut down that sensor!
(lots of fighting noise)Bypass that position!
(lots of fighting noise)Secure our flank!
(combat)Step lively!
(quiet)Shh! Let them come to us.
(assist mission successful)Enemy leaving positions.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Enemy still there. Suppress them on my order.
(assist mission successful)Sentries all silenced!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Sentries staying active. Take them out!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)I am at the system console.
(marine hacking)Starting system hack.
(assist mission successful)Auto-sentries shutting down.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Auto-sentries still engaging! Find their blind spots.
Self-destruct engaged! Start the override!
(relieved)Self-destruct shut down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)No time left! Escape to the pods!
(boarding successful)Success! We have control of all systems.
Too many casualties to succeed! Fight back to the pods.
The hull is failing! Sprint to the pods!
We are bringing the pods home!
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)Someone help me!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Another casualty!
Arrssst..(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by load bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Step back! Blast this hatch!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Supporting fire!
(lots of fighting noise)Steady! Steady!
(checking for enemies)This area is clear.
(sound of laser fire)Laser sentries!
Force field sighted ahead.
(assist mission successful)The force field has shut down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We need a bypass route.
The ships's crew surrender. She is ours!(cheers)
They show submission! The station is taken!(cheers)
We seem outnum--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)The target is ours!
(upgrades)Successfully upgraded. Setting out.
Successfully downgraded. Setting off.
Upgrades installed.
Choose the ship to upgrade.
Which upgrade should be installed?
(*Hiring*)
You have someone in that post already.
You have an Engineer.
You have a Marine Officer.
Am I to replace somebody specific, or should I go somewhere else?
You will be satisfied with my service.
Finally, you make a sensible decision in securing my service.
(On board introduction)Crew members, I am here to show you my professional superiority.
(Fired in space)Set me down at the next station. I will seek a sensible employer this time.
(Fired on platform)I leave you to your miserable existence now.
(Assign to object)I will assume my new duties.
(Assign to ship)I will assume command of that ship.
(Return to player)I will return soon.
(Leave player)Thus I depart your presence.
(Leave player)So now I go, and you feel my loss.
(Showing skills)Teladi is very skilled. You see this here.
(Showing skills)If these skills do not impress then you are ignorant of my business.
(Sell ship)I sold that ship. You have gained some credits but was the sale was sensible? That is yet to be seen.
(Sell ship)I sold your ships for many credits. I hope Teladi gets a cut of the profits!
(respond to free mode)You trust me. That was unexpected, but not unpleasant.
(respond to free mode)I anticipated your choice. My decisions are surely superior to yours in this field!
(respond to restricted mode)I will pass on all your orders. You do not trust Teladi decisions, that is a significant mistake!(sardonic)
(respond to restricted mode)Understood. You will be responsible for all big decisions. Teladi professional will have much time to play holo-games.(very bored)
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)So are you stupid or just bored?
(player attacks - friendly 2)Stop that! Just say what you want instead!
(player attacks - neutral 1)Such a bad day already, and now it gets worse!
(player attacks - neutral 2)See here! Some day you will seriously regret this!
(player attacks - enemy 1)Your action suggests that Teladi must take some strong measures against you!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Stop your actions or face serious consequences!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)If you seek the retaliation of the Teladi authorities, you will soon succeed!
(big object attacked)Open your eyes! Can you not see the size of your target?
(big object attacked)Someone tell this pesky pilot that our patience is not inexhaustible!
(light fire 1)Somebody seems upset with me!
(light fire 2)Somebody make this nuisance go away!
(mid fire 1)I have a persistent assailant that needs removal soon!
(mid fire 2)I have nothing for you! Seek your ill-gained profits elsewhere!
(heavy fire 1)Soon my ship will cease to exist!
(heavy fire 2)Assistance must come quick if I am to survive!
(heavy fire 3)My life is at serious risk! Help Teladi and we can discuss rewards later!
(station defence)Where are all the ships supposed to protect this station? Reinforcements are needed quickly.
(station defence)Save our station and I suppose we can spare you some credits.
(station defence)Somebody come and assist our incompetent station defence forces!
(death 1)Aarrrssst!
(death 2)Hisssshh!
(death 3)My sisters!
(shield warning 1)Shields useless!
(shield warning 2)Shields wasted!
(hull warning 1)Hull depressurising!
(hull warning 2)Hull soon submits to vacuum!
(Incoming Enemies)Finally, the enemies show!
(Incoming Wave)Yet more enemies closing!
(Last Wave)This seems the last wave of enemies.
(Player Needed)Why are you absent? Teladi needs you!
(Success 1)That was close! We win, but at great cost
(Success 2)Enemies lose this time. We succeeded, but not without loss.
(Fail 1)We failed, with massive losses.
(Fail 2)This failure leaves me in great distress!
(critical damage)My ship is almost useless!
(critical damage)My ship system says little still works!
(Incoming Enemies)I see enemies closing.
(Dangerous area)Coming here was always a mistake! Nobody saw sense when I protested.
(Plead for life 1)I submit! Spare Teladi this time!
(Plead for life 2)Stop! Teladi throws herself at pilot's mercy!
(Plead for life 3)Please cease your shooting! Think of my sisters!
(Plead for life 4)Soon I will be no more. I beg you to stop!
(player instructions)Follow us.
Stay close.
(followers)We will stay behind you.
Show us the way.
I am all set.
Ready to set off.
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)Sisters and hatchlings first. See them to the evacuation centres.(urging)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)So, are you still interested?
(General 2)Is this task for you then?
(Easy 1)This task is simple. Do not get stressed about it.
(Easy 2)This task would be suitable for a hatchling.
(Hard 1)How can you convince me you are up to this task?
(Hard 2)Teladi fears you squander all our profits by your faint hopes of success!
(Fight Easy 1)This is an easy target. You do not risk much.
(Fight Easy 2)You are callous! You will not squirm at such an easy kill.
(Fight Hard 1)Your optimism grates on my nerves! I risk as much as you!
(Fight Hard 2)You stake your life, I stake my business. It amounts to the same!
(Trade Easy 1)Even you should suit this simple stores run.
(Trade Easy 2)Your skills as a freight mover should not be stretched by this.
(Trade Hard 1)Only the best will succeed at this. For moving freight, are you the best option?
(Trade Hard 2)Teladi has serious doubts about your suitability. This is not an average delivery task.
(Acceptance Query 1)So, still in?
(Acceptance Query 2)You still want this?
(Accept 1)I accept. You get started.
(Accept 2)So, we are in business.
(Reluctant 1)Teladi is much stressed. I have to trust in your bid for success.
(Reluctant 2)Teladi does not believe in luck. Teladi believes in skill and business-sense. You must apply these to this task!
(Reject 1)You are unsuitable.
(Reject 2)You risk too much loss. No job.
(Info 1)The job details are on your system.
(Info 2)The task details are on your ship system.
(Success 1)Not so bad. You were satisfactory.
(Success 2)That is a surprise. You succeeded.
(Semi 1)Hiss. A few credits only. You make us few profits.
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)That is disappointing. At least it was not a total loss.
(Fail 1)I was right! You are a waste of Teladi attention.
(Fail 2)That will severely damage my business! You are a disaster!
(Credits 1)I can spare you these credits.
(Reward 1)I hate doing this, but here is a bonus.
(Client abort)Your services are surplus to client requirements.
(mission update)See your system for a change of job details.
(mission update 2)Your briefing has altered; check your system for the updates.
(Assassination Offer 1)I want someone killed. It is really that simple!
(Assassination Offer 2)I want to see evidence that a person is permanently neutralised.
(Target)You pose no threat to me! Go back and confess your incompetence!
(Target 2)You think a few credits balance the risks to your life? You are outclassed here.
(Bribe 1)Let us consider a deal instead. I fly away, you make more credits, and no-one is the wiser.
(Success)They could not escape!
(Fail)They escaped? You made such claims of your prowess! All lies!
(Fail by bribe)You cannot fool Teladi! I know when I sense a double-cross!
(Protect Station Offer 1)As if our day could get any worse! Hostiles are expected here soon. Please assist out defences and keep them away from this station.
(Protect Station Offer 2)Our station is the target of an incoming raiding party. If you can assist our defence then we will pay expenses and maybe a reward.
(Protect Ship Offer 1)I have raiders on my tail. Please come and see them off!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Any combat-capable pilots. Come and save me from these attackers and I will see you rewarded!
(Police 1)Smugglers frequent this route. An unmarked ship can get close enough to scan such ships. Interested?
(Success 1)At last! These leads will help close down their operations. Here are your credits.
(Semi 1)You saw nothing? At least you did not spook them. Here are a few expenses.
(Fail 1)Nothing passed your position? Rubbish! You will get nothing for disclosing our operations to them!
(Passenger Offer 1)I must get somewhere fast. Are you interested in a paying passenger?
(Passenger Offer 2)I must move on soon. Get me somewhere fast for good credits!
(On Board)I am aboard. This place stinks of human sweat.
(Space)You have no space. Sort it out fast, or it is your loss.
(Late)Have you no sense of time? I despair and suspect you of incompetence!
(Fail)You are slow. Teladi has lost business now! Drop me off at a station soon.
(Assigned to platform)I will go where assigned.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)I need some goods delivered. Credits are available for a quick service.
(Return Ware Offer)I need some wares brought here fast. The profits can be shared.
(Late Sell)The client still awaits the goods. Speed up or we both fail!
(Late Return)Where are those supplies? You risk our profits unnecessarily!
(Fail Sell)The client has severed contact. My business is ruined by your incompetence!
(Fail Return)Cancel all my requirements. I will seek someone more consistent.
(Emergency Offer)Someone hearing this, help us out. Please respond!
(Emergency Offer)Sending on all frequencies! This is a distress call.
(Emergency Offer)This is a plea for assistance! Hear me out, please!
(station manager)You may dock.
Come aboard.
You may access our facilities.
You are permitted access to most decks.
Our station owes you a debt. I suspect that our thanks may not seem enough.
(Defence manager thanking player)You were of some use, Skunk!
(Defence manager thanking player)Pride, your actions deserve some credit.
Your assistance was useful. You will receive some credits.
(trader introduction)Is there something I can assist with? Business is slow just now.
(trader introduction)Do you see anything you desire? I hope you are not a time-waster.
(trader introduction)I offer sound prices. Cheap bargains are myths for fools!
(trader introduction)See my inventory. Anything besides that is not for sale, so do not ask!
(trader introduction)Of course my wares are top class! Why would you consider otherwise?
(generic trader)This is what I deal in.
(performing service)I will start.
Setting to work.
(Confirm sale/handoff)Agreed in principle.
(Confirm agreement)That is sufficient.
(giving object or info){,4110}
(weapon/upgrade trader)I can make these systems fit your ship, probably without significant damage!
Restocking ammo is always sensible. See me if you want to do so.
Flying with reduced ammunition stocks is never sensible. I can assist you there.
My products are the sensible choice!
I sell the best items in the sector.
Sensible choice.
So, how many?
Was there something else?
I will see this onto your ship.
Let me start on your ship.
See how the Albion Pride seems more sinister!
Your modifications sit well. Your missions can be more serious now.
Now 'Albion Pride' seems a more suitable name. She seems eager to show off.
(Shady trader)Pssst. If you seek only ordinary wares, then walk away now. Mine are all 'special'.('special' meaning illegal)
Here is what I stock. You will see these on show nowhere else!
How many can you conceal from the authorities?
(licence trader)I sell licenses. Come and see.
These licenses can be supplied, to the right clients.
Pilots sometimes ignore the constraints implicit in holding a licence, often to their cost!
Use this licence wisely, or you will just lose it again.
(deal confirmations)Satisfactory.
Deal struck.
Sufficient.
Yes.
(accepting gift from player){,4300|4302}
I may be able to assist.
What do you expect?
(emergency call)Assist me, I need help!
Someone, anyone! Return my call!
Assistance needed. Respond at once!
Set course for my position. I need assistance!
(station contacting player)Station command to arriving vessel.
Station command calls Mister Otani.
(attacking object ally)Attacks such as yours are offensive to Teladi. Loss of credits is the least you should fear.
Teladi will expose your actions.
You will soon feel regret.
Compensation is the least you can offer!
I hope that incident was unintentional.
Severe consequences will follow your actions.
(player uncovered as enemy)Your subterfuge is exposed.
(station contacting law)Station command to local authorities.
I am under assault!
I seek assistance.
(police)Police units are speeding to your position.
Support is not possible at any time soon. Our ships are already tasked.
(NPC request for help rejected)A typically substandard support service!
(NPC request for help rejected)Without police assistance, Teladi losses may be astronomical!
Police report concerns Otani.
Sending details for Otani.
Sending Otani details.
He shows on our system.
He shows up yet again.
He is well-known to us.
Details being analysed.
It is Tarren once again.
She is also known to us.
Contacting officers of the law.
(Found discount)This is most unusual. There is a substantial chance of seeing profits here.
(Found discount)Here is a special place where I can see a substantial discount.
(discount offer)I offer spectacular prices on these items.
(discount offer)This is a rare offer! Do not dismiss it!
(discount explanation)My sisters could not agree who was to place the orders. There was confusion as to the amounts to be purchased as a result.
(discount explanation)Teladi managers are more efficient at business. Our stockists sometimes forget this!
(discount explanation)Our sources for goods are confidential. Sometimes it is better not to ask questions!
(player station manager)We have an issue.
(player station manager)There is a slip-up.
The station is at a standstill.
Station operation has stalled.
Sending an account.
Send advice.
I need a resupply of resources.
I must have more resources.
(can also be used for ships)My ship has no more space. Something must be sold off.
(can also be used for ships)I have no more storage left. Find something to transfer or sell.
(architect)We ask for a manager.
(can also be used for ships)Some possible options for increasing operations.
(can also be used for ships)Steps you can take to increase our efficiency.
(defence officer)We are under assault, requesting urgent assistance!
We are seeing a new enemy offensive. Support ships report to duty stations and assist!
(exchange wares)Who gets this transfer?
Which ware?
What is for transfer?
How much?
How many?
What amount?
Starting transfer.
Transfer has commenced.
Are these to be equipped or stored as wares?
I have insufficient credits!
Say now, or I will supplement my budget from your funds.
Back to business.
Speak about my budget as soon as possible.
I see the budget changes.
I will start operations when there.
(rejecting impossible mode order)That is impossible.
What is my mission there?
What is the destination?
(Witness)I saw everything and will report you to the authorities!
(Witness threatened or bribed)All right, there is no need to get aggressive! You will get away with it, as usual!
(Witness rejecting threat/bribe)Do not act so stupid. I am stronger than that!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)Teladi knows of you. (#crossarms01#)You are the big-shot hero who saved the day!
(Skipping smalltalk due to fame)I watch the newscasts. (#crossarms01#)I suppose you would be useful to show as a customer.
Is this just for me, or do I take my ships too?
(Pilot sold his ship)You sell my ship and then expect me to sniff around for a new assignment?
(new assignment)So where is my assignment?
I will join the fleet at your position.
I will move to you and set up in your fleet.
What is my next task? I shall join your squad if you are unable to decide.
(Manager)Which ship do you assign to me?
(Manager)I shall continue with that ship's current task.
(NPC already assigned to job)Come now, surely you already know what I do for you?
(Player scanned)Just let us do our job of scanning you, and do not make any fuss.
(Player scanned)Sit tight and let us do the scan. It will be over soon.
(Player scanned - aggressive)You will keep no secrets from me. You can confess now if you want, it matters not!
(Player scanned - aggressive)Do not think you can conceal anything. I will find your nasty little secrets!
(nothing found)See? It was nothing. On your way now.
(nothing found)Scan complete. Clear the area; I have other ships to scan.
(nothing found - aggressive)So you escape this time. I will apply greater scrutiny when next we meet!
(nothing found - aggressive)You have nothing suspicious? This surprises me. We shall meet again!
(contraband found - police)Teladi police here, I see your ship is far from innocent.
(contraband found - police)We see your contraband. Now you must obey all police orders
(drop instruction)Drop the contraband or face serious penalties!
(pirate plundering)This will please my sisters. We were missing our luxuries!
(pirate plundering)There is some value in what I see. Perhaps I will be generous and let it suffice!
(drop instruction)You let me have some of that and perhaps I will not be so hasty with my weapons!
(dropped)Suddenly you start to act smart.
(dropped)A wise decision. Perhaps you will leave unmolested, this time
(dropped part)So, you treat Teladi pilot as if stupid!
(dropped part)That might please some pilots, but not this one!
You speak well with Teladi. (#nod01#)I suppose I am in your debt for that
(#warm#)I am reassured by your apparently sage knowledge.
I can see that you have more to say. (#shrug01#)I am not displeased by this,
(#nod01#)Teladi sees that your interests are not restricted just to business.
You speak as one who knows some things.
(#nod01#)You seem to know something of what you speak.
You show Teladi the essence of what you discuss.
You speak of matters with some certainty. Let us continue.
(#gesticulate01#)Please continue, I am listening for now.
(#excuse#)While I still listen, I might do some other things.
(#nod01#)Your points means something to me.
(#gesticulate04#)Do not stop there, say something of interest.
You must be concise, (#shrug01#)I have other business too.
(#crossarms01#)You start to lose my interest.
(#rolleyes01#)When will we get to the point of this?
(#rolleyes02#)I think your choice of subject is suspect.
(#disapproval01#)You waste my time on idle gossip. Enough now!
(#hard#)This goes nowhere. I will stop now.
(#angry#)I am losing business by talking to you! No more!
And so it ends. (#angry#)Another useless time-waster.
(smalltalk reward introduction)I was pleased by the conversation. (#warm#)I can deal with you.
(smalltalk reward introduction)(#warm#)That has stimulated my business appetite. (#thinking01#)Let us see what we can work out.
(offering service){,4400}
(smalltalk station discount reward)I can introduce you to a select discount club at this station!
(smalltalk medium stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)Here are the details of a hard worker for hire. You could do much worse.
(smalltalk good stats hireable reward)(LOCA: Keep it unisex)This professional has assisted me with impressive skill in the past. They seek a new position now.
(smalltalk self itemtrader discount)Let us make deals now. I will apply a generous discount; (#warm#)one just for acquaintances, of course.
Argh. (#angry#)Why am I always beset with Argon issues?
(#disapproval01#)I've never known a race so officious and counter-productive.
Of course. (#shrug01#)Some of you don't realise where you would be without Teladi!
You're right. (#sad#)It's disappointing that I come here to share profit and all I get is abuse.
(#gesticulate01#)Then how about you teach these other idiots to show respect for fellow businessmen?
There's no profit in using Xenon technologies. (#facepalm01#)Plutarch should know this!
(#nod01#)There is every reason to be concerned.
(#cold#)Fire is easy to deal with compared to the sprawling virus of the Xenon.
(#shrug01#)I sense your irony but I must say that Plutarch is doomed to fail in this enterprise.
(#nod01#)This is a large part of my concern.
(#gesticulate03#)There is no profit in confronting PMC with Xenon tech of our own.
(#thinking01#)Why all the noise about AI?
(#gesticulate03#)Please tell me!
Correct me, if I'm wrong. AGI is AI that has gone beyond its original programming on its own. Evolved.
(#scratchhead01#)Really? I didn't know that. (#nod01#)It explains how they've got to this evolutionary point then.
(#sad#)Is yet another war inevitable?
(#shrug01#)Go on, if you must. Give me your strategic insight.
(#gesticulate04#)I hope it's not over too quickly. There's much profit in war.
(#gesticulate02#)Get ready to make some profits, do you mean?
(#nod01#)I may need a ship first. Thanks for the tip.
(#angry#)Why are we even talking about this? I'm not dying for anyone! Goodbye!
(#nod01#)Avoiding all that fighting is a great idea.

page.title: Teladi NPC 4 / Misc Plot Characters
page.t: (Metadata, do not translate)[teladi] female basic(grumpy)
(greeting friendly)Yes, what do you want of Teladi?
(greeting neutral)Be quick, this is not a good day for Teladi!
(greeting enemy)Why do you cast your shadow over my day?
(greeting rejected)I have no time for this!
(greeting service)You seek my services, or not?
(greeting neutral - no comm){,2}
(goodbye friendly)Maybe we speak of business again.
(goodbye neutral)Speak again when business is better.
(goodbye enemy)Loss of profit to you and your family!
(goodbye rejected)Speak no more.
(goodbye service)Come back if you need. Some work must pay the bills here.
(ship scanned - compliant)Scan and see that I have nothing of worth. Such poor trade so far!
(ship scanned - neutral)Scan if you insist, but I want recompense for my time.
(ship scanned - illegal)You shall see the error of your ways when I tell the authorities! Or perhaps we discuss a deal for silence?
(ship scanned - enemy)You cast a shadow of fear through your sordid interest!
(ship scanned - confident)I have nothing held in secret. See for yourself
(ship scanned - possessing)I just need to get those to the next station where I can secure the licences ...
(station/capship scanned - compliant)Scan if you must. You waste our time.
(station/capship scanned - neutral)Why do you stick your nose into my business?
(station/capship scanned - illegal)Your illegal scanning angers me. Stop before I call the authorities and seek compensation.
(station/capship scanned - enemy)What is the purpose of your scan? This leads perhaps to something more aggressive?
(station/capship scanned - confident)Just ask what we possess and we will all save wasted business time.
(station/capship scanned - possessing)So? It is not as if you can do something about it!(belligerent)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 2)See here! That cannot be ours. No sane Teladi would hold such stores in open view!(in denial)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 3)That is the downside of trading for mixed lots. Sometimes there are things you would prefer not to see. You understand?(persuasive)
(station/capship scanned - possessing 4)Another setback! What else can go amiss on this tour of business?(despondent)
(directions - location not known)Why do you ask me?
(directions - refusing to help){,4}
(surrender - reject)Get lost!
(surrender - hostile)So, you force my surrender. What choices do you leave?
(surrender - compliant)I submit! So now my business goes under!
(drops cargo 1)For profit's sake, accept these and shove off!
(drops cargo 2)Stop shooting and fight amongst yourselves for my leavings!
(bail from ship 1)I submit and leave ship! There is no profit in loss of life.
(bail from ship 2)I surrender my ship! I have already lost everything else.
(*Hired NPCs*)
(hired comm greeting 1)Yes? I see you.
(hired face-to-face greeting 1)So, you are the boss!
(hired comm greeting 2)What is your business with me?
(hired face-to-face greeting 2)I assume you have instructions for me?
(hired comm goodbye 1)Comms closed.
(hired face-to-face goodbye)I will go now.
What is your business?
I see you. What do you seek?
(join squad)Joining squad.
(leave squad)Leaving squad.
(accept order 1)Yes.
(accept order 2)That is indeed possible.
(reject order 1)No.
(reject order 2)Not possible.
(Automatic)Automatic operations are running.
(standby)Standing by.
Yes.
Understood.
No.
(jumpdrive charging)Charging drive for jump.
(jumpdrive aborted)Aborting jump.
(jumpdrive engaged)Drive almost charged.
(jumpdrive emergency)I am escaping by jumping!
(jumpdrive cool-down)The Jump Drive must settle first.
(jumpdrive cool-down)Starting jump sequence.
(jumpdrive success)Jump successful. Systems clear, as far as I can see.
(engage boost to player)Boosting to you.
(engage boost)Boosters engaged.
(follow)I will be in support.
(moveto)Setting off.
(moveto dock)Setting out for dock.
(docked)Docking successful.
(task completed)It is done.
(confirm no change)Staying on same orders.
(arrived)I am there.
(arrived)I have arrived.
(arrived at player)I am beside you.
(arrived at player)I see you.
Starting guard duty.
(greeting to player on boarding own station)So, you come aboard.
(lost drones for current task)My drones are all lost. Send new orders.
(task start but low on drones)We are short of drones. Expect issues soon.
(no drones to start task)I have no drones suitable.
(restock request to player)Restock my drones.
(request additional ships)I need more ships for this.
(received additional ship)I will set her to work.
That contradicts our present operation.
Stopping operations.
Send new orders.
(Player loses licence)Mister Otani, your licence with us is cancelled.
You know the reasons.
My ship condition is serious. What next?
(movement status)I am stationary and need assistance!
Setting off to nearest shipyard.
I am at the shipyard. Awaiting orders.
My Jump Drive is down and needs repair first.
I will jump when possible.
I am docked at the shipyard. Send a new set of orders.
My engine is useless. See to it first.
I will move when possible.
Starting emergency jump.
Emergency jump successful. Send new orders.
I am leaving this zone.
I am safely out of the zone. Send instructions.
I have insufficient fuel to jump so far.
I need more fuel to jump as far.
Heading to fuel station.
I must refuel before the jump.
Fuel supplies depleted. Resupply needed here.
Insufficient jump energy. Fuel stations are out of range. I need assistance.
Insufficient jump fuel. Setting up a jump using generator only.
I am short of jump energy. I will see if I force a jump.
Bring sufficient fuel supplies to see me through the jump.
(Hired Architect)Architect speaking. What services do you want?
(Asked how to get building resources)I need resources for all constructions. How should I arrange this?
I have everything I need. Be sure you want the station here. Once I start, that is it.
Module complete. Standing by for next construction task.
Station complete. It is satisfactory.
This module is next for construction.
These modules are available for construction. They are determined by the design progress.
Be sure you want this module. Once I start, there is no reversal.
Satisfactory. We will start straight away.
Architect speaking. Your station will need a Station Manager. Hire one and send them here.
I can construct these stations.
(builder ship moving)Moving to site.
(Ship builder)Want a new spaceship? See here for details.
That is sufficient. Sure you want this ship? Once I start you must pay. No refunds!
Ship complete.
Surely you can see I am busy! See my boards and come back later.
Your ship will need a pilot. Make sure someone suitable is here very soon, or else I must start to charge docking fees!
This is my ship list.
You did not supply enough credits.
(PC: You take care of it.)That is enough credits to press on with.
These extensions are suitable. Some will need others too.
Adjust the upgrade levels and issue the order to start.
Select the hull repair percentage for us to work to.
This lists the available modules for the station.
This lists my resource status.
(architect)I will transfer surplus credits back to you after construction is over. I assume you will leave a tip for the staff?
(Initiate Trade)Trade deals set up. I am on my way there.
(Receive)Set to receive wares.
(Deliver)Set to deliver wares.
(Fail Space)Cargo space is too full for this.
(Fail Type)That type of ware does not fit this ship.
(Fail Space Standby)My cargo space is full. Standing by for other orders.
(Fail Buy Amount)Another mistake! The necessary amount is not for sale here. I will buy what I can and push on, unless told otherwise.
(Fail Sell Amount)For profit's sake! Nobody wants the full amount of goods here. I will sell what I can and set off - if you say so.
(Fail Buy Ware) The specified good is not sold here and we have wasted time. Moving to the next order, unless instructed otherwise.
(Fail Sell Ware)The specified good is not bought here. How could we get this so wrong? I will swap to the next order, unless you say otherwise.
(Fail Buy Price)The current price exceeds my limit. Say now or I will purchase the said amount. Such a deal makes a Teladi most sad.
(Fail Sell Price)I cannot sell our goods for the expected price here. Say soon or I will sell the specified amount anyway. A Teladi trader would be sickened by such a loss!
(Fail)The requested trade is impossible here. Send new orders.
I have surplus credits from trade. I will send you the surplus unless you order something else. At least something must have gone well.
Deal agreed. Sending details now.
Destination reached, setting up trade.
(fixed something)Seems fixed.
(fixed something)Seems serviceable.
(fixed something)Seems OK now.
(Initiate Mining)Standing by to start mining operations.
(Launch)Sending collectors.
(Recall)Recalling collectors.
(Automatic)Starting Automatic operations.
(Fail Type)That sort of ware does not fit my ship.
The drones will pick up things you tag.
The drones will prioritise things you tag.
I have no collector drones.
My drones will start collecting.
I have ceased mining. I will follow you unless you send other orders.
My ship is full now. Setting off for your position.
(Squad member)Some officious person has told me to drop my cargo!
It was a police ship.
It was a seemingly hostile ship.
Should I comply or not?
(Boarding Commander)_Documentation
Awaiting order to start.
(scan successful)Scan received - assessing suitable sites for assault.
I select this spot.
(not scanned)This spot seems as good as any other.
(boarding pod launching)Pods away.
(boarding pod hit)Seeing defensive fire!
(marines under fire)Marines under fire!
(pod attached)Hull reached and drilling started.
(marine entering ship)Hull penetrated. Securing access.
Team shaking out.
Setting off. Stay sharp!
(marine on alert)Enemies massing ahead.
(loud)Contact!(sound of combat/laser fire)
Shoot them down!(sound of combat/laser fire)
(lots of fighting noise)Do not waste a shot!
(lots of fighting noise)Callsign injured!
(lots of fighting noise)Shut down that sensor!
(lots of fighting noise)Bypass that position!
(lots of fighting noise)Secure our flank!
(combat)Step lively!
(quiet)Shh! Let them come to us.
(assist mission successful)Enemy leaving positions.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Enemy still there. Suppress them on my order.
(assist mission successful)Sentries all silenced!
(assist mission failed/timed out)Sentries staying active. Take them out!(sounds of shooting and explosions)
(marine hacking)I am at the system console.
(marine hacking)Starting system hack.
(assist mission successful)Auto-sentries shutting down.
(assist mission failed/timed out)Auto-sentries still engaging! Find their blind spots.
Self-destruct engaged! Start the override!
(relieved)Self-destruct shut down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)No time left! Escape to the pods!
(boarding successful)Success! We have control of all systems.
Too many casualties to succeed! Fight back to the pods.
The hull is failing! Sprint to the pods!
We are bringing the pods home!
(Boarding Marine)_Documentation
(sound of combat/laser fire)Someone help me!
(sound of combat/laser fire)Another casualty!
Arrssst..(lots of fighting noise over dying marine)
Throwing stun!(pause followed by load bang/explosion)
Throwing smoke!(pause followed by soft bang/explosion)
Step back! Blast this hatch!(pause followed by loud bang/explosion)
(lots of fighting noise)Supporting fire!
(lots of fighting noise)Steady! Steady!
(checking for enemies)This area is clear.
(sound of laser fire)Laser sentries!
Force field sighted ahead.
(assist mission successful)The force field has shut down!
(assist mission failed/timed out)We need a bypass route.
The ships's crew surrender. She is ours!(cheers)
They show submission! The station is taken!(cheers)
We seem outnum--(explosion, cut off by static)
(generic success)The target is ours!
(upgrades)Successfully upgraded. Setting out.
Successfully downgraded. Setting off.
Upgrades installed.
Choose the ship to upgrade.
Which upgrade should be installed?
(*Hiring*)
You have someone in that post already.
You have an Engineer.
You have a Marine Officer.
Am I to replace somebody specific, or should I go somewhere else?
You will be satisfied with my service.
Finally, you make a sensible decision in securing my service.
(On board introduction)Crew members, I am here to show you my professional superiority.
(Fired in space)Set me down at the next station. I will seek an employer who seeks profit.
(Fired on platform)I leave, but you will lose profit without me.
(Assign to object)I will assume my new duties.
(Assign to ship)I will assume command of that ship.
(Return to player)I will return soon.
(Leave player)Thus I depart your presence.
(Leave player)So now I go, and you feel my loss.
(Showing skills)Teladi is very skilled. You see this here.
(Showing skills)If these skills do not impress then you are ignorant of my business.
(Sell ship)I sold that ship. You have gained some credits but was the sale was sensible? That is yet to be seen.
(Sell ship)I sold your ships for many credits. I hope Teladi gets a cut of the profits!
(respond to free mode)You trust me. That was unexpected, but not unpleasant.
(respond to free mode)I anticipated your choice. Teladi will not let you down.
(respond to restricted mode)I will pass on all of your orders.
(respond to restricted mode)Understood. You will be responsible for all big decisions.
(*Combat*)
(player attacks - friendly 1)So are you stupid or just bored?
(player attacks - friendly 2)Stop that! Just say what you want instead!
(player attacks - neutral 1)Such a bad day already, and now it gets worse!
(player attacks - neutral 2)See here! Some day you will seriously regret this!
(player attacks - enemy 1)Your action suggests that Teladi must take some strong measures against you!
(Player attacks - police warning 1)Stop your actions or face serious consequences!
(Player attacks - police warning 2)If you seek the retaliation of the Teladi authorities, you will soon succeed!
(big object attacked)Open your eyes! Can you not see the size of your target?
(big object attacked)Someone tell this pesky pilot that our patience is not inexhaustible!
(light fire 1)Somebody seems upset with me!
(light fire 2)Somebody make this nuisance go away!
(mid fire 1)I have a persistent assailant that needs removal!
(mid fire 2)I have nothing for you! Seek your ill-gained profits elsewhere!
(heavy fire 1)Soon my ship will cease to exist!
(heavy fire 2)Assistance must come quick if I am to survive!
(heavy fire 3)My life is at serious risk! Help Teladi and we can discuss rewards later!
(station defence)Where are all the ships supposed to protect this station? Reinforcements are needed quickly.
(station defence)Save our station, and we can spare you some credits.
(station defence)Somebody assist our incompetent station defence forces!
(death 1)Aarrrssst!
(death 2)Hisssshh!
(death 3)My sisters!
(shield warning 1)Shields useless!
(shield warning 2)Shields wasted!
(hull warning 1)Hull depressurising!
(hull warning 2)Hull soon submits to vacuum!
(Incoming Enemies)Finally, the enemies show!
(Incoming Wave)Yet more enemies closing!
(Last Wave)This seems the last wave of enemies.
(Player Needed)Why are you absent? Teladi needs you!
(Success 1)That was close! We win, but at great cost
(Success 2)Enemies lose this time. We succeeded, but not without loss.
(Fail 1)We failed, with massive losses.
(Fail 2)This failure leaves me in great distress!
(critical damage)My ship is almost useless!
(critical damage)My ship system says little still works!
(Incoming Enemies)I see enemies closing.
(Dangerous area)Coming here was always a mistake! Nobody saw sense when I protested.
(Plead for life 1)I submit! Spare Teladi this time!
(Plead for life 2)Stop! Teladi throws herself at pilot's mercy!
(Plead for life 3)Please cease your shooting! Think of my sisters!
(Plead for life 4)Soon I will be no more. I beg you to stop!
(player instructions)Follow us.
Stay close.
(followers)We will stay behind you.
Show us the way.
I am all set.
Ready to set off.
(When administrative module is under attack)(Systems malfunctioning, crackling, panicking people, radio noise, muffled)Sisters and hatchlings first. See them to the evacuation centres.(urging)
(*Mission*)
(General 1)So, are you still interested?
(General 2)Is this task for you then?
(Easy 1)This task is simple. Do not get stressed about it.
(Easy 2)This task is easy profit.
(Hard 1)How can you convince me you are up to this task?
(Hard 2)Teladi fears you squander all our profits by your faint hopes of success!
(Fight Easy 1)This is an easy target. You do not risk much.
(Fight Easy 2)You are callous! You will not squirm at such an easy kill.
(Fight Hard 1)Your optimism grates on my nerves! I risk as much as you!
(Fight Hard 2)You stake your life, I stake my business. It amounts to the same!
(Trade Easy 1)You should suit this simple stores run.
(Trade Easy 2)Your skills as a freight mover should not be stretched by this.
(Trade Hard 1)Only the best will succeed at this. For moving freight, are you the best option?
(Trade Hard 2)Teladi has serious doubts about your suitability. This is not an average delivery task.
(Acceptance Query 1)So, still in?
(Acceptance Query 2)You still want this?
(Accept 1)I accept. You get started.
(Accept 2)So, we are in business.
(Reluctant 1)Teladi is much stressed. I must trust in your bid for success.
(Reluctant 2)Teladi does not believe in luck. Teladi believes in skill and business-sense. You must apply these to this task!
(Reject 1)Sorry. Teladi cannot risk loss of profit with this task.
(Reject 2)You risk too much loss. No job.
(Info 1)The job details are on your system.
(Info 2)The task details are on your ship system.
(Success 1)Not so bad. You were satisfactory.
(Success 2)That is a surprise. You succeeded.
(Semi 1)Hiss. A few credits only. You make us few profits.
(Semi 2)(*sigh*)That is disappointing. At least it was not a total loss.
(Fail 1)Gah! (frustrated) You are a waste of Teladi attention.
(Fail 2)This was a disaster! It will severely damage my business!
(Credits 1)I can spare you these credits.
(Reward 1)I hate doing this, but here is a bonus.
(Client abort)Your services are surplus to client requirements.
(mission update)See your system for a change of job details.
(mission update 2)Your briefing has altered; check your system for the updates.
(Assassination Offer 1)I want someone killed. It is really that simple!
(Assassination Offer 2)I want to see evidence that a person is permanently neutralised.
(Target)You pose no threat to me! Go back and confess your incompetence!
(Target 2)You think a few credits balance the risks to your life? You are outclassed here.
(Bribe 1)Let us consider a deal instead. I fly away, you make more credits, and no-one is the wiser.
(Success)They could not escape!
(Fail)They escaped? So claims of your prowess were lies!
(Fail by bribe)You cannot fool Teladi! I know when I sense a double-cross!
(Protect Station Offer 1)As if our day could get any worse! Hostiles are expected here soon. Please assist out defences and keep them away from this station.
(Protect Station Offer 2)Our station is the target of an incoming raiding party. If you can assist our defence then we will pay expenses and maybe a reward.
(Protect Ship Offer 1)I have raiders on my tail. Please see them off!
(Protect Ship Offer 2)Any combat-capable pilots. Come and save me from these attackers and I will see you rewarded!
(Police 1)Smugglers frequent this route. An unmarked ship can get close enough to scan such ships. Interested?
(Success 1)At last! These leads will help close down their operations. Here are your credits.
(Semi 1)You saw nothing? At least you did not spook them. Here are a few expenses.
(Fail 1)Nothing passed your position? That cannot be true! You will get nothing for disclosing our operations to them!
(Passenger Offer 1)I must get somewhere fast. Are you interested in a paying passenger?
(Passenger Offer 2)I must move on soon. Get me somewhere fast for good credits!
(On Board)I am aboard.
(Space)You have no space. Sort it out fast, or it is your loss.
(Late)Have you no sense of time? I despair and suspect you of incompetence!
(Fail)You are slow. Teladi has lost business now! Drop me off at a station soon.
(Assigned to platform)I will go where assigned.
(Sell Ware Offer 1)I need some goods delivered. Credits are available for a quick service.
(Return Ware Offer)I need some wares brought here fast. The profits can be shared.
(Late Sell)The client still awaits the goods. Speed up or we both fail!
(Late Return)Where are those supplies? You risk our profits unnecessarily!
(Fail Sell)The client has severed contact. My business is ruined by your incompetence!
(Fail Return)Cancel all my requirements. I will seek someone more consistent.

Hmm. I don't have a ship, unfortunately. (#shrug01#)If I did, I'd be flying far away from here.
(#facepalm01#)I don't think that's a good idea... dying. That would definitely hurt my profits. (#crossarms01#)You can take such ideas away with you!
(#crossarms01#)Yes. Great idea. Goodbye!
So beautiful, (#shrug01#)yet so unreal.
For Humans (#shrug01#)but these holo-dancers lack proper shape and colour.
(#disapproval01#)If you consider such ugly images decoration.

(#nod01#)Well that may give more work to Teladi, so good news!
Exactly. (#rolleyes01#)Nothing good will come of this in the long run.
Yeah, I could see something like that happening in a number of ways. (#rolleyes02#)Extreme but not impossible ways.
(#smile#)They didn't even have highways forty years ago... amazing.
(#nod01#)Inspiring increase in technological development.
(#smile#)Such a technology will have a very positive effect on trade. (#punchhand01#)That's very good for me!
(#thinking01#)I was not aware of this fact. Very interesting.
(#smile#)Such magical technologies will pave the way to new profit opportunities.
(#disapproval01#)This PMC did what?!
Not all of it. Do you have more?
(#nod01#)This is incredible. Please tell.
(#sad#)They have kept this under wraps for too long.
(#sad#)This is a very unsettling development. I hope those guilty are brought to justice.
(#nod01#)The source only needs to be reliable and the evidence authentic.
(#laugh#)I sense a disturbance in Plutarch's profit margins.
(#gesticulate01#)This couldn't be more important! You shouldn't keep such things a secret. (#punchhand01#)Go now and tell everyone!
