page.title: NPC Types
page.descr: Job types of Non Playable Characters
page.t: $1: $2(Formatting)
Unknown(male)
Unknown person.
Unknown(female)
Unknown(male)
Unknown person. Probably not very important.
Unknown(female)
Unknown(male mission actor)
Unknown person. Might be important though.
Unknown(female mission actor)
Pilot(male)

Pilots are certified small spaceship pilots who may well have military or commercial experience. Competence and skills will obviously vary and it is worth checking into their credentials wherever possible. A Pilot is essential for taking over a newly-acquired small ship, whether through purchase, construction or by consequence of combat. You may come depend on one these Pilots in combat so keep an eye on their progress.
Pilot(female)

Pilots are certified small spaceship pilots who may well have military or commercial experience. A Pilot is essential for taking over a newly-acquired small ship, whether through purchase, construction or by consequence of combat.
Captain(male)

Captains are experienced in capital ship command. Their experience could lie in military or commercial fields, or even both if you are lucky. It is always worth taking the time to check their credentials before hiring, if you can. A Captain is essential for commanding that capital ship that you have recently had constructed, or have acquired by other means. You will issue commands to your capital ship by issuing orders to the Captain, so it is always a good idea to help them to develop in the fields in which you want to use them.
Captain(female)
Captains are experienced in capital ship command. A Captain is essential for commanding that capital ship that you have recently had constructed, or have acquired by other means.
Manager(male)

Managers will run your stations for you in your absence. A station without one cannot run effectively, if at all. They come with individual skills and experience and so should be carefully selected, if you have the necessary opportunity. Managers will report any issues or requirements that their stations encounter and so you are advised to listen carefully when they contact you. Hopefully you will come to trust and nurture your station Managers.
Manager(female)

Managers will run your stations for you in your absence. A station without one cannot run effectively, if at all. Managers will report any issues or requirements that their stations encounter and so you are advised to listen carefully when they contact you.
Engineer(male)

An Engineer is an important member of any crew. Not only can one repair surface elements of stations and capital ships but, when a member of the crew of the Albion Pride, one can conduct partial repair to the Skunk in space, or more in-depth and complete repair when docked at a platform. Different Engineers obviously come with differing experience and competences.
Engineer(female)
An Engineer will work to keep systems functional, repairing when needed.
Agricultural Engineer(male)

An Agricultural Engineer is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of production using agricultural resources. Products improved by their services include: Meat, Plankton, Soybeans, Spaceweed, Spices and Wheat.
Agricultural Engineer(female)
Architect(male)

An Architect is a designer and project manager for construction work for stations and modules. They are actually employed on the Construction Vessel, or 'CV', that does the actual building. Every new CV will require one and they come, as expected, with differing skill levels. Architects will listen to your outline construction intentions and then advise you what can be built, where, and in which order. They will also advise the costs in terms of credits and supplied resources for your construction requests.
Architect(female)

An Architect is a designer and project manager for construction work for stations and modules. They will also advise the costs in terms of credits and supplied resources for your construction requests.
Marine Officer(male)

A Marine Officer commands the detachment of marines on a ship. One is essential for conducting boarding operations and helps the pilots by interpreting scan data for the best place to send the pods. They then control the boarding operation in detail and help to suggest what assistance the Skunk could provide to the operational success, and also when to abort an operation destined for total failure and loss. As always, some Marine Officers are more skilled and experienced than others.
Marine Officer(female)
A Marine Officer commands the detachment of marines on a ship. One is essential for conducting boarding operations and helps the pilots by interpreting scan data for the best place to send the pods.
Mechanic(male)

A Mechanic sells a custom-ship pilot the very specialised upgrades to their ship onboard systems. Effectively they are customisers in such specialist upgrades and they can even downgrade ship systems for whatever reasons the pilot may have. Mechanics take great pride in their work and will rarely make a mess when installing or removing upgrades from a ship.
Mechanic(female)

A Mechanic sells a custom-ship pilot the very specialised upgrades to their ship onboard systems. Effectively they are customisers in such specialist upgrades and they can even downgrade ship systems for whatever reasons the pilot may have.
Ship Dealer(male)

Found only at Shipyards, a Ship Dealer will assist in the buying and selling of ships, their upgrade or downgrade, and their repair. The Ship dealer only deals with vessels docked at the Shipyard and this may place limits on the ship types that each Dealer can address.
Ship Dealer(female)
Capital Ship Dealer(male)
Capital Ship Dealer(female)
Small Ship Dealer(male)
Small Ship Dealer(female)
Mining Supplier(male)

A Mining Supplier trades in the smaller products of mining and artificial mineral production, and even just space scavenging. Their trade-wares include Silicate Minerals, Rough Gemstones, Gold Nuggets, Chipped Diamonds, Artefacts, etc. These are the people to see if you are interested in smaller but valuable trade items, or even just the rare or bizarre.
Mining Supplier(female)
This type of item is traded by Mining Suppliers. Typically you will find them in trading docks.

A Mining Supplier trades in the smaller products of mining and artificial mineral production, and even just space scavenging. These are the people to see if you are interested in smaller but valuable trade items, or even just the rare or bizarre.
Licence Broker(male)

A Licence Broker naturally sells only licences that are considered 'appropriate' for that location. Different licences are thus typically available in different locations. The Broker also reminds clients that licences come with responsibilities to the issuing faction and implied constraints to the holder's behaviour. Failure to heed their advice in these matters may result in premature loss of the licence without refund, and may annoy the issuing faction too.
Licence Broker(female)

A Licence Broker naturally sells only licences that are considered 'appropriate' for that location. The Broker also reminds clients that licences come with responsibilities to the issuing faction and implied constraints to the holder's behaviour.
Defence Officer(male)

Employed on Stations or capital ships, a Defence Officer controls the defensive turrets and drones of the host to maximise their contribution to self-defence. They also coordinate with other ships, dedicated or just available, to request or marshal additional assistance as necessary. Their skills and abilities vary and this will impact upon their overall effectiveness.
Defence Officer(female)
Employed on Stations or capital ships, a Defence Officer controls the defensive turrets and drones of the host to maximise their contribution to self-defence.
Police Chief(male)

The Police Chief will contact pilots with respect to local issues involving the police or local authorities. Typically these may include administration of bounties, dealing with law-infringements or other such matters. Police Chiefs are important officials with some combat ships belonging to the authorities at their disposal, so pilots are advised to pay heed to what they say.
Police Chief(female)

The Police Chief will contact pilots with respect to local issues involving the police or local authorities. Typically these may include administration of bounties, dealing with law-infringements or other such matters.
Junk Dealer(male)

Junk Dealers are not the most popular of traders to stand next to because of some of the items they handle and trade in. Suppliers of the recycling and recovery industries, these Dealers turn scrap and waste into credits. Their trade typically includes Scrap Metal, Ship Wreckage, Hazardous Waste, Radioactive Waste, etc.
Junk Dealer(female)
This type of item is traded by Junk Dealers. Typically you will find them in trading docks.

Junk Dealers are not the most popular of traders to stand next to because of some of the items they handle and trade in. Suppliers of the recycling and recovery industries, these Dealers turn scrap and waste into credits.
Space Farmer(male)

A Space Farmer supports the more agricultural communities with products or resources that assist their cultivation efforts. Their trade wares include Calcite Shells, Augmented Soil, Spacefly Eggs, Pesticide, etc. Although decidedly low-tech and generally naturally-found resources, their demand in certain developing communities should not be under-rated.
Space Farmer(female)
This type of item is traded by Space Farmers. Typically you will find them in trading docks.

A Space Farmer supports the more agricultural communities with products or resources that assist their cultivation efforts. Although decidedly low-tech and generally naturally-found resources, their demand in certain developing communities should not be under-rated.
Ship Technician(male)

The Ship Technician supplies sub-systems for ships but does not offer installation or support services. Instead consider these as items for further sale as resources for processes elsewhere. The items include Mining Equipment, Engine Components, Life Support Systems, Stasis Chambers, etc.
Ship Technician(female)
This type of item is traded by Ship Technicians. Typically you will find them in trading docks.
The Ship Technician supplies sub-systems for ships but does not offer installation or support services. Instead consider these as items for further sale as resources for processes elsewhere.
Equipment Vendor(male)

An Equipment Vendor trades in portable technical equipment items in general use. These items include Entertainment Consoles, small Teladianium Panelling, Small Arms, Space Suits, etc. All in all, a technical bric-a-brac trader.
Equipment Vendor(female)
This type of item is traded by Equipment Vendors. Typically you will find them in trading docks.
An Equipment Vendor trades in portable technical equipment items in general use.
Food Merchant(male)

Aimed more at the luxury end of the market, the Food Merchant trades in the more exclusive personal food and drink items. These include Chocolate-Laced Rations, Argon Delicacy Packs, Albion Tobacco, Jon Kayean's Whisky, etc. This is the person to see if you want to make good profits in isolated communities, or when organising a celebration.
Food Merchant(female)
This type of item is traded by Food Merchants. Typically you will find them in trading docks.

Aimed more at the luxury end of the market, the Food Merchant trades in the more exclusive personal food and drink items. This is the person to see if you want to make good profits in isolated communities, or when organising a celebration.
Black Marketeer(male)

These somewhat unscrupulous traders do not mind selling illegal wares to the unwary. The Black Marketeers make certain that they do not take much of the risk in the trade; they leave that to their clients! They typically deal in Hacker Chips, Neuronal Stimulants, Blank Freight Papers, Squash Mines, etc. While these traders can be useful for offloading illegal goods 'acquired' along the way, beware of their seemingly unmissable offers. There are no refunds or comebacks if you get caught by the authorities!
Black Marketeer(female)
This type of item is traded by Black Marketeers.

These somewhat unscrupulous traders do not mind selling illegal wares to the unwary. The Black Marketeers make certain that they do not take much of the risk in the trade; they leave that to their clients!
Drone Dealer(male)

A Drone Dealer buys and sells customised drones to pilots of ships equipped to use or hold them. This is the person to seek out when custom drone stocks run low or else particular drone functionalities may be at risk of being lost when most needed.
Drone Dealer(female)
Recruiting Officer(male)

The Recruiting Officer can supply pilots with Marines for boarding operations or local defence forces. There are various types of Marine with varying degrees of experience and capability. That will almost certainly be reflected in the Recruiting Officer's asking prices. Pilots are advised never to get over-intoxicated with a Recruiting Officer; they can never be sure exactly where they might find themselves on sobering up!
Recruiting Officer(female)

The Recruiting Officer can supply pilots with Marines for boarding operations or local defence forces. Pilots are advised never to get over-intoxicated with a Recruiting Officer; they can never be sure exactly where they might find themselves on sobering up!
Arms Dealer(male)

In this case, an Arms Dealer is mainly a missile stockist who can buy and sell customised missiles for the ships that can equip or hold them. While there are many different types and marks of missiles available from them, these tend to be designed and packaged with the custom and irregular ships that can actually fire them foremost in mind.
Arms Dealer(female)
In this case, an Arms Dealer is mainly a missile stockist who can buy and sell customised missiles for the ships that can equip or hold them.
Cell Specialist(male)

A Cell Specialist is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of cell production in power and energy processes. Products improved by their services include: Antimatter Cells, Energy Cells, Ion Cells and Plasma Cells.
Cell Specialist(female)
Food Technologist(male)

A Food Technologist is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of foodstuffs production using mainly natural resources. Products improved by their services include: Bofu, Food Rations and Spacefuel.
Food Technologist(female)
Chemical Specialist(male)

A Chemical Specialist is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of chemical product using various resources. Products improved by their services include: Bio-Electric Neuron Gel and Chemical Compounds.
Chemical Specialist(female)
Precision Assembler(male)

A Precision Assembler is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of precise component production processes using technical resources. Products improved by their services include: Bio-Optic Wiring, Microchips, Plasma Pumps and Quantum Tubes.
Precision Assembler(female)
Weapons Technologist(male)

A Weapons Technologist is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of technical production processes using various technical components. Products improved by their services include: Missiles, EM-Spectrometer, Scanning Array and Warheads.
Weapons Technologist(female)
Pharmaceutical Agent(male)

A Pharmaceutical Agent is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of pharmaceutical processes using medicinal resources. Products improved by their services include: Medical Supplies and Narcotics.
Pharmaceutical Agent(female)
Metallurgical Engineer(male)

A Metallurgical Engineer is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of metal-based processes using metallic resources. Products improved by their services include: Refined Metals, Silicon Wafers and Reinforced Metal Plating.
Metallurgical Engineer(female)
Geophysicist(male)

A Geophysicist is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of production using resources extracted from asteroid debris. Products improved by their services include: Cut Crystals and Nividium Cubes.
Geophysicist(female)
Surface Technician(male)

A Surface Technician is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of system production processes using sub-systems and components. Products improved by their services include: Shield Generators and Turrets.
Surface Technician(female)
Power Specialist(male)

A Power Specialist is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of power generation production using various resources and components. Products improved by their services include: Fusion Reactors, Podkletnov Generators and Plasma Flow Regulators.
Power Specialist(female)
Hydro Specialist(male)
A Hydro Specialist is employed on a station to monitor and improve the efficiency of water-production processes using natural resources. Water production is greatly improved by their services.
Hydro Specialist(female)

Let's get a move on.
(male)Transport passenger
(female)Transport passenger
Passenger Transport
Pick these passengers up and get them to their destination.
{30101,1}(Please come aboard.)
Late for a meeting!
I'm really late for an important meeting. I need someone to get me there, pronto!
{30101,1}(Please come aboard.)
Low-key Taxi Needed

If you're seeing this job offer then you apparently fit the criteria of what I need. I think someone's been tailing me and the security office says it's not their problem until a crime is committed. I simply need transport to a station where I have friends.
You're clear to come aboard.
I missed my ride!

Ok, funny story. It looks like I may have overslept here and the ship I work on has left without me. I need a fast passenger transport to catch up to the ship and drop me off. My job is on the line! Get me there fast enough and I'll throw in a bonus.
{30101,4}(Let's get a move on.)
(male)Transport crewman
(female)Transport crewman
My ship left me behind!

My shipmates seem to have pulled a practical joke and left me behind. I need a fast passenger transport to catch up to the ship and drop me off. If you get me there fast enough I'll also include a bonus.
{30101,4}(Let's get a move on.)
(male)Transport crewman
(female)Transport crewman
The ship's about to blow!

{30101,4}(Let's get a move on.)
(male)Evacuate captain
(female)Evacuate captain

page.title: Assassination Mission 2
page.t: I did manage to strike a deal with the mark to the tune of $REWARD$ credits.
$REWARD$ credits seem enough for me to look the other way.
(full credit)That was a very well executed job. Thank you for your time.
(partial credit)Word is that you got a bit of help during the job. Unfortuantely that means partial credit for the payment.
(partial credit)It seems the target was hit hardest by someone else and that means partial credit for the job. Hit harder and faster next time.
(no credit)That was either a very low-key operation or you hardly dented the target. I simply can't pay anyone for a job like that.
(vague mission name)Assassination Bounty
(Title)Catch Dangerous Criminal
(Male)The elusive criminal %1($Target_NPC_Name$) is hoping to find shelter and avoid capture. We can't allow him to go into hiding.
(Female)The elusive criminal %1($Target_NPC_Name$) is hoping to find shelter and avoid capture. We can't allow her to go into hiding.
Assassinate known criminal
Cartel Boss Vulnerable
(Male)The cartel boss %1($Target_NPC_Name$) is currently without the bulk of his escorts. If we take him out, we destabilise their whole operation.
(Female)The cartel boss %1($Target_NPC_Name$) is currently without the bulk of her escorts. If we take her out, we destabilise their whole operation.
Assassinate cartel boss
Shake Up the Market
(Male)Our rivals at %1($Enemy_Faction$) are enjoying a bout of economic success but we could do with a shift of fortunes. Let's give them a little scare by taking out one of their area managers.
Assassinate trade rival
Take Out Enemy Agent
(Male)%1($Enemy_Faction$) have been growing bold and their agent %2($Target_NPC_Name$) is leading the charge in this area. Take him out.
(Female)%1($Enemy_Faction$) have been growing bold and their agent %2($Target_NPC_Name$) is leading the charge in this area. Take her out.
Assassinate enemy agent
Continued Xenon Threats

We're continuing to suffer losses to the Xenon ravaging this sector. We've marked a target known to be a lead vessel in their strike forces. With our forces stretched, we're asking for any assistance to help slow the Xenon down.
Take out Xenon target
Business Partner Double Crossed Me

(Male)I have a serious problem. My business partner and I were close to closing a deal but it looks like he's gone ahead and closed it without me. I've invested so much into this, this'll ruin me. If he's taken out I may be able to salvage something.

(Female)I have a serious problem. My business partner and I were close to closing a deal but it looks like she's gone ahead and closed it without me. I've invested so much into this, this'll ruin me. If she's taken out I may be able to salvage something.
Eliminate business partner
Searching for Justice

(Male)Several years ago a dangerous criminal kidnapped my partner and I've not seen them since. I heard this criminal has now served his time and is back at large. Please don't let what happened to me happen again. Stop him, at all costs.

(Female)Several years ago a dangerous criminal kidnapped my partner and I've not seen them since. I heard this criminal has now served her time and is back at large. Please don't let what happened to me happen again. Stop her, at all costs.
Kill the criminal
Open Bounty Collection

(Male)A small-time weapons dealer is trying to boost his reputation by branching out into open violence. We're not prepared to let him upset the status quo, so we want him removed before he can cause too much trouble.

(Female)A small-time weapons dealer is trying to boost her reputation by branching out into open violence. We're not prepared to let her upset the status quo, so we want her removed before she can cause too much trouble.
Eliminate weapons dealer
Searching for Vengeance

(Male)I feel ashamed to admit that I have fallen for a con artist's trap. He tricked me into giving him almost everything I own. I don't have much hope of getting that back, but I want him to pay for what he's done.

(Female)I feel ashamed to admit that I have fallen for a con artist's trap. She tricked me into giving her almost everything I own. I don't have much hope of getting that back, but I want her to pay for what she's done.
Assassinate con artist
Stop the Snitch

(Male)We want you to deal with an agent who has double-crossed us and has started working as a snitch for one of our rivals. Before he gives them any more information, we want to see that he is safely removed.

(Female)We want you to deal with an agent who has double-crossed us and has started working as a snitch for one of our rivals. Before she gives them any more information, we want to see that she is safely removed.
Eliminate snitch

page.title: Defend Station
page.t: Repel attackers
Cartel Raid Incoming
A petty cartel believes that if they attack us, they'll force us into paying them protection money. Sign up if you want to be part of the surprise party to greet them.
Xenon Targeting this Station
We have had word that a Xenon force may be on its way to attack this station. Our defences are armed and all non-critical personnel are hunkered down but we could do with more ships.
%1($EnemyFaction$) On the Charge
The fools of %1($EnemyFaction$) believe that attacking this station will hand them victory in this sector. Our defences are ready to meet them, will you?
Criminal Attack Incoming

Some criminals believe that they can attack this station, so we're hiring third parties to help bolster our defenses. As long as the station is still standing at the end of the assault, you'll get paid.
Xenon Attack Incoming
We don't know what may have drawn their interest but the Xenon will soon attack this station. We need every able body to defend against them, and will gladly pay for your assistance.
Defend this Station

We have discovered that %s($EnemyFaction$) is planning to launch an attack against this station and are hiring able bodies to show them that we will not go down lightly. We'll pay for your services in this matter.

page.title: Destroy Objects
page.t: Capship Needs to Go!
Our superiors have had enough of a certain capital ship entering our space and causing trouble. While we risk escalating the conflict, we have to deal with this ship!
Capital Ship
Destroy capship
Bad Publicity

While not a direct competitor, the target is drawing people from far and wide. This is lowering the number of potential customers in our area of space. Nothing says 'shop somewhere else' better than a bit of vandalism.
Ad Signs
Destroy ad signs
Weaken Station Defences
Given our current security situation, it has been deemed necessary to go on the offensive. We are planning attacks on several targets but we want some of their station defences put to the test first.
Turrets
Destroy station turrets
Pirate Raiders
There have been reports of raiders destroying freighters around the sector. We need you to find and destroy them, before they can do too much more damage.
Raiding ships
Eliminate pirate raiders
Capital Destruction

A capital class ship has been pestering both security forces and civilians. We don't want to risk escalating a conflict, but we do need to eliminate this threat before it gets worse. Payment will follow destruction of the ship.
Take Back the Market

One of our competitors is driving away our customers with a new marketing campaign, made up of a range of advertisements. If those advertisements were to disappear, we would be a lot more confident of our customer base.
Deactivate Station Defences

We have reports that smugglers are about to hit a rival station. As it is, the smugglers would likely be killed on entry or exit to the station, but if its defences happened to be... disabled, then who knows what might happen. Payment on completion.
Halting Marauder Activity

There has been a dramatic increase in marauder activity in recent times, and we are hiring third parties to help deal with them. We have reports of an impending attack, so you'll be paid if it is successfully repelled.

page.title: Escort Convoy
page.t: (common texts)Traders
(common texts)Fighters
Escort Needed
Our ships seem to be drawing unwanted attention on trade runs. We need someone to watch our backs. Expect a fight.
Escort freighter
Escort freighters
Backup Required
Looks like someone's planted a virus into our nav systems. We're flying almost blind with risk of ambush. Trusted escort needed.
Escort fighter
Escort fighters
Escort Required
Pirate activity has increased somewhat in recent weeks, so we want to make sure the freighters coming to our station are protected. You'll receive payment for successful escort.
Trusted Escort Required
We're about to move some important goods across space, and are looking to make sure it reaches its location successfully. Payment will follow a successful escort.

page.title: Patrol
page.t: (patrol)to $DESTINATION$(location)
(patrol)to $DESTINATION$(object)
Patrol 1 location
Patrol $NUM$ locations
Neighbourhood Watch
To protect our assets and our citizens, we routinely set up patrols undertaken by local people. Keep our space safe and you'll be rewarded with gratitude as well as credits.
Military Patrol
Given these troubled times, we have to step up patrols in our space. We require our best agents to secure our borders and protect our assets.
Keep Our Space Safe

There are reports of ships entering the sector and attacking civilians. We're not sure who they are yet but we think they'll be heading this way. If you've got lasers, warm them up and lend a hand to fellow citizens.
Xenon Invasion
The Xenon have returned to our space and we are rallying all soldiers to drive them back. We're paying to make sure our citizens stay safe. Good hunting, pilot.
Xenon Scouts Spotted
We've had several reports that Xenon scouts have appeared in the sector and want to eliminate this threat before it becomes a full-scale invasion. Light them up, pilot!
Seeking Patrol Pilots

After several reports of hostile forces in the area, we have decided to extend beyond our standard patrol routes and are looking for able pilots to weed out these hostiles with extreme prejudice. Details follow.

page.title: Targetpoint race
page.t: (race)against $OPPONENT$
(race)to $DESTINATION$
(race)around $DESTINATION$
Station Race!
I'm throwing down a challenge to a race to any passing pilots. Have you got what it takes to come out on top?
Pilot Skill Testing
To keep our agents sharp, we're offering a prize to those who can navigate our challenge course within a certain time.

page.title: Ship distress call
page.t: Ship Distress Call!
A ship distress call has been received!
(protect)Ship in distress

page.title: Deliver Wares
page.t: Deliver Wares
$WARE$ Shortage!
Given our desire to ramp up production, we must secure a delivery of $WARE$.
$ENERGYWARE$ Shortage!
Our power requirements for production are causing us serious delays. We need some $ENERGYWARE$ before we have to start turning off the lights.
$WARE$ for Victory!
A strong economy is imperative to keep our military and infrastructure in top condition. The lack of $WARE$ is hindering our ability to meet the demands placed on us.

page.title: Reveal Station Mission
page.t: Scan Station
Info Collection Required
While some information is free, it is not always simple to acquire. We need someone to analyse a station for us, to update our database.
Sensitive Data Required

To better keep tabs on our rivals and enemies, we must remain vigilant with regard to their activities and technologies. One of our agents must uncover information regarding a certain station in order for us to make a threat assessment.
Inspector Calling
One of our stations is due for safety inspection but all of our inspectors are currently busy. We'll pay for a scan of the station to let us know of any problems.

page.title: Harvest Resources
page.t: $AMOUNT$ units of premium value $WARE$ from $ZONE$, $DISTANCE$ zones away

We require delivery of $WARE$, which may be found in certain regions of space.
High-Grade $WARE$ Required!
We require the collection and delivery of $WARE$ from a specific region. This area has proved to be very suitable to our needs.
$WARE$ Analysis

We have noticed in increase in activity in certain regions where $WARE$ is collected. While it may have been triggered by rumours of riches, we must analyse the area and take samples before we consider moving in and locking down the area for further study.
$AMOUNT$ units of sampled $WARE$ from $ZONE$, $DISTANCE$ zones away
$AMOUNT$ units of sampled $WARE$ from $ZONE$

page.title: Police Scan Mission
page.t: Anti-Smuggler Operation

Despite our efforts, it seems that we still have a significant problem with smugglers being able to get their wares onto our stations. We are in need of additional eyes, capable of scanning passing ships.
Problematic Dealers

It seems the conditions on our stations are suffering due to the impact of smugglers and their illicit goods. The bosses want us to take a stand and deter any more of these criminals setting up shop on our stations.

Assign a ship to this station to help expand its capability.
Ship
Assign a trade ship to this station to help in the buying of resources and selling of products.
Trade Ship
Assign a mining ship to this station to help in the collection of resources.
Mining Ship
Assign a combat ship to this station to help in its defence.
Combat Ship
Set up a trade ware
To fully utilise your station, $OBJECT$, you can ask it to trade wares as well as store them. You can manage the trade offers this station makes through its manager(translators:see 20208,601).
Manage station trade offers.

page.title: Clear Explosives
page.t: (hint)Use the long range scanner to find objects.
(hint)Destroy them from a distance.
Clear Explosives
Explosives Clearance
We're not sure who or why but mines have been laid in the zone $ZONE$. We need skilled pilots, preferably ones with experience, to fly to the area and take care of the mines.
(Destroy:)Mines
Rigged Asteroids

Earlier today a mining drone was destroyed as the asteroid it was approaching exploded. It seems that some of the asteroids in the sector $SECTOR$ are rigged to blow. We need pilots capable of identifying the rigged asteroids and detonating them from a distance.
(Destroy:)Rigged Asteroids
(hint)Check the contents of asteroids in the area.
Explosive Extraction

A local pirate ship carrying important data on recent pirate activity has been abandoned, and we wish to claim the vessel before the pirates recover it. However, the pirates placed smart mines around the ship before we could get close enough, and we need someone to disarm the mines without destroying the ship.
(Destroy: )mines so that the ship can be salvaged.
Disarmament

Some pirates have laid down tracker mines in the zone $ZONE$. Many organisations have already started losing ships and if someone doesn't deal with the problem soon, it will only get worse. We'll pay for you to disarm these mines.
It's a Trap

Ships travelling by an asteroid field in the sector $SECTOR$ keep being destroyed. We suspect some of the asteroids have been rigged with explosives, and need someone to destroy them or detonate them from a distance before there is more disruption.
Fragile Salvage

We require a pilot to disarm the smart mines placed around a ship we have been attempting to track down for some time. We need the ship in as good a condition as possible, so please be careful to detonate the mines as far away from the vessel as possible.

page.title: Protection Detail
page.t: (hint)Clear the client's path of enemies before transporting a passenger from one station to another
Protection Detail
One of our ambassadors needs protection as he travels to an important good-will meeting. It may not be easy; it may not be quick, but it is vital that he survives.
One of our ambassadors needs protection as she travels to an important good-will meeting. It may not be easy; it may not be quick, but it is vital that she survives.
(patrol:)the space between the ambassador's location and destination.
(talk to:)the ambassador
(transport:)the ambassador to the meeting.
I'm here to take you to the meeting.
any station
Protection Needed

We're looking for someone to transport an ambassador to important trade talks, but are worried about sector security. Before you move him, please sweep the path to the talks. It's vital that he gets there alive.

We're looking for someone to transport an ambassador to important trade talks, but are worried about sector security. Before you move her, please sweep the path to the talks. It's vital that she gets there alive.
I'm here to take you to the talks.
Seeking Protection

A high-level employee of our corporation has managed to make some dangerous enemies and we would like to move him before the situation gets any worse. Please sweep the path to his new location before picking him up. We don't want to take any risks.

A high-level employee of our corporation has managed to make some dangerous enemies and we would like to move her before the situation gets any worse. Please sweep the path to her new location before picking her up. We don't want to take any risks.
I was told to pick you up.

page.title: Drone Hunt
page.t: (hint)Destroy the targeted drones harassing the client's station
Stop Station Attack Preparations
Some drones are scanning our station defences, and we believe someone is preparing for an attack. Destroy these drones; at the very least we can stop them learning more about what we have here.
(destroy:)the drones scanning the station
Halt Economic Espionage
We are being hacked by drones belonging to a rival company. If you destroy them before they can download all of our station data, we will reward you greatly.
(destroy:)the drones hacking the station

page.title: Collect Loot
page.t: (hint)Collect wares from lockboxes and take them back to the client
Lost In Transit

A freighter carrying some... precious cargo was attacked en route to this station. I need that cargo, but I'm... unable to fly right now. Bring whatever you can back to me; I'll pay you for what you bring back.
(Unlock: )the marked lockboxes.
(Deliver: )the collected wares back to the client.
Medical Emergency

A transport carrying desperately-needed medical supplies was attacked and destroyed while travelling to this station. Please retrieve whatever supplies you can and bring them back to us. You'll be well rewarded.
Quick Pickup

A freighter carrying some of my cargo was attacked on its way here. I can't get off the station right now, but I need that cargo before the authorities investigate what happened. I'll pay you to pick it up, no questions asked.
Supply Recovery

A ship carrying medical supplies due to be delivered to this station was destroyed en route. We think some of the cargo may still be salvageable, and we'll pay for the return of as many of those supplies as possible.

page.title: Craft Rare Item
page.t: (hint)Craft the rare item the NPC is looking for and bring it to them
Treasure Hunt

Many years ago, a great scourge was wiped from this galaxy. It is said that hundreds flocked to witness their destruction. But they left behind relics, which I have searched for but have not been able to find. Bring them to me, and you will be greatly rewarded.
(Deliver: )the item back to the client.
Pieces of History

It is said that long before the Argon, even long before the Community of Planets, there existed others who observed and studied us from a distance. I want to prove this theory, but lack proof. If you can find some of the artefacts that, apparently, they left behind, you will be greatly rewarded.
A Healthy Enthusiasm
Perhaps you have heard of our... interest in genuine spaceflies, or specifically their eggs. I would dearly love to have some, and if you can bring me a collection of them, I will reward you greatly.
Rare Engine Parts Required

I found the schematics to a ship engine that is better than any you'll find locally. My problem is that the parts are so rare, I haven't been able to find any of them. If you bring them to me, I will build the engine for you. Looking at the pieces should be enough for me to make them reproducible.
or

page.title: Build Station
page.t: Build station
Supply Reassurance

In these uncertain times we are finding our station operations limited by the loss of supply ships or even the suppliers themselves. We're looking for a partner to construct a station nearby to help reduce our dependence on far-off suppliers.
New Station Required

We're looking to keep ahead of the competition by making sure our freighters don't have to travel too far. For this we need a partner willing to make a long-term investment with a station constructed in this area. The station will be yours, of course. We just need its products closer to home.

page.title: Destroy Matching Objects
page.t: Random Act of Distraction
We have business we need to conclude here, but security is paying too much attention. We need you to distract them while we conduct our affairs; with as much chaos as possible.
Civilian ships
Mass Chaos

We want to move some containers off this station, but there is too much heat from security. A large distraction is needed to give us the time we need to move the cargo; preferably something they won't forget for a while...
Prison Break

My colleague is stuck in a holding cell on this station and I'm trying to get him out. My problem is the security around the station. Distract them while I get my friend out; you'll be well paid for it.

page.title: Deliver Specialist
page.t: Specialist Needed

An internal review has highlighted an opening for a specialist on our station. We're looking for anyone with the required skills. Should you not have those skills yourself we will provide a finder's fee should you aid us in contacting one.
Deliver specialist

page.title: Deliver Ship
page.t: (reward)\053 Ship value
Relinquish control.
I have your ship.
Seeking a Ship
I'm looking for someone to provide me with a certain model of ship. I don't care where it comes from, I just need to have one! I'm willing to cover its cost in full as well as a bonus on top.
Deliver ship

page.title: Cache Sale
page.t: Valuable Cache for Sale

Over the years I've built up a collection of items I don't really have a use for. I have finally decided to get sell them off. It is pretty valuable stuff, so I've set the price at %s. I've left the goods in a secure lockbox out in space. I'll send you directions if you accept the terms.
the area to find the stash
Collection of valuable items
Survive: the ambush
Ship for Sale

I have a small ship that no longer suits my needs, so I have decided to sell it on. If you're interested, it is only %s, and I have left it in an area where it should be safe. Accept the terms and I will send you directions.
the area to find the ship
Ship
Valuables for Sale

Looking for that valuable inventory that just never seems to be there when you need it? I've got a deal for you! I've saved up a load of stuff over the years that I want to get rid off, and I am offering it for the low, low price of %s. You want directions? Accept that offer now, now, now!
Something Just for You!

The people I work for have procured a lot of inventory in recent months and I'm looking to move it for them. If you think you might be interested in what we have to offer, it will cost you a modest %s. Pay that price and we'll send you directions to a secure lockbox containing your purchase.
Ship Going Cheap!

Our group currently has a small ship going cheap, stored in a safe area of space. Because it's second-hand, we're selling it for the low price of %s. If you're interested, contact us. Accept the deal and we'll send you the coordinates to your new ship.
Sale of the Century!

I have generously put down a reward somewhere in the sector for those willing to make the trip out there. If you think you might be interested, just pay %s and I will send details to your ship computer.
the area to find your purchase
A mystery
Valuable Items Going Spare

I've come a cross a lot of pretty valuable items on my travels that I simply do not need. I'll sell them to you for the modest price of %s. Just accept the terms and I'll send you directions - I've left everything in a secure lockbox out in space.
Collection of valuable items
Selling Fairly Priced Ship

I've run into some financial trouble and need to sell my ship. It is in good condition, and I'm selling it for %s. I've left it in a safe area, so if you're interested, accept the terms and I will send you directions.
Ship
Deal Right Here!

If you want a great deal on some really valuable inventory, look no further. I've got a stash of stuff in a lockbox out in safe space. It's priced at %s. All you have to do is transfer the money and I'll send you the location. You won't regret it.
Exactly What You Need!

I'm a collector of valuable items. I am in it for the thrill, so the items themselves are going spare. Think you are interested? Pay a lowly %s and I will send directions to your ship computer. That'll take you to a secure lockbox containing your purchase.
Second-hand Ship on Sale!

Interested in a new small ship for your collection? Fancy an extra set of weapons to help keep you safe in space? We have the ship you need, at the easy price of %s. If you want this deal before it goes, accept this offer and we will send you details on where to find your brand new ship!
Mystery Box for Sale!

But is it a box? Only I know for sure, but I will give you the chance to find out, and who knows what you might find along the way? All you have to do is pay %s and I will send directions to your ship computer.

page.title: Assist Theft
page.t: Hacking Specialist Wanted

If you are seeing this offer then perhaps you have the skills we are looking for. We're looking for a hacking specialist to improve our chances. Should the operation go as planned, we'll end up with quite a valuable haul, with enough profit to go around.

(objective)Fly through( : Anomaly)
(find: )Anomaly in $ZONENAME$
You have earned a bonus payment of $AMOUNT$ credits.
Research Opportunity

I represent an independent science institute and we are currently looking into reports of strange anomalies in nearby sectors which may be naturally occuring wormholes. They may also be caused by malfunctions in nearby Jump Gates or even Jump Drive experiments from a distant system trying to reach us.\nWe require a pilot to find one of these anomalies and analyse it.
This scan data looks incredibly detailed, thank you. We will start analysing it immediately, so that we can begin to understand what these anomalies are.
We have received the scan data. It's not enough to unlock the all the secrets of these anomalies but it's a start. Thank you for taking the risk.
We did get the scan data but some of it seems rather incomplete. While it is unfortunate we understand that it is not an easy job.
Missing Ship Investigation

There has been an increase in ships going missing. While some may have been attacked, a handful of pilots report that they were taken off course by some strange anomalies.\n\nWe need someone to attempt to find and scan one of these anomalies so we can better advise pilots how to avoid them.

page.title: Dynamic Mission Chain
page.t: (Title)Dynamic Mission Chain
(Description)This chain will have a randomly selected set of missions. Each set has a title and briefing description.
(reward)Trade Offer Updates
(Set Specific Texts)Standing Bounties
We have some people we would like to take off our standing bounty list. Prepare for a lot of combat pilot; payment on completion of all bounties.
Bounty Work
Everyone has enemies, and we would like some of ours dealt with. Should you accept, discretion is expected. There can be no link back to us.
Traders' Union Signup
We're currently accepting new members into our Traders' Union. Complete this trading portfolio to join an elite group of clients with a chance to gain a wide variety of perks.
Big Money Opportunity

We would like to give honest traders the opportunity to make big money with us. Taking part will lead to rewards which will aid your own pursuit of riches. Do you want to take it to your competitors? Join up here, today.
Asset Protection
We've found a lot of our assets are coming under fire lately, and are now hiring third parties to help deal with the problem. Details follow.
Bodyguard Required
After some recent unfortunate incidents for this company, we would like to increase our security. You'll be greatly rewarded for helping us out.
A Dangerous Business
We're looking to have more control over the local economy. To do this, there are things we need to know, as well as things which we would like to have disappear for a while.
Stranglehold
One of our competitors is using underhand methods to create a monopoly on the market. We want you to find out more about their assets, then take them out.
(Generic Chain Texts)Hiring Third Parties
While our agents are busy with other matters, we are hiring third parties to take care of some things for us. Details included.
Contract Work Available
This corporation is expanding quickly, and we don't have the workforce to keep up. We are contracting some work out to compensate. The contract details are included.
Freelance Agent Sought

We are looking for an agent with significant experience in a wide variety of areas to help resolve certain issues we are facing. Freelancers who are accepted can look forward to being compensated significantly.

The Albion Skunk
Under the promise of repairs for the Albion Skunk, transport Yisha Tarren to a nearby station.
The Heart of Albion
Fly to a Heart of Albion ship to hand Yisha off.
An Unexpected Lodger
Find something to do after Captain Borman tasked you with distancing Yisha from a Plutarch investigation.
Finding A Crew
Search for a suitable crew to man your freighter.
Battle Scars
After the skirmish you must repair your ship and continue to improve its defence capabilities.
The Trade Run
Yisha suggests helping to supply a Heart of Albion station in the hopes that they will fit the Albion Skunk with mothballed Argon Military weapons.
The Long Goodbye
Rendezvous with Borman to deliver Yisha to safety.
Station Scan
{1012,181}(hint text)
Into the Unknown
Continue to evade pursuing Plutarch forces while exploring this unknown system.
Escort Ship
A ship was encountered when exploring this unknown system. The pilot has requested help to reach their homebase safely.
Old Ties
Make contact with the people living in this system.
Protect Station
A station is under attack by ships which seem to be of the faction known as 'Reivers'.
Reiver Raids
Help defend the Canterans from Reiver forces.
Albion Rendezvous
Attempt to return to Albion in the hopes that you can meet with Borman.
Find Yoolis
The Teladi trader {30302,701} may have information on where Plutarch is impounding captured ships.
Prison Break

Crews of impounded ships and many Heart of Albion supporters are being held on Prison Ships throughout Albion. Prepare for the boarding operation. Find and hire a Marine Officer to lead the operation. You can acquire Marines through a Recruiting Officer(see 20208,2601) on stations. Furthermore, hire a Captain(see 20208,501) so you're prepared for a getaway.
Impound Raid
An operation is in place to recover several ships impounded by Plutarch.
Rebuilding DeVries
Help improve the Canteran infrastructure by providing them with resources from Albion.
Unknown System
After being forced through the gate, keep ahead of pursuing Plutarch forces.
Construction Zone
Take advantage of the lack of competition and build a new station in Canteran space.
Joint Operation
Take part in the first joint operation between the Heart of Albion and the Canterans.
The Beryll
Investigate Plutarch's interest in the Beryll.
Albion Exodus
Help escort ships from the war-torn Albion system to DeVries.
Alliance
With the Heart of Albion and Canteran alliance newly christened, help shore up the defences in DeVries.
The Battle For The Gate
Allied fleets from both sides are ready to strike Plutarch positions around the Jump Gate.
Re-group after the battle and support any stragglers.
Anonymous Enemies
Ward off, or flee from, the unknown attackers.
Omicron Lyrae
Explore the thriving Argon Federation system of Omicron Lyrae.
Gaining Support
Attempt to gain support from the {20203,801}(CHOW) corporation for your stranded allies in DeVries.
Unconventional Tactics
Meet with Argon forces to evaluate the Xenon threat.
Prepare for an incursion into Maelstrom.
Maelstrom
Find the Argon fleet and help support them against the Xenon.
The Split
Attempt to find the base of the Split in Maelstrom to establish relations.
Help {30302,1601}(Kol t'Yo) make contact with Split in Argon space.
The Camouflage Device
Help in the completion of a Camouflage Device which may allow a ship to enter Xenon space in safety.
The Xenon
Use the Camouflage Device to enter Xenon space and sabotage their stations.
Assault
Join the battle to destroy the Xenon stations and lessen their threat in Maelstrom.
{20004,11}(Commerce Core) Disturbance
Investigate the distress call in {20004,11}(Commerce Core).

page.title: Argon Secret Service Missions
page.descr: Missions to unlock the Argon Secret Service Licence
page.t: Mission List
What is this about?
Aid Argon-Canteran talks
Disrupt Heretic Vanguards activity

It seems that all our efforts lately were not in vain after all. There's a marked drop in Heretic Vanguard activity, especially near the Canteran border. These Argon-Canteran talks will go on for a while yet. As long as they don't turn on us if more Terran systems reconnect, that'll suit me fine.
 
I thank you for the help you provided during this phase. We've seen fit to register an Argon Secret Service licence(see:20207,2301) to you. This will make more jobs available to you; usually with more risks involved but with suitably higher compensation.
 
Good luck out there,
$ACTORNAME$
Received: Argon Secret Service licence(see:20207,2301)
Message received. Please check your logbook.
Operation Forge Guard

Restricted Access: With talks between the Argon Government and Canterans entering a new phase, the Heretic Vanguards(see: 20203,2501) have stepped up their anti-Terran rhetoric and want to disrupt any alliance. You have been singled out as someone we can trust to help make these talks go smoothly.
Assassination
(Assassination 1)Lead Heretic Vanguard Takedown

Restricted Access: Intel on the Heretic Vanguard leader Hari Kamon(see: 30302,1801) has placed him on a freighter known to supply weapons to suspected anti-Terran individuals. We have a fair idea of where it plans to go next and we hope to lie in ambush. Should they resist we will use deadly force, which is where you and the other backup will come in.
Assassination
(Assassination 2)Top Agent Defection

Restricted Access: One of our agents, Timofy West(see: 30302,1901) has been under scrutiny for some time now. Now it seems that he has defected to the Heretic Vanguards. He must be tailed and apprehended. However, if he meets up with other Heretic Vanguard members, it's possible he will prefer to fight. Should that happen, he must be taken out.
Defend Station
(Defend Station)Terran Civilans Under Threat

One of our stations, $STATION$, has quite a high population of Terran civilians, stranded in our space from the time of Jump Gate Shutdown. They often find themselves targeted by Heretic Vanguards but a recent threat has us concerned that a heavy attack is on the way. Help keep watch over the station and aid in repelling any attack.
Ambush
(Destroy Ships)Heretic Vanguard Meeting

We've been tipped off about several Heretic Vanguard meetings happening soon. When they meet like this we can't listen in and we're spread thin trying to disrupt each meeting. We simply need to discourage these types of meetings any way we can. Swoop in, strike and get out safely.
(Attack:)Heretic Vanguard Ships
Escort
(Escort Ship)Canteran Freighter Escort

Escort duty is nothing to be scoffed at. It's a good way to build relations, should everything go to plan. We need to make sure that the Canteran freighter remains safe in our space. Some ships will come close just for a look whereas others could be Heretic Vanguard agents looking for a quick kill and destabilisation.
(Escort:)Canteran Freighter
Patrol
(Patrol 1)Patrol Canteran Trade Routes

With relations between us and the Canterans still being in the early stages, we hope to at least allow safe trade between our two systems. It should come as no surprise that the Heretic Vanguards want to discourage this as much as possible. We left them alone while they just seemed to stalk around but some recent skirmishes require us to deal with them with a heavy hand.
(Patrol:)Trade Routes
Patrol
(Patrol 2)Terran Reassurance

Omicron Lyrae has quite a number of Terran ex-patriots from when the Jump Gates shutdown. They have integrated well over the decades but still find themselves feeling alienated, especially when the Heretic Vanguards make their presence heard. We need presence of our own to keep the Heretic Vanguards in check and the Terran civilians feeling safe.
Passenger Transport
(Passenger Transport 1)Terran Tourism

Many Terrans in Omicron Lyrae have expressed wishes to visit the Canteran system, some even in hope of staying. As they are free to do so, all we can do is make sure it goes over smoothly and does not adversely affect talks between the Argon Federation and the Canterans. Transport some of the Terrans to the Canteran system and hope it's an uneventful journey.
{30101,1}(Please come aboard.)
Passenger Transport
(Passenger Transport 2)Canteran Dignitary Transport

Some low-level dignitaries from the Republic of Cantera wish to have Argon transport to Omicron Lyrae. We assume they just want assurances of their safety which they could not get with one of their ships in our space. We need a low-key operation to simply get them here safely.
{30101,1}(Please come aboard.)
Deliver Wares
(Deliver Wares)Defence Restock

Restricted Access: Our talks with the Canterans have entered a new phase where we hope to start stabilising our borders, especially against the Reivers and Heretic Vanguards. We have several shipments of defensive armaments to be delivered to Canteran stations and would like those with freighters to help with the first runs.
Clear Explosives
(Destroy explosives 1)Explosives Clearance
It seems that the Heretic Vanguards have resorted to laying mines in certain areas to hamper movements between Omicron Lyrae and DeVries. We need pilots to fly to the area and take care of the mines.
Clear Explosives
(Destroy explosives 2)Rigged Asteroids

The Canterans have voiced concerns over unidentified ships in their asteroid fields. Ships sent to investigate were damaged as some asteroids exploded. We need pilots capable of identifying the rigged asteroids and detonating them from a distance.

page.title: Diplomatic Aid
page.t: (title)Diplomatic Aid
(description)Help two factions in their diplomatic talks by protecting them from those who would rather the talks fail.
Diplomatic Aid

After some difficulties with another faction in recent times, we have decided it is time to settle our differences diplomatically. If these diplomatic talks were to succeed, it would tip the balance away from other groups, and these groups have targeted the talks in order to further destabilise the situation. This cannot be allowed to occur.

After some difficulties with another faction in recent times, we have decided it is time to settle our differences diplomatically. However, there are those in that group who do not wish for these diplomatic talks to take place, and they are now attempting to further destabilise the situation. We would like you to counteract their efforts while we focus on the diplomacy.
Protect the diplomatic talks between: %1($Client_Faction$) and %2($Other_Faction$)

Part 1\n\nAs a sign of good faith, we believe the following tasks should be completed. These tasks are not of the highest priority, and so their order is unimportant, but completing them all will prove that we are taking these talks very seriously and will go some way to improving our relationship enough for the real work to get started.
(patrol:)parts of the sector, looking out for enemy agents.
(protect:)a station which is vital to local operations.
(transport:)a dignitary to the talks.

Part 2\n\nWe are so far very impressed with your efforts, and the talks are slowly moving towards a resolution. However, those targeting the talks have really stepped up their attempts to disrupt them, and we will need your help to keep them under control while we continue to work on stabilising the situation. Be mindful though; if you fail at this stage, further attempts at this task will have to be made.
Provide protection for one of our dignitaries.
(escort:)our dignitaries safely back to thier base.
(defend:)the station where our talks are to take place.
(transport:)one of our dignitaries safely to the talks.

Part 3\n\nWe are now very close to completing our task, but after you scuppered attempts to disrupt the last round of talks, we fear some may try harder than ever to destroy all of our hard work so far. Nonetheless we intend to enter into the final stages of this mission, and so continue to ask for your help. Of course you should know, pilot; at this stage, failure is not an option.

Part 3\n\nWe are now very close to completing our task, but after you scuppered the insurgency's attempts to disrupt the last round of talks, we fear it may try harder than ever to destroy all of our hard work so far. Nonetheless we intend to enter into the final stages of this mission, and so continue to ask for your help. Of course you should know, pilot; at this stage, failure is not an option.
(escort:)the dignitaries taking part in the talks as they travel.
(defend:)the station while the final talks there are underway.
(transport:)the leading dignitary back from the talks.

%1($Player_Name$),

As you may be aware, I have been leading the diplomatic efforts that you have recently been protecting. I would personally like to thank you for your help during this difficult time - you put your life on the line to make sure these talks succeeded, and I fear they may have fallen apart without your help.

I would also like to thank you for transporting me away after the final round of talks; I found the flight most comfortable.

Sincerely,
%2($Leading_Dignitary$)

We plan to hold diplomatic meetings in the next few hours and have offered to provide transport for our colleagues on the other side. Make sure the dignitary arrives at the talks unscathed.
I am here to transport you to the talks.

Diplomatic Aid - Desperate Times

One of our leading dignitaries is set to meet other diplomats soon, but we believe he has been marked as a target to kill. Before we can move him, you must clear his path. Only then will it be safe to transport him to the talks.

One of our leading dignitaries is set to meet other diplomats soon, but we believe she has been marked as a target to kill. Before we can move her, you must clear her path. Only then will it be safe to transport her to the talks.
The path to the talks is clear.

A group of our dignitaries are in the process of closing talks. We need them to be escorted safely back to their base when the talks are finished.

We believe the station where the latest round of talks is set to take place is under threat from attack. Please ensure the station is not destroyed before the talks take place.

The final talks are underway. Protect the station in which they are taking place, at all costs.

It's safe to return to base.

Now that the talks are over, we believe those targeting the talks will make one last attempt to kill our leading dignitary, %1($Leading_Dignitary$), as he travels back to his base. We are entrusting you with his safety.

Now that the talks are over, we believe those targeting the talks will make one last attempt to kill our leading dignitary, %1($Leading_Dignitary$), as she travels back to her base. We are entrusting you with her safety.

page.title: The Rising Tide
page.t: The Rising Tide

We live in uncertain times; times that are perfect for people like us. The Jump Gate realignment has provided us with an opportunity to spread our influence far beyond the Serpentine Haze, and we intend to take that opportunity.
(Smuggle: )wares into Albion
(Scan: )a station to find its weaknesses
(Sabotage: )that station

There are many in Albion who would pay dearly for some of the wares we provide, but certain... restrictions placed on these wares by the Albion authorities mean we cannot risk moving the merchandise ourselves just yet. Still, reputation is there to be gained, and so we would ask you to make the delivery for us.
(Smuggle: )wares into Albion

You do not survive long in this business if you do not realise that someone else must suffer if you are to succeed. We have identified a station that obstructs our grip on the local economy; we would like you to scan it to find its vulnerabilities, before sabotaging its production. Use whatever methods you see fit.
(Scan: )the chosen station to 100%
(Sabotage: )the station's production modules

We have a problem. A member of this faction has developed...cold feet, as you say, and is going to the authorities with what he knows. If he reaches them, this entire plan goes to waste. The Teladi authorities cannot be allowed to know what we have been doing. Stop him. At all costs.

We have a problem. A member of this faction has developed...cold feet, as you say, and is going to the authorities with what she knows. If she reaches them, this entire plan goes to waste. The Teladi authorities cannot be allowed to know what we have been doing. Stop her. At all costs.
(Kill: )the informant
Return to the Haunt to discuss a reward with the client.

page.title: Another Gate Open
page.t: Another Gate Open
No sooner have we resolved one disaster, another potential problem raises its ugly head. (Do not take space out here)

Another gate has opened in Cold Peaks(translators: see zone name translation). So far nothing has come through it and we have been careful not to let any of our people through from this end. We need someone to take a look. (Do not take space out here)
If you're willing, please go beyond this new gate and map out the space behind it. We will follow your progress and keep an eye on what's what.\nGood luck, Otani.
Map out the space behind the new gate.
Continue to map out the area.

No... I can't believe it. Home of Light. That was one of the core Argon systems before the gate shut down. It was connected directly to Argon Prime! That's amazing! Please continue mapping the area - if we have found this... who knows what else is out here.

Well, I think that's everything, Otani. I wasn't expecting you to appear in Maelstrom, but it genuinely looks like whatever shut the Jump Gates in the first place is really starting to connect them back together again. Who knows where this could lead?\nWe have exciting times ahead of us, Otani. Exciting times.\nThank you for your assistance. Your reward is being transferred to you now.

page.title: X-Perimental
page.t: X-Perimental

Scientist looking for research assistant:
- Must be willing to collect necessary research items
- Must be willing to test possibly dangerous device
- More details on mission acceptance

Thanks for accepting this contract.\nI have been working on this for a long time, and I think it is ready to go. What is it, I hear you ask? An Experimental Jump Drive for small ships, I reply. No, no. Your eyes do not deceive you!\nThe problem is that I am not much of a spacer, and there are parts I am missing. They are listed below.
Great work. I'm not sure I want to know what trouble you went to to get those parts. Bring them back to me and I will start adding them to what I already have.

Okay - as I said I will get started on actually putting the Jump Drive together.\nIn the meantime, I could really do with a testbed engine; a good one, if possible. I don't suppose you have one available, do you? No? Could you grab one for me, please?
That... should work fairly well. If I can get the Drive working with a really rare engine, it should work with the more common ones, right? That makes sense. Fine. Bring it back as soon as you can.

While I am putting it together there is something else you can do for me. The Drive won't need fuel, but some {20201,16001} might help make jumps quicker.\nI hear a lot of it is ending up in... the wrong hands recently, shall we say? You should grab some for the tests.

Okay - I can install the Drive on the Skunk now, then we can test it.\nLet's just hope you don't get stuck in a distant part of space where people are under constant threat of destruction by a terrifying race of machines and you become their only chance of survival, hey? That would be terrible...

Well - I can still contact you, so I guess you haven't jumped out of the Jump Gate network. That is excellent!\nThank you, for all of your help. I do, really, thank you!\nYou can keep the drive I gave you - I've got the blueprints to make my own. With a bit of work, maybe I'll be able to jump to Home of Light and sell it to Terracorp... if they still exist.
